I've never been a huge fan of fig newtons, but these cookies are pretty tasty. They're kind of like Danish butter cookies with a bit of blueberry. They're probably appropriate for someone trying to diet (but are tasty enough for someone who isn't worried about weight) because they don't seem to have that much sugar (8g per serving of 3 cookies (30 grams)) Also, they have some whole grain which you'd think wouldn't taste good in a dessert, but this is good.

As you might imagine this is a dry cookie, not moist (again butter cookie texture) and they are thinner than a typical cookie, but also not that small - about 2 inches across, I think. 3 cookies (which is one serving) is pretty satisfying and a 140 calories isn't extreme.

The packaging has the white plastic flaps on the end that let you sort of reseal the bag, but I've never thought that to be the best system for preserving freshness so I'd probably move the cookies to ziplock bags if you're not going to eat them fairly quickly. Oh, and now that I'm looking at the bag, it says "contains: wheat, soy". So now you know.

I actually really like those Nabisco 100 Calorie Fudge Petites 100 Calorie Packs Fudge Petites, Mint Fudge Chocolate Shortbread, 5-Count Packs (Pack of 6) which obviously are slightly lower calorie and super delicious, but my issue with a lot of these portion control packs is the amount of packaging required seems less than great for the environment. So points for these fruit thins for not having as much packaging although obviously the temptation of eating more is there since the bag that holds all of them is open. (He says, now that he's had a total of six cookies.)

Overall, it's not like triple German Chocolate Cake Supreme, but for a fairly "sensible" dessert with some whole grain and real fruit (oh, and the bag just informed me there is no high fructose corn syrup) I think these are pretty good, and I'll probably get them again.

I really like the Baja Chicken sandwich from Quizno's, so when I saw this Chipotle sauce I thought "I could make my own Baja Chicken sandwiches!" and I got it. Naturally, I never did manage to make that particular sandwich, but I did enjoy the entire bottle of sauce on pulled pork sandwiches. The sauce wasn't spicy at all, which was a little disappointing, but had a nice creamy, smoky flavor.

I liked this sauce, but I would probably try to find a different, spicier, Chipotle sauce before trying this one again. Though if offered this sauce, I wouldn't turn it down. If you like mild, then this is probably a good sauce for you.

Wanting to be a responsible dog owner I wanted to give little Sasha the best I could afford. Being intimidated by the choices (like buying toothpaste in the supermarket) I relied on reviews by others who seemed to have researched this subject more than I. After a period of adjustment and no alternative Sasha finally started to munch out on it. Now she loves it. I think it is the best value, (cost vs quality), and with Sasha's approval I will continue to buy it through Amazon.

I lost 90 lbs and have not had pasta in over 10 years! I found this product on hungry-girl, ordered it and now have had chicken fettucine alfredo and spaghetti and sauce for the first time in years!!

The KEY is in preparation! I was lucky enough to read this on HG's website. You have to rinse it REALLY, REALLY well in strainer. Then pat it dry. Completely dry. Then i add whatever sauce and microwave for less than a minute. Ive had it 2 days in a row and im ordering more now! My first order came within one day! Go noodles!

I have not tried the product yet but I was pleased with the Shipping I had received, we will be using the powder in coffee, Hot teas and cooking, so for now it is tucked into my Food Storage ! I didn't give 5 stars due to not having tried the item yet ! but we will this weekend.

While brewing, it smells yummy. Makes me think of the winter holiday season. The coffee is good, but the french toast is more apparent in  the smell than the taste. It's more of a novelty than a daily coffee for me.

Highly addictive, takes me back to my childhood when candy stores use to sell chocolate covered honeycomb.  Be sure you get the expedited shipping, and the regular route arrived with the cold packs melted and warm.

I was excited to find that I could purchase this here on Amazon. For over a year I've been looking in the grocery stores and was unable to find it. I'm every glad that I found it and the shipping was quick!!!

I was impressed to get all those poptarts for a low price, but some of them seemed to fall apart easily. It had something to do with the delivery. It's a great snak or breakfast item, but you may be better off getting them from stores.
I like the product coz of its convinience & as it comes from agood brand I don't feel guilty using packaged food for my family.

We bought these to put in gift bags at my daughter 5th birthday party. All the kids liked them! We also bought the mini twisted ones too, also loved! These are a great size lolli pops and colors are wonderful! I hope this helps!
Having a cookie that actually tastes like a treat is  ... A REAL TREAT.  Thanks Pamela! I keep them in the freezer and parcel them out very carefully.

I loved how the cookie was nice and soft when I opened the packaging. It seemed to be made of fresher ingredients. I decided to split the cookie in two and let the kids each have one side. I had to split it because the package only had one cookie in it. My daughter devoured it, my son...he saw there were raisin's in it and freaked out. K ended up eating her brother's half as well. I was bugged for days by her for another cookie so she must have loved it since that's how 3yr olds express love for food! (I WANT MORE COOKIE!)
I didn't get a chance to personally try the cookie, but over all it seemed good and from a brand that I like and trust, it also smelled pretty yummy!

I've had sweet potato fries before, and they really are delicious where I had them, so I wanted to give these a shot. From the first bite I'm pretty sure I got a hilarious look of astonishment on my face. It's like nothing I ever tasted before--weird, but quite good, which is about how I felt when I first bit into a properly ripe mango. Definitely the spices are unique when balanced with the sweet potato flavor. I think I tasted some garlic, but I know there's a very faint smidgeon of cayenne, and the cilantro was noticeable as well, but no one flavor or spice overwhelms the others, which is good.

If you like any sort of spiced potato chips, like mesquite barbecue or jalapeno or the buffalo ranch doritos, I'd give these babies a try. They're healthy and you might find a nice occasional alternative to the not-so-healthy stuff. Hey, if it tastes good, why not? One thing these chips prove is that not all "health food" has to taste bland or nasty. Sort of like spelt bread and Newman's ginger cookies, and Izze's luscious pear soda. Terra's spiced sweet potato chips have a surprising flavor and are probably not for everyone, but if you like the spicy kind of regular chips, pick up a bag of these somewhere--they'll probably be just your sort of thing.

Like the Lasagna, this product is relatively thick and has flavor. It needs to be heated well or it will taste like mush. I found the noodles to be a bit mushy, but there was plenty of meat and a tangy sauce.
Quick and Easy and so yummy. Add a few marshmallows on top and you have yourself a wonderful cappuccino...add a little creamer to jazz it up!

I should be embarrassed to admit this but I had to stop ordering this because I ate four bags in one day; this is NOT normal behavior for me. Now I know how crack addicts feel.

I *would* like to recommend 479* because this is the BEST caramel corn EVER, but alas I cannot because of the inherent possibility of winding up a co-conspirator in anyone else's resulting addiction

This tea can be awesome if it is prepared correctly. If left too long to brew it turns and can be so bitter it is almost undrinkable.  So no more than 3 minutes a cup in hot but not boiling water and you will love this tea.

I recently received a Kuerig Coffee Maker  and realized that the coffee cups would be a costly add on to the product. DisposaCups came to the resue. These durable cups can be filled with your own coffee rather than the expensive Kuerig cups. My only issue with these cups is that when I fill them to save for later use, the tops do not stay on snuggly. Hope they work on this.

I can't say that these sheets actually attract fruit flies, but if you put them in stakes in your plant, flies will get trapped on them.  If you want something that is eco-safe, these are a great way to go.  They're not going to kill all your fruit flies, but they'll make the problem more manageable.

I came back to see if these were still available.  I ordered a case in 2008 after finding them down in Texas and falling in love with them.  The packages that I received were expired by a month.  I thought that was kind of crappy, BUT I ate them and gave them away to friends just the same.  They are the most awesome cookie/pastry/cracker, don't know what to call them but they are GOOD!  Not healthy at all, but when you're reaching for some good dessert items, who cares!!  : )
A great dark roast full flavored coffee. Very smooth. Not bitter. A good value if you subscribe.

Pretty good.  Nothing earth shattering though.  Maybe I don't have as keen a taste for coffee as I think I do, but this tastes like a lot of other "gourmet" brands to me.  Which is to say it's yummy, just not anything special.

In years past I had to get in my car, drive to the super Wallmart, drag myself across the parking lot, get a electric cart, fend of the lady's (I always wear my 3 wolf and moon teeshirt), go to the cake mix isle, pick up the box, go pay $1.58 for it then travel all the way home.  NOW thanks to the Interwebs and Amazon I can just click buy now and get cake mix delivered to my house in 5-9 days for the low price of $24.61.  No more wasting valuable time away from my afternoon stories at the store like some looser, now ups delivers my cake mix to my door.  This is A.W.E.S.O.M.E!  Now if only I could find a way to get milk this way, maybe milk from a remote Italian region.

I think this arrived around a week after I had ordered it. When I did, it was on sale and less than $1 per bar.

I expected some of the bars to be broken since the chocolate in itself is crumbly and prone to breakage. The packaging it came in was a bubble wrapped box that had been obviously thrown around, but I don't fault the company Pharmacy Place for that. 1 of the flake's packaging unraveled so when I opened the box, it showered my desk with chocolate specks and bits. I then checked the flake to see if it had actually come from England and was not Arabic (seeing that many people on different flakes had gotten the Arabic version rather than an "authentic" English version), to my surprise, it did not appear to be from any place other than England, though a quick peek at the expiration date explained why it was on sale. It had expired about a month before. Shelf life isn't what it is now, so I don't really worry much about that, instead I did a taste check. The flake itself is a bit older than if you had bought it from a Sainsbury or another in England, but the taste wasn't compromised. It still had that chocolatey and tarty flavor that I had grown to love. Though, the chocolate wasn't as glossy as it should have been had you bought it from England.

So, they get 4 stars. -1 for expired candy, -1 for slightly stale, but +1 for fast shipping.

If you could get this for a bit under $1 per bar, then I would highly recommend it, but if you had to pay nearly $20 for just 12 flakes, I would wait until it's on sale since this isn't the best quality that you can actually get.

But to actually get the addicting flake in the USA rather than in Europe, I would buy this again (and it's a great gift to give to your friends who haven't tried this candy yet!)

I received this espresso maker as a gift. Although I like the look and style of the machine and how easy it is to make a quick espresso what I don't like is that the espresso is never hot. I always have to preheat the cups in the microwave for 30 seconds in order for the coffee to retain its' warmth while I drink it.
Over all a great product but they could use more variety in the bags 90% of one bag was some sort of coffee flavored bean.

I agree with the other reviewer that Amazon's current pricing (as of Feb 2011) is ridiculous, being about double what my local HEB sells the stuff for. Having said that, I gave a 4-star rating because I think the product itself is to be recommended (just don't buy it from Amazon unless they lower their price). Prep time is about 5 minutes, and the resulting pizza crust is quite good.

While some purists may scoff at a pizza crust that's ready to cook just minutes after making the dough, in my experience this stuff is far better than any of the other "instant" alternatives (for instance, stay away from Betty Crocker Pizza Crust Mix unless you want your pizza crust to taste like it was made with bisquick).

Good quality ingredients, a very good value in dry dog food.  I feed my dog high quality kibble like this and I also make about half her food.  Variety in dog food is recommended, dogs can develop allergies to food otherwise.

First, 2 of the cans in the order were dented. Amazon was very good about shipping out a replacement, and one of those cans were dented as well. There was absolutely no damage on the amazon boxes, I can only assume that the damage was pre-shipment. However, with Amazon's great customer service, it just takes a little more effort to get a complete order of undamaged cans.
Second, there is added sugar in the ingredients. If I had known this before ordering, I would not have ordered this brand.
Third, they are absolutely delicious. They beat out the taste of canned flame roasted red peppers hands down. These peppers are small and packed full in the cans. This can contains more peppers than a 24 oz can of normal red peppers (flavor wise, this can may have more flavor than a #10 restaurant can of normal flame roasted red peppers)
Ordering through Amazon, this is less than half the price of buying in the specialty shops, not even including the cost of gas. I thought I would be using them for 1 special occasion dinner but after trying them, I'm sure we will be using them on a regular basis.
I like it because it makes me feel comfortable. I don't feel dry or itchy or anything. BUT I hope it can smell better.
This retro candy box was given to me for my birthday, and  was a lot of fun to look through!  It only received 4 stars instead of 5 because the Double bubble gum pieces were harder than a brick!
It seems to work, not sure if it is my pump working good to keep up my milk supply or the fenugreek but it definitely makes my milk smell sweeter.

I bought this product with two goals in mind. First was a dry cream option that I could keep in my desk at work for coffee and tea. The second goal was to have some dry cream at home that could be used for medium term food storage and emergency substitution purposes. This product works well for both purposes.
For coffee and tea, this product works well as a low-carb, no corn syrup creamer. However, I found I like it best when mixed 1 part cream powder to 1 part dry whole milk powder (similar to what others have said). This does increase the amount of sugar per serving, but it is still significantly lower than anything else I have found. It does take a little stirring to get it to mix well, but this does not distract from the results.
I wonder if the price will drop if this product becomes more popular. Let's hope!

Very few, if any nuts. Product tastes pretty good, and knowing it's sugar and fat free makes the indulgence worth it. Pretty expensive at Amazon.  I've since found in a supermarket (same product) for 75 cents.

Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee is the best flavored coffee I have ever had. 50 pack would save some money per cup except that the last two boxes have had several K-cups where the tops are not sealed.  If you don't notice the problem before you brew then the coffee grounds blow by the normal brew process and you have grounds all over the brewer. I had 8 bad K-cups in the previous order and had seven in this order. Not very good quality control.  But the coffee is the greatest. I haven't found the K-cup defect in other flavors.

I'm a crunchaholic! I have to have something during the day to crunch! All other chips are so high in fat or sodium that it makes it very difficult to be eating healthy and still get my crunch on. PopChips is the answer and the individual bags are a great way to control your calories too! I highly recommend them all, but the salt and pepper are my least favorite!
Not bad but could use a little more buttermilk tang and definitely needs a pinch of salt.  Very versatile, too.

The Amazon label was misleading (8-count (Pack of 4)) in my mind meant 8x4 but this item is just 4 bags.  Still an OK deal but not as amazing as I was expecting.  I like them (wouldn't say I love them), they're too 'spicy' for my kids taste but they aren't into anything with too much zest.

It's not often I drink iced coffee but I found this drink very convenient when I didn't have time to brew hot coffee.  The flavor is a good coffee flavor.  Because it contains sugar I drank it as two servings.  I like that the can is recyclable so no guilt about the container.  I also like the slimmer size of the can compared to other beverage cans.  For me, it's a convenient fit and I'll probably buy some to have on hand.
Great substitute for milk - Even my kids will use it in their cereal. I also use it for cooking and baking. Good brand too.

Smelled wonderful as I was brewing it. Sadly, it smells more blueberry than it really tastes-however! I do have a bit of a cold, so I may not be tasting in it fully. I just added creamer and it was splendid. Would totally order again. Really awesome with fresh scones.

My only complaint about this product is that sometimes it is difficult to squeeze just a very small amount from the bottle into the mixture to be colored.  I don't do massive amounts of baking, and I find that sometimes it is really hard to get a very light color when adding this product to very small quantities of mixture.  However, the colors are very bright and I was very pleased to find that the color is evenly distributed throughout the mixture.  I thought this product was a little pricy, but after trying it out, I do believe that it was worth the extra money.  The product seems of high quality and it shows in my cooking whenever I want to add some color to things.

I really like the taste of this dry milk.I use it since I'm lactose intolerant. However, it's really difficult to mix.

i tried a whisk as per the instructions, but finally had to resort to a blender. Other than this drawback, it's really good.

This good maple syrup, in medium amber, the most popular grade. It's from Vermont, which has slightly more stringent standards about maple syrup density. Thus I was surprised that this Highland Sugarworks syrup was weaker than the L.L. Bean syrup I was about to run out of. But reading the label provides a clue to my disappointment. It's labeled "Pure NEW ENGLAND Maple Syrup", as opposed to "Pure VERMONT Maple Syrup". The reverse of the label says "We also purchase syrup from our friends and neighbors". (The L.L. Bean container says "Packed in Vermont".) So I conclude that this is rated on the (weaker) U.S. scale rather than the Vermont scale.

It's still good syrup; it just seems a bit "watered-down" compared to what I expected.
Right amount of caffeine to wake you up.  Flavor and strength are fine too.  I will buy these again as soon as I run out.

Two jars of Barlean's organic coconut oil arrived on time and in excellent condition with a sale date in 2013.  All seals, external and internal, were intact.  Upon opening, no suspicious odor of any kind was noticed, only a light coconut smell meets the nose.  However, the oil, currently well solid, does not have a uniform appearance.  In places that might be due to proximity to the black jar. In other places, however, swirls of oil seem denser or grayer or perhaps not as gelled.  Any frequent user could tell me whether this is common with this product.  A call to the manufacturer's representative said comment could not be made unless the contents were seen and that I might easily return the jars to Amazon, which I would rather not do if it is able to be used.  Thanks.

Clear Men Scalp Therapy 2 in 1 Anti-Dandruff Shampoo and Conditioner works. The bottle I received to try was a bit damaged from the shipping. What was left of the product I tried was very effective. After using it for a couples of days, the flakes disappeared and my hair looked very good. I'm very pleased with the results and I can't wait to buy a bottle (when mine runs out). So, if you're looking for a very effective anti-dandruff shampoo then look no further than Clear Men Scalp Therapy. Your hair will look good and smell great.

Highly Recommended.
The Starbucks Espresso pods are a great way to make quick lattes.  Unfortunately, it takes more than one pod to make a tall drink.  They are still functional and taste great!

My three dogs do love these but they are a bit pricey for a treat that gets fully consumed in 30 - 45 minutes. I did shop around and the price from this seller seemed to be the best, especially when taking into account shipping costs. This product would have gotten five stars from me were it not for the cost per chew.

I bring these to work all the time.  They taste good and are a healthy snack.  Buyer beware:  it is not uncommon to crunch down on something that feels like a shell, or sometimes even a rock or dirt.  And occasionally there is a very, very slight fishy aftertaste that I'm not sure about.  Perhaps they need to be stored in the fridge.

The candy must be wet to scrape off all the paper that is left behind after the wrapper is removed. Only one in five has the wrapper coming off completely and easily. Too darn much trouble. If you don't get the paper off, the result is candy with bumpy little ridges in it from the paper left behind. Nasty! Buy the bigger "bars" instead. They are wrapped in plastic which comes off easily. The flavor is good. Not exactly like it was fifty years ago but close enough.

Most of my cats really like this Wellness Turkey and Duck flavor food. I wish the sauce was a little thicker like the other varieties. Wellness makes high quality pet foods with great ingredients that are good for our pets.
We love these chips and were thrilled to find them available by the case through amazon.  The only problem with ordering them is that both cases we ordered arrived rather poorly packaged.
A good strong coffee for those who aren't shy about flavor.  Great for morning.  Wakes you up without caffeine. I'd buy it again.

I love the taste of this flavor. One hint - it is a 12g pod which is a bit more than some of the other Baronet pods. With my Keurig, 12g will overflow using a pod holster. I find it best to remove the grinds and use another k-cup devise. A bit of trouble, but the coffee is so good!
Love it. I use it after i shower. It is great for dry feet,  i also put it on my face before i go to bed.

I work in a special needs clinic, and sometimes our babies/toddlers are really picky, have massive food allergies. A lot of the parents are now ONLY feeding kids Organic to make sure there isn't any processed nonsense and pesticides in the food.

Most of the kids have not turned down this baby food, and its so easy to just squeeze a bit out, replace the cap and send it home with the parents if they love it. I have even seen kids carrying it around like a sippy cup and just squeezing away!

It doesnt have to be refrigerated until you open it. And also make sure to check the expiration date because the batch I got was only good till June.

This is a pretty decent horseradish for using straight on your meat or what have you. Not too hot. Horseradish fans will find it a little bland. Mix it with a little mayo (about 2 parts horseradish-1 part mayo) for the more squeamish eaters.

The rice is great and the containers are great too. (The containers make great light-bug lanterns).  The quantity is decent but one would expect more for the price. However, if you are like me- far away from any place that may sell small grain rice (sticky rice, sushi rice) then this is actually a decent price for buying on line (especially with free shipping if you are a prime member). I searched the web over for a good price on this rice and this one ranks up there in lowest price AND best quality (and you get those awesome clear containers that can have a multitude of uses).  If you live where you can buy it locally, it would be a lot cheaper to do that.  The rice is of high quality; the bonus being that is grown and packaged in the U.S. (Alvin, Tx).

If you are looking for the same dressing as Wendy has look for Marzetti Simply dressed & light Raspberry Acai.  It is just as difficult to find, but the ingredients are the same as Wendy's dressing, except they had a little lemon juice.  It tastes the same and is yummy.  They only place I have found it is Mybrands.  Their shipping prices are outragious, but the bottles are pretty reasonable.  Still haven't found it in the store.  Enjoy!

My wife and I LOVE the Ghirardelli Brownie mixes, so when I found this hot chocolate mix, I ordered without batting an eye. Upon receiving the order, I eagerly heated a cup of milk. The first taste was surprising. After five or six cups, I have decided that I like it better than any other brand chocolate mix that I have ever tasted.

Usually, I make a double batch, with works perfectly in our mugs.

That being said I also ordered the hazelnut flavored mix that I actually prefer more.

Just served this large can of wraps to a picnic group. Recommended best at room temperature, these were a quick and unique finger food. Sprinkle with lemon juice and red peppers. The only drawback, they can be very delicate, a pinch mushy. I will definitely serve these again. They thought I slaved over them....big hit.
After a slow start at our meeting of guests embracing these coffee packets, everyone ended up enjoying them.

The lime taste is pretty prevalent, but it blends in well enough that it's not like the pure lime flavor. The overall taste is like a sweety lime with a kick, I throw hotsauce in with my noodles, and this particular flavor did make me sweat a little. As for the shrimp part of this package, I guess it's in there somewhere. XD

I have tried lots of different products over the years when it comes to Betty Crocker. Some were really great and I use them everyday in my kitchen, others were a 'one time flung'.
I bought these intitally because they were made from Yukon Gold Potatoes that are a family favorite to start with. I had my doubts but the the first time I made them they were GREAT! even the picky eaters at my house asked for seconds. My only thing I think that would improve them was in the labeled servings per box. I needed to make BOTH pouches to feed 2 adults, 2 teen boys and one tween girl.
They are a good alternative for quick & easy dinners or for when company is here but no very cost effective for regulars family dinners.

Mrs. May's bar tastes great and I have them before tennis or during a round of golf. Works well for me. The only thing is the size of the bar offered through Amazon is smaller than the size from Costco. Be aware of that!

These are not short on chocolate and peanut butter flavor, and that's the way I like it! If you're looking for a super healthy snack, then move on, but if you want a decadent treat that you don't feel TOO guilty about, then you've found your bar. A soft, chewy and very sweet granola snack that the whole family will enjoy, very similar to Kudos.

It's a great replacement for a chocolate bar with less of all the stuff that's bad for you. I will buy this product for sure, and probably try other flavors.

This bar has a unique taste. It is good chocolate and toasted sesame seeds. I eat it slow because it is dense but it is not too big of a bar-just the right size. It is not as nutritious as the other nut bars but it offers variety to the mix.

I am a tea lover, and have found rooibos, with the bonus of vanilla flavouring, to be a pleasing alternative to other decaffeinated products. Normally, unless one loves weak herb teas, decaffeinated tea has barely any flavour. The richness of rooibos is enjoyable, and the vanilla essence is a lovely combination.

I would caution those who, like myself, prefer strong teas that rooibos is of very light strength. I found I needed to use two sachets per cup, and steep them for ten minutes, for the blend to be satisfying.

I've been using this product for a couple years now--one packet each morning in my coffee. I've never experienced any of the digestive issues or tasted any kind of after taste with it. The packets are convenient and easy to carry with you. My only issue is that in the last three boxes I've ordered, I've had several packets that were empty. I'm guessing something's off with their quality control in the filling process. Hopefully, they get this fixed.

People under the stress of change sometimes wish for reminders of the "good old days". Obviously one is unable to relive the past....but one can come close with food. Milo is one of those foods from my past, that warm rich flavor makes me forget about the bitter cold outside. Hooray for a piece of the past !
I loved the delivery response which was quick and my family and I enjoyed them. It was nice not having to run out to the store.
It is a Christmas gift for my nephew who loves to cook. With the easy back he is able to do more baking than if he used the oven. I love this idea and will buy more in the future.

This is a great-tasting, easy to make, low carb pasta. If it's true that there are only 5 grams net carbs, then this is a dream come true for me. I love a good, home-made pasta dish but I avoid them because of the high carb content. With this pasta, I made a couple of my favorites and enjoyed them without feeling guilty. My only complaint, as with all low carb products, is the high price. That's why I only gave it 4 stars instead of 5. So unfortunately, I can only buy this once in a while. I'm glad I found this though because I know I can have a really good pasta dish every now and then.

I put one decent squirt of my mango peach Mio in a glass of about 6oz of water. The flavor saturation was excellent! It has a nice little tart zing to it, although it's very sweet, sweeter than i really like. I think in the future I will use this in iced tea to help counter act the heavy sweetness. The flavor is good, but it still has that twinge of chemical flavoring. But of course, it IS made from chemicals, so what do i expect, right? Overall it's a good product that is fun and easy to use, and tastes pretty good.
Chickweed is an ok tea as far as taste but if you feel like you are retaining water this tea helps with that.
The teabags are not individually wrapped but come 4 in a wrapper.  Most people won't be bothered, but for those looking for the individually wrapped teabags these are not them.

I don't usually drink/buy instant coffee, but since I got a sample of these I had no reason to not try it. It is very quick, empty the packet in a mug, add 6 ounces of hot water and stir. In a standard coffee mug, 6 ounces is slightly over half a cup so that was a little disappointing. The flavor was not the best but if you are really jonesing for a cup of coffee and don't have a lot of time or don't want to brew a whole pot, it will do the trick.

I got this for $35 for a pack of 24 boxes. Each box contains 2 pouches and each pouch makes two large (2 cup) serving of soup. So basically, if you half the pouches, you are paying for 96 (24 x 2 x 2) servings, which is not a bad deal at all. Compared to the Sun-Bird brand egg drop soup mix, it is a little harder to mix (harder to get the clumps out), and a little less flavorful in my opinion, but you get more than twice for the price (the cheapest I found Sun-Bird is 48 servings for $45). To help with the flavor, I stir in a little soy sauce, and chives. It tastes good.

The instructions on the box are odd. It says to add noodles (I've never heard of adding noodles to egg drop soup), and then continue to simmer it after adding the egg, but you shouldn't need to do any more than just bring it to a boil, stir in the egg, turn off the heat and let it cool. The egg is done enough by then.

My mother used to make this pizza every week when I was a kid.  I LOVED it.  I moved cross-country about 14 years ago and had almost forgotten it existed as you can't find it anywhere in Los Angeles.  Someone from back home mentioned it recently and I went on an internet hunt for it soon after.  I was DELIGHTED to find this seller on Amazon and beg them to keep it in stock!  It's almost exactly as I remember -- crispy and tangy and fantastic!  It does seem like the pizza sauce is thinner, more watery, then I remembered it being, but when it bakes, it's bubbly and rich.  There's never enough cheese, but I always have ground parmesian on hand, so with a few extra sprinkles of that, I think it's about perfect.  So excited to have it again.  If only the shipping charge was a bit better... this would be a meal for a steal.

This afternoon I had a Nongshim Bowl Noodle Soup of the Spicy Chicken variety. It's a quick lunch (four minutes) and quite tasty. My only gripes would be that it's too high in sodium, a complaint shared by almost all noodle bowls, and that it doesn't have enough protein for a good meal. I can easily add the latter. I also had a big Delicious Apple to supply something fresh and something with a lot of fiber. Altogether, the combination made a good lunch, and it was quick and easy.

Gary Peterson

Pretty comparable in my view to Johnny Walker Red label, maybe a little smoother.  Good for the price, but it all boils down to preference.  I've drunk a lot of scotch over the years, some quite good.  You wouldn't be embarassed to share this with a friend.

Firm, sweet and tasty if you cook it right. Firm means not marshy or soggy, a quality you'd like to have in rice. Easy to cook; it doesn't take long. Above all, what I like most about Botan is the pure quality in the taste, almost crystal-like; it must've been grown in good quality water.
Taste-wise, these are pretty decent.  I found that I got tired of the orange flavor that is added.  I remember liking them a bit more when I was younger.

Growing up in Dalmatian region of Croatia I never appreciated this herb ........It was widely available, commonly growing wild, and it was an every day thing.....little did I now - nothing can compare to Dalmatian Sage. Something about Adriatic Sea mist, Dalmatian soil, sun.....sage is strong and aromatic. I use sage tea every day. It is bitter, but healing. For sore gums,dental problems, plugged up sinuses, cuts, abrasions, skin problems, stomach ulcer,...I'm sure there is many more medicinal uses for this sage. Maybe even culinary uses. If you google "Dalmatian Sage" you will get much better view of it. I'm glad somebody is marketing Dalmatian sage for USA consumers, and only reason I'm not giving 5 star on this review is  - shipping and packaging. My excitement of receiving my order turned to anger when I saw huge cardboard (10x12x12) box filled with packing peanuts to ship ONE pound of dry crushed herb safely packed in to mylar bag. What a waste! Shipping was pricey, but whole thing could be mailed in the envelope! What, they were afraid it might get crushed? I will order it again, when my supply gets low, no sage can compare to Dalmatian Sage.
Oil is very pleasant to the palate Fruity with a distint olive taste, which is what I was looking for. Excellent product. Far superior to any Italian EVO I have tried.
I like this type of gum, but Trident's flavor didn't last as long as Orbit White, nor was it as intense. I prefer Orbit White better.

Why make it yourself at this price? Well packaged and it arrived quickly.

I will buy it again when the time comes.

We have had some of this that we received from a friend. When we ran out, we had to search to find it and the only place we could find was Amazon. It is great popcorn salt to use with Wabash Valley Farms popcorn oil.

I buy these for my neices, nephews, and grandsons. I've also been known to scarf one down on occasion. My only complaint is I've never received one of these in at least five or six shipments where the individual packets were broken in less than several hundred pieces. It doesn't effect the taste, but for around three bucks apiece, I mean?  Are the ones that aren't shattered sold separately?
This vanilla is very good but not as good as the previous brand I was using, so I just added a couple of split vanilla beans to it.  For the average baker it would be excellent.

A bit more than twenty years ago I began having a great deal of trouble digesting deep fried foods. I was only in my mid thirties at the time but items such as donuts, french fries and fried chicken were wreaking havoc on my stomach. I listened to what my body was telling me and decided right then and there to give up all deep fried foods. The year was 1988. I am proud to say that I have not had so much as a french fry or a donut ever since. Over the years I found that one of the things I missed most was potato chips. I always enjoyed chips with a sandwich and occasionally as a snack watching television. For quite a few years I simply did without. Then in 1996 Frito-Lay introduced Baked! Lay's Original Potato Crisps. I thought I had died and gone to heaven! One look at the Nutrition Facts on the bag told me it was OK to indulge with this product every now and then. Just compare. A 1-1/8 oz bag of Lay's "Original" Potato Chips contains 230 calories with Calories From Fat amounting to 140. Meanwhile, the same size serving of Baked! Lay's Original Potato Crisps contains only 130 with just 15 of those calories coming from fat. That is quite a difference! The fact of the matter is that these tasty treats have 80% less fat than regular potato chips! How do they do that?

Although I usually don't keep any in the house I allow myself to enjoy Baked! Lay's Original Potato Crisps a couple of times at week when I go out for lunch or a pizza. Being a very plain eater I prefer the original to the flavored varieties which I am told are pretty awesome as well. I find that I enjoy these baked chips every bit as much as the regular chips that I used to eat. In fact, I could never go back to eating greasy potato chips. A great step forward in the history of junk food! Highly recommended!

WoW, who wouldent love this mix for extra creamy and thick milkshakes or add coffee and it a latte or frappe ! I love the milkshakes, add milk and ice and blend to an amazing flavorful milkshake that is just the best ! My son loves it with cold leftover coffee, and ice a touch of milk, and he has cut some of the calories and has a 'guilt free' dessert and loves it soooo much. Family fun for everyone!

We make these all the time and especially when having BBQ ribs or chicken. The rich cheesy taste of the potatoes works well with the hearty BBQ sauce. My daughter and I also like them cold right out of the refrigerator! I like how they provide instructions for making two packages at a time, which we usually do, and they also give times for different cooking temperatures in case you have something else in the oven that needs a lower temperature.

I use this as a Ghee ( melted butter) server.
The glass bowl is removable and its thick (like pyrex)
The spoon is very small , just about right to serve little quantity of anything.

I did enjoy this just add water & mix fruit tea. Because of the tea granules it does take some mixing which is not a problem. I was surprised that the drink could have a strawberry flavor that was sweet but not too fake tasting also I was wondering about the strange aftertaste that was reminiscent of a diet drink.

The drink touts itself on being sweetened with HONEY and other natural juices yet maintains its paltry 5 calories without the aid of aspartame - so it is healthy right? Well that super sweetness is in thanks to SUCRALOSE an artificial sweetener that just happens to be 600 times as sweet as table sugar and 3 times sweeter than aspartame.

Wow.

So the drink is an official diet drink if NOT 100% natural.

This is the easiest way to enjoy green tea with lemon flavor. The taste is great and has all the benefits of green tea without the hassle.

The price is however too much on Amazon and that is why its getting four stars. My local Wal-Mart has these 10-packs for $2.50 each which is a LOT cheaper then Amazon.

I've seen mixed reviews on truffle salts.  Some people love 'em.  Some people hate 'em.  I will say that, when cooking with this salt, there is a definite "flavor"... and it's good.  But the smell... oh man, the smell.  When you open this jar, anyone in a fifty foot radius will know it.  The jar holds it in well, and we don't have a problem with the smell leaking out into anything else in the vicinity... and maybe it's just us... but it's so potent.  It smells awful.  I don't know how something that smells so bad can taste so good.  It's a cheap enough luxury item that it's worth a shot.  If you can't stand it, someone is bound to take it off your hands.
Taylor's of Harrogate Irish Tea is very good, great flavor.  My only complaint and surprise is the individual packaging.  They come as a loose bag and not individually packaged, easy to rip the bag.

****
Tazo's Zen Green Tea with Lemongrass & Spearmint has a subtle, mild, light green tea taste, not bitter at all. I don't taste any of the additional flavors Tazo puts into this tea; maybe my palate isn't developed to this point. However, it still is one of their better teas, and has less of an artificial taste than the others I've tried. Maybe the flavorings are just too mild in this tea, but when it comes to flavorings, I prefer them this way; I like a natural, real taste with real ingredients sans vague "natural flavors" and sans flavorings, sans essences, etc. It is not a strong green tea, so it would definitely appeal to people who enjoy herbal infusions and milder teas.

The ingredients in Zen are: green teas, lemon verbena, spearmint, lemongrass, and natural flavors. Zen contains caffeine.

Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.

On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "an enlightening blend of the finest green teas and rare herbs available in this world." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Zen as "smooth, lemony, earthy, refreshing". Tazo describes the aroma as "lemon, mint". The web site also says, "Select pan-fired green tea from Zhejiang province in China, artfully combined with lemongrass, spearmint and a hint of lemon essence. Zen's distinct green tea flavor accented with lemon and mint is impossible to express in words. Best simply to experience its sweet, lingering aftertaste." I don't taste the lemon or the mint or the sweetness; still, it is a nice green tea. It is relaxing and enjoyable to drink.

I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings.

Recommended.
****

I got pounds of this to make Lego lemon cake (because it has sour flavor and my son loves lemon cake) and for the goody bags. It was a big hit. I wish the colors were bright and prime color. But other than that, it taste really good and kids had so much fun building with it also. I used spray food coloring to make it primary colors for the cake.

Aptamil formula is a fantistic food for my 3-months old baby. When I came to USA 2 month ago, I couldn't find this formula in any supermarket in the USA. So, I fed my baby an enfamil and a similac. My baby began to have green stool (before feeding enfamil or similac, he ate aptamil and pooed in 'yellow' collar and it is a signal of good health). I ordered 12 Aptails and my baby is now defecating in yellow color again and I'm so happy with that.

The only reason that I gave 4 stars to this product is because of it's bad shipping.
It was delivered wrapped with only a layer of low qulity aircap and it was no wonder the formula can got torn and the powder was escaped in air transport which treat shipments carelessly.

I like these more than I thought I would. They're sort of the inverse of a chocolate bar with almonds: instead of a lot of chocolate and few almonds, you get a lot of almonds and a little chocolate flavor. My personal preference tends toward high-cacao percentage chocolates, so the minimal sweetness here was not a problem for me. Also, and unlike conventional chocolate-covered nuts, these will not turn into a lumpy, gooey, mess if you leave them in the car this time of year.
This chocolate is wonderful! I prefer the Belagio Sipping Chocolate, but for people who aren't as keen on dark, rich chocolate, this mix is great!

Due to the oil spill, we were unable to locate fresh oysters locally.  The oysters were a good value.  They arrived in a very timley manner.  When they say bulk, raw oysters....they mean it!  Although I feel they could have been picked a little better.  It appeared as if they just shoveled them out of the sand and shipped them.  They were definately worth it though.  A few were dead, but that is expected.  The live ones were delicious! and recieved extra, I'm sure to account for the ones to die in transit.  Will definately order again.

We use this in our espresso maker and it makes a good latte, but I thought I'd be blown away by the "crema" part of the taste. Just tastes like a normal homemade espresso - nothing different than when we make it with Starbucks or whatnot. That said, great price if you do the Subscribe and Save....

"Lemon Lift" is a refreshing and slightly spicy tea that is much enhanced if you add about a tablespoon of lemon juice to each mug of tea. I use two teabags to get a good flavor. The ingredients in this tea include black tea, natural lemon flavor and spices. It is a refreshing tea that can perk you up a bit late in the afternoon. I'm looking forward to trying this as iced tea in the summer.

~The Rebecca Review

Like other reviewers on here, I was looking for beef jerky under $20/lb. I was also quite impressed by this product's claim that it lacks MSG, artificial flavorings, nitrates, and preservatives. I decided to give the sweet n' spicy variety a go, and I was quite impressed despite the lackluster reviews. The texture, I must admit, lacked consistency; some bites were tougher than others. Overall, however, the flavor tasted great and the quality of the beef was apparent. If you're looking for inexpensive, natural beef jerky, you can stop your hunt right here.

I like the Organic Mother's Milk tea very much.  It has helped increase my milk supply which is typically low.  The flavor is just fine if you like herbs.  I add a little splenda to mine to sweeten it up.  If you drink the recommended maximum of five cups per day it also has the added benefit of increasing your intake of liquids which is important when nursing.  I have also noticed that the smell of the tea does not come out through my pores much like the fenugreek supplement did which I have taken in the past.The only problem I have with it is that is quite expensive if you decide to drink it during your entire nursing experience.  Thus, that is the reason for 4 stars.  However, I would highly recommend it.

It has a smooth clean taste to it. I can drink a lot more of this water with out that bloated feeling I normally get from other water.  I've read about the benefits but I can't honestly say I feel any of them. I only tried one case.

With this product there are no surprises.  These are the exact "sparkles" (they look almost like tiny, tiny squares of pink plastic that you might wrap an Easter basket in, only about 1/4 of the thickness) you see in Michael's or other craft stores.  They're cute, eatable and I think worth the price.

I prefer these smaller bags of chips for several reasons. One. I like a little variety; Regular Lay's today, Doritos tomorrow and Cheetos later. Another great thing is that each bag stays fresh because they are still sealed till you open each one. A big bag (which is only half filled most of the time) may go bad before you finish it.

These are also good to keep you from eating too much, when you finish the little bag, you are done. My one complaint is the BBQ/ Sour Cream chips. You don't know which of these you will get till you open the box. I love BBQ, I despise Sour Cream, but I was lucky and got my BBQ on this order, the next I may not.

[...]
Good price and good product, have trouble finding the bites in my supermarket. Have subscribed to receive at my door every few months.

These olives were pretty good, but not as delicious as I had hoped they would be. I lived in Spain for many years and really love olives. I enjoyed them enough to order them again, which I'm going to do in a few minutes. And this seller is a real pleasure to purchase from.

i like this oolong tea.  not much of mango flavor though, and nothing listed in ingredients said mango.  40 calories and 10g of carbs.  not bad at all.  i'd drink it again and try out more of ito en products.
This wheat-free bread mix is better than I expected.  The bread is moist and tasty, and it makes a passable pie crust (without the yeast).

I finally decided to give the Wild Hare Beef Jerky a try since it kept popping up on my Add On options whenever I ordered my K-Cups. My family loves jerky and so I thought it would be a good idea to try something besides the grocery store favorites for a change.

Size: The 3 oz package came with 10 jerky pieces (not strips) and its apparently a Grand Champion Recipe winner from Wisconsin, so I figured we were in for a treat!

Texture: This is a thinly-sliced jerky, robust and chewy, gives your teeth something to work on

Flavor: Peppery! I love pepper so this was a nice surprise over the saltier versions we have tried in the past. There is a slight smoky flavor to it, but doesn't overwhelm the beefiness

Price: I bought the 3 oz for $7.00 which seems like a good value and the smaller size gave me the opportunity to try the teriyaki and hot cajun.

I will definitely order this again and might try the beef sticks, too.

This is pretty hot stuff, so a little goes a long way. However, it is great as a base when added with other, milder sauces or salsa. It works with any Mexican recipe and Herdez is a very reputable brand.

A good value and a staple to keep on hand.

These taste very similar to the real thing to me. The only difference is the crunch.. you can't hear a thing while eating them except for the crunch, crunch, crunching going on in your mouth. LOL The price on Amazon seems high, but they were $3.99 a bag in our cheapest local store, just 8 bags at the $3.99 would equal amazons price for 20. Great deal!

I'm training for a half marathon and I've just discovered these bars as a source of natural fuel for before my workouts. I had half a bar before my run tonight and half a bar after and it felt light on my stomach and I had steady energy throughout.

So many energy bars out there are full of junk (and things I'm allergic to) and this is natural, portable and is nicely sweet - like the fruit that it is. Very minimal ingredients - fruit and chia seeds. A GREAT option for anyone trying to keep with whole foods. I also love the chia in it - the crunch is nice and I feel good eating chia, so it's a bonus for me.

Drink a little water with anything with chia in it as they absorb water. A great product - I will be taking a whole bunch of these with me for the marathon and to have handy for training! Seems like a healthy option for kids, too - softer than a fruit leather and not too sweet. Grateful to be finding more healthy products out there like this.

The jams and jellies were very good. It's nice to take to picnics, the beach, and lunch! You don't have to pre-make the sandwiches so the bread doesn't get all soggy by the time you eat it.

I only gave it 4 stars because there is only 40 of the yummy strawberry jams and 80 of the grape and mixed fruits. They are also pretty small, so to make a peanut-butter-jelly-sandwich, you need 3-4 of the jellies to make it nice and gooey!

But overall, very tasty!

I've been a religious buyer and maker of dark coffee for 20 + years now and I have to say, this is terrific coffee. It almost tastes like cold press because of the very faint trace of acidity. If you like bold, use the same amount of beans you would for Starbucks French or a dark Tully's roast.

The flavor is more like red Popsicles than Hawaiian punch, but still really yummy! There is a bit of an after taste that I don't care for. The bottle is pretty large - you get a lot more with this than you do with one of those little things of Mio which is nice for monetary reasons but also convenience reasons. I didn't really notice a boost in energy, but I usually don't with these things. My one bad note is that I wouldn't have this shipped to you unless you're going to use the speed shipping. When I got mine, because of the lengthy journey in the heat - I opened it and there was a mini explosion, the red in it stains the skin for awhile. I would just drive down to the store and buy it.

I totally loved the contents. However, it looked nothing like the picture. The contents were very yummy and were a hit amoung my husband and I and our friend. We all enjoyed it very much. I would order it again if I could. Nothing was stale, it was all very nice and fresh and I loved my godiva chocolate. I am a Godiva hound so it really pleased me that there was some in there. I get what people say about the "fluff" but to be honest, there really wasn't that much "fluff" in the thing. It was pretty much full of everything that it said. Minus the wafer and a few other things. But those were replaced by really good stuff. So all in all we were very happy with this as a gift.

Thank you!

Chocolate is by definition a Good Thing, dark chocolate doubly so. And organic, Rainforest Alliance Certified dark chocolate? Very nice. It has a good flavor. At 54% cocoa, it's not nearly as dark as some of the other bars on the market, and so is rather smooth on the tongue (I will dispute that it's waxy as one reviewer reported.) It's true that it's not silky the way really fine chocolate is, but it doesn't purport to be. It's the sort of chocolate you could find at your local supermarket. High end there, but nowhere near the price or quality of a bar of Vosges organic dark chocolate. Nor should it be compared to something like Vosges or even Godiva. It's a good, affordable organic chocolate bar that has some good credentials in the environmental department.

The bar is smallish, but I also debate the assertion that it's too small to share with a friend. There are six good-size squares in this package, which are more than enough for two assuming that no one is being a glutton. (That said, I admit I ate the whole bar myself today, but if there'd been anyone else here I'd have shared.) Yeah, more is better when it comes to chocolate, but it's by no means necessary.

Enjoy this chocolate bar for what it is.

I like to make hot cocoa from scratch using Hershey's cocoa, milk and 2 tablespoons of sugar (sometimes with a pinch of salt and vanilla). But I was falling asleep about 15 to 20 minutes after drinking the cocoa, regardless of how much sleep I had the night before.  I had this problem years ago when I used to eat cereal for breakfast, switched to eggs or other non sugary breakfasts. I'm not a diabetic, but sugar sometimes makes me sleepy. As an experiment I bought this Agave Nectar and used it to sweeten my hot cocoa every night for the past week or so. I have not fallen asleep once. So, based on my results, it would seem that this is indeed low glycemic and does not trigger an insulin surge. I'll use it to sweeten Oatmeal from now on. I also used it to sweeten a Latte today and it was great. In the past I've used a small amount mixed with an once of filtered water, 100% Agave Tequila, and fresh squeezed Lime Juice to make an excellent Margarita (without Triple Sec, which is garbage).

Personally I like the Special K red berries better, but this is decent as well. The serving is smaller (only 3/4 of a cup instead of 1 cup), add some skim milk and a serving of fruit and it makes for a great start to the day.

strawberry twist has a long-lasting pleasant flavor SWEET-but, not excessively so. delivery is timely and price is just right. Supieror to other TRIDENT flavors! Though, SPEARMINT isn't bad either. My next pick would be blueberry
We like these Sugar Free Licorice candies. They are small and strong with good licroice flavor. Small box fits in your pocket or purse easily.

I purchased the 2.5 bags for my  new Whirley Pop pan. I like the idea of the oil on one side and the popcorn on the other, very much like I remember the old TV Time popcorn from when I was a kid. I popped up the first bag, but I found there was way too much salt for me. The next batch, I clipped a small corner of the popcorn side off and removed most of the salt. Now, the popcorn is just the way I like it and I added just a bit of butter. Try it first and then see if the salt/seasoning is too much for you - it was very easy to remove. I found that the 2.5 size was perfect for one, maybe two people, but truthfully, I can eat all of it by myself while watching a movie.
the product is moist,tasty and high quality, however it is packed in sunflower not olive oil, I would recommend it the lemon nicely balances the sardines and is actually lemon not citric acid.

I am not a big tea drinker (I like coffee more) so I am trying to find teas that I can like.  I tend to like dark teas more than herbals.  This tea was interesting to me because it wasn't just a straight green tea but a blend.  I also am a milk adder so you need to know that.  I found that you can add milk to this tea and it seems to still have a very pleasant flavor.  IT might be a little too flowery for me or earthy or whatever that puerh flavor was but I enjoyed the expiernce and it was a very pleasant tea.

I was looking for the old Celestial Seasonings raspberry green tea. This is probably what they make now instead. It's a blend of green and white tea. It's very good, and tastes much like the old tea, but it is NOT exactly what I thought I was buying. The white tea upsets my husband's stomach, so he can't drink it.

Still, it does taste very good, so I wouldn't discount it. Just be aware.
This bouillon is both delicious and too salty.  I love it and use it sparingly.

There is a lot to like about this drink. The flavor is rich but not too sweet. The size of the bottle is larger than its competitors The drink is touted as an energy drink and has 40mg of caffeine, about the same as an 8 oz can of Coke. The issue with this is that people tend to squirt different amounts in their water so the serving size as well as the caffeine intake is subject to this.

The other issue I have with all of these drinks is that you must use the bottle up in a month once it is opened. This drink, unlike Mio, must be refrigerated after opening so you cannot carry it around with you. It is also too large to carry around in a normal sized purse.

The drink also claims it has 120 mg of vitamin C in every portion. The daily recommended intake is 70 mg so drinking this should fill one's quota-I would hope.

All in all there is a lot to like about this drink and very little to dislike.

This was very easy to use. I do not eat fondant so I can not comment on the taste but it is just as easy to use as the wilton products and the color was great and did not run all over. I would reccomment this product

This little carbonated juice product is pretty tasty. "The Switch" is 100% fruit juice combined with filtered sparkling water. The 8.3 oz can contains 100% of daily vitamin C and 140 calories (along with 36 g of total carbs).

The watermelon strawberry can be identified as such to the taste, but it's also pretty clear the can contains some apple juice as well. A look at the label confirms this and also indicates grape and acerola (whatever that is). The carbonation isn't overpowering and The Switch tastes more like juice than a carbonated soda. The only complaint is the sweetness--the natural fruit juices do provide quite a sugary punch. Overall, pretty tasty, but very sweet. As an added bonus, there are no added colors and it's gluten free.

The noodles were great--both kids liked them!--and I was very happy with the price until I realized that I was going through this pasta twice as fast as the organic wheat, at twice the price.  So if you don't mind paying a lot more for quinoa, it's a great product.  Check the weight of the box and judge for yourself.
This bean salad does not  have the typical flavor of 3-bean salad, but it works good for using in minestrone soup!
My mother bought Eight O'clock Coffee when I was a child.  I bought some just to see how it tasted and I was hooked.  It's good coffee at a fair price.
Very good coffee.  Flavorful, mellow, and earthy.  Well packaged and a bargain.  I grind and brew it each morning using a Zojirushi coffee maker.

Good but Folgers version is significantly better tastewise and so far amazon doesn't carry it. Good price though, and I like the free shipping--which I'm not certain will last. Having a huge supply of these on hand makes it's hard to make coffee any other way though!! This is just sooo easy!

If you like tangerine and you think you need carbonation, then I think you'll like this product. No sugar that I could taste to cut through the sourness of tangerine though there was a hint of the orange that helped take the edge off. Of course if you really like tangerine, I mean you REALLY LIKE it, then you will get more than enough of it in this drink.

We do need to be wary though of claims that natural equal healthy. Is no sugar added really healthier? What about the carbonate process that adds the fizzle and bubbles, what are those health affects if any? Much like claims of organic we need to remember that not everything in nature is good for every person. There is still a nice chunk of calories here, far more than water. If you are allergic to citrus you shouldn't drink this even though you might drink things like Sunkisk.

Did it taste good, oh yeah, it did to me because I like tangerine and orange. But it did also have a slightly sour after taste that was annoying, easily solved with water. Since I don't normally drink carbonated beverages though I felt a bit off after drinking this as well.

This isn't just juice and you shouldn't make this a substitute for juice or fruit. I don't doubt that it is slightly better for you thank other carbonated beverages though I think it would be better if they could cut some calories out as well.

It has sugar added so this is more of a dessert tasting peanut butter. I like it on occasions, but this is not my go-to peanut butter of choice. At times, the texture seems grainy and not truly smooth.

So this tastes pretty good, and it has a great mouth-feel. When you bite into it, you get a bit of a crispy crunch and then a tasty burst of chocolate! Those are very good things.

On the other hand...this is clearly not health food. If I had kids, I wouldn't let them within a thousand feet of this stuff. When I was younger, my mom had a guideline for me and my sister where we couldn't buy any cereal where sugar was the first or second ingredient. In this case it's the second, the way my teeth tingled after made me feel like it was the first.

That said, this was indeed very tasty. I think I'll have another bowl, then break out the toothbrush.

I appreciate that someone took the time to make a healthy lunch that is easy to take with you...no fridge needed! I enjoyed the food in my box when I really didn't have faith that it would be good. Brilliant !

These bowls are a very nice option for a small lunch or large snack - they're quick and have a nice flavor, even on their own. They're also great for practicing one's dexterity with chopsticks (part of the reason I bought them).

The other reason I bought these bowls was to try furikake (Japanese rice seasoning). The rice maybe has a bit too much of its own flavor; the addition of the furikake made it too sweet. I even made sure I added the correct amount of seasoning.

For most people, these bowls will prove quite nice and convenient. But if you want to try furikake with them, don't - just order some takeout instead.
I used to sprinkle this on my popcorn!  Tasty, just a little too strong in the 'herb department.'  I would recommend!

These are pretty tasty, but extremely salty - like cheesy salt concentrate. Certainly keeps you from eating too many, but probably not my first choice to grab as a snack. That being said, very convenient form factor, and great in case of emergency hunger pains. Just make sure to have something to drink handy.

I love these for stashing in my desk drawer for a quick lunch at work and keeping in the pantry for when I don't have nearly an hour to cook brown rice at home. The flavor's not bad by itself, but remember this is plain brown rice. Add a bit of leftover chicken, veggies or a dash of sauce to round things out.

Well if your a health nut like me you will love these minus of course all the calories and sugar.  IF your picky then this probably won't be for you.  I drink regular Crystal Light on a regular basis so I am use to it and love the taste. I shared the drink with some of my friends and the health folks like it but sugar addicts did not like the aftertaste.  Hopefully if you know your personal taste that alone should be able to help you.  They need a bit of work to get that authentic mojito taste without all that sugar, but in the meantime,  for me its a winner!

I highly recommend this product.  I had been buying it at Walmart for the last two or three years until they quit selling it.  Thank goodness I found it on Amazon, and at an even better price than I was paying at Walmart!  Thanks to Amazon I now have a standing order for this great tasting coffee flavoring!  Not only does it taste great, it has zero calories!

The pasta was actually better than I expected, even though it was a bit too spicy for my tastes. I ate a few saltine crackers with it to help "tone down" the spiciness. The directions were spot on as far as the cooking time.

For those who are concerned about the packaging, I've started washing and reusing my containers. You can add your own pasta (I used a little less than 1/2 cup), cook it just like the original instructions say, then add some spaghetti sauce. Viola! ;-) I'm still experimenting, but so far I'd recommend a small-sized, thin pasta so it'll cook faster. Regular elbow macaroni takes longer than 3-1/2 minutes to cook. ;-)

But anyway, I'll give the dinner 4 stars, and would bump it to 5 stars if they'd tone down the spices just a bit.
This water was crisp, clear and refreshing, I think it may have hydrated me better.  Nice sturdy bottle and a very generous size.  Definitely worth a try !

I love this drink, I truly do.  It is the first pick-me-up drink I have found that works for me.  I react strongly to large amounts of caffeine (it makes me incredibly hyper) and I never developed a taste for coffee, so my choices for something to keep my brain running when I'm worn out are limited.  Add to that the fact that I'm not a big soda drinker and the choices are even fewer.  Neuro Sonic is a great blend for me.  There's some caffeine in it, but not as much as other products, so it makes me a bit quicker on the draw without making me babble like an idiot like I do when I have too much caffeine.  It's carbonated, which I don't care for, but *lightly* carbonated, so it's not unbearable for me.  The flavor is pleasant and light, not at all overpowering.  The packaging is unusual, so it stands out in the refrigerator at work and I never have to wonder which drink is mine.  The one major con to this product is the price.  As the other reviewers have stated, it is very expensive.  I would probably drink one of these a day if it weren't so expensive.  As it is priced currently, I don't even drink one a week.  I save them for when I really, really need a boost.  So, yes, as another reviewer said, this company could really learn something about the merits of selling product based on quantity.  I would be happy to purchase it more often, if the price were to come down to something more reasonable.  That said, I do still buy it and I do still believe in the product.  The price just dictates that I consider it an indulgence instead of a necessity.
Good flavor.  Clumps more than other kinds i've bought.  Not really an issue for baking, but I get little bits of cocoa lumped in my protein shakes...

Be careful when ordering this item, I expected for every type of tea pictured to come in the pack, however what comes is based on availability and there were two kinds replaced with more of others. I still received the correct number of teas, I just should have read the description more carefully.

Tree was packaged securely, but bird was broken off and there are a bit of brown needles. That being said I don't truly expect a living plant to be shipped with no damage what so ever. All in all I am happy with the product. I just hope I can keep it alive.

UPDATE: I will admit, I have been keeping my eyes open for this at the grocery stores and have not found it yet. I think back and admit I love the pulp! If this was a larger bottle and cheaper, I would keep some in my house! Thus, I've given it another star ;)

This is my first aloe drink. To me there are two distinct aspects to this particular drink. First, most notably the pulp. There is lots of pulp. I had some with every sip, but it was never too much pulp. It made it a fun drink for me! Also, I totally disagree with another reviewer, the pulp is not slimy. I guess that if you consider lemon pulp or orange (fresh) to be slimy, then you might not love this. I yhought that the pulp texture was nice. Secondly, the flavor itself. That was three stars to me. Not great, not bad, but not fresh or juicy..just a prefab juice flavor. Lastly, this is not a big drink, not enough to enjoy for long. Overall, three stars based on flavor and price value to me.

I am pleased with the price and the value for these teabags. The order transaction was simple.
I was a bit surprised that the 200 teabag packages were loose (not in a plastic bag or other package), but other than that I have no complaints.

i bought these on a warehouse deal and loved them.  the salty sweet taste was addictive.  Of course, that is dangerous because the are more like candy than nuts.  The sugar content is pretty high and compared to regular natural almonds these are higher in calories.  As long as you can eat these in moderation as a treat they are awesome.

Ever had Bigelow's peppermint tea? The flavor really beats you over the head. That's why we tend to stay away from such teas in my household (the reason I would drink them is because they were decaf...I'm rather sensitive to caffeine).

Yogi's mint tea does not beat you over the head. It doesn't pound your tongue with mint flavor. It's like a gentle massage, giving you the slightest hint/trace of mint.

The only problem: it has caffeine. Oh well, can't win them all. Recommended.

I've had the Brezza for about 4 months and have blended many fruits, vegetables, and meats with it. It steams and blends well. It is quite convenient to simply put the contents in the bowl and set the machine to do the rest. I really like that it has a button that will steam and blend as well as a separate setting to manually blend and to steam. It also comes with a recipe booklet with a list of how long to steam common items, which is very helpful. Luckily I have not experienced the issues some of the 1 star comments have discussed. If I do I will definitely submit an update.

Keep in mind that this is a novelty item more than anything since using a steamer and a blender/processor will do the job just as well, although having to only deal with one dish is better than handling two. At least those are common kitchen items that anyone will get more mileage out of for other reasons besides making baby food. Have that in mind when considering whether or not you want to buy the Brezza.

My main complaint is that it is EXTREMELY hard to remove the blade, which makes it difficult to get the food out from the bottom of the bowl. The only way to remove the blade is when the bowl is on the unit. It took me a while to figure out that the blade needs to be turned and pulled at the same time while the bowl is still on the unit. It doesn't matter if you turn it clockwise or counter clockwise, just pull/turn and hope it comes out. This is very hard to do especially when the blade is not clean because I can't get a good grip to pull it out. I now use a paper towel to get a better grip. The top piece of the blade shaft ALWAYS ends up coming apart from the rest of the blade when pulling, which is very annoying.

Overall the Brezza gets the job done by consolidating two common household kitchen items into one, which makes the baby food making process much more convenient, but it definitely has its kinks that need to be ironed out.

We are daily home brewers and love full flavors like French Roast. After bouncing around from various retailer chain-branded coffees (which were inconsistent in my opinion), and occasionally trying the stronger roasts of more maintstream coffee brands, we decided to try Eight O'Clock. I think I heard it was highly regarded by Consumer Reports. Aside from the convenience and value of buying in bulk here, we are loving the taste - smooth, rich and no bitterness. Great product.

I got this to give to our cat as an occasional treat. Like many of the reviewers here my cat now acts like an addict. I don't know what they put in this stuff, but she wants it all day and all night. It's gotten so she has started pestering me non stop. I'm glad I found a treat she likes, but it's a nightmare if we run out. I just came on here to order another box. I'm not sure if I want to keep dealing with this. I might have to consider kitty cat rehab.

The Knorr/Lipton Cajun Sides Red Beans and Rice is a yummy dish I could eat it a few times a week... BUT I can eat Rice a Roni Red Beans & Rice, 5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)EVERYDAY Y'ALL!!! Knorr's/Lipton version is milder in flavor cooks faster and can handle an array of customizations like kielbasa, green peppers or sauteed ground beef/turkey and onions while the Rice a Roni version is closest to the homemade flavors in my in-laws recipe and the add-ins need to settle into the original powerful flavors rather than try to enhance them UNLESS it's Tabasco Sauce (Cajun Ketchup).

Greenies Treats for Dogs Monster Treat-Pak 50 Petite, 30 OunceMy little Jack Russell loves Greenies! The new and improved Greenies are much softer than the earlier variety and I give them to my terrier as a special treat. She loves them more than any other treats. I like that they don't stain or leave any residue and they don't smell like some other dog treats. My other dog is indifferent to them so you might want to try the smaller package to see if you dog likes them or not.

The vanilla and mint flavored Stevita drops are my favorite. As with any stevia product, you must be careful of the dosage. Add too much and it will have an aftertaste described in some of the previous reviews. If it tastes funny, try adding less next time.

You used to be able to buy this stuff for about $2 a bottle. Why has the price shot up so much?

I like these chips a lot! They're better for me than regular potato chips which is why I bought them in the first place.

I do wish there more in the little bags but I get that they are only supposed to be a serving so it's not a huge problem.

I placed an order for multiple boxes of this item. When I opened the first box, I immediately noticed the bars were all jumbled up, with obvious voids in the box. I took the bars out and counted them, and there were only 17, not 24 as was indicated on the box and on the Amazon website. I weighed the box and it weighed considerably less than the other boxes. I opened one more box, and it did have all 24.

I guess the machine packing it malfunctioned, but it should have been weighed and the discrepancy caught before being shipped from the company, IMHO.
Purchased as gift for someone from Argentina, they were delighted with a bit of home - same product as they enjoyed back home.
Any time you have organic food is good. This is good tasting organic mac and cheese albeit still processed food. The only way to get better food is to make  an organic batch from scratch.

I bought this because of the great things I've heard about all the minerals in this water. It takes a minute to get over the color but it actually tastes just like water an I think it's pretty good. I would definately buy this again.

This is a great product. I can't find corn nuts around here. They are sooo great. I can't remember the manufacture from years ago, but these are very close. The only difference I note is that these are a tad less salty, but that's o.k. we all get way too much salt.

I will continue to purchase these lovely, crunchy, nuggets of corn!!

The product was great and arrived earlier than expected. I would order this over and over again.
The drinks were just as fresh as when they were packaged.

We use this to make nocciola (hazelnut) ice cream, which is generally not available in the US. Just like a trip to Venice - ice cream-wise anyway.

Drawback: to keep the butter moist and preserve it, there is a bit of excess oil that must be drained/squeezed.

I just started my search for a good-tasting protein bar with a quality taste, and this bar is my favorite so far.  This one tastes much better than the Clif bars that I tried, and it is much cheaper than the Myoplex bars, so I recommend giving it a try.

After having stacked drawers full of every treat sold on the market (Begging Strips, Milkbones, Busybone, Charlee Bear,Bonz, Carry-outs, etc.) I'd finally given up on finding a treat my dog would not turn his nose up at. Found 'em! These were on sale at Petco so I picked up a bag. My dog will do anything for one of these treats. They are great. I've never had an issue with him throwing these up or having a reaction and he is prone to those types of things. Not with these. I also break them up into smaller pieces and put them in his kong.
