I am happy with my purchase of vanilla beans. I used them to make homemade Ice ceam. It turned out great.

We recently got this product, not knowing what to expect.  If you like flavored waters, than this is the stuff for you.  You're not really going to get a kool-aid type of beverage from it.  I have a quart sized water bottle, and I put in about 1/4 tsp of the product then add water.  I don't have the clumping issue, because I shake my water bottle.  I get a nice drink that isn't too sweet and is refreshing.  I'm going to try other flavors too. =)

Many reviewers did not realize and/or did not like that these are randomly selected prior to shipping. The surprise element was a major reason I chose this sampler. The teas I received were Oolong, Pu-er, Jasmine, Lychee Black, China Green, and Tikuanyin Oolong. All of the teas tasted anywhere from decent to quite good, with the China Green being the stand-out. The Lychee Black would be awesome except for a sort of stale, dusty aftertaste. Up front the Lychee is fruity and sweet, quite enjoyable. Seconds after swallowing though it's like you've just licked a dusty old book from someone's basement. Very odd. At any rate, the tins are adorable so when the tea is gone I will probably reuse them, they'd be great for storing buttons, loose change, incense or what-have-you.

This is NOT "Puppy food" -- that is to say, it is not branded or sold by NutriSource as quote-Puppy-unquote food.

In fact, while large print on the package says "Adult Dogs," this food IS perfectly suitable for puppies; and NutriSource say this in the smaller print of the packaging. It's certainly not part of the branding: NutriSource do not currently make any such thing as "Grain Free Chicken" food specifically for puppies.

That said -- this is the same food as the small bag (with, confusingly, a quite different-looking packaging) of kibble our breeder sent us home with when we adopted our little Havanese puppy.

He loves it. He produces a nice stool and has never either been constipated or had diarrhea using this formula.

So, hooray, a very good puppy food that is not "Puppy food."

I just rec'd my 5lb bag.  The packaging survived the trip to Afghanistan - so no worries there.  The plastic packaging is sturdy and has a zip lock style seal across the top.  Now the peas!  I am a big fan of Hapi brand but was tired of paying the premium price.  I began my search for a reasonably priced veggie that packed a wasabi punch.  I found them on the first try.  Since I know Hapi best, I will make the comparison 1) Price:  Feng Shui is cheaper; 2) Taste: Hapi peas are a little sweeter and the wasabi is a tiny bit more mild that FS.  FS peas pack a bigger crunch - not tooth breaking crunch - more like a half popped popcorn kernel crunch.  Some of the FS peas have a huge wasabi punch.  In fact, I just ate one that brought a tear to my eye and prompted me to write this review.  3) Appearance: Hapi looks a little more appealing - but I am not sure that is a good thing.  How does a roasted or fried pea retain that neon color?  FS looks more natural and may be healthier.  Look at the nutritional information/ingredients for yourself.  The only real concern I have is that FS is a product of China.

These are a great heavy duty bone for vigorous chewers.  Only thing wrong is they smell pretty bad after they have been chewed on a bit.  Normally chewed rawhide doesn't smell much, these not the case.  Still a great value, and I will just live with the smell since the girls love them.

I honestly never thought in a million years that this stuff would really work well. I've been using shampoos and conditioners from everything from Lazartigue to Kiehls and always had a problem with a dry, itchy scalp and dandruff. After a month or so of using this shampoo and conditioner I don't have a problem. I'm ordering more when I run out of the products I received from the Vine program.

I tried the smoker bag twice. Since my bbq is very hot (3 burners at 30,000 btu each) I need to cook at a very low heat setting. I've tried ribs and steak. The ribs were perfect and smoked nicely. The steaks were overcooked as I had the heat on medium low (should have been low). I had four steaks each about a pound. If you follow the directions I estimated it should smoke for about an hour or so. Boy were they overcooked. Since the directions also say not to open the bag it's hard to know how much time. If you have a very hot bbq, as I do, you may try cooking half the time, say 30 minutes. One thing for sure, the bag really works. I've never had a real smoker type bbq but the bags do a great job. ps, don't try your kitchen oven as the bags really give off alot of smoke and would smell up the house if you don't have a high output exhaust system. Experiment on your timing. Good Luck

I purchase this tea for my boyfriend due to how much stress he goes through on a daily basis.  He's tried the tea and says it helps him to be calm and it also helps with is sleep, placing him in a relaxed state.
this cereal really delicious, a good mate with milk or soymilk. I like it very much and will keep eating it for my breakfast.

My wife and I have enjoyed dehydrated refried beans in the past, so we thought that we would give these a try. The beans are ok, it is just that we don't like the seasoning that is in them. If I were to order some refried beans again, I would make sure that they were plain.

Great alternative to the popular caffeinated drinks. No crash and burn after drinking this green tea drink. It's a nice pick-me-up.
The only problem is with the packaging. Some of the cans were dented.

The Nature Valley Chewy Trail Mix Bar (Fruit and Nut variety) is a typical, but decent entry in the world of snack bars. There a a few traces of raisins and cranberries in the bar, but it is dominated by oats (as expected) and rice, with a few bits of almonds and peanuts thrown in. At least in my samples, I was surprised to see more sunflower seeds in the mix than nuts, but it not enough to detract from the product. And as advertised, the bar is chewy, but luckily not sticky or overly sweet.

I'm having a hard time coming up with a word that describes the taste of the bar other than "typical." There is not enough of any one product, either fruit or nut or sunflower seed, to change the taste from that of the oats, rice, and honey that make up a majority of the product. And as noted above, the honey used to hold the bar does not make the product overly sweet. In this case "typical" isn't a bad thing, it just keeps me from giving the highest rating to the product.

Overall, an acceptable product with a pleasant but not-quite-memorable taste.
I love these, great for travel.My son loves them. Target has these for $0.89 each! Buy them there instead.

Price: This was a great buy, only $17 for a pack of 12, about $1.40 a box with promotion plus subscribe & save. They run for $2 on sale at the supermarket and $1.59 on the Annie's Homegrown website.
Taste/Flavor: They are not as good as the white cheddar (purple box) but still taste good and has less sodium than the others. We only have one mac n cheese lover in our home so this 12 pack has lasted us well over 8 months, however I will consider purchasing this again in the future when our child is older.
Other Comments: Quick and easy to make, with 11g of protein per serving (each box is 2.5 servings, however, it is quite possible to finish the entire box for one person if you're hungry!), and a decent source of calcium as well. Having all natural ingredients is also a plus.

...illy issimo Cappuccino coffee is pretty good. They have avoided the chemical taste or aftertaste that so often makes prepared food and drink go from seeming to be a good idea to definately a bad idea with one taste. This was tasty and refreshing and just as good as Starbucks sold in bottles in the grocery store, although a bit more expensive. It is not a bad idea to keep a few of these in the refrigerator.
These treats are a great buy for the money. I buy them in larger quainties, and save money. My dogs love them.
Kalvert Rose Syrup exceeded my expectations for flavor and aroma.  I use it in ice cream and in to sweeten some teas.

I have loved these from the beginning when they were delfa rolls and then danish ribbons. I was devastated when they were nolonger available and could not wait to try the "new formula" because they are not the same and they have a more artificial manufactured strawberry flavor. I searched for their return online since I am a fan along with my sister and husband and we adopted the new taste and it grows on you and becomes oddly addicting with the same texture that you love to unroll.

I had originally written a bad review with 1 star.  This was because I thought I ordered "certified" san marzano tomatoees.  Certified means they are grown only in a certain part of Italy.  When they arrived and I saw  they were not I proceeded to write a bad review, which was before I tasted them.  They are pretty good.  I would order this product again.  thank you

This is a good gluten-free snack.  My son likes the berry flavor best, and from what I have tasted, I would agree.  My son is gluten-free, so snacks are a challenge, but he likes this and it is not so expensive as some other alternatives.

No need for plastic baggies or sloppy tin foil wrappers. Honey Maid Fresh Stacks are the perfect package for a snack on the go or to keep a few in the car for unexpectedly long rides.

We homeschool our children, so there's no need to pack lunches, but - if the price is right - I'll consider buying these again in the future.

Recommended.
Great service and a bit expensive.  Couldn't find them in my grocery store and happy to find them here.

We like this product very much, but it suddenly disappeared from
the shelves of our local market (Albertson's - Bradenton, FL.)
Being able to order online was a great convenience. The price, however,
was slightly higher than we had been paying over the counter. Why?

This jerky contains MSG or I would probably give it 5 stars. The MSG doesn't really bother me personally, but it does add a bit too much saltiness.

Aside from being a tad too salty this is really some of the best packaged jerky I've bought. The quality of the meat is some of THE best I've ever seen, as good as I could make myself. It has a nice note of heat in the after taste, but the taste of the beef itself comes thru wonderfully. Awesome texture and consistency and definitely a good value for a whole pound of jerky.

I will say value-wise Wild Ride Sweet n Hot is still my favorite choice. But from now on, when they are out of stock this will be my go-to product. If MSG doesn't bother you, try it!

I'm not a big coffee drinker, but when comparing Illy's Issimo Coffee Drink to other canned coffees, like those from Starbucks, the taste seems a bit less "natural." Instead of tasting the lowfat milk and cocoa that the can mentions in upper-case, reassuring letters, I seem to taste the cellulose gum and artificial coloring, and no cocoa whatsoever.

One thing I did like about Illy's canned coffee is that it wasn't as sweet as Starbucks. I find the older I get the less sweet I like things to be. I also liked the size of the can since I'm not a big fan of post-coffee jitters.

Illy's coffee isn't bad, but it isn't really anything special either. I'd buy it again if something else wasn't available, or if I was in the mood for something less sweet.

I am a big fan of strong English & Irish teas and have had numerous brands of English Breakfast for decades. The Davidson's is quite good except that it could be packaged to stay somewhat fresher and more aromatic. As it is, I gave it 4 of 5 stars. The price is great and the tea is good. If had been packaged more airtight I think it would go from good to excellent. I would happily pay an extra dollar for better packaging. As it is, it is still a very good value on a good tea. It is a nice rich brown flavorful tea with plenty of morning "kick".
pretty solid bars.  provides energy and something in ur stomach for hiking... took these for a hike on katahdin... provided plenty of energy, but they don't take too many--they weigh you down.
This is my second purchase. Good tea, smooth taste if your brewing does not exceed more than 4 mins. Overall I am happy with this product

If you love espresso, but are always on the run, this is a great product. I am a huge coffee drinker, and this, plus the other version with low fat milk, and a little sugar, are both great. I love the option to grab this, black and unsweetened, or the if in the mood, the lightly sweetened version, when running around with no time to brew my own. The quality is very high, and I gave this 4 stars, instead of 5, only because it is very expensive. If the high price is offset by the convenience, as it is for me, give this, or actually any of the illy coffees a try, they are all great. Also, travels with you very easily, as a few of the 6.8 ounce size cans can go in a briefcase, or any bag with ease.

This is just what I had hoped for, a much better value than those little jars or, even worse, those measly, overpriced envelopes.

I was sad, though, to discover the same product at Sam's Club for less than $5 after I had already bought this and paid $7 for shipping & handling.

I've now sampled four different varieties of LaraBar, and here's my main take on the lemon ones: if you like lemon squares, this is your bar.  The all-natural raw foods approach makes for a great snack bar - not over-sweetened, no sticky aftertaste, not too dry, and one bar was often the perfect mid-afternoon snack to carry me over until dinner - but the lemon flavor here is definitely not subtle.  I still enjoyed the box, but prefer the cherry pie or banana cookie flavors.

Why? Because the noodles come SOFT, sealed in plastic! If you are tired of noodles that "crunch" or that have to be reconstituted out of the original cardboard, you are in for a treat! Available in something like a dozen different varieties, try them all and then subscribe to your favorites in order to get the lowest price.

Note: The seasoning comes in a sealed pouch so if you tend to prefer yours less salty or less strong in taste, don't use it all to start. You can always add more in later.

Note: Since the bowl is made partially from cornstarch, it will biodegrade completely so toss it in the trash when you're done without feeling guilty. (For this reason you should NOT attempt to reuse this bowl like you may have done with other brand instant noodle meals that came in plastic bowls.)

Note: Of them all I believe this to be my least favorite flavor. Why? Because it is the blandest. I think this was intended to be the one that entices ordinary Americans unfamiliar with Asian foods into sampling their products, but in the process they overdid it, producing a rather boring extremely mild tasting chicken soup with of course their excellent thick, soft, Hokkien noodles. I'd agree with other reviewers that this is the one you are most likely to want to add things to in order to spice it up.

Although I haven't ordered this product through Amazon, Vanilla Bean is my favorite flavor of the Gu Gels. I've tried several other Gu flavors, and I like this one the best. To me, it's the most refreshing during or after a long run. It's light and has enough flavor without being overbearing or heavy tasting.

I like the GU Gels in general because they have less sodium than other sports/endurance foods I've seen on the market, and while some extra sodium is good during long runs and other distance endeavors, I am watching my sodium for health reasons, so GU gels are a good compromise for me.
Can't complain. Taste good and had quick delivery! It was my first time trying this tea out. I usually drink the peppermint one but this gave me energy and sustained me throughout the day.

The previous review and the price were determining factors for me.
I've used the packaged versions and I thought it would be time for a change.

I'll report back later.
This makes a tasty quick meal, it is a bit sweet for my taste, so I added a touch of chili oil. Not earth-shattering, but really not bad at all for a quickie microwaved meal or snack.

This has a very nice flavour and chewy texture. It sticks to me pretty well through the day also. I'm definitely a fan of GOLEAN bars, this isn't my favourite but it's very very good.

Cheers

These were pretty decent crackers, however, I do agree that there are too many wasabi peas, they can get pretty hot. The funky circular crackers wrapped in seaweed to look like a sushi roll was a real trip though, it really was tasty. Dont eat too many though, as it can produce a log jam, if you catch my drift.

Product is great, same brand as supermarket but much cheaper. Be aware that each bottle is 44oz by weight, not 44 fluid oz, even though it is a liquid. Missed that when I read the description, but it's still cheaper in this size.

Both my husband and I love the taste of this oatmeal.  A nutty flavor with wonderful texture.  I never realized how bland some oatmeal was until I tried this brand.  This is a long cooking oatmeal but worth the wait.  I think that precooked oatmeal has too many nutritients removed in the process. If you want fiber in your diet, this is one of the best sources available and low calorie if don't add in butter or cream.  I always make a big pot of it so it lasts the week.  I add jam or preserves for sweetness and sometimes maple syrup or honey.  Fresh fruit when in season really is great or spices for a change. Since we use it daily, the 28 ounce tins are the most economical especially if on sale.

This is my dog's favorite food. She especially loves the large dark chunks of dried meat. She eats those first. The pieces are a good size for her. My dog is a large size small dog (not quit medium sized). I prefer she have the beef or chicken and not the lamb but lamb was all they had as a subscription. I could not beat the subscription price. Cheaper than the stores and it shows up at my door as often as I need it.

Have a very juicy taste.  But with only three flavors, you may get tired of them if you eat too much.  Good thing candy lasts forever.  They're on the small side, so you may need two to satisfy the sugar craving.
I have a picky 15 pound dog and he loves this stuff. Like a child he spits out the peas. I know it is lacking in ingredients bur he will readily eat this food.
Dr. told me to avoid white sugar due to adult onset diabetes, but brown sugar was acceptable.  It would be nice to have been able to buy less than 1,000, but I expect it will keep.

My local grocery store stopped carrying Bristling Sardines, No salt added, packed in water.

This product is it!

I prefer smaller sardines than this company packs; if it was up to me I would pack a smaller sardine and charge a little more. However there isn't any fault involved as these sardines came as advertised.
The spices are good, but it would be much better if you had the ground spices rather than a paste.  However, the paste is good in a pinch.  It has a good flavor and a nice kick.

Shipping was super fast from the seller. It came in a protected envelope which kept the bacteria from all the harm the post office could muster up. It was protect so well in fact that after I split my order in half (gave one to my mom to try out too) I can't seem to find it. The bacteria was alive so I'm assuming it must of ran off. That envelope was protecting it not just from shipping harm but from the world. Hopefully once it grows up it will come back.

My moms batch of yogurt came out wonderful though. Better than the store variety any day! We were able to make a gallon of yogurt (that's a gallon a milk if your keeping track).

If your new to yogurt making or even a pro grab some today just make sure you lock it up so it doesn't run off once you get it!

Who orders cereal in the mail? apparently I do. This box came, and It felt like there was a box of rocks in my hand!

Oatmeal Squares are tiny boxes of brown sugary-ness, and they are heavy in more weighs than one (Im Punny). They taste very much like Golden Grahams Cereal, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5) BUT with a earthier, Hay like aftertaste. If that makes sense. about a 1/2 a cup would fill you right on up for the whole morning.

I liked them well enough. Maybe would get them again in the future.

I received this cookie to test from Influenster.  I had the raisin cookie and it was really so good!  I like that they use whole grains to make the cookie.  Breakfast really isn't my favorite meal of the day and I like something that is fast and easy.  This cookie is a good breakfast option for me.  I'm an on-the-go mom and it's easy to grab this to eat for breakfast or as a snack any time of day.  The cookie is a good size and it is moist and yummy.  I really liked it and will be buying more!
Not as tasty as the Chunky Peanut Butter Bar, but still loaded with protein and gluten-free.  Thank you, Think Products!
Good mild tea.  I would prefer it in bulk, but the bags are ok.
While my favorite F&W scauce is Mango-Ginger-Haberno, this sauce is very unique and is great on chicken in particular.  If you like mustard, you will probably love this sauce.

Community Coffee is a great Product. I've been drinking Community for over 20 years and the quality hasn't changed.  Its difficult to find in Georgia and the price has gone up considerably. When I found it on Amazon with free shipping, I ordered it imediately!!!
This cereal,(along with some Kashi products),is a very good cold cereal. Tasty & crunchy,not overly sweet.If you are a breakfast cereal fan ,you should like it.!
I'm not a coffee conniseur but these beans taste good.  Not too strong or bitter.  This is the only bean I've ordered on a regular basis.

Mum mums are known as 'baby crack' in our house. They crunch satisfyingly yet melt easily, meaning no teeth is no problem and the mess is really minimal. They do tend to break and powder inside each pack of two, though.
I lived in London and it's been impossible to find this pickle in South America. Now I got it and its awesome. Best companion for cheddar cheese.
Variety wasn't as good as other variety packs I've purchased from other sellers.  But not bad.  Right amount of cups, good cost per unit.

Boy is this a strong flavor!  My husband likes kahlua so I figured he'd like this, but it has a very strong flavor, too strong for me.  And I don't think it will be a regular with him, but nice for an occasional taste hit.

Overall, this has a good taste for a canned coffee drink and I was happy to have tried it. It has 100 calories, which isn't all that bad for a drink of this type.  I also like the packaging - it has a slim can, so it's easier to fit in a purse or bag than a larger soda can. However, I can't really say that there was anything outstanding about the drink - in fact, I think I have a slight preference for the Starbucks version.  That's really all just a matter of personal taste though, so if you like this type of drink, I would recommend trying this one to see if it could be your new favorite.
This is a great product to keep in the office just in case you run out of creamer.

Having previously tried the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4) and Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4) flavors with mixed results, I'm placing this one in the plus category.
I don't usually drink Appletinis so I'm not sure how it compares to the alcoholic drink but I found it to taste like Jolly Rancher's Sour Apple candy, which I'm fond of.
The taste is strong enough that in addition to a stand alone beverage I believe it could be used as a mixer.

Great price on a great product, but a case of 100 is a bit excessive - I ended up giving bags of them to my family members as well. I love to add them to a salad or soup. A 0.5 oz bag is 70 calories, better than many other salad toppers.

Have been using this product for a good while, so sorry that I can only purchase online. Thanks to the Amazon marketplace.
No refrigeration needed and no need to sweeten coffee.
I'm very pleased that a Lite coffeemate is available and I like the smaller size container very much - easier to handle, for one.  To me the lite product tastes no different than original.

This is the best, hot sausage on the market!  They are indeed, HOT!  That was exactly what I wanted.  Most of the sausages are advertised as hot, but don't even come close to being hot.  I have been looking for a replacement for the old Penrose Hot Sausages and I've tried many of them, but this one is by far, the hottest!  I rated this item with four stars because, while the taste IS good, it is not the best one I've ever tasted.  If you are looking for HOT though, with a fairly decent taste, then this one is IT!

I'm a recent user of this product.  Everything about it is high grade.  I have only one complaint, and that is that it does not easily dissolve in hot water for making hot chocolate.  I need to earnestly wisk it to get it smooth.

The flavor is very good in this kind, but does it ever pack a punch. With creamer and sweetener in it, it helps alot. When I got my CBTL Briosa, I bought a bunch of these capsules in varying flavors. Some are better than others, but I still love most of them and my machine.

While I don't buy 'real' healthy cereals very often, I'm always up for trying new ones. And face it- when there's a cereal called Crunchy Vanilla Sunrise, it pretty much tells you that you're in for a good meal. With high expectations...I was right. So right, that I took care of the whole box within a day. No, THAT wasn't a very healthy thing to do, but my god was this cereal great. It looked like some kind of rabbit food when I poured some into a bowl, but upon taking the first bite, I was in love. Crunchy, but not super crunchy. Vanilla, but not super vanilla-y. Sunrise...well, the sun -was- shining when I was eating it!

There are only so many things you can say about a food that you like in a review, because the only way if you know you'll like it is by getting some for yourself. Anyone who loves vanilla flavored cereals should like this stuff. It seems like a lot of people here aren't too big on the taste, but I didn't have any problems with it at all. As soon as my first bowl was over, I moonwalked back to the kitchen and poured another. It's a heck of a lot lower in sugar than nearly everything else I get, though I suppose health nuts will always find something to throw a fit about.

I was on the fence on giving it 3 or 4 stars because I love the flavor so much, but there's one glaring problem. Someone posted an image above in the Customer Images section, and that's exactly how my cereal was as well. And if you're one of those people that really does go by the Serving Size listed on the size of the box, this stuff isn't going to fill you up very well. When you see how much you're getting by buying a pack of 3 here...for the price, it doesn't seem like a good deal compared to buying 2 bigger boxes of a similar cereal.

Problems aside, if you don't mind buying this stuff in bulk, you should be happy.
Though the container says '3 servings', it is really hard to put down the container once it is opened. Good snack. Better (more healthy) if you have self-discipline!

Our two dogs like this food for its variety. My little dog pulls out the chewy meaty bits first and our big dog wolf down the crunchy chunks. Both eventually eat all of them, but they have their favorite pieces- just like my kids. This food smells good (not fake and smelly) and has a nice color to it. I would recommend this a as a nice upgrade from basic dog food and as a healthier alternative to the basic dog chow. Neither one of our dogs had digestive problems in switching to this food.

I have had Douwe Egberts coffee for many years.  Mostly at resturants, which has a different proccess then the avarage home.  I have tried to find this coffee in many places & fortunitly Amazon.com was the only place I could, besides Aruba!  However, I'm not going to fly to Aruba to buy it when I need it, I will continure to order it from Amazon.com & highly recommend this coffee if you are a coffee lover like I am.
If you have allergies you NEED to try Wink Frozen Desserts.  They ship just like Omaha Steaks and actually taste incredible!!  Life changing
Really nice change of pace. Had the right amount of bacon flavor to complement the chocolate. A darker chocolate version would be interesting if it didn't overwhelm the bacon.

Another reviewer stated these are second only to the black forest ones, and while I like the black forest ones, I think the Haribo ones stand up to it. But I'm used to the Haribo and black forest ones in the smaller bags you pick up at the brick and mortar, and these seem to be slightly harder than those. But considering the price at the local stores for the smaller bags, the difference is well worth the savings.

It's amazing how many fit into a 5 pound bag, too...

Delicious and cheap, a wonderful combination.

I have had a special place in my heart for these "meals in a box" or dinner kits. Mainly because I can recall as a child my mother being able to really doctor these box dinners. She would add cheese, veggies and various spices making it so much more that a "pre-packaged meal". I have adopted many of her techniques in my cooking today.

As for these dinner kits by Velveeta, it seems that the Cheese Masters are a little late to the party since Hamburger Helper and even Rice/Pasta Roni have had a corner on this market for years. Nevertheless, this "dinner in a box" calls for chicken rather than beef. The promoted flavor is broccoli and cheese.

Inside the box there is a bag of orzo (rice shaped pasta), a seasoning packet, and a packet of dried broccoli florets and a standard foil package of Velveeta. The only thing missing is a pound of chicken. The preparation is about 15 to 20 minutes and the result is pretty good. I did however make two minor adjustments in my preparation of this meal. I lightly dusted my chicken with low sodium seasoning as I cooked it and added fresh broccoli to the completed dish. I feel these additions really made the flavor pop (I am sure onions and peppers would be good too).

Overall this is a pretty good meal and easy to make. I was somewhat turned off by a boxed meal "starring" Velveeta. I like Velveeta but it is a very processed food and I find a little of it goes a long way. In other words has a very strong flavor and I try to avoid too much sodium. However this meal doesn't taste too salty and isn't too cheesy. I am eager to try one of the other box meals Velveeta has. For the novice cook this is a good meal for the "seasoned chef" this could be a nice foundation for a more epic dining experience.

I have to admit that at first taste I wasn't impressed with these nuts. I'm pretty sure you can get the same taste if you just lick an almond and dip it in chocolate coco mix. Plus I'm not a big fan of dark chocolate so that didn't help. But after having a few, I couldn't stop. Finally, my wife had to take them away, insisting that she would be using them in some future culinary masterpiece.

Conclusion: Almonds are good.

I think even if you washed off the chocolate these things would be addictive. And that's probably not a bad thing since as far as I know nuts are good for ya.
good tea, with mild flavor.  everyday tea is a good description.  i steep it twice with decent results for the second cup.

I love the sumatra coffee pods but I do think that Java One has changed the blend. The pods now read sumatra and not sumatra mandheling. I don't think they have the same taste but are still good. After I finish these though I will search out and see if there are other sumutra blends that compare with the previous blend that Java One had.

When first opening this bag of cookies, I got a burst of spicy, slightly sweet scent that was quite pleasant without being overpowering. The cookies (more like biscuits, really) were only slightly sweet - then one of the little fig bits exploded with sweetness in my mouth!

These more wholesome, lower sugar cookies would be ideal for long summer car rides with kids; as they are less messy than most cookies, and won't get the kids as wired.

Very nice, slightly more sophisticated take on the usual cookie.

One of the cool points of the Keurig brewer is the capability to brew both coffee and tea. Although I use it mainly to brew coffee, I got a box of this Earl Grey, and use it in a rush.

I drink most of my tea using loose tea (Adiago Tea's Earl Grey Bravo is wonderful), and nothing beats loose tea for having a tea with some body and full flavor. Tea brewed with a K-Cup is brewed too fast, and is slightly more bitter than other good teas, and doesn't have the same mouthfeel.

Still, I've been drinking this regularly, especially when I'm running out the door and would rather have tea than coffee some mornings. It's quick, and it's a reasonable cup.

We have been feeding our dog, lady, this product.  We have seen an obvious improvement in her skin and in the luster of her coat.  She has not been gaining weight on it as she did with the previous brand, in fact she has lost a little.  The chunk size concerned me a bit as we had to have most of her teeth removed a couple of years ago but she just digs right in.  Recently she has been able to jump up on our bed at night where she sleeps at our feet, she had been begging until we picked her up and put her on the bed, and I think this is largely due to IAMS Proactive Health Adult Chunks. If you like jellybeans, you will likely enjoy these. The flavors are very good. They're average-sized, not small like Jelly Belly's.
I love this brand and the English Breakfast tea is amazing however I like the 50 bags pack better than this one.

Original Review Summer 2008 (original review was no longer attached to item):

These are by far the plumpest, juiciest dried cranberries that I have ever tasted. Yes, there is a smidgen of sugar and sunflower oil but I have yet to see any dried cranberries without those added. I love to toss a handful into cereal--hot or cold--for an added taste treat.

Incidentally, these are 6 4-ounce bags of the tasty treats.

Update: I've reduced the number of stars as I have a new favorite Oskri Cranberries, Dried, 3.53 Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)and my choice of 4 stars may be confusing to some.

When comparing the two dried cranberries, side-by-side, the Oskri are by far, the better of the two. When taking the Oskri out of the equation and comparing the Newman's Own cranberries to other brands out there, then Newman's Own stands above the rest.

If, what you are looking for is a replacement for all of the varieties out there in the marketplace, then Newman's Own are for you. If you are looking for a fabulous dried cranberry fit for just munching, then reach for the Oskri.

I actually like to keep both brands on hand. There are times, when I am baking, that the Newman's Own Cranberries are my preferred cranberry. If I am substituting cranberries for raisins in a recipe, then odds are that I will choose the Newman's Own over the Oskri. If I am baking something where the cranberry is the centerpiece, then I choose the Oskri.

Your mileage may vary.

Maybe I don't have as rich a pallet as the others that have reviewed this tea, but it did nothing for me. It was very bland on the pumpkin side. Just matcha to me. I added some cream and sugar, and ended up having to add a lot for me to get it down. For me, if I'm adding more than three spoonfuls of sweetener, the tea is just too bland for me.

I was actually really excited for this tea. I expected something really rich and decadent and a "kick in the mouth" kind of flavor. I had high expectations when I opened it, it smelled really delicious and I was excited, but I ended up just pouring my cup out and setting my packet up on the self. Maybe I was making it wrong? Maybe I added two much water...

Well, I'll be trying again until it runs out, but I wouldn't buy it again. I wish they had a smaller trial size that wasn't twenty dollars...

EDIT: I gave it two stars at first, but I'm raising it to four. Four and a half if I could. I was making it wrong and with a good shifting of the powder and a good shifting of the tea it's self, plus some sugar and cream, the tea is quite, dare I say it, "delicious." Even decadent. Now that I know how to make it correctly, I'd certainly buy another, larger portion. So just be careful of the directions, unlike yours truly.

The Barilla Mezze Penne with Spicy Marinara Sauce is ready in 60 seconds from the microwave.  The sauce has Barilla's usual high quality and the red pepper gives it just the right amount of "kick" to make it spicy good.  After heating, you pour the sauce over the penne, which comes out nice and firm. This pasta meal has 320 calories, 0 cholesterol, 700 mg sodium and 6g fiber. Combine this with a green salad and a slice of French Bread and one can have a scrumptuous meal in just a few minutes' time.  One of the best 60-second meals around.

I love this creamer in my coffee.  However, reviewers are correct about the pump, and many many reviewers comment on its poor quality.  I can't imagine why the folks at the company don't get the hint.  Executives...what do you have to do to make them come to their senses?  Anyway, it will work for a while, but soon stops pumping all together.  It just gets gradually harder and harder to push the pump down, until you are leaning all your weight on it just to get the pump to depress.  I finally sawed through the top with a serrated knife and poured it into an empty water bottle so I can easily unscrew it and use.  I plan to buy a nice (empty) soap dispenser to pour the creamer into, and use it that way.  The above reviewers advice to freeze the extra creamer is a good tip that I will use.  I will just thaw it out when I need to refill the dispenser!

I received Gudrun chocolates as a gift.  I'd never heard of Gudrun, so I was curious to see how they'd stack up against other premium chocolates.  I'd have to say that they're good, but not my favorite.  The best way I can try to compare them is to say that if you like your centers whipped to a lightness that almost floats away and is delicately flavored then these are for you.  If you prefer, as I do, a denser texture and richer flavor then I'd have to say that you'll want to pass on these.  One thing I did like was the beautiful golden box mine came in.  At first I couldn't figure out how the box stayed shut but then on closer examination I discovered that there are little magnets cleverly mounted in the flap of the box.  Very nice, and a solid choice at a lower price.

I was unsure what to make of this new hair care line. All of the basic ingredients are the same as my other shampoos for color-treated hair. Also, my understanding of basic health science regarding healthy hair & scalp left me skeptical that the Clear shampoo or conditioner would be much different than any other.

Many people rely on hair care products to give them healthy hair, but forget that the food you eat and the shampooing technique used are far more important. To properly shampoo hair, use the pads of your fingers, stimulate the scalp in rows of circular motions, for at least 30 seconds. This increases nutrient-rich bloodflow to the scalp to encourage healthy hair growth, as well as adequately exfoliate the scalp.

----------------

Despite my initial misgivings that this line was all hype, I still gave both the shampoo and conditioner a try.

The shampoo lathered up better than the other shampoo I had been using, so I ended up needing less of it.

It rinsed away smoothly, leaving my hair feeling strong. My other shampoo left my hair feeling a bit rough and tangled, and I had always thought this was just how colored hair felt.

I see sunflower, soybean, almond & coconut oils, as well as aloe vera, further down on the Clear ingredient list. While my other shampoo contains some fruit extracts and grape seed oil, it does not contain the soothing ingredients found in the Clear product. I do think this must be part of the difference between the two that I've experienced.

I don't have fragrance sensitivities, but I don't like when it is overwhelming. I found the fragrance to be pleasant, to me it smells like apples.

The lid design presses open with a lever-like motion, which is much easier to operate with wet hands than a flip-open cap.

The assymetrical design of the bottle is interesting to look at, but is a huge pain when the wider part is put away facing down (such as when the contents are running low). It works, it delivers a nasty little shock...it got my dog once and made her yelp. I leaned against it once (accidently) and it got my attention real quick. It managed to kill a squirrel, fry a rat and short-circuit a mouse when they got caught between the wires...and yet somehow the wild rabbits still got into my pumpkin patch and trashed my entire harvest! That's more of a design flaw...next year I'll run solid fencing 3' high and then use this runing along the top.

Just buy the shock unit by itself. The green post are flimsy, I ended-up using 1-foot rebar into the ground, having 1/2-inch PVC slide over that, and then used duct-tape to attach the green tubes to the white PVC....you use the green tubes because they have the holes drilled in them to run the wire through. Got a drill? Do it yourself. As for wire, they don't include enough. You can buy more at OSH, Home Depot didn't care much selection of small-guage wire.

One thing to know: if the system gets shorted-out in any way, the whole thing goes down!!! If a mouse gets into the wires and dies there, it's little body will keep the system shorted and the whole thing collapses: no shock field. I had a neighbors fig tree drop a fig that fell between two wires...the fig dry-roasted on the wires and sure-enough, no electric shock happening!

Get a little voltage 'tick' tester at Home Depot for $7....it makes a beeping noise and flashes when it senses voltage, you'd be surprised how you can wire a whole system and then somehow it gets shorted..run those wires clean and check the system routinely! Happy shocking! :)

My husband and I drink a good amount of Crystal Light powdered beverages. I don't consider many of the Crystal Light selections to have an adult quality to them. However, there is something about the Mojito flavor that is mature.

First, it lacks the shockingly vibrant colors of many of the company's other selections. If you picture the coloring of bright red lipstick or an orange pumpkin, you can get an idea of how many flavors of Crystal Light look in a glass. The Mojito mix looks like cloudy water, if it is unadorned with mint leaves or other additions.

I also find that compared to other Crystal Light beverages, the Mojito has a more complex flavor. It tastes like a diet limeaide and while I can see how the scientists that crafted this beverage would consider it to be a mojito-inspired creation, I don't know if I would have thought "mojito" without a packaging hint. Still, it is a good beverage with layers of citrus and a bit of mint; a glass can be made even better by adding fresh mint leaves.

If you are a pregnant gal, the designated driver, or a dieter, I think you could dress this beverage up to make it quite satisfactory for party purposes. Crystal Light has successfully created a mature Crystal Light beverage option, which Crystal Light has relatively few of (the company's Crystal Light Peach Tea Drink Mix (12-Quart), 1.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4) and Crystal Light Ruby Red Grapefruit Drink Mix (10-Quart), 3.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4) are two other "adult" flavors).

One negative with all of the Crystal Light products relates to packaging. First, the container is a #5 plastic. Unless you live in a relatively progressive place, #5 plastics are typically very difficult to recycle. I know Whole Foods engages in a recycling initiative to collect #5 plastics but if you don't live near one and you care about recycling, these can be a challenging item to deal with. Additionally, if you like Crystal Light, it can be very easy to go through these containers quickly. Some Crystal Light flavors have six packets and others, like the Mojito flavor, have five. The container could hold more flavor packets, which would reduce the overall number of containers that the user has to dispose of.

Overall, a good beverage that is encased in packaging that is not very green.

For anyone who isn't familiar with plantain, it is an Asian fruit, which like it's cousin, the banana, was introduced to the new world by medieval explorers, such as the Portuguese and Spanish sailors. For more than a year, I was looking for a good gluten-free cracker and I never considered a plantain chip as an excellent substitute until now, and shame on me, because I discovered them about twenty years ago. As a matter of fact, instead of making dumplings out of wheat flour, Puerto Ricans make them out of ground green plantains or bananas. I never ate plantain chips as a kid, but I did enjoy the plantain dumplings in soup; they were delicious and low in fat. Puerto Ricans also combine the ground plantain with other tropical tubers and stewed meats to make a huge dumpling that they boil in parchment paper in order to keep it intact while it cooks in a light brine; it's delicious and filling. At the West Indian markets in NYC, they sell plantain, banana, casava, and peanut flour. So, if you like to cook and experiment, you may want to make dumplings from such flours; I'm not a cook.

The Inka chips are thicker than the plantain chips that I ate years ago, making them a suitable cracker substitute. I cover them with peanut butter or fruit preserves and enjoy them as a snack. I also crush them and add them to my bowl of soup in order to give the soup a nice crunch; these chips hold up well in liquid, better than Saltine crackers, with less salt.

I bought this tea to increase my milk production after I noticed it was decreasing. I pump at work and could no longer replace the supply that my baby drinks during the day. However, I also did other things to help increase my production, so I can't say with 100% certainty that the tea is the reason. If nothing else, by drinking 3-4 cups a day, I increased my fluid intake, and my milk production increased. The other things I tried at the same time were: sleep as much as possible, nurse or pump at least every two hours, eat better, and try not to stress about not having enough milk.

As for the tea itself, the taste is actually pretty good, as one of the ingredients is chamomile. You really only faintly taste the fennel and anise (I hate licorice). I don't find it hard to drink the recommended amount everyday, and even look forward to it at night since it helps me relax before going to bed.

So I would recommend this tea, but can't say for certain that it was *the* thing that helped me. Rather I think it was a combination of everything.

It is hard to review a product that was meant for a dog but I will give it a try. Now for taste I left that to the dogs. I have two dogs a Schipperkie and a Mini Aussie that are given treats twice a day plus training treats. When I first gave the treats they both took them from me and ran off to enjoy. All in all I wish the product was sold in a smaller size but the quality of the treat seemed to be good and the dogs liked the treats but I dont feel they loved them (as I mentioned before they did not go to their special place to eat the treats in piece and quite as they will do on their favorite treats).
