First of all, this is Kool-Aid. So right off, you know you are basically getting a surgar fix with some artifical flavoring. Those desiring something healthy should go elsewhere - this is not it. Given that we are talking about Kool-Aid and not something that will make some governmental food pyramid or whatever polyhedra they are using at the moment, the only thing worth discussing is the taste.

Back in the day (and I am old enough to remember "the day"), Kool-Aid came in pretty basic flavors: cherry, orange, grape, etc. It was in a bit of a competition by a johnny-come-lately competitor by Pillsbury called "Funny Face" that had such flavors as "Choo Choo Cherry", "Rootin Tootin Raspberry", "Goofy Grape", and "Jolly Ollie Orange." Kool-Aid won and now rules as the sugar drink of choice.

It now seems the choices are a lot more varied these days. I guess all the competition from other those squeeze pouches with their unusual flavors have made Kool-Aid keep up with the trends. No one would have imagined there would ever be a "peach mango" Kool-Aid or that it would actually taste like anything other than sugar water with some fake flavor. But this stuff tastes pretty good - even fruit like. It makes me wonder if the rest of the stuff has changed over the years as well. In summary, this tastes pretty good for sugar water. Isn't modern science great!!

I must say I am totally enthralled with these candies. I originally purchased the "plain" tamarindo strips as well as these and found that these were not only fresher, but they had a distinct spicy bite to them that made them more enjoyable and tasty than the regular tamarindo strips.

Additionally, these didn't have the annoying corn-starch covering that is found on the plain candy, that is replaced instead with a nice layer of delicious chili powder!
I thought I was buying the organic, but this was relatively good.  I used it all, won't be buying it again.
Price was great for this product.  Kids enjoy this more than the cheetah bars but both are superior with less sugar than typical granola bars.

I was fostering 7 kittens and all 7 of them loved this brand of kitten food. I like what I pay for the price and the ingredients. It's not the best top shelf ingredients for cat food, but it's better for the other brands in the same price range. My kittens love eating it straight up and I feel better about feeding them.

I ordered the escargots in January and thought I had ordered two cans and when they arrived I had twelve cans.  I kept them and am really glad that I did.  We have already used several of them.  They are very good and so easy to fix for a quick appetizer.  I rate these a 4 1/2 out of 5.

I love carbonated drinks. Coke, Pepsi, Red Pop, Creme Soda... I think what makes me prefer them is the carbonation. Somehow, it makes me slow down and enjoy the drink more.

However, most soft drink companies are just creating different flavors of high fructose corn syrup mixed with the carbonated water. I don't like that. There's nothing good or healthy about HFCS, and I get enough of it in the various foods I purchase without having to drink several ounces of it every day.

This product, The Switch, is a great alternative to regular soft drinks. It's basically just carbonated fruit juice with some preservatives added. It gives me that zing I like in carbonated drinks, but without any of the high fructose corn syrup (of course fruit juice has its own sugars). It's much healthier and tastes great.

That's what's good about this item. The only bad thing I can think of is that the cans are TINY. I'm sorry; I'm an adult male, and I can't be satisfied with an 8.3 ounce can of juice. Two cans is about right, and at the price they're asking, that's about a dollar and ninety cents to get close to the quantity of a typical bottle of soda pop (20 ounces). Is it worth the upgrade? Yeah, I guess so, but I would think it would make a 24-pack go quickly in my case. I really wish they'd just package them in 16.6 ounce containers, and then still sell as a 24-pack.

This flavor, Black Cherry, does not sit with me well. To be fair, I'm not a fan of cherry juice anyway, but when you introduce the carbonation to cherry juice, it ends up tasting more like cough medicine than a tasty beverage. That's just my opinion, of course, and I'm sure fans of cherry juice will love it. Personally, I would like to see just plain Strawberry, and I'd probably like some other berry choices like Mulberry, Blackberry, and Raspberry. Cherry, for me, isn't the ideal choice, which is why my review of Strawberry-Watermelon gets five stars, but this one only gets four stars. Quality-wise, they're both the same; My biggest grip as concerns this review is this specific flavor.

All told, I'd have to recommend this product if you want a fizzy drink without the crud you find in most other soft drinks. This is at least real fruit juice, and while I can't say that carbonated drinks of any kind are "good for you", I can at least say that this one is made with good intentions and won't make you feel like you're bloated after downing a couple of them. I'm going to "subscribe" to one of their products soon, just to see if I can notice a change in my weight, energy level, and general health by switching (Hey!, See? Good product name!) to something that is a bit more natural.

As always, your mileage may vary. I'm sure your taste does.

Follow up purchae of a theraputic Honey. The larger quantity was what was required. Response and delivery were very good.  I do not have the knowledge to enter the "Genuine ~ or Not" debate. This product tastes fine and seems to have healthful properties. I am buying more.

Angostura has produced a very good orange bitters to go along with their classic, world-famous cocktail bitters.

However, other orange bitters (which are harder to find) namely Regan's Orange Bitters are better balanced and more complex - qualities that make them a better addition to most cocktails. Try and seek them out if you can.

Angostura's orange bitters benefit from being widely available at most larger supermarkets.

These chips are delectably delicious. I am on a low sodium diet. I didn't have to give up totally something that I truely love to snack. These chips are bursting with flavor, and you can't really tell they are missing all that salt. There is just a kiss worth on a chip, but beleive me, it is a total makeout!!!

But actually as with any variety, there are many we didn't like... but now we know !

Wish it were in a smaller quantity for our test batch .... but 5 stars for delivery and packaging and price !
the natural truffles have an unsweetened coaco powder on the outside with a nice smooth texture.  this is not to sweet more of a european style candy, wonderful.

Wow, this stuff has a zing to it. You have to taste it yourself to see what I mean. If you care about some thoughtful balance of protein and calories, which is easily achievable in a product like this, you'll have to look elsewhere. There is something downright malicious in the recipe for this confection and its insistence on sources of empty calories and borderline objectionable food products. The best you can say for it is that it isn't immediately harmfull.

Oh yes, the product package implores the shipper to keep it below 70 degrees F, "because it is natural". As you will find out, this is a signal for shippers to ignore any precautions, since refrigerated trucks don't occur on most shipping company routes.

It has been a while, but I bought this product in the high-end grocery store in my local area-that being publix. I like drinkiing buttermilk, and hoped it could be a replacement for always having to buy fresh. Well, it didn't meet that expectation. On the canister, I believe, it tells you what it's purpose is, and that is to add to baked goods in place of having to buy fresh each time to cook with.
There was a recipe on the back of the canister, for buttermilk biscuits. I made them several times. They were great! I would not go back to using fresh buttermilk, if I could find this product regularly. Unfortunately-at least in my close local area in tampa bay Fla, I don't see that publix is carryng the product widely, if at all, anymore. Great product. I'm still looking to find a way to use it to make a substitute for fresh buttermilk to drink. But if not, then I will use it in biscuits, and see whatever else it does well. Guess pancakes should be next since I love buttermilk pancakes. Whoo hoo!!
They love it but still get hairballs unfortunately.  So I also give them treats for reducing hairballs as well.  Apparently it must taste good though.

If you haven't had Bumble Bars please do so. I love them, and the Lushus Lemon flavor is the only one that really stands out to me. It actually tastes like real lemon. Not that fake lemon flavor that you get in candy sometimes.
Give it a try, I think you will be pleased.

I feed this to my puppy along with the dry formula to get her to eat more. She now is licking the bowl clean!

She does seem to have large bowel movements with this, but it is getting her eating and I know I can trust the ingredients.

This set comes with four different coffees. Here's my feedback on each.

Green Mountain Nantucket Blend: This is probably the best of the bunch. Just an all around good coffee without being overly rich or laced with any extra flavors. It smells great and tastes smooth.

Newman's Own Organics Special Blend: This is my second favorite. Paul may be known for his salad dressing, but he also makes a good cuppa.

Caribou Blend: No complaints, but it's nothing special. Just a regular run of the mill coffee.

Tully's French Roast: This is my least favorite of the bunch. The coffee seems a bit watery and bland. I never have been a fan of French roast so that may weigh in on my opinion.

Overall this is a good collection of K-cups for your morning coffee fix. Perfect for someone who doesn't want any flavored or frilly coffee, just a straight up good cup of Joe.

Overall, the product is fantastic and the coffee is great! I am giving a review of 4 stars only because Amazon's advertising is misleading, it does not come in the advertised box, as someone else indicated, it's an unmarked box with 3 smaller bags on the inside.

It is not a "plastic K kup", the product that you receive is what is pictured, with a filter type bottom. It does fit in your Keurig and brews just fine.

I love the aroma and the taste of this coffee, reminded my husband and I of espresso we had in Siily, Italy a few years ago.
Just so you know, you can usually get this at your local bodega or Mexican grocery store for less than half the price.  I'm like 1500 miles from Mexico and I can still find it locally.
This cracker is good for gluten free, but not so good that I would buy them if I wasn't gluten intolerant.

Order arrived on schedule. I tried it and found it very strong but the I made a large cup and it is bold but not bitter, just the way I like it.
I would order it again.

"Reduced fat" food is something I pretty much never eat. If I don't want to get a bunch of empty calories from some sugary thing, I just don't eat it. The diet versions invariably taste like cardboard, and who wants that instead of sugary treats? I only ate these because of the Vine program, and I have to say, I was shocked by how much I liked them.

First, they actually taste like caramel corn, which was quite a treat. The chocolate drizzle is really not that noticeable, but that's not a huge problem unless you're buying this specifically because of the chocolate (and you probably aren't, right?). Second, the portion size is remarkably large. How they give you this much food for 130 calories I do not understand. The little pouch must have had 20-30 pieces of popcorn in it. As a little after-work snack, there was almost too much here. That's not a bad problem to have!

Overall, very pleasantly surprised. If this is your kind of thing, or even if it isn't, you may want to check it out. This is an intriguing product.
When this product was unavailable in my town, I found Amazon to be a good source. THe product was as advertised and I would trade again.

Since personally I cannot read what this package really says, I was curious to try them. I had received a couple of these at work and was curious if they tasted like flowers or not, so I ordered my own bag, well when I got my bag of candy, I popped one in my mouth, the taste is very good, candy is shaped like a flower, so I'm guessing that is where the flower part comes into play. Flower tasting or not, very satisfied with this candy!
I used the agave nectar on some mixed berries and was pleasantly surprised how sweet they became in a short time.

This Wolfgang Puck coffee tasted great. The vanilla flavoring is just right. Some reviews said it was not so good, not enough flavoring, etc. Don't pay attention to the bad reviews posted on here. I have never posted for a product and I have tried many different k-cups. This is a good k-cup and don't hesitate to purchase this flavor because of the negative feedback. I almost hesitated and didn't buy it and then I figured I would give it a shot. It was worth it to pick the vanilla francaise flavor. You will enjoy it. It tastes better then other k cup vanilla flavors like folgers and van houtte flavor.
My dogs love these, and they help clean their teeth.  I have bought them for 4 years. However, Virback has reduced the size over the last several months- without reducing the price.

Beetlejuice Beetlejuice [Blu-ray] is a timeless classic with Michael Keaton providing an excellent performance. The afterlife concept of the film is excellent as well as entertaining; this film is a must for your video library... It's to be watched over and over again.

The casting for this film is perfect, Michael Keaton is the outrageously funny and whacky witted (Betelguese - the afterlife's leading freelance bio-exorcist) with Alec Baldwin and Geena Davis playing (Adam and Barbara Maitland), a young couple that die prematurely. Adding to the cast are Jeffrey Jones and Catherine O'Hara (as Charles and Delia Deetz, and their Goth daughter Winona Ryder (as Lydia).

One of the most hilarious scenes is the dinner party accompanied by Harry Belafonte's Banana Boat song `Day-O'. This is truly Tim Burton at his finest taking the significance of being dead and dousing it with humor.
The bread packets are ready to go into your bread machine, and they come out hot and delicious.  I would recommend these delicious packets to anyone who has a bread maker, and loves hot bread.

The Back To Nature Juice is very healthy for children. The taste is great and the pouches are great for traveling. My children thought they were the same as Caprisun so they didn't notice a difference in taste which was great. I selected these as a healthier alternative for my children with Autism. They only complaint I have is the packaging however it could very well be the delivery Amazon choose. These were brought by UPS and upon opening after ordering a few times a few had burst inside of the box. Amazon was very courteous about replacing it. The packaging is the only reason why I'm giving 4 stars.

I liked this dinner kit as to me it seemed the flavor balance was a tad better than the other Kraft Velveeta dinners we have tried. What I liked about this dinner was the seasoning balance and it didn't seem so salty. I did add a shake of salt and pepper to my serving to help spice things up.

What my kids thought the dinner was too bland. They preferred the Velveeta barbecue chicken dinner as compared to this one.

Recommend.

This is a fine product.  My daughter eats it right up and seems to enjoy it.  I will say however that it is very liquidy (no texture) so I have more drips when feeding her.  I wish it were a bit more solid in texture (I really like Plum Baby Food due to the texture).  Again, daughter loves it.

During a recent trip back east, I had a similar item purchased at the Cracker Barrel restaurant. These candies are not quite as tasty, but very close. The problem is that it is very easy to pop these squares in your mouth and keep snacking without realizing how many you've had. Good taste, crunchy but not too hard, not healthy at all but delicious and I'll buy again.

These are bigger than normal peanuts and the taste good. It does not have the taste of Spanish peanuts but have a good taste. I like Spanish peanuts but the price is on the higher side than this product

These pockets are the only thing that helps our beagle take his allergy medication.  Otherwise, he spits the pill out.  His pill is small enough that I can break the pockets in half and use half for one pill.  They are expensive-but great!
Were not as big as I had expected, but this was not a reflection of the shipper.  But they did come on time.
Bought it for the ice cream maker which did not make ice cream since then sitting in the fridge.

This chocolate is good, but it tastes more like a candy chocolate due to its sweetness. It has a good mouth feel and texture but for "dark" chocolate it tastes a little to sweet. Packaging is good, and the sample I got was well preserved, not old or dried out like some chocolate bars you get in the store.

Overall as a candy or treat this is good, environmentally responsible chocolate.
We have a picky dog and this is the only food he will eat. Thanks

I had soba noodles a few months ago at a restaurant and really liked it. So I was hoping to find some good noodles to make my own soup. I haven't been able to find the noodles that tastes like the restaurant yet, but this one is the best one I found in term of texture and taste. Also, it's cheap.

Delicious full bodied coffee.  I alternate this one with the medium roast, depending on my taste at the time.  But all of the senseo coffees are good.  It is so easy to make a cup of coffee. and another fresh cup whenever I want it, in one minute.

This was a great little snack.  I'm a big fan of chocolate-drizzled caramel popcorn.  This was not the BEST I've ever had but it was very good, especially considering that this is a 100-calorie pack.  There are six such packs in each box with a nice portion in each bag.  I don't think you'll be disappointed - I wasn't.

The bottle may make you think this is a salad dressing. It's not. It's a smooth, medium consistency, tangy sauce. It is a little spicy, but not overly so. I haven't tasted anything similar to it at a Taco Bell fast food restaurant. I first tried it on chicken tacos and it was pretty good. Where it really shined, though, was as part of a dip. I added a bit of sour cream, cilantro and finely chopped tomatoes. It was quite good. I would definitely serve it to guests.

My wife brought a couple variety packs of Fruit Gushers for the last Halloween give-away. Unfortunately, we had a few packs left over so we've been consuming them from time to time. My wife likes to give them to our toddler as a little reward. He loves them, of course. Actually, they are rather good. They're a candy that looks like a small irregular blob. It's soft to the touch and tastes fruity. The trick is that when you bite down the soft blob crushes and releases a sweet and fruity flavored syrup into the mouth. They're quite flavorful and enjoyable to eat. My main worry would be that the candy itself is quite sticky and hard to get off the teeth, so brush carefully after indulging.

Gary Peterson

I love organic food for my children and this multigrain cereal is the best so far, only it come is a huge container that is only half full, what a waist... I like to be earth friendly and I don't like over packaging like this.
Otherwise good product

I bought this out of curiosity and out of the fact that I was just craving some jerky. The original flavor has a mild peppery taste to it and it's really tasty. It's mostly tender, but there are some strips of meat that have beef tendons, making the strips really hard to chew. Yes, there does seem to be some sort of "grit" in the beef jerky, but I'm not really too bothered by it. The other thing I don't like about this is that there are sometimes (just sometimes) strips of meat that have no flavor. But overall, I think this was a pretty good buy. I might buy it again, but only after I try some other brands.

This food is one of the best values for high-quality cat food. My cats seemed to love it at first. Now, a few months after I started feeding this to them, they will still eat it (peas and all), but only after it sits there for a while and they realize that there are no other options for dinner.

As always Haribo Products are the best when it comes to taste. This product is hard to find but is great specially if you are into sour gummies.The only reason I give it 4 not 5 stars is the cost. over 5 dollars for a small bag (175gm-5.8 ounces) seems a little pricy to me.

Since peanut butter preference is in the mouth of the beholder, I'll sum up what I liked about this Planters brand:

(1) There was no oily aftertaste. In some variations, the oil separates from the peanut butter and makes it taste strange or look "sweaty" but I didn't notice that here.

(2) Planters has a very smooth consistency. Some peanut butters rip up the bread you're using or require a dental pick to remove it from your teeth because they stick like glue...Planters didn't do this.

(3) While trying other peanut butter brands, there were some that added ingredients such as molasses...I was glad to see Planters had no additional flavorings.

All in all, I enjoyed this peanut butter very much. It made several delicious PB&J sandwiches, and it's the perfect companion for a lonely Hershey bar.

Recommended!

I had been reading about Farro for a while and was very curious to try it. I purchased the 3 pound bag because it was a great price.

The first thing I did was make a Farro Mac and Cheese that was featured in Rachael Ray's magazine. My husband went insane, he loved it so much. Its a very hearty grain, but is also very creamy....almost like barley....making it a great addition for soups, salads and casseroles. I froze the leftovers and they held up very, very well.

My only complaint was in the packaging...there wasn't instructions on how to prepare it. Just a specific recipe using Farro as an ingredient. However, I looked it up online and was able to find a lot of basic preparation recipes.

It seems like whenever I read about a new ingredient and can't find it at any of my local grocery stores, I can always find it at Amazon.

I will definitely purchase this again!
I don't know why, because it doesn't look very appetizing, but my two dachshunds love this stuff and scarf it down with great abandon.
For the price you cant beet it. It is not to sweet, but enough to have some flavor, and it really does taste like root beere.

For what is is, this cookie is pretty good. Does it taste like the soft, under-baked, buttery kind you get from a bakery or your favorite shoppe? No, however it does satisfy a sweet tooth. In my opinion these taste just like a "less sweet" version of the chips ahoy brand I ate as a kid.
This candy might be sugar free but it is VERY HIGH in Carbs. So if you are diabetic and looking for something sweet to eat, this is not the answer.

I wish I knew what was really in this variety. It doesn't say much on the can.  I toss this one in for a little variety, but it's not his favorite.  He loves the carved versions the best, but he tolerates this one as one of those I use for a little change of pace for my cat.  He appreciates it some, I think, but seldom eats the entire can.  But I really would like to know what it consists of so I know what he's eating.  The gravy sure looks nice and the pieces are a nice size as well - not too big so he can get it into his small mouth.
I used this tea to make a black currant ice cream from the Perfect Scoop book. It tasted great! The tea has a beautiful smell.

I love fruit-flavored coffees, especially blueberry. I also like darker roasts, and unfortunately, fruit flavors often have to be light roasts for the flavor to come through. This brand pulls off the "Blueberry Muffin" taste very well, while still being a medium roast that hasn't lost it's coffee-ness. I'm impressed!

I find Kashi products to usually be hit or miss. Overall, this is a hit. Neither the chocolate or banana taste overwhelms the other and the texture is fine. This is for people who enjoy Kashi products, if you never had anything by them I would start somewhere else.

This popcorn was fine.  But I recently purchased some Jollytime brand white popcorn at a local grocery store.  Of course way less expensive than the price of this product.  Jollytime was $1.50 for 2 lb bag and I'd say the quality and tenderness was about as good.  So even though this is a fine product, don't think I'd pay this premium when I can get something pretty similar at the local grocery store.

This initially tasted bitter compared to 'Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Blackstrap Molasses'. After using this for a few days i don't find it that bitter, but i may go back to using the Wholesome's product because of the taste. The label claims this has 20% iron and 15% magnesium compared to 15% and 8% respectively for Wholesome's molasses.

These are the same Honey Graham Crackers we grew up on, in a new package to keep them fresh.

If you are one of those who finds yourself throwing away the rest of your graham crackers because they get stale, you'll find these Fresh Stacks a more convenient way of keeping them fresh. They come 8 squares to a package, and can be more handily used in this smaller size package.

However, if you are looking for something to carry with you (lunch, snack, etc.) you need to note that these packages are each TWO servings. What is nice is that the package clearly notes the nutritional value for both the single serving AND the package size. The package size has 250 calories and 6 grams of fat, as well as 46 grams of carbs - a "hefty" snack for anyone trying to moderate either item. In fact, if you add peanut butter to these (I keep the individual packs of peanut butter on hand, which could be easily used with these), you hit 500 calories.

While I appreciate the convenience, I would most likely compare the price with the "regular" packaging before I purchased these, and carry the individual servings in a sandwich bag. Good idea ... just don't assume one serving per package. ;-)

Try these if you can't have gluten. Crackers are one of the things I miss most and these are a nice platform for a good cheddar, creamed herring, or smoked salmon. I like the fennel overtones. As anyone who has ever searched for a great (or even good) gluten free cracker it's difficult.

With that said, they often are broken and I hate the little foil pouches they come in - you can't reseal them or fold them over. I am looking forward to trying the vegetable Glutinos. I also wish they could be browned a little more - might give them a little more resistance to the teeth. At any rate, give 'em a try.

I have consumed no fewer than 30 or 40 packs of this gum over the past year or two, mostly because it consistently outlasts other gum (both in flavor and texture--it doesn't become very tough, even after hours of chewing). I'm not a fan of all of the plastic each one comes wrapped in, as that contributes yet another large supply to our landfills, so I knocked off a star for product packaging.

That being said, this Amazon price is absurd. The only place you'll see a buck seventy per pack is at a convenience store--grocery stores are 40-50 cents less, and the 3-pack at a grocery store comes out to about a dollar a pack. The TEN pack should be cheaper, because you're buying more! Costco and Sam's both sell these bulk packages for less than a dollar per pack of gum...
