This product arrived in a timely manner, well packed & in good condition.
The pamphlet does say the cheese should be quite safe to consume even after a couple of days 'at room temperature'. Here a temp range should be provided.
With the aid of the package tracking feature it should be possible to take a guess at how long a shipment may have been without proper cooling and whether or not that is a factor to you.

Lovely product, strong & distinctive.

Was much less pricey--including the S & H-- from IGourmet than any of our local vendors. We do intend to order from IGourmet again.

The first ingredient listed on this product is propylene glycol and while this is an "organic" compound which has many uses including non toxic antifreeze; It is rather misleading as the first ingredient really should not qualify this to be called "PURE" hazelnut

Ok, so I never buy this coffee on Amazon--I think it is actually cheaper at the grocery store, which is the only reason I took off one star. The only reasons I started buying it were (a) it was cheap and (b) it came in a can, and I like to re-purpose coffee cans. Since then, I have not been able to find a coffee I like more (at least when it comes to home-made coffee). I've tried Starbucks and Dunkin'and didn't care for either--I make both hot and iced coffee in a french press, so that might have something to do with it.

My boss gave me a small can of this seasoning for Christmas, and I soon grew addicted to sprinkling it on popcorn, fish, vegetables, you name it!  It is spicy yet flavorful, and doesn't overpower the flavor of the food.  Before long I had used mine all up and craved more!  So glad to find the larger size on Amazon.  It is cost effective and should last me a long time.
We have been getting this syrup for close to a year and really like it. Like that it supports a small company.

My daughter had severe gas pains for the first three months of her life, which caused her to be extremely fussy--especially during the evenings. She would scream and cry and refused to be soothe for about three hours every night due to her gas pains. We almost feared that we had a colicky baby, but around 3-3.5 months old she started settling down as her digestive system matured. She was BF for the first 6 months, so needless to say, when we had to slowly start transitioning her to formula around 5.5 months (due to low milk production) I was terrified that the painful gas and fussiness would return. My daughter wouldn't take the powder version and they used RTF at the hospital to supplement her the first couple of days due to low birth weight. I mixed Enfamil's Infant Premium and Gentlease RTFs in the beginning in hopes to transition her to 100% Infant Premium (which she is on now). I am not entirely sure if Gentlease helped with my daughter's fussiness and gas, but it definitely didn't hurt or upset her digestive system. It didn't interrupt her daily BM (considering that she was coming from full-time BF to formula) and she also didn't notice the taste difference from the Infant Premium.

After reading the other reviewer's comment about receiving spoiled formula, I tasted each can I opened. Gentlease tastes like a slightly watered down version of the Infant Premium, but it does have a very slight bitter after taste that the Infant Premium doesn't have (which is normal). The formula from Amazon had a long expiration date (which means it was fresher) and the cans were dent-free, but I still made sure to taste every batch I made. The cans do need to be opened with a can opener and must be used within 48 hours after opening. I transferred the entire contents to an airtight pitcher and used it that way because you should not be storing an open can in the fridge. Overall, I liked the formula and would recommend people give it a try to ease the transition from BF to formula.

We really like this cereal. My whole family eats it almost every morning, even my preschooler. I mix it equal parts with rolled oats, and add dried/fresh fruit and nuts. It is bland by itself but great with the fruit. I also replace a portion of the flour with it in many baking recipes like banana bread and similar items and you cant tell the difference. Very good.

Ive been drinking coconut water my whole life and seriously LOVE the stuff. When I first found VitaCoco all i could think was these guys are geniuses and somehow managed to create a coconut drink that actually tastes like the real coconut. When I saw amazon was selling the product in boxes of 6 i thought, "Even better, its shipped right to my door." That is until i received my second shipment and found a box full of sticky Vita Coco packages with two of the boxes open and half empty. I decided it would be apt o return the boxes, but for whatever reason, that is not in the Amazon return policy.

Conclusion:
Love the product, but the shipment packaging sucks and Amazon wont allow you to receive credit or return the broken boxes.

This is an excellent honey mustard, great for dipping.  Be sure and check your order carefully because my order had some busted bottles and broken seals under the tops that leaked everywhere. Company reshipped the items to me quickly without any hassle.

The only local Italian deli sold out of this for Christmas. It was a real treat to find it online. Two nice smaller (than I usually buy) fillets arrived, wrapped in plastic with a (totally melted) ice pack -- you shouldn't really need an ice pack for salted fish, should you? It was packed in a lot of styrofoam peanuts which also really seems unnecessary for fish. Maybe we could cut back on the shipping charges somehow?

I cover mine in water and bring just to a boil then quickly drain. It takes 3 times with the deli cod, but only 2 times with this. It's a bit more delicate (due to smaller fish?). I always break mine apart by hand and feel for bones, and just like the deli's, this had exactly one bone in it. It's like they want you to have to keep checking for bones. There's always just one.

Updated 7/8/2012:
On my second order of this, I got the dregs from the bottom of the case. It might weigh 1.5 pounds, but it's made up of tiny scraps of fish, all very thin. No full fillets. I'm very disappointed in the drop in quality and have dropped the stars rating to 4. BTW, they had 4 left when I bought 3 and now they still have 2! must have found more crumbs on the floor. Don't buy until they get a new shipment in would be my recommendation.

The second batch did arrive without a plastic bag and ice, which was really never necessary. But it was poorly wrapped in white paper and the outer box was broken open at the corner. That wonderful (to me) smell of salted cod got me a lot of complaints at my mailbox company. These should be well-wrapped in white butcher's waxed paper, people, before shipping, and shipped in a box that is sealed, please.

I got this for my daughter who loves plants and watching them grow over time. She has 3 of these but with different type of plants.

As far as "fun" I don't know.. I mean, it's a plant, so it takes time!

Nice product!

From reading all the amazing reviews, I expected it to taste better than it did. I love regular peanut butter, so I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up. I think if you manage your expectations about taste, this is a good purchase to ease your PB tooth! It works best mixed with some regular PB and in recipes (versus eating it plain or on a sandwich). Def worth a try!
purchased this popcorn for a gift to a friend for her "amish" birthday.  It arrived in good condition.

While I don't know a lot about Indian food, I was treated to some Indian food that was rated "very good" by some friends who know a lot more about that cuisine than I. I immediately went on-line to see if I could find a recipe so my wife and I could cook it at home, but the more recipes I found, the more confused I became about what would taste closest to what I had eaten.

As I searched, this product came up, and on a whim, I decided to order a kit. It quickly arrived, and with the exception of meat or poultry and oil to fry the meat in and yogurt for the sauce, comes complete. Opening the spice packets, the delightful smell of cardoman, dried chiles, and garlic powder filled the kitchen, so I was favorably impressed (and surprised) with the apparent freshness of the ingredients. The jasmine rice, while not as flavorful as some I've used, was fine.

Using organic chicken breasts, I quickly and easily cooked a very tasty meal. While I'm sure results might have been a bit better using freshly sauteed garlic, coconut, and onion, we enjoyed this flavorful meal that was both quick and easy. I will try the lamb soon.

RECOMMENDED

I break this out as a treat when the family has a big barbecue and our nearly 2-year-old chocolate lab Sampo can barely contain himself, migrating from one person to the next begging for scraps and bones that might kill him. It's a nice, gourmet step up from his usual kibble, and he loves the heck out of it. Same goes for a much smaller dog, my friend's tiny little westie terrier Lucy; obviously she gets a lot less, but she has a lot of allergies and intolerances, and this food agrees with her in every way. You're probably hard pressed to find a dog who wouldn't go ga-ga for this tasty treat.
Less acid? You wouldn't know. Puroast has an excellent coffee for those of us who can't do regular coffee.  Well worth it!

I've only tried strawberry but I truly like it. After reading the reviews I didn't expect it to taste like icecream, so I wasn't disappointed. I would buy this product again - just wish it wasn't so expensive.

Always a favourite of mine in UK.  This drink mixes well with spiced rum.  It proved a hit with my US friends and is capable of crossing the pond in a single bound.....SUPER!  The Amazon product information would be improved with ingredients information as shown on the bottle.

I love this stuff.  Tasty, no calories, not too sweet, better than the awful Crystal Light.  Hard to find, 'tho.  American's love their sweet soda!  Ignore the other reviews. If you like green tea, this is great stuff.

Very tasty! More spice than I would've anticipated. Cooks quickly (~4-5 mins). Impressed with overall quality and flavor of these instant noodles. Used to Top Ramen, but these are above average, that's for sure. Premium ingredients packet contained a good mix of chicken, spices, and peppers, much to my delight. Perfect for a quick snack/meal. Would recommend to others!

we ordered our squid ink and got it quickly!! I thought it was out of date but they were very friendly and helpful to help me understand that it wasn't i would order from this person again and again!!

I really think this is the best juice for kids. It tastes WAY less sweet that regular kids juice, even juices with an equal amount of sugar. It has lots of vitamins! It's the ONLY juice my kids drink! When they get apple juice at other kid's houses they think it's too sweet.

The only reason I gave it 4 stars and not 5, is price and availability. When I started buy the juice it was everywhere, grocery store, Target,etc. Now I can only find it in one store and at Amazon. It is also pretty expensive especially because it's the only juice my kids drink and I have 3 kids!!

I have had Green Mountain coffee before, but had not tried the French Roast.  I am just realizing that there is a taste difference between different manufacturers, even with the same types of roasts.  The Green Mountain French Roast has the flavor I like and was expecting.  The price was reasonable and my order shipped quickly.  My only disappointment was in the shipping packaging.  I knew that I was ordering 2 boxes of K-cups but was surprised to see how big the shipping box was.  There was room for 3 boxes, with the extra space filled with bubble-wrap, which seems wasteful to me.  But on the whole, I am very happy with my coffee!

These are so yummy!  And sooo easy to make.  The only downfall is that we find it difficult to bake them evenly.  We have begun making them in cupcake pans and this seems to work great.  If you have a mini muffin pan it might even work better.  When you use a cake pan the outside is baked nicely but the center is gooey.  If you try baking the center the edges get burnt... at least in our experience.

My son loves the old fashioned filled hard Xmas candy.  I purchased this rock candy which looked close to the old kind for one of his Xmas presents.  This candy was close but not quite like the old kind of candy.  Wish you would stock the old candy so there would not be a hassle of ordering from another company.  I've been looking for the candy for 2 years with no luck so I settled for this.

MIO makes a wonderfully tasty product that is simple to use and flavor plain water.  Unlike prepackaged granules, this liquid will let you adjust the flavor, so if you don't want to be overpowered, you can just add a few drops.  This is incredibly concentrated so I recommend that you start with one squirt for 8 oz. of water and add more until you figure out exactly how strong you want it to taste.  I also discovered that this is great to add to plain ice tea since it will flavor and sweeten it at the same time.

I love how Velveeta makes a creamier, richer sauce than the powder mix in boxes so I ordered this. I usually make my mac and cheese with a loaf version of Velveeta and my own noodles, but for just 2 of us, this seems a lot easier. Good to have on hand for those moments you don't know what to make. Smooth, creamy and cheesy. An ultimate comfort food. It's not my homemade but it's very good for what it is.

I was worried about this product being on recall until I was notified that this version isn't on the recall list!

From "The Simpsons": The recall is for the microwave version ONLY, and only the ones with "use by" dates between March and May 2012.

My dogs love their Greenies, and their teeth are pearly white from chewing on them.  The only problem is that Greenies are expensive, so I buy them in bulk on Amazon to keep the prices down a little bit,
This has a great, fresh, finishing salt. I personally prefer Murray River Pink Salt for the more delicate crunch, but I do like this for a change. Try both!
we love this granola, lots of crunch and healthy ingredients.  its good with yogurt.  watch the calories though!

Quick and easy meal. Very tasty, and as a vegetarian
I like that there is some chewiness to it. I especially
like this on chilly evenings, or when I turn the a/c down
and pretend it's a chilly evening :) (Live in southern part
of Florida so I have to pretend a lot lol)
The tea is really smooth and has a very nice taste.  It takes only seconds to prepare.  No boiling water.  The pod is great, as well as this tea.

These are good little crackers but not quite the goldfish taste we were looking for. Hard to get that flavor in a gluten free product I guess...still the closest we have been able to come to having our dearly missed little goldfish crackers.

Having drank at LEAST 30+ different KCUP flavors from Timothy's, Diedrich's, Green Mountain, Gloria Jean's, and Van Houtte, I think is one of the best! Unlike other reviewers, I really LIKE the aroma and taste--it seems to be a medium, flavorful, roast. DON'T be influenced by reviews, I would recommend you TRY it as I've HATED other flavors (Coffee People Doughnut Shop, for example) that MANY enjoy and has good reviews.

These are the BEST crackers I've ever tasted.  They have crunch, a slightly sweet taste and most importantly: sesame seeds.  I adore them.  And, have been looking for them for years since my favorite gourmet store stopped carrying 'em.  That was a big mistake on their part.  I'm just thrilled to have found them on Amazon.  For those who are watching their wasteline this is a great lil' snack without the guilt.  Try 'em, they're GOOD!!!!!
I was expecting some heat with these sardines. I was disappointed. These sardines are pretty much swimming in tomato soup. I dump two cans into a bowl and call it a meal.

I bought this product to take backpacking.  It worked quite well by adding cold water and letting soak for an hour. The  beans were still hard a bit in the center so heated them and that was all it took.  Quite tasty BUT they taste salted to me.  If you are on a restricted diet for low or no-sodium added, beware.  The maker does not disclose that the beans have been salted as far as I could see.  I think it should be written somewhere to warn folks.
This is good stuff - I replaced my plain black pepper on the table with this and it's not real hot but has more flavor.

Good option for K-Cup coffee makers.  The filter pod fits right into the machine and brews a great cup of coffee with less plastic waste.  The packaging allows a pretty good price point, but for a stronger better tasting coffee  (you know the one named after the actor) I will stay with club stores 80 pack for $39, keeping the coffee price just below that 50c mark.
This coffee had good flavor and aroma. I find that most of the Mexican coffee's to be good in flavor. I would buy again.

You know those quart milk cartons? That's what this is; a LOT of salt, enough to last thru literally hundreds of pounds of popcorn. Well worth the few bucks, so don't overthink it. More than enough salt to share with friends or family if you don't want to keep it around for years, as you will likely not use it all before the date printed on the package.

I'm using coconut oil and Flavacol as many posters have suggested. This combo makes GREAT popcorn! On the stovetop, I'm heating the oil, adding the Flavorcol, then the kernels. It's popping up fluffy and yellow. Great smell and great taste. Then I bought a West Bend Stir Crazy, adding the salt to the oil as some reviewiers suggested. Absolutely love the convenience of the Stir Crazy over the stovestop, but too much salt remains on the popper, so I just shake it on immediately after popping, while still hot.

Right now, I'm not using fancy or gourmet popcorn, just the regular store stuff. It is still great.

Couple of tips:

1) The package lists recommended amount of product for the amount of popcorn you're making. Remember, this product is basically salt with artificial flavor and color added, so preferences will vary. Start with the recommended amount on the package and experiment. Just remember, you can always add more if not salty enough, but your batch is ruined if you use too much.

2) I use a dredge (shaker) for easier dispensing. The carton is not convenient for regular usage.

So if you're a popcorn lover and want to take your popcorn to the next level, this is a good start.

This Breakfast Blend from Green Moutain coffee company is my favorite flavor of coffee when I just want a regular cup of coffee without that extra kick from a bold blend or a flavored coffee.  It has always been consistent and calming in its flavor.  It is top-notch coffee.

Earth's Best Baby Food
My favorite brand of baby food by far. Both my son (who is now over 2 years old) and my daughter (now almost one) have used a wide variety of foods from Earth's Best. I am a huge proponent of feeding children primarily organic and/or locally grown foods to promote proper nutrition and growth. But I do not feel that all organic brands are equal. I've tried many varieties (including store brands and others only available through internet purchase) and found that Earth's Best is by far the best for your money.

1st Fruit Starter Kit
If you're like me trying to decide what flavor to give your baby the first time can be difficult. I had an idea because of going through this with my son, but my daughter (as it turns out) has completely different likes and dislikes. This variety comes with pears, bananas and apples. It's pretty basic and on a whole I think most babies like all of these, but you just never know. That's why I like it in this kit. You can try them out without having to hand pick and sort through a bunch at the store. It takes the guessing out of it. Yes, the price is a little high, but if you just need something to get you started it's great!

The cookies arrived, albeit a few more broken inside than I'd like, but I really enjoy them.  They are not overly sweet, have a nice buttery texture, and the dried bluberries offer a good contrast to the rest of the cookie.  However, I assumed (never do that...) that they were reasonably low calorie, but in fact the serving size is three cookies and the calorie count is well over 100 for that amount.  They are addictive, so watch out!  All in all, a good cookie with a nice flavor and no funky aftertaste.  Just break out the food scale or bag up 3 in your lunch box and leave the rest of the pack at home!

I refuse to compare this product to something like a fruit and cereal bar.  It is a health food bar and, lets face it, most of those are horrible.  I will agree that the banana and chocolate flavors don't really come out and there is a hint of a burned flavor, but all in all, I found them to be okay.  Compared to other health food bars, they were pretty good.  I actually really liked the texture.  They were filling, fairly low calorie, and pretty healthy.  I went through the whole box in a few days and didn't share any with my kids, so that is saying something!

These nibs are very bitter, but I knew they would be.  I eat a pinch or two whenever I get a chocolate craving and they sure do kill the craving, which is what I, a huge chocolate junky, was looking for.  A little bit goes a looooooong way ;-).

Next to the Goya Pico, I think this is the best locally available salsa on the shelves
today.

I did note other reviews that said this product had "changed." That could be, the company
was bought by the giant food processor and enemy of the consumer Hormel. Not long ago, Hormel
was a name you could depend on, but they have reformulated so many of their canned products
its impossible to recognize them anymore.

In any event, this is still a very good salsa, much better than all your other store bought
options, and at a better price than all the boutique salsas that keep popping up for insane
ticket prices like $6-7 a jar. A fresh tomato and onion base with the enough chiles to get
your attention, and the exact blend of garlic and cilantro will make you beg for more. The
perfect compliment to any meal, or just on chips or even to reconstitute dishes like spaghetti
or to enhance soups, you will absolutely love this stuff.
This food is very tasty - my cats love it and as soon as I put it down, they all rush to eat.  Ingredients are top quality.  Highly recommended.

This honey is very pale, thick, and translucent, almost opalescent. It's actually rather pretty when you let it run through a fork. The smell and taste are both mild but pleasant. The smell is similar to vanilla, and the taste is a buttery vanilla. It has an immediate aftertaste that is a bit bitter, but a sweetness that lingers for a while. I think the flavor would be quickly lost in cooking or baking (it might works with seafood, but I don't think I'd try it with red meat), but it would go very well with white and green tea, and mild herbal teas.

There were a few of the flavors that were not good (to us).  Subjective here because what we didn't like, others might.  Overall; good combination of flavors and a nice way to find out what you like and what you don't.

I have a total sweet tooth, and routinely get shocked looks when people see how much sugar I add to my tea. To the extent possible, with cold drinks, I try and use Splenda, since it dissolves quickly and evenly. However, I've never liked it for hot drinks -- that wisp of bitterness and artificial taste comes across stronger. This sweetener solves that problem, I've used it in a variety of hot teas and found it to be uniformly superior in taste to Splenda. I've tried it in cold drinks too (iced tea and iced coffee) and found it to be slightly stronger tasting than regular Splenda. So, I'm not sure I'm going to make the switch for cold drinks, but definitely for hot!

Note: I'll admit that I have no idea what monk fruit is, and obviously I haven't researched the effects of using this stuff for twenty years. Also folks should check the label to see just exactly what else is in this besides monk fruit extract.

We've gone through all of the flavors now three times. Both cats chowed down quite happily on the food. The boy got quite vocal and insistent the next few days about how much he wanted more of the wet food. Far, far more vocal than he got after getting the 9 Lives canned food before. Judging from that it seems to be tastier.

It definitely looks more appealing to me. Actual flakes of fish, small shrimp, no unpleasant smell beyond a slight seafood smell. After putting the food into a bowl the can doesn't look nasty either. White interior, no discoloration spots. A quick rinse gets rid of any remaining juices before tossing the can in the recycle bin.

Can is made of aluminum, not steel. Cans are opened with a pull-tab, no can opener required. The other cat food we had varied; some flavors had a tab on the can to open it and others required a can opener. In our house it's much nicer when it has a tab to open. Otherwise I had to go hunting for the can opener after pulling the bowls out of the cupboard. And of course the cats heard the clang of the bowls coming out of the cupboard which meant they appeared within seconds and promptly started exclaiming how much they wanted the wet stuff while weaving in between the legs in an attempt to get me to give them the food as fast as possible. We all know how difficult it can be to dodge cats weaving around underfoot while digging through drawers and cupboards searching for the can opener.

Amusingly, the label lists the product as being gluten free. Not something I expected to see on the label.

Overall we're pleased. I'm not offended by the way the product looks or smells and the cats love it. My only complaint is that it is rather pricey compared to other options.

Update Feb 17, 2009:
Well, after trying this I started sampling some other upscale cat foods. I also started reading the ingredients. I had no idea that wheat gluten was such a common ingredient. Now that makes sense.

As for price, it is close to the price range for other upscale / premium / gourmet (whatever you want to call the small expensive cans) cat foods. Without subscribe & save the pricing is a bit higher here compared to what the other premium foods go for in the local stores. With subscribe & save there isn't as much difference.

I didn't think I would want to spend this much on cat food yet I just ordered some more. To me there is significant value in that it doesn't have that 'canned cat food' smell. You know what I'm talking about, and it really isn't a great way to wake up in the morning. It also helps that Petite Cuisine is more visually appealing than the other stuff.

The menadione thing? From what I can find that may be valid. Most of the stuff online references (and quotes) one article but the material safety sheet does have notes about toxicity of the substance to human organs at high doses. It is in other pet foods as well, not just Petite Cuisine, so if you're concerned about it you need to read the label of any product.

I did contact the company asking about it and stated that I was concerned about its use in their product. If enough people contact them about it explaining their concern they may rethink using it as an ingredient. For me, I'll probably use it in rotation with other foods. Hopefully I can find something that doesn't stink and doesn't have any potentially objectionable ingredients.

I was really glad to find a treat that is actually just meat (without grains or additives), since my cat has a sensitive stomach.

We have tried Turkey, Chicken, and Beef Liver.

My cat LOVES them except the Beef Liver - they will sit out for several hours before he eats them (if he eats them at all). After a couple tries, I ended up getting rid of those. They must be really bad - I've never seen him reject any food in the past.

He seems to really like the Chicken, but some of the weight in the bag is "chicken dust"..so the only way to really feed it to him is to sprinkle it over his food once all the actual treats have been eaten.

Overall, I think it's a good product.
The price is great, and he gets pretty excited whenever we go near where they're kept.

I love real Scottish haggis and this brand, though American made, isn't too bad.  A bit bland compared to what I've eaten in Scotland. I improve it by adding some ground pepper and a touch of nutmeg, even a few drops of scotch on occasion.  I wish I had ordered more before the price went up.  It was a good deal at first,  less expensive than buying it at the Scottish shops in N. Carolina.  I buy it much less often since the price increase.

This chocolate is good, but I've had better.  I give it three stars for the flavor and texture, and one more star because it's all organic.  For the price, I expected a smoother flavor.  Scharffen Berger's Extra Dark chocolate is much smoother.  Newman's tastes like it has some powdered milk in it.
This is the only kibble my toy poodle, Susie, will eat. It's a good thing it's so good for her.
Very good coffee if you like it bold, real good flavor and you can bring down the boldness with a creamer.

We use powdered creamer regularly in our household.  Typically this meant Coffee Mate, Cremora or occasionally a store brand at the expense of taste.  Decided to give this one a try recently as I tired of seeing Coffee Mate everywhere and watching its price increase.  Community Coffee is good coffee so how bad could their creamer bad.  Well ... actually pretty good.  At least as good as Coffee Mate, which puts it at the top of the heap for taste.  The only thing preventing 5 stars is the presence of hydrogenated oils.  Unfortunately ... they all have this and so you really can't avoid it without avoiding coffee creamer altogether.  For now at least - I'm making the switch to Community Coffee Creamer.

My daughter is a ballet major in college and she dances about 6 hours or more each day. The fluid needs are tremendous to keep the joints lubricated and to prevent dehydration, but she doesn't really like to drink plain, boring bottled water. I got her this MiO Liquid Water Enhancer, Mango Peach 1.62 fl oz (48 ml) to try so she might be encouraged to get the fluids she needs.

She added one squirt to her water as the directions indicated and found that the flavor was not quite as strong as she had hoped so had to add more to really get a good mango peach taste. Perhaps other flavors are stronger? At around $6.00 for a small container, it can get expensive since it really doesn't give enough flavoring to make the 24 8-ounce drinks as it advertises on the product label. It is a nice size, however, to carry in a purse or bag so that you can always have it with you. This water enhancer provides no vitamins so it is not nutritive as some other products are. It adds no calories to the water -- which is an important consideration for many.

It's good enough that I'd like to try more flavors, but the price is the main drawback since a person will actually likely need to add more drops if they want a strong taste of the flavoring.

Whatever your preference, this is excellent chocolate: rich, smooth and sweet on the tongue. It kicks like a cup of coffee and serves to brighten a dull afternoon. However at 54% cocoa, it doesn't really qualify as dark chocolate.

I'd draw the line for dark chocolate at about 60% cocoa content. Still rate this as a quality product, easily superior to Dove or Hershey. Newman's Organic label consistently strives for the best in their line of food products. I think they have gone for the "best" flavor here and have created a chocolate bar that is sweeter than my personal preference.

If milk chocolate is for kids, then this is merely teenage chocolate...it still has some growing up to do. Real dark chocolate doesn't get by on sweetness alone. Real dark chocolate comforts because it has known adult sorrow but has managed to overcome it without becoming too bitter. Real dark chocolate knows about sin but winks at guilt. This may be too philosophical for a review about a candy product. Have some more chocolate and don't think too much about it...

These aren't the most delicious things you'll ever eat - the taste is a little bit off and chemically.

But they're certainly better than tolerable. And that fact that you're going to want to wash them down with plenty of water? That's a good thing - you're working hard, and you could use the extra H20.

Best of all, these get the job done. They keep me from bonking during my workout..the carbs are great and the caffeine can't hurt. Amazon's price is good, too.

I've been eating this brand for the last 3 years and love it. I was eating the powdered kind but this not only tastes better but is so much easier to use. I didn't have to give up any more Plus Points on my Weight Watchers plan but it still has a awesome peanut butter taste. The only difference between this and "regular" peanut butter is that this stuff is stickier. I use on everything including using it baked goods.
These were super cute.  They're great for Easter or Spring Time and the containers were actually a little larger than I anticipated so I'm pretty happy with that!

The whole fam gobbled them down! I didn't get more than 2 I think. I am not familiar with these but my husband is all wild about them so I ordered some this year. I got the buy 3 deal. There were NO other deals on Amazon and they were wayyy expensive at the BAM stores around here if they even had them at all. They are really pretty in the box. I couldn't tell the different flavors apart. I gave the other boxes to my landlord and in-laws.
This is a wonderful vanilla for baking. The bottle with cork stopper is a nice touch and adds to the effect as a gift. Good product with a great taste.

If you want heat without the taste of peppers, this is for you. It will even add a kick to beer or soft drinks without changing the flavor. If you like the actual flavor of peppers, this probably isn't for you.

Haven't opened them yet...bought them for Book Club as we will just have read Lost in Shangrila. The survivors lived on Charms! Thought it would be fun to have them. Not sure what I will do with all the rest of them as the meeting is in November...

I must have liked these since I ate six upon opening the packet. These cookies are certainly tasty, flavored with both fig and honey. I suspect they would be delicious with cream cheese. On the other hand, as I gobbled these down, I kept wishing I were eating those delicious chewy fig newtons so I guess I'm damning them with faint praise.

Additionally one serving-- that's three cookies-- has 140 calories and 45 from fat.

I see from the packet that Nabisco offers other fruit thins as well.
I bought this due to my dog seeming to have a food allergy to corn and grains. He eats it and seems to enjoy it so time will tell if this solves his skin problems.

I am trying to eat a better diet. I am making smoothies at home with some items I had never heard of before. I was very lucky and found organic raw Cacao powder,(on Amazon.com) that comes from Peru. It was only $10.00 for a pound , except that free shipping got me again! My order was separated into almost all single packages. Which a course had to have shipping charges when the price of the items in their packages was not enough for the limit of (guess what) free shipping. I paid as much in shipping as I paid for the product. But, who do I know in Peru to go to the grocery store and pick up some Raw Cacao powder and drop it in the mail for me.

I can no longer afford pure Jamaica blue mountain.  Reggie's Roast comes close - I don't know how much blue mountain is in the blend but I can definitely taste it.  On the subscribe and save program I'm getting it for $8 for a 12 oz can.  Just the ticket for my daily grind and brew.

Yes, this is good chocolate. Yes, it's addicting. If you like aerated chocolate and the flavor of Hershey's chocolate in particular, you'll love this.

While it reminded me of the Choco-lite from the 70's, the flavor and composition of the bar is different. It's as if someone emptied the inside of a solid Hershey's bar and filled it with an aerated chocolate that also tasted like a Hershey's bar.

It's good, don't get me wrong. If you're looking for a Choco-lite experience, it will do in a pinch, but it's not the same to me.

I like coconut - pretty much in/on anything and everything. I took a chance on this because of the value and while it is flavorful, either I didn't realize/see, or the description of the product failed to mention (not sure which it is), this coconut is NOT long, narrow, shredded texture, which is what I expected. This is tiny granules - more like sugar crystals. Even raw sugar granules are larger than these coconut mm's. It doesn't affect the flavor or any recipes (so far). It is just messy working with it as it is more like a fine powder that just gets everywhere when spilled. While I wouldn't buy it again, that decision is based on my preference for shredded coconut; not this price, the flavor, or even the packaging all of which was great.

OK, first off, they claim this 16 oz. can is 3.5 servings (?) maybe so...but maybe not. So multiply those single "serving" nutritional figures on the can by 3.5 and here is the total for the whole 16 oz can. 595 calories, 35 from fat. 2,520 mg Sodium (105% of daily req. Yikes!), 24.5g protein, 52.5g sugar, and so on. OK, so this is definitely not health food. ;)

It is however pretty tasty and a decent value (especially if you use subscribe and save as I do). I am happy with the flavor, texture, quality, and so on. There is almost no bacon to be seen, and little bacon flavor. I spotted two teeny, tiny bits in one whole can. You could taste a bit of brown sugar, but not a strong taste. Overall, they tasted fairly typical to me, but good enough to satisfy. So these are *not* extraordinary beans, they're just good beans. However, that's enough for a can of baked beans.
This is a very unique flavor for decaf coffee.  Both my wife and I love it.  Great for after dinner and settling down to read.
Excellent product if you need to stuff pills down your puppy or dog. Different flavors and most all dogs like them.

We couldn't find our favorite bread machine bread in the stores anymore and was excited to find it on amazon.  Very sweet and tasty.  Perfect bread to make for company.  Leftovers make good french toast.

This was a great bargain for the K-cups. It was less than half the store price, these funny cups use less plastic but still work in the machine and they were delivered very quickly. The coffee is a little stronger, I think since there is a filter bottom instead of just 1 hole so more coffee seeps out. I just run the machine cup-less for hot water and dilute it myself.

I was really surprised by the good taste of this mix. The only downside is that it is grainy- at least, it is for me, but I simply dump a packet in water and stir it in. Perhaps using a blender and adding ice would lessen the graininess of it, but I bought it in the individual packets for the on-the-go convenience. I make green juice or green smoothies nearly daily, so I'm quite used to a much "greener" taste than this provides- this is actually quite sweet and I consider it a treat! I'm going to reorder this and keep it on hand.

This water enhancer by MIO is really, really good. The flavor in question is "Mango Peach" and I found that these two flavors balanced very well together. The first flavor I tasted was mango and then chased by peach. It was also nice that is no aftertaste with this product.

The application is simple; just fill a glass with water, squirt a shot or two of this liquid enhancer and stir. Personally, I use less than recommended because I don't want an overbearing flavor. Nevertheless, an individual has the ability to make their beverage as mild or strong as they wish. I also like the "non leak" packaging. The only way the liquid comes out is if the container/bottle is squeezed.

Overall, this is a good product with a good taste. I have already tried the strawberry, peach tea and look forward to trying other flavors.

I ordered these to hand them out for Halloween this year, so of course I had to sample some for myself.

The lollipops them self are good. In my opinion, they are very sweet and even though some people say they are small... I think they are just the right size for a quick sugar fix.

My problem, and I'm probably just nitpicking, is that the stick is so frail. By the end of sucking down a lollipop, the paper part that the stick is made out of would get wet and fall apart, and I'll end up eating some paper at the end. This happens every time.

Maybe, if I bite and chew the candy I wouldn't get to where the stick would fall apart... but I suck down and let it sit in my mouth while doing stuff, like playing video game, or watching TV, etc.

Other than that, the candies taste great... but I really wish the stick wouldn't tear apart every time, and I end up having to spit out the paper at the end.

The flavors in the bag is pretty evenly distributed. So far, I tried all the flavors, and they all taste great. I like the Mango, and the blueberry the most. I think I will keep some for myself and not give all of them away for Halloween.

These are by far the best gluten free chocolate chips I've had.  They are thicker than the "normal" cookies that you are used to, but they are moist and chewy in the center.  They taste the closest to gluten cookies as you are likely to get on the market right now.  Just open up and enjoy!

As I look for inspiration...I thought this pumpkin tea might  put me into a pre Halloween state of mind! :) It does tastes like pumpkin and mild spice. I'm pleased w it! I'm sharing w friends! Sit down for a moment;  lets chat and drink tea! Boo! See your terrified...puts ya in a good spirits!

My daughter likes this product.  It may not be love, but it is edible, at least to her standards.  She is not picky.  She has been an Earth's Best baby since she was 10 weeks old.  I started her on baby food, in addition to her formula, early on.  It just seemed like the right thing to do.  She has been the happiest baby some people have ever met.  When I fed this to her the first time, she ate half a package.  I had a bite and it is pretty good.  I will buy it again, definitely.

I ordered this Chai because of the reviews I read expecting a yummy taste comparable to chai products purchased in Starbucks or gourmet drink establishments.  I followed the instructions using 3 heaping teaspoons, and mixed it with hot milk first, and then experimented by mixing it next in hot water, and again in half and half combination of hot water and hot milk.  I even have mixed it with hot water and used it with a chai tea bag for a stronger taste.  I am not getting the spicey taste I desired but the product is good.  It's just not AS good.  I am not certain if I will reorder.  What I like about the product -- you can use it just with hot water and it is good.

My husband loves this candy.  I cannot tell you how many stores we entered to see if they carried it.  We were unsuccessful. Good old Amazon.com, I checked to see if I could purchase them here and Eureka! I found them! ................CROWS by Tootsie, our childhood memories were awakened!  I bought a box of 12 and gave some to our son-in-law who also enjoys this candy.  Again, Thank you Amazon.com, you make life uncomplicated.

I was suprised at the coffee that I ordered had these neat little cups.  What I like most is that they are reusable.  I just tear off the top, then fill with my coffee and put a little piece of foil and cover the top, it works perfect.  I can only drink half and half coffee and my husband drinks regular so he uses the original coffee then I reuse the cups.  He really likes the coffee too.
I think it was a good buy. I have nothing to compare to since i never bought bee pollen before. Im pretty sure its cheaper to buy them online though. Good product. smells good. tastes good.

These are pricey, but make for a great gift because (1) they're beautifully packaged and (2) they are excellent chocolates. When I was in Brussels I sampled chocolates from many different chocolatiers, and I think Gudrun represents Belgian chocolate well: creamy & smooth, rich and distinct flavors, and good consistency. I wouldn't buy a box of these for myself because there are probably better values for comparable haut chocolat, but these are impressively packaged and would make a distinctive gift for a client or associate.

Pantry moths are just gross. So when I Googled it & realized why I had so many moths in my house, I quickly got onto Amazon to find the right product - one that didn't use harsh chemicals & one that was effective. The minute (literally) I opened the pheromone packet and placed it in the trap, I had 4 moths fly in from who knows where attracted to the trap. [I have video proof -- I'll try to upload]. One got interested enough and was caught on the sticky trap immediately. Unfortunately, the other 3 just kinda hung out but never entered the trap. And I didn't catch any more for a couple days. Just as I was feeling disappointed by it's lack of victims, after being away from the house for a couple days, I came home to 3-4 more moths captured. [Hooray!]

Overall, it works but not as aggressively as I hoped. But I'm not sure another trap would. I'm happy with my purchase because it is capturing the moths and my problem does seem to be reduced (I only see about 1-2 moths a day... I still have to majorly clean out my cupboards before I expect any full reprieve). I might try a stickier fly strip as suggested by some - I have not seen that the tackiness doesn't work, but I'm willing to try anything to make sure all the moths are gone.
They no longer sell these in any stores around my area. I used to buy them when I was much younger and enjoyed them so much. They have the same great taste.

This Folgers Gourmet blend is more of a medium roast than a bold roast. It isn't bold or bitter, so medium breakfast blend coffee drinkers should like this selection.

Smooth, with no aftertaste, but also no distinct flavor, it is a decemt choice for your morning cup of coffee.

(we use this in a My KCup & brew a 10oz cup)

I ordered this for review (provided by company) and thought it's conditioner, it's not a miracle.

It's not a miracle product, but it out performed my regular conditioner and I would say it worked as well as the product I bought at the saloon.

It smells nice--not overwhelming.

My hair isn't heavy or greasy.

I'll purchase more when I run out of it.

Although fruit punch isn't my favorite flavor, I like the idea of adding some flavor, vitamins and little caffeine to make plain water or seltzer more interesting. It adds enough sweetness without being to sweet and you can adjust the intensity of the flavor by how many squeezes you add. Everyone else I let try this liked it as well. I will probably get it again, just a different flavor.

As another reviewer mentioned, it is expensive. But my dog loves it; these are a fail-safe method of keeping him busy for few hours atleast. With a very active Siberian Husky in cold Minnesota winters, thats always a plus!
And also, couple of hours of chewing on one makes his teeth seem cleaner and whiter.

I like the taste, enough blue-berry flavor to enjoy the taste, but the over all product is dry, leaving me with a thirsty feeling. At 100 calories per bar, it's a pretty good treat. High in fiber, low in fat, low in sodium. I tried the "Blueberry" and they also have "Strawberry" and "Apples & Cinnamon"

Great set to have during travel or outdoor. No need to worry about freezing or heating up the milk. Wish the nipple comes with fast or standard flow for older baby.

I have become a big fan of RAW products because of their bio-availability, but I was leary of whether I would be able to get this down. After reading the reviews on this and the vanilla flavor, I decided to take the plunge. I followed the suggestion of other reviewers to cut the amt. of powder in half and add in the fz. banana. I use 1/2 fz. banana, 1 cup soy milk, 1 cup water, and a handful of ice cubes. This keeps it from becoming too thick (which I find impossible to swallow). Making it this way is actually tasty and enjoyable. (The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 stars is because I didn't want anyone to expect it to taste like an ice cream milkshake. I'd have given it 4-1/2 stars, but they don't offer that option.) I have tried this with and without the banana and other fruits. I have found that both this one and the vanilla meal taste best when mixed with the 1/2 raw banana (and I'm not that big of a fan of bananas otherwise). Another good-tasting option is to use 1 cup soy milk and 1 cup brewed, flavored coffee (unsweetened; I like my coffee sweetened with agave and soymilk--don't get me wrong--but when adding it to this powder, you don't need the extra sweetness and calories). I originally bought the vanilla because most reviewers preferred the vanilla over the chocolate and the plain. However, I found single-serving pouches at our local Vitamin Cottage Natural Grocers and bought a pouch of each flavor before my Amazon order of Vanilla arrived. I actually preferred the chocolate and was disappointed that I'd ordered the vanilla. However, I have almost used up my (huge) container of vanilla meal powder and have enjoyed it every day and am ready to now get a chocolate container. Hope you find this helpful :)
This soda is as good as coke and potentially more healthfull. I would recomend that anyone interested in it should try it.

I'm nuts about nuts, so I did like the nutty taste of this cereal. While it was a little on the sweet side, it was tolerable. The cereal did not get soggy in milk and was true to its "Crunchy" label. The box had the word "honey" on it, but the product contains more sugar than honey in its ingredients. All-in-all, I liked this cereal and would recommend that you give it a try. But for those averse to too much sweetness, it may not be what you're looking for.

Originally I wanted to do a video review for the Bit-O-Luv treats that showcased the tests that I did with my dogs, but alas it was not to be as my daughter proceeded to disperse them all before I could get to it...lucky dogs.

Having said that, here's what I have: Border Collie, Japanese Chin and a Miniature Datsun/Terrier mix.

All of my dogs loved the treats; in this case the Bistro Beef Recipe. Personally though I believe all dogs will enjoy anything out of the ordinary and eat it eagerly too, so I decided to do a test.

I took three different treats (names omitted to protect the innocent...lol) and then lined them up in a row, spaced apart about two feet. I then let the dogs free to see which one they'd run to first. I did this three times. Each time the dogs ran to the Bistro treat first, however, they didn't run to the other treats after as I'd expected them to, instead they came to me looking for more -- well, that's what I assume anyways, I'm far from a Dog Whisperer.

All in all, the treats were good and the dogs enjoyed them and at roughly about four-dollars a piece through Amazon, they're comparable in price to your local store.

Illy issimo coffee drink - Cappucino is a decent "coffee like" drink in a can. I would describe it as a mild cappucino flavor that isn't to sweet but fairly smooth. I received one can and drank it out of the refrigerator on a hot day, so mine was ice cold.

The drink gave me a modest energy boost similar to a regular cup of coffee. I normally wouldn't buy this type of product but I think its the best "coffee replacement in a can" type drink you can get although things freshly brewed area always better in my opinion.

I've said it before, I'll say it again - I'm a white gal who likes to throw her ample weight around!  I find these cupcakes to second only to the mighty Ding Dong when it comes to Hostess treats.  The chocolate cake is great, and the frosting is absolutely delectable.  Avoid the bastardization that is the golden Hostess cupcake.

I bought these for one of my kids for final week. I got to taste them and I certainly did enjoy them.

My daughter said she would like them better without the salt. Me too, however these are not too salty for either of us.

For those who like salt and Almonds... you'll love these! Enjoy them!

This tea should be treated as a laxative. I have horrible problems with bloating and cramping so i take this sometimes. I'd advise using it ONLY when you are going to be home for a long time :P And DON'T drink more than one cup a day unless its an emergency, I made that mistake once.... T_T

I really hate the taste but I suppose that is probably different person to person. I think it's the senna itself I hate, not the carob(chocolate) taste, because I've tried other senna teas and they have that same disgusting flavor :/ I just drink it with my nose pinched xD
This product has improved our dog's breath and the tartar build up on her teeth.  I would recommend this product.

So my husband and I have been receiving Zico water with mango for several months, with subscribe and save. This month both cases taste HORRIBLE.  Expiration date is in just a few months.  In the past they were over a year away.  Also the cases were different in color.  Tasted no hint of mango, but cannot drink this batch.  What is up with that?  We love this stuff and have come to depend on it for after exercise.

We have bought this mix and enjoyed it several times...it's one of our favorites.  Delicious with coffee or tea in the morning, this is a great mix.  When we first started making it, we had an old inexpensive bundt pan; and, like the other reviewers, we thought the coffeecake was tasty, but a little dry.  After making it in a new higher quality bundt pan that we received for Christmas, the outcome improved 100%.  I guess it's true what they say about having the right "tool" for the job.  I have also noticed that I get a better result when I reduce the cooking time slightly on all of the Barefoot Contessa mixes.  We'll keep buying this as long as they offer it.
I bought this as a gift and have not bought one for myself yet. The recipient loved it, but haven't heard much else. I still want one for myself.
I use this in making Primal/paleo Chocolate Almond Coconut bark. It adds a nice texture and a boost of fiber. Shipped very quickly from Amazon.

Both of my English Bulldogs love them!!  They are a great size for training, however they are a little more chewy than I thought they would be.  The 1 lb. bag is a great size and a great value.  I will be ordering more!

I came across the Fizz Pops here by accident and ordered them immediately.  I hadn't had them since I was a kid and wanted to see if they were similar to those I remembered.  My grandparents used to bring one for me and one for my sister every time they visited.  I also recall them being in glass jars on the counters of small stores as we drove "up north" to visit grandma and grandpa.  I don't know what brand they were, but they were almost identical to these Paskesz Fizz Pops.  The best way I can describe them is that they are like compressed confectioner's sugar with a very light fruit flavor.  Kind of like the texture of a sweet-tart, but without the tart.  If you suck on them like a regular lollipop, it will hurt your tongue and the roof of your mouth.  They don't dissolve in the same way that hard candy does.  Instead, you kind of chip away at them with your teeth and chew the little pieces that come off.  Now, if I didn't have this good childhood memory, I admit there's a chance that trying them as an adult for the first time, I might not be that excited about them.  But, it was fun to find them again.  Everyone in our family liked them.  And, I found one friend who remembered having these as a child, too and said "Oh, I missed those lollipops that hurt your mouth if you sucked on them too hard!"  So, if you don't compare them to a regular lollipop and judge them on their own, you might find you like them, too.
The coffee is great, no complaints.  However, contrary to reviews about the price, the Target store I shop at sells these everyday for 3.29 and sometimes less when they are on sale.  Do the math.

I am not sure how much I can say, they are nuts, and they taste like nuts. So thumbs up for meeting expectation in that regards!

The only complaint I have is the packaging... the plastic turns a little weird in the freezer, kinda fragile.. I pulled two bags out of the freezer, and the plastic tore just by knocking against other freezer items. It was a nutastrophy.

These Nature Valley "Sweet & Salty Nut Granola Bars" are good for between meal snacks and are fairly filling. While not very big, these bars pack a lot of flavor and energy that make them a real treat and I like that my kids will eat these in place of a candy bar.

The only issue with these is that the bottom peanut butter layer can be come very soft and messy when heated up by a warm day of from being held in the hand too long, but I have learned to eat these held in the open wrapper to avoid the problem.

My family also enjoys Nature Valley Sweet & Salty Nut Granola Bars, Peanut, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)

Recommended!

CFH

I am a coffee snob, I'm also a coffee snob who drinks a lot of coffee (is there another kind?) While this is not the best coffee I've ever had, it is a very good dark roast that is neither bitter nor bland. It has a slight nutty, almost chocolaty undertone that I really enjoy but doesn't make it taste like an artificially flavored coffee. Each bag is sealed tightly and always arrives fresh. I have this coffee on subscription and for the price it just can not be beat.

This is a great pre workout drink. I had some issues using other products such as N.O. Explode with upset stomachs which resulted in unproductive workouts. This stuff works and is made by the makers of muscle milk. Does not taste great but it is drinkable. The only problem I had was with the 200 mg of caffeine present in every scoop. I liked this but they now have a new item out called Muscle N.O. I bought it at Costco. It is the same company. It only has 100 mg of caffeine and has no creatine in it like the Fast Twitch does. Another option is the Fast Twitch lemonade flavor which has no caffeine.

Overall, good product.

Wellness had been recommended by several pet owners, primarily because of the use of more natural ingredients versus more processed ingredients in Science Diet.  My dog has made the transition from Science Diet to Wellness without any problems.  Still too early to tell if this will have a positive impact on her health, but I could probably say that about the Science Diet even after all the years I have used it.  I started buying Wellness through Amazon after my local pet chain store stopped carrying the Wellness we use in the larger size.
I wanted a product just like this to mix with yogurt. It is just what I was looking for. It is hard to find Meusli

These cookies are so good that its a bit difficult to stop eating them ... and though "gluten free," they are not dietetic, so beware.  One other caution ... I had purchased some at Whole Foods, and then decided to buy more through Amazon. I think the ones that arrived via Amazon were not as good ... like maybe they were from a different cooking date/lot that had been baked a little too long. They were still good enough to eat, but I noticed a slight difference. However, the convenience of being able to shop online and the fact that even those cookies from the "bad lot" were very enjoyable, somehow makes it worth giving a second chance( with the hope that it was just one time they were overdone).

McCann's Instant Oatmeal is great if you must have your oatmeal but can only scrape together two or three minutes to prepare it. There is no escaping the fact, however, that even the best instant oatmeal is nowhere near as good as even a store brand of oatmeal requiring stovetop preparation. Still, the McCann's is as good as it gets for instant oatmeal. It's even better than the organic, all-natural brands I have tried. All the varieties in the McCann's variety pack taste good. It can be prepared in the microwave or by adding boiling water so it is convenient in the extreme when time is an issue.

McCann's use of actual cane sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup helped me decide to buy this product. Real sugar tastes better and is not as harmful as the other stuff. One thing I do not like, though, is McCann's use of thickeners. Oats plus water plus heat should make a creamy, tasty oatmeal without the need for guar gum. But this is a convenience product. Maybe the guar gum is why, after sitting in the bowl a while, the instant McCann's becomes too thick and gluey.
We really enjoyed this product -- containes no sugar (contains dates and such) and it's healthy while giving you the chocolate fix you need!

Tazo's Calm Herbal Infusion is a nice chamomile tea. I taste the chamomile and some flavorings, and they are not unpleasant, just hard to pin down as to what they are besides the chamomile. In general I'm not a big fan of tea with flavorings added, preferring the subtleness and authentic taste of the real thing.

The ingredients in Calm are: chamomile flowers, hibiscus flowers, spearmint, lemongrass, rose petals, blackberry leaves, safflowers, peppermint, sarsaparilla, lemon balm, licorice and natural flavors. It is caffeine-free!

Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.

On the package, Tazo writes, "a soothing blend of chamomile blossoms and other relaxing herbs." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Calm as "creamy, floral, minty, toasty, sweet, honey-like. As the name gently implies, Tazo Calm has a lovely floral bouquet with an apple-like flavor and distinct toasty notes. Naturally sweet in a nice light way, with a smooth finish". Tazo describes the aroma as "minty, hay like, rose". I don't taste all of these various flavors, but I do taste the chamomile, and it is fine, not overwhelming or as artificial tasting as several of the other Tazo teas I've sampled.

The bulk packaging is a definitely plus, making Tazo Calm much more affordable.

I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi. I'm soooooo spoiled by Numi teas, which is why Tazo Calm gets only four stars.

The Bold Series has several different flavors. Some of these are hit and miss with me. Some of the flavors are "too" bold, and some taste great the first few almonds, but quickly overwhelm you. If I am famished from hunger, and a real meal is many hours off, I don't feel bad about eating one of these glorified candy bars as a mini-meal. It is filling and satisfying, and if you put chocolate and peanut butter on a shoe, I'd probably like it. The chocolate coating is formulated for durability and it does that job well, although there is a price to be paid in taste. The filling, however, is the best part. Peanutty and chewy, the grains, chocolate and peanut butter combine brilliantly leaving me wanting another one or three.

The problem with bars like this is that they are neither plain candy bars nor real nutrition, and they have to balance the great taste of candy with the fact that they actually have to have some nutritional value to compensate for the huge premium the makers charge for this bar over a plain old candy bar. Kashi does this better than most of the competition, and their bar is a bit larger and sturdier than most, which makes it the first choice for my gym bag or purse for an emergency meal.

Try not to let these slip from "emergency food" to "substitute for lunch" or "regular snack." These bars, although healthier than candy, are not a real meal, do not have the fiber and nutrients to hold you over to the next real meal, and are a lot more candy bar than piece of fruit. These are good to keep in a bag for a day when you have no alternatives, but if you find that there are too many emergencies to be good for your health or your waistline, try putting an apple in that purse instead.

I recently purchased a Saeco Vienna Plus to replace a Vienna Deluxe model that provided great service for eight years. We make about 24 shots of espresso a week, on average, so over the eight years the old machine pumped out about 10,000 shots. I felt we got our money's worth from that machine and was eager to replace it with another Vienna Deluxe.

When I went to do my research, however, I found that Saeco had discontinued the Vienna Deluxe model. The Vienna Plus appears to be the only current model in the old Deluxe form factor. I initially was tempted to buy up into one of the pricier "Giro" machines, mostly for the more stylish design. But after talking to a couple of Odea and Talea Giro owners, and reading lots of online reviews, I decided these more expensive machines also might be a little more temperamental. So, I chose the Vienna Plus.

It's only been about three weeks, but so far the Vienna Plus is meeting my expectations. The main difference between the old Vienna Deluxe and the new Vienna Plus is in the boiler. I assume the Deluxe model had two boilers, one for coffee and one for steam. (I think Saeco is now calling this feature "Rapid Steam".) I assume that because there was no wait time between steaming and brewing, or brewing and steaming. I always steam my milk first, and the Plus model makes me cool down the boiler from steaming temperature to brewing temperature before brewing the espresso. That's easy: you just disengage the "steam" button and open the steam control to run hot water through the wand. After less than a shot's worth of water comes out, the "brew" light comes on and you can brew your coffee. The wait time for this is under five seconds.

Other than that small difference, I'm finding the Vienna Plus comparable to the Vienna Deluxe in terms of both the quality of the coffee it produces and convenience. Who knows how long the new machine will last, but if it comes anywhere near the eight years I got from the Vienna Deluxe I'll be delighted with the investment. Speaking of investment, while the list price on the Vienna Plus is similar to what I paid for the old Deluxe model, the street price on the Plus model is quite a lot lower. I was able to get the Vienna Plus from a local warehouse store for $380 including business delivery. California sales tax ran the total to about $416, but even so I paid about $200 less for the Vienna Plus than I paid for the Vienna Deluxe eight years ago.

First, I had to get over my bias against instant coffee. Going in, I told myself that there are positives about instant coffee: (1) the packets are easy to carry & easy to mix (time saver), (2) the flavor has improved over the years, and (3) there are more varieties today (even Starbucks packages instant coffee).

What I was looking for in the Nescafe Memento Cappuccino was (1) a not so calorie laden coffee and (2) an afternoon or after dinner dessert coffee.

The Memento Cappuccino is not a coffeehouse cappuccino because it isn't as strong as the cappuccino that I purchase at my coffeehouse. However, it isn't bitter, so I do give it points for that since I can remember the days when instant coffee was very bitter. I followed the instructions & mixed the packets contents with 8oz of hot water in a 10oz cup. The ratio of milk to coffee was good & the mixed drink tasted like a cappuccino. The mix produced a slight foam that sat on top of the coffee for quite a while. The mix contains sugar, so I did not need to add more sugar (but those who like a sweeter coffee will want to add more sugar).

Verdict: Nescafe Memento is a decent, convenient coffee packet to have on hand for those times when you want a cappuccino but don't want to brew one or go to your coffeehouse to purchase one. With the individual packets, it is also easy to throw a few packets into your suitcase or backpack.
