These bars were tasty and provided a quick hit of energy.  They kind of reminded me of Mr. Peanut bars I had as a kid or "PayDay" candy bars.  These are great to slip into yo0ur gym bag, briefcase or car glove box if you need a quick energy boost.

I purchased the Peanut Butter & Co. Peanut Butter, White Chocolate Wonderful, 16-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6) by Peanut Butter & Co., directly from Amazon, in July 2011. The expiration date stated Jan 2013, which is plenty of time to go through 6 jars of this tasty peanut butter.

The listed ingredients are as follows:

Peanuts, evaporated cane juice, vanilla, cocoa butter, palm fruit oil, lecithin (from sunflowers), salt.

The packaging also states that it is gluten-free and certified vegan. This product doesn't require mixing, as some of the more natural peanut butters sometimes do.

While I personally can't discern any white chocolate flavor, it is a very enjoyable peanut butter.

It's was hard to star this review since taste is so subjective. I ended up giving it four stars because I love the company and their Jambo! flavor so much. The tea is high quality. The cause is good (a portion of the profits goes to children orphaned by HIV/AIDS).

That said, I really disliked this flavor. The second I opened the package, the scent of cloves hit my nose, and the clove taste in the brewed tea was even stronger. Not my thing! The cloves totally smothered the cardamom, ginger and tea flavors.

In short: Great company, but only buy this if you love cloves!

Because the tea is small, you'll want a fine filter. I highly recommend the swissgold® TF 300 Tea Filter.

It took some tweaking for me to get it down, but this has helped me cut sugar in recipes by 75% and maintain the same taste.  I have yet to find a sugar substitute you can use as a 1:1 ratio replacement for sugar/other natural sugar sweeteners (agave, etc..), but this is the best for reducing sugar without using chemicals and no bitter or weird aftertaste.  It's now a staple for me.

I got this from a friend for my b'day.

PROS: I wish the stainless steel was brushed as it gets all the regular kitchen stuff on it. It comes with a spoon but I use my fingers as I was getting way too much salt for what I needed. It is super convenient to have this right next to the stove instead of grabbing the salt from the pantry several times a meal.

CONS: I wish there was two spaces so I could have pepper there too.

I would recommend this product.

REALLY like the product... only 2 bummers....alot more expensive than regular syrup (more along the lines of pure maple syrup) and my husband complains that on pancakes you have to use too much to get the moistness you're used to.Otherwise..... tastes great and I use it in everything! Like to think I'm helping my body out just a little too!

I found this chocolate bar to be truly delicious. It has a perfectly respectable ingredient list.. all organics, essentially evaporated cane juice, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin and vanilla, all USDA organic certified). The cocoa is listed as "Rainforest alliance certified."

The chocolate is only 54% cocoa, so it is not bitter or overwhelming like some dark chocolate. This would be a nice bar for someone wanting to make the move from milk chocolate, but not liking the super-high-cocoa-content bars.

One thing to note is that this bar is smaller than most that I see on the market. I though that was just the angle of the photo and didn't think much about it, but it actually is smaller. It comes with scores for 6 square pieces that are a bit larger than I might otherwise give myself, although even with that, I'll admit that I planned to eat one piece and ate two instead! The chocolate is creamy, and nicely satisfying. Probably not the bar for a super-serious-chocolate lover, but a nice quality bar for someone wanting to support organics and find something a bit nicer than average, but widely likeable.

My dog likes this product.  That is most important.  It doesn't have a foul odor...  The description says you can break it in pieces... you can but it is a bit dry and pieces don't come off in the same size consistently.  Overall I would recommend.
Little Stars are the right size for training treats.  I have not offered the Cheddar Cheese bites yet but our dogs love the sweet potato ones.

I have two dogs, a medium mixed breed and a small Chihuahua who has had a few rotted teeth pulled.  I gave both one each and the mixed breed ate it right up and finished it off in a couple of minutes.  The Chihuahua on the other hand chewed the end for a couple seconds before going into guard mode.  The broke it in half in hopes that he could chew from the middle which is smaller than the ends.  He was able to crew off a half an inch from the middle before giving up again.  At the end of the day, I figured it was too big for him and tossed what was left to my other dog that was more than happy to finish it off.
The title alone caught my attention to this product.  Jet fuel it is.  A good, strong cup o joe perfect for daily consumption.  Smells fantastic brewing too.
This is the only canned food my kitties will eat. I checked with several Vets and they said it was a perfectly good food.I supplement with a very high quality dry food.."Evo cat and kitten"
I was a little unsure about this one, but it's another good flavor from Nuun, though tangerine ginger is still my favorite. I'm a big fan of Nuun!
Although well packaged and delivered in excellent condition, these chocolates were drier than I expected and were rather hard to bite into.  Maybe that's why they were on sale!

I've tried other low-carb, sugar-free spreads/preserves/jams in the past, and I've hated them all. I remember buying Steel's cause a slew of low-carbers recommended it,and I ended up throwing out the jars I got. Horrible. Chemically.

This actually made me stop and go, "Wow, this is pleasant."

Let's face it, it's not regular, sugar-laden preserves with that thick, luxurious texture. But it's also only 20 cals per tablespoon and doesn't spike your sugar. If you have diabetes, Metabolic Syndrome, insulin issues, or are just a low-carb dieter (or dieter in general), this line of preserves is worth checking out.

The Lowdown: I first used it on plain old toast over Smart Balance (I love the combo of fat spread with sweet spread, whether it's cream cheese and grape jelly or butter and jam.) It was very nice. The spread is thinner than I expect preserves to be--like a thickish fruit coulis, fruit puree, sort of thing. The taste is very fruity, apricotty, with an acidic edge. That's the reason I removed a star--the thinnish texture and slightly overacidic bite. However, I don't want to exaggerate either. It was a good flavor and a nice addition to breakfast. Also nice over low-fat waffles and pancakes, if you go for that sort of thing.

I want to try the strawberry and blueberry, and I foresee that this might become a staple in my pantry. Finally, a lower carb, sugar-free preserve that I can enjoy.

Update: I'm switching my rating to 5 stars. I'm just enjoying this more and more. Maybe my spring allergies affected my perception of the flavor, cause since my congestion eased, this tastes BETTER. I'm almost done with the jar and next time will stock up with 3. Yum.
I used this when I ran out of low carb pancake mix. Not as good but definitely better than no pancakes!
I got this for my friend for Christmas- it was great, he loved it, it wasn't expensive, and plus, I got to help test the merchandise.  Fun gift.
I must be too accustomed to artificial-flavor grape, because these candies don't taste like "grape."  They're slightly floral or perfume-y, but still good.

Light and refreshing.  But if you are looking for an alternative to soda,  sorry, but this is pretty much soda. I appreciate the fact that it is 100% natural, and has a full complement of Vitamin C. And I actually like the fact that it isn't too sweet, nor too tart. No added sugar, but plenty of "fruit sugars". In the end, though . . it's a soda. My 6-year old loved it.
this popcorn was delicious, but is too expensive to be an everyday popcorn , if you're a popcorn junkie like me. i mixed a batch of great northern with a batch of redenbacher to make it go farther.

These are a great value and are exactly what they claim to be: 1 dram borosilicate glass vials; not quite Pyrex but very heat resistant. I cannot stress enough to clean all of these vials (a tedious process) before using them. This should be done more thoroughly by the supplier. I would even pay a bit extra if they were pre-washed, rinsed, and dried. I learned the hard way on vial #1 and washed the other 11 immediately. I dropped one today on concrete from ~14" height and it did bounced with no cracks. I would buy this product again.

Take it from someone who has never taken an energy drink, never downed an energy "shot". I am a total newbie to the burst of energy you're supposed to get with these new fad drinks. So here is what happened when I tried this product.

I waited until I was dragged down and tired. Side bar: I am fit and active, and am rarely tired. Continuing, the day I was dragged down, I drank 1/2 of the can and had to stop because the flavor repulsed me. I forced myself to drink it so I could see if it worked or not. After about five minutes of downing 1/2 of it, I definitely felt a surge of energy. I got to my feet and continued my day with the energy I like to have all the time. I did not notice that the effect died off; I seemed to feel fine the rest of the day (approx from noon to bedtime).

So I think this product does what it says. I just wish it tasted better. It was unpalatable to me, but sometimes, medicine doesn't taste as delicious as we wished it did.
Received package on time the product was in nice clear packaging the label affixed to the product was a bit worn looking ~ however do not expect that to influence product.

This was recommended by my UK friend-he uses it on his cheese and toast.  I thought I'd give it a try-oh yummmm.  It's not for everyone but it does punch up the flavor for this quiet snack.  It's a bit like worcheshire sauce or A-1 steak sauce but a bit more tomatoey.  My hubby likes it on anything beef.

I didn't care for this cereal with milk, it got soggy too quickly and when it's soggy it just isn't good. But grabbing a handful as a snack? It's really good. It's like chocolate graham crackers, or Cocoa Puffs, but with a chocolate filling. Just enough crisp with a chocolaty center to satisfy a sweet tooth after a meal without having a full dessert.

At this time it's being sold here for 4 boxes for $20.... I saw it in a grocery store for less than $3 a box.

I'm writing this review on behalf of my husband who grew up with Carr's. This is his favorite selection because all the different crackers in it are good.

The only drawback was that the first box we opened was mostly smashed up. I guess this isn't surprising, since the crackers are made in the UK, shipped to the US, sent to the stores, then sent to us - but it was a fairly serious consideration. Amazon made good, of course. We have enough crackers to last until 2010 at this rate, and if there are any more smashed boxes, the local birds will eat well.

This is the perfect afternoon, snuggling, book-reading tea. But, hold the cup in both hands for the first deep breath. And be sure not to let the leaves steep too long. You don't want to ruin perfection.

First off, let me express my disappoingment that Crystal Light is still using Aspartame as it's sweetener. I had hopes they had continued their move forward by sweetening this product with Stevia (as they have will some of their other newer offerings). That being said, although the taste of this drink is ever so slightly artificial (it's not "natural"...DUH), it is pleasantly refresing and does have more than a passing resemblance to a mojito (without the ETOH, of course). Because of the Aspartame, I'm not likely to buy this again, but if they changed the sweetener to Stevia or Stevia blend and kept the taste the same, I would definitely purchase regularly. If artificial sweetener choices aren't an issue for you, I recommend this product whole heartedly!

How could anyone truly substitute peanut butter? You're right. They can't! However, this stuff has a whipped texture comparable to cake frosting and is palatable when used on low-calorie brownies and such. Also, PB2, a powdered peanut butter can be added to this to give it a more realistic flavor with only 45 calories per serving. I'm on a calorie-restricted meal plan and use it just how I suggested you should above.

I dont really worry about my weight these days.  These bars are not exactly low calorie, though, in the writeup I read on the internet I , the guy who created the product says he sometimes eats a couple  of them for lunch. That's about right, it would be a tasty light on-the-go lunch at 420 calories. So much better for you than a candy bar. I read an interview the magazine about the founder of the company, and it inspired me to try other bars also, where they are selling them everywhere . I loved it. The one I sampled was different from this one, but this one sounded like I would enjoy it even more, and I did.
Love the flavor.  It doesn't last a long time like Black Jack, but it still very enjoyable.

My dog loves these!!! But they are very light not like real jerky, if that is what you are expecting.  They do not last very long.  I thought it would occupy the dog for longer then 5-10 minutes. He is a medium size dog. But even a 5-10 min break is nice from our very hyper puppy.

I bought this to eat as a birthday treat, I am undergoing the "gluten challenge" pending Celiac diagnosis but did not want to be sick on my birthday so I skipped a day of eating gluten foods (after the tests are performed I am forced to be gluten free for life anyway, I am confirmed gluten intolerant whether or not it is full on Celiac disease). This macaroni surprised me, I had the expectation that gluten free food wouldn't really taste like food at all. The al dente texture of the pasta was awesome, I had expected it to be even mushier than regular macaroni sometimes gets and it wasn't at all. The cheese sauce was just as good as the regular Annie's (my fav!). The only thing about it I don't like is that the rice noodles don't have much flavor of their own at all and they stick together a bit worse than wheat pasta does, but it is what it is. I knew it wouldn't have that yummy wheat taste but it was still a little disappointing. I gave it four stars because yes, I'll eat it again, but it needs a little something extra in the cheese packet to counter the blandness of rice noodles.

Having had Jack Links jerky for a while I picked up this brand during one of Amazon's deals to try it out. While it is nice and the smokey flavour works well, there is a much sweeter flavour to it than Jack Links brand. Personally this puts me off this brand a little although others in my house do like the sweeter flavour.

So it really depends what you want in your Teriyaki jerky and if you like it sweet or not.

The jerky pieces are a good size though, they definitely give you some big jerky.

Crystal Light Moctails are not "real" cocktails, but they sure are close. In fact, they pretty ,much could pass for the real deal eithout the alcohol. The Mojitos are a blend of sweet and refreshing citrus with a hint of spearmint. Just like a real Mojito. I made up a pitcher and my friends were amazed that they came from Crystal Light-I had to show them the packaging! I think they were just as sweet as real Mojitos, and still only 5 calories! Great for anytime  you want the taste of a refreshing Mojito without the worry of extra calories!

Knowing these types of snacks are unhealthy has me in a state of guilt, to purchase.
I hope they will soon have an organic variation. Cheetos, and Lays do!

This was lots of fun to make, but it was not the best tasting thing I have ever had.

The flavors were hard to explain. The gelatin was grainy and not smooth like gelatin should be. The textures were just weird! :) However, that was what I was expecting so it wasn't too bad.

I will buy the sushi set, just because it's so fun to make!

The third in the series of hair care products by this company that I've reviewed.

this is another woman's product and like the last one is exceptional. Does the job and leaves the hair pretty nice. No complaints from any member of the family.

So far the general conciseness is the products for women are good to exceptional and the products for men are Ok. This one did not get the rave review from my wife as the last one, but it hasn't gotten the complaints from my son either.

I'd say it's worth the bucks. Give it a shot

Taco Bell Chipotle Sauce isn't quite as spicy as I thought it would be but it is still creamy and tasty and a little goes a long way.

The taste is almost like a barbeque sauce with a bit of spice to it. Weirdly, I liked it with my chicken salad. Instead of putting it on the salad like a dressing, I used it as a dip. It was really good.

I also used it with a steak and egg burrito that I made with leftover steak. The creamy texture worked well against the bell pepper that was part of the burrito filling. I also liked it with the baked chicken for another dinner. Like the salad, I used it as a dip rather than drizzling the sauce on it.

All in all, it is a simple sauce. Not quite the taste that I expected, but still very good in surprising ways. I will definitely be getting it as an alternative to salad dressing and dip. I wouldn't use it all the time but it is nice to have as an alternate to ketchup or salad dressing.

The tea is fantastic and the price is better than I have found. We bought two packages and for some reason one of them was half pomegranate as ordered and half mango which we did not order. Both teas were good, but the pomegranate was more suited for us.

I prefer the Lavazza Supercrema. This is a good coffee though. I recently found a local coffee made at the Wholefoods in my area and I find the in-store roasted espresso there unbelievable. So I stopped ordering these big bags at Amazon and buy locally instead. The Lavazza Rossa whole bean from Italy is the best Lavazza in my opinion but I can only find it in Italy. They have the ground Lavazza Rossa here but its not the same. The Rossa from Italy has great comlex flavors and I find it as good as the Illy in a red can. The Illy is terribly overpriced so I'll stick with the local stuff now.

I love 100% kona coffee but who wants to spend $20+ a pound all the time? I do that for special occasions, but for daily drinking, this blend is nice and much more affordable.

This is a mild/medium roast (not for you fans of french roast!) with a smooth non-acid flavor, which is just how I like it.

I like mint, so I decided to try this product.  I am not willing to spend the big bucks on fancy latte drinks at restaurants, so this is a compromise.  It's not "too" minty, and it's quick to fix and satisfying when I want a little sweet pick-up.  Probably not as rich and decadent as "store bought, but then it doesn't cost $2 to $3 a serving.  My kind of treat.

My cat had a blocked urinary tract infection and after a trip to the animal hospital, our veterinarian recommended a prescription food since it's typically a recurring problem. We opted not to get it and found the Purina Urinary Tract food in the store. Our cat hasn't had any trouble in the six years since switching the food and his litter to Feline Pine.

I wanted to add that I am using subscribe & save and I was a little nervous because sometimes my Amazon packages arrive and sit outside all day and I was worried that the neighbor's outdoor cats or other animals would break into the bag. Fortunately, the bag arrives inside a box and I didn't have any problems.

My son is allergic to regular milk and is on a Gluten Free diet, but still needs to get protein & calcium in his diet.  He loves taking the Pacific Natural Foods Almond Milk cartons to school in his lunch box, and you can't imagine how disappointed I was when the only store near us that carried it stopped.  This delivery service is great, we set it up so that it arrives just as he is finishing the last 4-carton pack, right to the front door.  The other great part is the price per 4-pack ends up being less than what we were paying at the local store.

This cereal is filling,lots of fiber and has a distinct Maple flavor. The value was great but I only buy if it is. I did not give 5 stars because I always think there is room for improvement! Good tasting and very good for you.
My son LOVES this stuff. He recently got braces and cannot eat popcorn. This is a great substitute...and much more flavor.

I ordered 2 4-packs of the Irish oatmeal.  The cans were poorly packed and were loose in the over-sized box with only inflatable air bags packing, therefore most of the 8 cans were dented. One can was bashed so badly that the rim became detached from the can, and some of the contents  spilled into the box.  While I love the oatmeal, I was very disappointed with the careless packing.  Items this heavy should be in a stronger box.

I have tried probably every tea by Yogi and this one is as good as any other. Yogi Teas are just good! However, don't buy if you can't stand that licorice-sweet taste typical to the brand. Also, do not expect this tea to work wonders on the brain as other Chinese Ginkgo teas seem to do a bit more effectively. It's a nice drink-during-the-day-while you're at work...but try to buy just one box before going all out on 6 pakages if this is your first time buying it.
Pricey but good - OK sixteen more words to say the same thing Pricey but good - four more words

K-Cup Cider is a good option this time of year when hot cider hits the spot. Because it is cider and it's being made in a coffee maker, you will also find out whether or not you need to clean your keurig if you happen to get a mouthful of cider with a hint of coffee.

I love Westsoy products. And this is no exception -- Westsoy Chocolate Peppermint Stick Soy Beverage has a deep chocolate flavor, is thick and rich, but .... peppermint? I can barely taste the peppermint. I ended up adding my own peppermint from my peppermint flavor bottle.

I love herbal tea, especially Celestial Seasonings..  The Mandarin Orange Spice is one of my favorites.  It tastes great both hot and cold and is very refreshing. Buying it at Amazon is the best deal (save $5.00 as compared to markets).

CAMPBELL'S RED AND WHITE MUSHROOM SOUP, 10.75-OUNCE CANS, (PACK OF 48), certainly
DOES have a lot of salt in it, (sigh!) But somehow, the salt does NOT make this delicious soup taste too salty at all!

It's true that CAMPBELL's Does make a less-salty variety, but -- having just had their "Healthy Choice" variety, I wonder if taking out the salt is all that Campbell's does with their less-salt variety. The "Healthy Choice" Campbell's mushroom soup is far more watery than their regular variety, (does this mean more wheat flour?), and doesn't taste half as good.....

I have decided to use this soup, (which I have bought in the supermarket before buying 48 cans all together on Amazon), as a substitute for the far more expensive, (per ounce), mayonnaise that I put in my tuna salad. Yes, it gives a different taste -- but an altogether delicious one. And mushrooms are certainly more healthful than oil!

I may make my Campbell's Red and White Cream of Mushroom soup a bit healthier by adding a can of whole mushrooms, (pieces and stems is the least expensive), to the soup. As a snack, as a substitute for mayonnaise, as a base for other recipes, Campbell's Red and White Mushroom Soup is a favourite -- and for good reason!

But all that salt isn't really necessary, is it? Vitamin E is a GREAT preservative, and I hope that Campbell's will soon make another variety -- with Vitamin E as at least half of the preservatives, with a few more mushrooms, less salt, and a little less wheat flower.

One "Yummy", as it is now. Ten million "Yummies" for the soup, if produced, as described in the last paragraph!

We just bought a Keurig a few months ago and are trying different coffees to try to find what we like best. So far it is the TWC Italian Blend medium...very smooth and not bitter. However, I do not like an Extra Bold coffee.

I recently got my order of this in the mail the other day, and I must say this is quite good!  It has an odd after taste, but this citrus soda from Scotland is really something I could get used to! It's hard to describe the taste, but despite its' carbonation, the drink does go down smooth. It almost has a beer like aftertaste, but it's very good. Much different than soda found in the United States. I suggest anyone willing to give it a try, buy a case (or a single bottle). It's worth the exploration!
these cheetos were very good and fresh very expensive to buy online though wish it did not cost so much to have them shiped to me.other than the cost they were fine

I agree with other reviewers who said these were a little too dry. Some of the pieces are almost crunchy and hard to chew.  The pieces are also quite small which works well for not putting too much in your mouth but was bothersome when trying to get a decent quantity out of the bag. I think I prefer Trader Joes over these, but overall I enjoyed the flavor & the convenient sized bags.

My cats seem to enjoy this food as much as their erstwhile favorite, Wellness wet food.  They are pretty fussy so I am pleased.  I also like the fact that the the ingredients seem to be nourishing (no by-products) although since some reviewers have mentioned a possibly dangerous ingredient, I think I will do a little more research before ordering this again.
There's a couple other mint tea K-cups out there that are a little stronger, but they're almost twice as expensive as the Bigelow.  The flavor and odor are pleasant, and the price is right.

Really for the price you can't beat the quality ingredients. I got lucky and my cats actually like the taste. Its quite a bit more expensive than what I was feeding them, but also much better for them. Just make sure you transition it slowly, I added a bit too much into the mix one of the days and my cat felt a bit sick for a day, but has been fine since.

Edit: I have been feeding this to my cats for over a month now and have noticed they seem much more energetic.

Edit 2: This review was written during the old formula. My cats actually prefer the new shape but I don't like the new ingredient list.. they really reduced that salmon. Hopefully they compensated with more chicken but no way of knowing. My cats have seemed a bit less energetic since the switch to their new formula so doubting it is as healthy. I'm guessing the formula was to reduce production cost yet the price has gone up.. so I'm taking off a star.

I was very surprised on how much I liked the tea.
I originally purchased this tea thinking it was Sencha Tea. I didn't realize it came mixed with roasted and popped rice. After making my first cup I found the smell and taste to be familiar but I couldn't put my finger on it. I am still surprised on how the combination of Tea and Roasted rice work. The Sencha taste is there but the roasted flavor makes it a very interesting drink that I definitely recommend trying.

The Pasta and Cheddar was wonderful, as always. It allows my wife, who is Gluten sensitive, to have mac and cheese, which she loves. My complaint lies in the packaging. I had indicated that the item was a gift, yet the package arrived with the contents boldly indicated on the box. It also had the invoice openly displayed, which I had requested not be done. In short, LOVE the product, but the packaging policies need to be reviewed.

The flowers were delivered on-time and my ("sender") name and other details were not shared to person whom I sent the flowers was ensured ,which is appreciated. Very pleased with the effeciency demonstrated by the vendors promoted through Amazan. Their rating also helps in selecting the vendor. Thanks very much. If possible, enable us to make payment in our countries' currency rather than in dollars. It make the entire puchasing even more hassle free.

I really like this flavor. It has a nice mix of spice flavor without being overpowering. I use it on the 10oz. cup size with my keurig and it is perfect. You are supposed to mix it with 6oz. of hot water, but that is really rich and sweet for me. I am not a big fan of sweets though. My husband always think my hot chocolate tastes watered down so others would probably like it better with less water. It has a nutmeg and cinnamon flavor to it with a bit of ginger mixed in. I try to buy a lot of it at the end of season when it is onn sale so I have it on hand year round.

It's been a while since I've enjoyed a flavored coffee. I'm something of a purist and honestly, most flavored coffees taste artificial and over-done to me. But Starbuck's has come through with a very natural-tasting vanilla-flavored coffee for coffee drinkers who want a bit more without the addition of a sugary syrup.

The scent of the coffee is a nice vanilla-coffee blend with the vanilla more understated than I'd have expected. As it brews, the scent of vanilla rounds out the coffee aroma without ever overpowering it. And the cup is smooth and almost velvety, pretty much all you could hope for from this sort of blend.

I'm not saying they've won me over to the flavored coffee camp, but I will say that this is a cup of coffee I can respect in spite of the addition of a flavor. If you love vanilla coffee but hate artificial flavors, give it a try. I think you'll be pleased.

This pudding is great in a pie crust, but I bought it at the dollar store.  $25.00 for a six pack of pudding cans is out of this world expensive.  Definitely removing it from my wishlist - sadly though.

This product has great taste, and not too sweet. The tea mixes up in your water like coolaide, and comes in individual packets so you can take it along with you. However, the packets do not tear by hand, but you must use a knife or scissors to get them open. That is the only thing that needs to be improved.

Healthy great tasting tea. A little on the expensive side, but you can use the tea bag twice to make it more affordable with out any taste loss.  Delicious and full of good things, what else could you ask for?

After trying numerous brands of cat food, I finally found that this and only this brand, and it must be chicken, is what my kitties like.  They particularly like the white meat, the brown pellets are left after juice and white meat are gone.
The astronaut ice cream was so yummy!  It did arrive broken, but that's okay, it was sooo cool!

I've never been a fan of black licorice but find myself enjoying a package of Red Vines every so often - but they MUST be chewy. So imagine my joy happening across this new treat from Newman's Own and having my first bite having the required "chew" without having to let the package stand out in the open for a few days.

Yummmmmy. A whole new way to enjoy licorice with a healthful "kick" of tangy pomegranate to stave off the guilt of indulging in some delightfully chewy and delicious candy treats.

I'll be sneaking these babies into the movies from now on.

As with most bread machines particularly mine, whether it's a mix or from scratch most recipes need some tweaking. This mix makes a delicious bread, but I found it necessary to add some vital wheat gluten, a little honey, and some nonfat dry milk to get it to come out perfectly.

I still prefer grinding my own whole bean coffee, but for a pre-ground, flavored coffee, this is probably the best I have had. The vanilla flavor is just right, not too over powering like many flavored coffees. Instead it has just the right level of vanilla. The only issue is that you do NOT need the amount of coffee that is suggested, you can probably get by with half of the amount of coffee and still enjoy a great cup of joe!

I picked this up at the store after reading mixed reviews online. I am on a diet that is low calorie, sugars, and carbs; I've been missing a lot of foods as per usual so I was hoping that this would mix it up. Well it did.

When you pick it up you can see that it is runny, which is a con in my book, but the flavors are pretty spot on. I added some extra seasoning like cayenne, paprika, and a pinch of salt. Possibly cooking it down would make it a bit thicker.

Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar is a newer granola bar from a company that knows a few things about peanuts. I have been enjoying Planter's peanuts for as long as I can remember and when I heard about these granola bars, I was anxious to give them a try. With Planter's peanuts and granola, it sounded like a winning combination.

Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar, like the name suggests, contain plenty of peanuts. Looking at these granola bars, one can clearly see the peanuts, along with added oats, brown sugar, and other ingredients. Other granola bars contain peanuts, so this is nothing new. But few come close to matching the amount of peanuts used in Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar. The peanut- enhanced flavor will bring joy to the taste buds of peanut lovers everywhere. This, balanced with the great taste of granola and other ingredients, make these nut bars better tasting than most competitors in the granola/breakfast bar market.

These granola bars offer a nice balance of flavors. They do tend to make one thirsty, but one surprise is that each individual bar contains only a small amount of sodium. Based on the taste and the tendency to heighten thirst, I would have guessed the sodium content was much higher, but Planter's managed to keep this ingredient under control, and this is certainly good news for the health- conscious. However, some other facts about these granola bars could make them a questionable food option for certain diets and nutritional concerns. First, there are thirteen grams of fat in each bar. If you are the type who usually eats two or more bars at a time, these numbers can add up quickly. Second, there are a few less-than-desirable ingredients. The majority of the ingredients are natural, but there are some that could raise a few eyebrows. Nutritionally, however, these bars are better than most. Each serving provides seven grams of protein and one- hundred percent of your daily allowance for Vitamin E.

I enjoy granola bars and I enjoy the taste of peanuts, so Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar is a product to which I have taken an instant liking. These bars are a little more costly than some and there are only five bars in a standard box, so they aren't likely to last very long. But they are still a product worth trying. The great taste of peanuts, peanut butter, and granola combine to make a very good- tasting snack for morning, noon, or night.

Let me start by saying I'm reviewing this based on what it is...a bargain priced kit. It's not really fair to compare it to a $120 premium kit. With that said, I found it to be a solid product with nice flavor.

Based on other reviews on Amazon and forums I knew that I shouldn't make this kit to the full 6 gallons or it would be weak and lack body. I only made it to 5 gallons, but I would recommend you make it based on specific gravity rather than volume, because mine came out a little strong. Mine came out to about 13% ABV. On a Cabernet or a more full-bodied wine that would be okay, but it's a little strong for a Riesling. They give you the recommended starting SG, so I would shoot for the middle of that, rather than filling to volume, but probably about 5 1/2 gallons is where you want to be. That will allow you to leave the sediment behind and still fill up a 5 gallon carboy. If you have left over, then keep it in a one gallon jug/carboy and use to top up later in the process.

The flavor is still excellent and very drinkable. It was a dry kit, so I sweetened with 1 1/4 cups of wine conditioner. I added a little sorbate after clarifying and before adding the sweetner to avoid fermentation kicking off again. Give it a few days between adding the sorbate and sweetening to make sure fermentation is completely killed off. It's still not very sweet, so I would recommend 1 1/2 cups conditioner/sweetner to get closer to a Washington style Riesling.

Overall I think the kit is a true bargain, especially with free super saver shipping. I've since ordered the Shiraz and so far it is exceeding expectations as well.

Another thing I like about this product is the description said that some of the proceeds go to breast cancer research.

So, I'd probably use this as an afternoon pick-me-up, but replace my morning coffee? Probably not.
The French vanilla flavor is stronger than in the Baronet or Senseo french vanilla varitey.  The coffe taste is also a little bolder.

Taste like water. Nothing special in taste. At least I couldn't find any flavor. Which I like. I don't like the taste of arrowhead water. I prefer drinking Dasani water. Can't compare to this water due to the pH. Didn't notice any benefits of drinking water. Pretty sure if I had continued drinking the water overtime there would be some sort of advantage over regular water. As far as price I will stick to the regular water that is less expensive.

This tuna has excellent flavor, and I keep several cans at work and at home. It's perfect for lunch or a snack, in a salad or by itself. It is sooo much tastier than dry, water packed tuna. I do prefer the larger 5 ounce cans that require a can opener, and wish they were available on subscribe and save. Maybe someone with smaller hands would do better with the tiny cans.

I give 5 stars to the tuna, but 3 or less to the can, which is why I gave it a 4, not a 5 rating.
This is a hard product to find especially since I have been looking for it for sometime.  Received product as advertised.  I have no complaints.

Cooks up easily. Very tasty cooked in chicken stock. I did rinse and soak overnight in an acid medium (sprouts quickly by the way). Not so very different from rice or pasta in taste to us.

I ordered when the cost was just a couple dollars a bag, which was a good value. $89.99? NEVER!

I tried the plain mix and it left an empty feeling for the flavor. I mixed the product with other soups and noodles and this was a very good way to add a little spice to other things. Amazon has the best varity of these products.
Good deal, but a bit weak.  Can't add more water than directed or you'll be drinking coffee-flavored water. Other than that, not bad for decaf.

We were pleased to find the "K" cups at a (somewhat) reasonable price from Amazon.  They arrived quickly and we exactly as expected.  Trouble is, when we went to re-order, the deal was no longer available.  I thought Amazon would be my 'go to' resource for this product.  Now I'm surfing and shopping for deals elsewhere. I am so happy that I can stock this up in my office and home at such a cheap price. Well done!

Be sure to use the smaller setting (in my 2 cup machine)to avoid it being too weak.  If brewed strong enough, this is fabulously soothing and relaxing. Only reason I didn't give it 4 stars is that it wasn't strong enough on the larger setting so I feel like I don't get as much as I would like for my money.

My husband and I both tried Izze All Natural Sparkling Pomegranate Juice and here's what we think:

First Impressions...
We are not sure we can taste the Pomegranate in it, but my husband definitely tastes apple juice which is really not surprising because that's at the top of the ingredient list, followed by grape juice and others. I like that it is not super-sweet and only sparkles moderately, quite pleasant and refreshing actually.

Second Sips...
We both come to the conclusion that it almost has a wine-y taste, as if one were drinking an alcoholic beverage - maybe due to the grape juice? My husband also remarks that it would probably be great as a mix with alcohol, but let's not go there for the purpose of this review :-)

Conclusions...
We like it better than we thought we would, especially my husband who at first was very skeptical of the idea of having to drink sparkling pomegranate juice. It is quite refreshing and a great thirst quencher on hot days although I am not sure that it is something other than a regular, not-so-sweet soda. I don't have much to say about the added vitamins - I, for one, don't need them but they likely won't hurt either.
We will probably buy this again from time to time, just for a change from the same-old sodas in our fridge...

I do think it needs something more. I'd like a biscuit or some other type of flavor to offset the waxiness of white chocolate. Hazelnuts are good, but this product would be better with a biscuity crunch or rice cereal to give it a bit of oomph.

This is the perfect snack food to keep in your purse, office and car. It's really low cal and high protein, so you don't have to feel guilty.

I would give it 5 stars but it is a bit dry and chewy, that aspect could be improved upon. Still, I just ordered a bunch more and it's my favourite snack.

My 18 yr old cat (Mr.Kit T) was diagnosed with CRF and heart problems nearly 5 months ago and was near death.

The advise of 3 vets was to put him down. Vet#4 prescribed antibiotics, Prednisone,and Enapril. The only food advise was have T eat whatever he would eat the most of. He had dropped to under 5 lbs from his usual 9. For 2+ months human baby food, home made chicken broth, water and Pediasure were all he'd take. T was only eating the baby food if it was hand fed to him, licking one little dab at a time off the tip of my finger. He refused most other foods after a taste test including the expensive prescription brands.

Despite mixed reviews of the Neo diet I decided to try it.
T ate 1/3 of the first can all by himself with no prompting. In the past 2 1/2 months he will consistently eat this stuff and has gained a couple pounds. He likes it better when the can is freshly opened. If it has been refrigerated, bringing it up to room temp. & sprinkling 1/2 a crushed PetAg Taurine tablet and 1 Vetri-science Renal Essential tablet on top will get him going. (Note he will not touch it if it has been microwaved even for a second!). On a good day he can finish 1 1/2 cans but mostly it's 1 can/day. He now is back to batting paper balls around and the occasional catch-me-if-you-can chase around the house. He still has some problems with hard stools so I also add ~1 1/2 Tbsp cooked oatmeal, 2-3 Tbsp cooked, mashed sweet potato per Week and 1/4 tsp. Kefir live cheese/yogurt ~ every other day.

Can't say for sure how much of the change is due to the Neo, drugs or other supplements but since Neo is 95% of his diet, I have to believe it is a major factor. May not be the same for all cats but it has saved me a lot of time and expense in comparison to the first couple months of this final journey.

Non-fat instant tastes okay, it will never taste like fresh milk, but the SACO brand is probably the best tasting of the bunch. Mix it up and chill it well for the best flavor.

What I do use this milk for is cooking and baking. I either make up a small pitcher of the milk for cooking or use about 1/3 cup dry milk powder with 1 cup water for the recipe.

You can also use this milk to make homemade buttermilk, if you have some buttermilk as a starter. Search the web for a recipe.

If you want milk to drink, using milk powder, I'd recommend the Nestle Nido Milk Powder, Imported, (400 gm), 14.1-Ounce Cans (Pack of 3) as it tastes is very good.

Recommend for cooking and baking.

I bought this at Wild Oates, and I can really recommend it.  One tube is enough for two pesto pasta dinners for a family (total 8 servings or so per tube).  It has a lovely flavor, but I would not use quite so much olive oil (it suggests a 3 to 1 ratio) as it suggests.  Pair with a good Tuscan olive oil for best results as the flavor of the pesto seems designed for the burning sharpness of a really nice Italian oil.

It's hard for me to review these as I have two cats.  One is crazy for them, one won't touch them.  I didn't realize they were actual shavings, paper thin shavings of the fish. This was not something I achieved the first time trying this at even the lowest bake time. My brother described it akin to a tortilla chip. Ouch.

Additional sugar and butter and lowering the baking temperature has alleviated this quite a bit, but I will probably continue to make some changes to the mix.

Lastly, this mix is indeed quite spicy, and I normally handle spicy foods very well. As a product itself it is not overwhelmingly spicy, but this definitely has a little bit more kick than I was expecting. I will be experimenting whether this can be changed as well and will update my review accordingly.

My rating of 4 stars goes mostly for ease of using the mix. Rating would probably be lower if my taste preferences were of higher weight, but this is what happens when everything is already in the mix!

this brand is fantastic tasting. I have tried other brands but always come back to mauna loa brand. you will totally enjoy these macademias. I purchased these through amazon & the whole process went smoothly. I will buy again with amazon.

If you can stand this level of burn, at least this sauce is providing something other than burn.

I suspect that I'll use most of this in cooking homemade soups as a source of heat, where its good flavor will be diluted too much to matter... rather a pity.
Works great in smoothies, hot drinks and even on pancakes. Love this stuff! The best sugar substitute I've ever tried.

I always buy tahini at the supermarket and I'm used to it being the consistency of peanut butter, with a thin layer of oil at the top that must be stirred in. This was my first experience with Al Wadi Tahina. The Amazon price is fantastic, coming out at about a third of what I pay at the supermarket ounce per ounce. It has a rich sesame flavor and tastes very good. I was very surprised at the thin consistency. It's like a sauce, not a spread. It is so thin that I can put a long spoon in the bottle and stir it around without running into anything resembling peanut butter. It pours out of the jar like sauce. I tipped the second jar and could see that it was just as thin, so it wasn't a fluke. I feel like there's a very high oil to solid ratio. I was still able to measure it to the same amount I normally use in my hummus and the flavor came through just fine.

Also, the lids were on tightly and the plastic seal was intact, but oil had still seeped out of both jars and made them slippery. I don't believe that air entered the bottles, it was probably more of a vacuum effect during packaging and I feel it is safe to eat.

Overall, I'm happy with the purchase and I'm sure I'll order again because it's a great value.

I've been very successful at trapping moles with this trap. It was a little hard to figure out how to set it initially---the directions on the box aren't perfectly clear--but finally figured it out. It does require pretty good hand strength to set it. I used a 2 x 4 to prop the jaws of the trap open until I figured out how to set it. This trap was one of the few recommended by "The Mole Man" [...], whose web site it really great for learning about mole biology, habitat and how to control moles. Traps appear to be the only effective method. And this trap is certainly effective. I caught a mole the first night the trap was out and several more since.

I used this on tacos and quesadillas. Taco Bell Chipotle Sauce added a smoky, zesty flavor to both while not being too hot. It has a richer, more decadent flavor than salsa with more calories, but what the heck! I'm a firm believer in splurging every once in while.

This product seems to work, but for me it is a maintanance thing, it's not a normal tea taste for me, but it's drinkable for the benefits that it provides.
