I enjoy good beef jerky and this one was quite good.  The real problem is I can buy it cheaper at my local store than online.  Wanted to get several 12oz bags but the Amazon 2 package price is $4.12 more than at my local store, no deals here.  Be sure to shop around. Will definitely buy more.

I was looking for something different to put in my daughter's thermos for summer camp when my wife mentioned these. I haven't had Hawaiian Punch in a long time, so it sounded good. Being sugar free was a good thing because kids already get too much sugar anyway. As soon as it arrived we all tried it and liked it very much. I bought some regular (non-sugar free) a few days ago and now that I have had that I can taste the difference, but only slightly. If you haven't had Hawaiian Punch in a long time or if your kid has never had it, they won't even know the difference with this one.

This review is for Newman's Own Organics Ginger Snaps, Family Recipe Cookies.
These ginger snaps taste good. The cookies are about 1.25" in diameter. The right amount of ginger and the right amount of sweet. Although some cookies are crunchy and slightly hard, and others are slightly more chewy possibly due to a larger percentage of molasses in individual cookies. The bag has a resealable tape to seal the bag, yet it is not as effective as a zip lock, but it works. I prefer another brand of organic and natural ginger snaps over these cookies, but these are still quite good.

This is by far the best peanut brittle I ever tasted. I was puzzled by the '1 star' review given earlier. I checked the box and they are not accurate in their advertising. Corn syrup NOT pure sugar....
Still, ain't tasted none better........

I like these OK.  They are convenient and tasty enough.  But I just clicked on the link in my previous orders and it appears that they have just about doubled in price unless I read it wrong.  At almost $1 a cup, I'll pass....

De verdad los productos de esta marca son excelentes, pero a pesar de ser de carne tienen una textura un poco grasosa y un sabor acido, prefiero las Slim Jim.

this brand is excellent, but the taste is sour and the texture is a little greasy, i prefer the slim jim.

I liked the taste of the No Fear energy drink. I didn't experience any kind of after-taste. As for any kind of "energy" boost...I don't know. If I felt any kind of energy boost, it was slight. But, to be honest and fair, I've tried other brands of energy drinks and I can't say I ever feel any kind of boost.
All-in-all, this is a delicious drink and ranks right up there with any of the other drinks on the market.

The label doesn't even call this Balsamic Vinegar, let alone the Traditional variety, but for the price this is a very decent value.  Syrupy, complex notes from the various woods used for aging, clearly made from the finest grapes, I don't need to go Traditional and spend $100 as long as I can get this "must" instead.
Excellant flavor and not to chewy. I am not a fan of the multiple layers of packaging.

There is good instruction in details about how to take good care of these seeds into plants. I appreciate it because I am the first time planter of Bonsai. I follow the steps by the guidance and I hope those seeds will become a bonsai plant. If I really succeed I will come back to write my other review.

I'd heard about these from a few people, but the price in the supermarket, generally about $6/jar, kept me from trying them.  These aren't too sweet and the chocolate flavor isn't overwhelming--think of a dark chocolate bar.  I don't have much of a sweet tooth so I found these pretty satisfying, but I'd keep these as an occasional treat only.
I love this drink and it is very convenient to purchase from Amazon.  The last shipment had some lumps in the cans so I am not sure if they were older, or got moisture in them or not.

If you're feeding a large family, or use water chestnuts often, this is a good choice.  These water chestnuts are reasonably priced.  They don't seem quite as flavorful as some brands, but when used in stir-fry, they take on the flavor of the other ingredients, and add a nice crunch factor.  I've also added a can to a pound of snow peas, and cooked them together in a little olive oil with salt and pepper, for a nice side dish.
My friend is a big coffee drinker and he loved this coffee. Very flavorfull and smells great when perking.

My co-worker turned me onto Steel Cut Oatmeal and then I introduced it to my family. Although I can find it in my local grocery store, it is at least twice the price. My most recent order here on Amazon I paid an average of $2.14 a box using Subscribe and Save and an additional discount that was being offered. Can't beat that deal and it keeps my cupboards stocked.

For those that don't know what steel cut oatmeal is, I suggest trying it locally before buying in bulk. It is not your "usual" oatmeal. It is thicker, chewy and much more filing. A little definitely goes a long way! Additionally there are some wonderful overnight cooking recipes out there worth trying too.

I've used Splenda for years, so I was eager to try this new Splenda. The taste is fine. In a single cup of tea I didn't notice any difference from regular Splenda. However, when I used a teapot with my usual 3 cups of water and 3 packets of Splenda, the tea wasn't as sweet.

Didn't taste any difference on cereal.

The individual packages can spill Splenda if not carefully opened. The added fiber, (which is good), makes the serving size larger, and it's packed into a very tight package. It's sealed on three sides, rather than just the top and bottom. There's no room to give it a shake and have an empty area to tear open.

If you use it for single cup servings, I doubt that you would sense any difference from regular Splenda.

If you feel you need more fiber, this is an easy way to get a little.

As a somewhat health-nut I am always in the search of healthy snacks that aren't packed full of chemicals or high fructose corn syrup. When it comes to graham crackers, it's usually hard to find these qualities in most brands but I like how Back to Nature stepped up and delivered. As with most of their products this one is devoid of HFC and has mostly natural ingredients. One thing I was let down by was how low the fiber content was - most of their products have a lot of fiber in them but this one is lacking severely. On the flip side, it isn't loaded with sugar (just 7 grams per serving) and is sweetened instead with evaporated cane juice and brown rice syrup. Overall, these are addictive and quite tasty unlike many "healthy" snack alternatives. Definitely recommend.

I haven't seen these in sale at the local supermarket in a while, while browsing Amazon's warehouse deals I saw these. $[...] for 64 bags not bad at all. I ordered on 1/10/11 and it came two days later, the expiration date for all of them is March 8th. Not too shabby considering these will be consumed by two growing boys lol. I mainly bought them for my brother, since he buys crisps at school anyways and a little bag like this will cost $.75-$1.00 pending whether he buys at school or at a petrol station.

The only compliant I have is that the box arrived smashed up a bit on one side, but I just had a bag of crisps from that side and it seems perfectly fine and whole. There also isn't anything that protects the bags of crisps. As soon as you open the box all you'll see is the bags of chips and your Amazon receipt.

While I think this is a great deal, you should be aware of the short shelf life, it's a good deal because they need to unload expiring products. So if you live by yourself, your probably better off buying from the supermarkets. If you have a ton of kids, or just really enjoy in indulging in DELICIOUS BBQ CRISPS these are for you!!!

If you would like to buy these crisps you MUST click on "See more buying choices". Or else you'll be buying these crisps for $[...].. PLUS $6.95 shipping!!!!

I rarely drink instant coffee, but sometimes go to rural India on medical trips. Outside of Starbucks cafes and large western style hotels (in all cities, but not in rural India) it is nearly impossible to get brewed coffee in India. Ask for coffee, and you get instant, everywhere in India (except as noted). Anyway, to get a coffee fix on the go, I've tried the Starbucks Via Columbia packets, and (for instant coffee) they are wonderful, won't fool you into thinking you've got a good cup of brewed coffee, but better than common western office coffee, and much better than the instant served in rural India. The Starbucks packs cost 75 cents to $1 each, and I was hoping the Nescafe Clasico packs would be nearly as good, at 1/8 the price. Unfortunately, not. If you want something that reminds you of brewed coffee, bite the bullet and pay for the Starbucks.

I like this tea, and its a good value, but I feel like it isn't full bodied tasting as some other roasted rice teas like that of yamamotoyama.  For me it's almost like drinking hot water.  Would be a great tea for somebody that likes  a light subtle tasting tea before they go to bed.

I use a lot of raw cocoa for my power protein drinks.  With the high price of cocoa on the commodity market, this is an excellent price, especially for an organic product.  The cocoa is less "tasty" than my regular brand, but does very well for the price.  My main complaint is that the product came in a sealed plastic bag with NO label.  I would like to see an organic label, as well as, the nutrition info for the product.

If you're going mainstream with your coffee, Peet's is the way to go. It's not burned, has a great robust flavor that doesn't get watered down by simple additions. There's nothing more annoying than making a should-be strong cup, adding a little half-and-half and then wondering where the flavor of your coffee went. Peet's has a large assortment of grounds as well, which is nice if you're the type that likes to venture from the ordinary with different traditional coffees. I used to drink Starbucks, but their coffee is routinely burned and acidic. This is well-rounded in comparison and strong, without being too bitter.

I bought a product very similar to this one from the Boy Scouts last year. That was good, but very expensive. This one was also good, but the price is more digestible. Really, you get what you expect from this product. No one who doesn't like popcorn is going to buy this product. People who do like popcorn are going to buy this product and really enjoy it. Is it a healthy snack? No! Did you really expect chocolate- and carmel-covered popcorn to be healthy? I guess you get some fiber in there, but - no - this isn't a health food. It is a guilty pleasure. It's just what you'd expect, and that is a great-tasting snack! Each of my kids is going to school, today, with a pouch of this in their lunches. The serving size is just right for this. The only reason I didn't give this product five stars was that I realize there are healthier snacks out there. But if you are just looking for a light snack that tastes great, this is a good one to choose! I'd love to get another free sample of this stuff!

This is a mayo my hubby and I can agree on.  I prefer the cheaper stuff from Trader Joes but he likes "regular" mayo from the grocery store.  This is our good compromise - less fat and still a taste like "regular" mayo.  But its mayo - its not made for daily consumption!

First, $1.00 per pack is an excellent value. Each pack contains 12 little sachets of two crackers each. The nutritional value listed about the crackers is for four of these little sachets (8 crackers) so each packet has three servings. The taste is good, if neutral, but I like neutral taste in a cracker so you can dip it or dress it as you wish with little interference from the cracker. The taste is not sweet (surprising since the 2nd ingredient is sugar) but 1s ever so VERY slightly of soy/sweet....very lightly salty/sweet....altogether quite nice. Each cracker is substantial enough to carry any heavy dip without breaking. The sodium is 125 mg. and the sugar is 3g for each 8 cracker serving. All the nutritional info is listed here on Amazon, just thought I'd mention those after the salty/sweet remark.....
Altogether I am happy with the purchase but will probably donate about 1/2 the crate of 30 packages to a local food bank.
I can recommend these for a nice change of crackers. If you opened a bunch of the little sachets and put them on a platter they'd be great for a party. f.y.i., each cracker is approx. 2 3/4" long and 2" wide.
Enjoy.

I know these are Great. I ordered these (a box of 6-1 pound bags) on Feb 28. It is only March 17 and I have already eaten 3 of the bags. They taste great and are fun to eat. The only thing wrong is that they are NOT the Potato Sticks we ate as kids. These look like they took ripple chips and cut the chips along the ripple. They are very small sticks of chips or more like bits and pieces.

I have three dogs, a caucasian, and two Alsatians. They all love Beneful. I thought i would have some problems switching over to this as they had been used to another brand. But this was not the case, from the first time i gave it to them , they ate it with abandon and enthusiasm.

The Beneful dog food is a nice tasting food for dogs I also know this because we have tried other dog foods with them and they didn't really like them . The packaging is a bit difficult to open and you will need another airtight container to store the food as the bag it comes with is not airtight and cannot be re-sealed once open. So i would reccomend an improvement in the packaging. From my Dogs perspective , its 5 stars based on taste, from mine 4 stars for the less than perfect packaging.
Cafe' Escapes Chai Latte K Cups-it taste so smooth and it's a quick treat for the middle of the Day just sweet enough.

Shake 'n Bake has been around a long time, which should tell you something about the product. It's very easy to use -- just put it in a plastic bag, add your pork chop (or whatever), and shake until the meat is coated with the crumbs. They tell you to put the crumbs in a bowl if you don't happen to have a plastic bag, so you're not limited there.

I used the coating for pork chops and they didn't stick to the pan. The underside crumbs were a bit mushy and not crunchy, so I don't know if I should have flipped the pork chops halfway through cooking or what. I guess I'll have to get more Shake 'n Bake and try it again. My husband said it was "okay," which isn't a bad thing. It's not something to rave about

The ingredients are enriched wheat flour, various B vitamins, salt, canola oil, sugar, spice, caramel color, dried onions, dextrose, yeast, extracts of paprika, and ascorbic acid (vitamin C). There are six 40-calorie servings per pouch. My only qualm is with the "spice," since I'm trying to avoid MSG and I don't know if it can be hidden under "spice." If it's in there, it's a very small amount, but I prefer full disclosure on ingredient labels. The onions are also very, very small. I actually don't like onions, but I do like onion powder. If you have kids who are picky eaters, they won't notice the onions. I didn't. ;)

The "original pork" flavor is mild and makes a nice meal by itself, but if you want to spice it up, you can always mix in your own herbs and spices. That makes it very versatile. Overall, a good item to have in your pantry.

There is no question that these days, it can be hard to get everyone in the family together to come to the dinner table for a meal. For Velveeta they are looking for new ways to get good meals to everyone in the house, made in creative ways for you. Their new Velvetta Skillets Dinner Kit isn't a bad idea. It is a simple and easy way to help with dinner in the home. It is a delightful mix of cheese & broccoli in the pasta sauce. The taste is pretty good, but the problem is that it is very complicated getting the dinner and meat together. It can take longer than Kraft's Suddenly Salads which is easier to make for the family at home. Still, I think you should give this Velveeta chicken & Broccoli Skillets Dinner a shot.

Price: B-

Taste: B-

Convience: C+

Overall: B-
Great flavor, though a little chalky. The only problem being that the quantity is too large for just one flavor. It gets old after a while.

I've been using CLEAR Conditioner for a couple of weeks now and it does what it says it'll do. I have very long hair and CLEAR has cut down on the frizzies to an incredible degree. My hair looks healthier and feels better than it has in a long time. Highly recommended for those two attributes alone, and an added bonus is its lovely lingering fragrance, not overwhelming at all.

The only drawback to this product I've found, and this is probably because my hair is so very long, is that I've developed some nasty snarls at the nape of my neck. They're fairly easy to untangle, but they're there and didn't used to be. The first one could have been an anomaly, but three or four a week is not. The only thing I've changed is to use the CLEAR. It's not a deal breaker, but worth a mention.

I'd rate CLEAR four and a half stars but since that's not an option, I'm awarding it four.

I have the Keurig with the 7 and 9 ounce settings. As a coconut fanatic, I was so very disappointed in Green Mountain's Island Coconut coffee k cups not necessarily because of the taste, but because even when you use the smallest setting on the coffee maker, it is very weak and tastes like coconut flavored water.

I just found these Coconut Mocha k cups while shopping at Staples and grabbed two boxes. Just had my first cup and again, even though this coffee says that it is bold on the box, using the mid-size setting on the Keurig resulted in a good but not great cup as far as strength goes. The taste is very smooth. I did not taste the mocha though, just a smooth coconut flavor that was excellent but I wish it was a little stronger. You can tell while the cup is brewing that the water flow turns clear about halfway through the brewing process so a lot of plain water is added after the initial coffee pours through. I think for the next cup I will pull the cup away to avoid all that additional flavorless water to drop in. Taste-wise these cups are great once you get your desired strength figured out.
I was impressed with the freshness, tast and texture of these Gogo Berries.  The taste and sweetness was exceptional.
I am very pleased with this tea. I have given 4 stars only because I felt that the peppermint flavor should be a little stronger.

No matter how highly rated of a kibble we would get for our little shih tzu & yorkie mix, she would throw up about three times per week.  Once we switched to this raw dehydrated meal at the recommendation of some folks at a local pet store who have a pomeranian with a sensitive tummy, the problem was solved!  Even if she would get into something she was not supposed to, no vomiting, seemed to do miracles for her digestive track in general, so was very pleased!  Have also used the lamb formula, which we have had a great experience with, as well.  Also - she LOVES it!  To save money, we would buy the large 8 pound bag and I am very sad that the price has recently risen so drastically (Nov. of 2011 from $60 per bag to $75, BIG jump).  Because of the price increase, we had switched to Grandma Lucy's (Artisan freeze-dried), with equal success as far as no vomiting and her loving the food, but have switched back to Addiction because she was looking thin, as if the protein content was not enough.  I would recommend calling around to specialty feed stores in your area to find the absolute best price.

I got this 6-pack simply to round up an order to get free Amazon shipping.  The Cilantro does not have much taste or smell when sampled from the palm of my hand.  Maybe the flakes work well when seasoning/cooking a turkeyburger but my palate did not tell me so.

Good mate'.  Not my absolute favorite, but good.  I just bought this same sized bag of this same brand at a local international market for $4.50 (the most expensive brand they had. They had some for $3.50/500g).  This offering is overpriced.

Actually a really good idea - a variety of coffee without having to buy multiple boxes. Let's you see the breadth of choices out there for Keurig machines. I didn't know half of these types existed. Some flavored, some single-sourced, some blends - you won't know what you're getting for sure but you're sure to find something you'll like.

Downside: you might get some decaf. :) You might also get some non-coffee K-cups like tea, hot chocolate, cider, etc. that you might not like.

It goes well with popcorn ,eggs Pizza and as a general condiment however I would not compare to the real taste of Bacon, a delightful alternative for the diet conscious person , I will buy again though when i run out.

One of my friends is big into organic foods and introduced me to these crackers. They are extremely crunchy & crisp, reasonably low in calories (140 calories for 13 crackers) and don't contain any gluten, wheat or high fructose corn syrup.

They do have a slight nutty flavor, but the texture makes me think I am eating bird seed.

They don't taste salty at all to me, but contain 190mg of sodium per serving.

Obviously, if you have wheat or gluten allergies, these crackers could be perfect for you. If you are like me and eat pretty much anything there are better crackers out there, but these are probably a bit healthier than most.

I would like to try other flavors, but I'm not willing to purchase a box of 12 just to find out I didn't like it. It would be nice if Amazon sold an assortment of 12.

First time we have tried stevia so I have no other brands to compare to.  Stevia has a different taste than sugar so you have to get used to that.  In baking with it it did not seem that sweet but I am learning that you have to make your own adjustments.  I love being able to make wholesome cookies & muffins for my children without sugar so I am willing to learn how to use stevia.

I find the MiO Liquid Water Enhancer to be quite handy. It's the easiest way I know of to put together a glass of iced tea. I squirt this stuff, as an octopus squirts ink, into a glass of ice water, keeping in mind that a little goes a long way I stir and add until it resembles the tint of what I would expect a glass of tea to look like.

The flavor is nice. Exotic ingredients are at a minimum: acesulfame potassium (Google for its interesting origin) is a sweetener. The rest is water, propylene glycol, malic acid, a couple more additives and some colorings.

If you enjoy your tea sweet, this stuff replicates the flavor. I recommend MiO if the speed and convenience of simply squirting a concentrate into a glass of ice water seems appealing.

We received this order in perfect condition. I purchased this product for my mother-in-law. She likes the convenience of the product in the Keurig Coffee Maker. The chocolate does not stick to the sides of the cup like the cheap hot chocolate in the paper bags. Overall it tastes pretty good. It is a little weak but good. Use only on the small cup setting in the Keurig. 4 stars.

The only thing keeping this product from five stars are all of the broken shells. At the top of the bag, I found a number of half shells. However, when I got to the bottom I realized that many of the seeds had collected there in a pile of shell remnants and seasoning salt. Blow the seasoning off and you may lose some seeds as well. Otherwise, a great eating experience.

I actually got this flavor for my husband who really does like flavored coffee, usually I'm not a fan of them. After trying a French roast K-cup in my brand new coffee brewer and being very disappointed, I decided to give this one a go. Brewing a cup with 5 ounces of water makes a very nice medium strength, vanilla flavored coffee that tastes pretty good in the morning.
Usually when I have vanilla coffee, I grind an inch or two of a vanilla bean that's leftover from cooking into dark roasted beans and brew coffee in a regular drip brewer. Compared to that, this coffee is a lighter roast but with a nice flavor, and the vanilla flavor is mildly sweet. This is a coffee k-cup I would serve without hesitation to my dad and I think my husband will love it.
Definitely planning to try more of Van Houtte's flavors.

I recently bought a Keurig coffee maker and was looking for k-cups when I discovered this.  My daughter is a hot chocolate lover and so I decided to give this a try.  If your coffee machine has different size drink settings use smallest size setting otherwise it is too watery but when done on the lowest size setting it makes a very good cup of hot cocoa.  My daughter loves it and has it nearly every morning.  It is very convenient and if you have a Keurig coffee maker and are looking for drink alternatives to coffee this is a good choice.

I gave this a full 30-days to see if would live up to it's claim. And so far, it has. My main issues are with neighborhood dogs and rabbits. It didn't do a thing for the bunnies, nor does it claim to. But dogs are quite annoying. There is absolutely nothing more annoying than stepping in crap when doing yard work. Or discovering a dog decided to dig through the garden.

This stuff is basically a combination of various peppers that would repel most humans, let alone common critters. You might want to wear gloves and mask if you're sensitive to stuff like that. As directed, I applied this around the perimeter of the back and front yard, and waited. I was skeptical it would last with the sprinkler system and occasional rain.

Of course dogs are smart. Once they get a smell of that repellent, they often avoid it in the future. In either case, I'll be applying another "border" fairly soon just in case they forget or we get some new dogs in the area.

Overall, this is somewhat pricey for what it is. But it does have a handy shaker for easy distribution, and so far, its working against the neighborhood dogs. The only other negative is that I wish there was something in there to repel bunnies. I think those guys actually like this stuff. :)
My dog likes the Canidae, and he's very fussy.  The fish product is a little, well, fishy, but the other varieties are solid.

This Nectresse Sweetener is rather light in taste --but is very nice over other light foods such as fruits , berries , melons -----anywhere that lightness yet sweetness is desired.

I also enjoyed it in iced teas .....especially my fruited teas like strawberry or orange.....

I also used it hot teas as welll---but since it was summer more cold drinks went to table than hot.But it would be great on and in either.

I did not try it as a cooking sweetener because of its smaller sized containers....so I cannot recommend it for baking or cooking.

I can and whole heartedly DO RECOMMEND it for any type of sweetening where its to be sprinkled over such as cereal , oatmeals ect.......or in drinks of any type...and fruits as I mentioned earlier !!

NO bad tasted only nice sweetness !!

This was a good buy for the household who enjoys escargot in a shell once in a while and does not necessarily need the highest quality snail. I realized that there were other more expensive options out there that would probably be better quality, but I have always been happy with Roland for special occasions where escargot is on the menu.

My toddler son loves these cheddar bunnies and I'm pleased to be able to order these online and just have them delivered to my home. The only downside about the small package is that they are probably environmentally unfriendly but at least they don't get stale like the big boxes which I have to pour into his snack trap container.

This chocolate is rich, creamy, bitter and every bit satisfying. I like to refrigerate it then eat a couple squares (read: half the bar) chilled and crunchy jagged. Most Americans will find this chocolate too bitter for their taste, at only 5g sugar per half bar serving. But if you're the type who likes your espresso straight up, and bitter flavors in general... you will HEART this chocolate! It also may not be as bitter the 2nd and 3rd time you try it... so hang in there and at least eat up the entire bar.

I just reallyreally wish they'd find a better substitute for the soy lecithin.... which is the only reason why I took away one star. Pretty please???

This stuff tastes great.  I wasn't expecting much when I mixed it with my orange juice, but I was wrong.  I can't claim any miracles in the health department, but I haven't had any recent cholesterol checks either.  It makes a delicious smoothie, and I will continue to use it because I read and believe the studies on acai.

I liked this, very smooth tasting with no aftertaste from being sweetened
and left in a can...amazing. I added some 1/2-n-1/2 to thin it for this
American palette and still enjoyed it a lot. If you purchase this, note
it says do not shake...unlike the Starbucks products you better shake or
leave 1/2 of the product at the bottom.

Nice Flavor if you do not want things boring.  I have purchased other sea salts that were much more expensive, but I genuinely prefer this. It's grey in color (that may bother some but not me) and too moist to put in salt grinders (Great to use when marinating your finest bad-ass Fred Flintstone-type steaks! Try this, I highly recommend! Great product. Yummy! Tastiest sea salt out there as far as I am concerned. Nice price for this much salt. Grains are large and it packs a burst of flavor,  so it's easy to over salt stuff, you'll get used to using it quickly.

There was no exceptional taste difference to me between the dark and milk chocolate. Still the classic Reese's taste. It is an interesting change but a little bland for what I consider dark chocolate.

This is a very good product.However due to poor packaging by Nutricity two bottles got broken.This had to be discarded by the courier company and the remaining ten bottles were repacked by them.Nutricity refuses to entertain any claim as they say that the time to make a claim has elasped.

I really like this oil for my hair. It says you can take it as a supplement but I didn't do that. I only use it for nourishing my hair when it's dry. It has a great sheen. I know it's natural coconut oil, but I sort of do not like the smell. But I still like using it every two or three days. To use it, I poured it into a smaller jar and keep that on the vanity for regular use, because it returns to a solid form.  I leave the larger jar it came in sitting in the window, to keep it in liquid form. But I guess you could just scoop it out when needed. Very good oil!
The Frontier Kelp Powder is certainly healthy and far better for one than regular salt but I have to say it's a little slimy. It helps to mix it with spices.

I have two mastiffs; an English and an Italian (aka Cane Corso). As owner of giant breeds Im always looking for the best products for my babies. With a recent lay off I needed to slash my budget without compromising the health of my girls. Naturally I was searching for a holistic food that caters specifically to the needs of giant breeds. I was ecstatic when I found this food. The ingredient levels were nearly perfect and had extra minerals good for joints too. All natural food with chicken being the 1st ingredient and at a great price especially since im buying for two. I compared it to Blue Buffalo, which is great but still a little pricey, the labels were almost identical. What a God send! Unfortunately, neither one of my girls liked the food. They disliked it so much so they did not eat for 3 days. I added a little water to release the aroma, I soaked it in chiken broth, they just didnt want it. Maybe my girls are spoiled. I would recommend starting with a small bag to see if your dog likes it. As for me, the search continues.

what is it? I'm so confused!

My sweet, adventuremonger husband, Norman, thought this was a hoot, so he bought it and cooked it up for me, for our 15 and a half year anniversary candlelight dinner.

MMMmm, yummy. After a few dee-lish bites, I, of course, asked him, "Sweetums, what IS this?"

"Why, Snugglepuss, it's Turducken, of course!" he answered, with a wicked grin. I kept eating, trying the different colors, white and dark meat, that sliced in a lovely way.

"Huh?" I managed, with a mouthful of white meat.

"Tur - duck - hen," he pronounced patiently, slowly. as if speaking to a very slow thinker. Like, oh, now I get it! Not.

Then, he kindly showed me the packaging, which he fished out of the trash. Ohh, but of course, a part Turkey, part Duck, and part Hen. why didn't I see it!? The hen, I assume is the part that's chicken.

Well, I give the inventors a gold star for inventiveness! Who'd of thunk??

Being as I love it when my man cooks for me (and shops) I didn't complain. It was lovely. tender, moist, and certainly unusual. Pricy, perhaps. But, how often do you see a turducken?

my Norman is a hunter, and he's never brought home anything like this!

Tasty, unusual, a conversation starter for your next party! buy a few! yummmmm.....

I'm not a health nut. In fact I'm a foodie who wouldn't give up anything in the name of health. I do tend to think that stuff like this sacrifice taste and don't buy them. So why did I get this? the description had said they could be sprinkled on yogurt and I do eat lots of yogurt.

Surprisingly, however, these taste good. I like them. For the most part, I ate these with milk as morning cereal or I snacked on them. I never got to put them on yogurt (which was my original intention). If these come with the subscribe and save plan, i'll order it just to have them over. Otherwise, they'll be an as needed buy.
A little goes a long way with these. The didn't taste like raw bran or some "healthy" cereal completely robbed of taste. Instead, even a sweet tooth like me liked it. Just a reference, I don't drink skim milk because i think it taste like water so that should give a little idea of where i'm coming from.

My only con with these: they packages aren't big. Not like regular cereal bags. They're much smaller. I wish they came a little bigger which is why i took of a star. But then you don't need to eat much to feel full so i guess....

Anyway, If you're the kind of person who avoids stuff like these because you think they taste bad, try this and be amazed. If you're a health food junkie, well, now you don't have to sacrifice taste.
Cheers!
We all know that gummi bears are awesome.  This bag, while it seems massive to begin with, once you start, this stuff goes really quickly.

We drink a lot of ice tea.  Offering this decaf ice tea to the family with some spenda as the sweetener is so much better for us than colas.  I like that I can have a nice big drink of ice tea in the evening and not worry about staying awake all night.

I bought first bought this product from PetSmart (where it is $8 by the way) for my 15 year old cat who had been mysteriously losing weight.  She loves it, but I cant give it to her too often or she stops eating it.  It turns out that she is hyperthyritic and thats why she lost weight, but since shes only 5 1/2 pounds I still feed it to her a couple times a week even with her thyroid medicines working quite well.  Not all cats like it though.  My other cat, a 7 pound long-hair tuxedo, wont even taste it.  So it depends on your cat.  I would get a can from PetSmart or PetCo first to see if your animal is willing to eat it. This chai tea is pretty good, much better than the Celestial seasonings. It still needs some vanilla latte creamer to make it thicker but the taste is pretty good.

I'm not generally a fan of raisin brain, but I decided to try this, and surprisingly -- at least to me -- it's pretty good stuff. That's why I'm giving it 4 stars. Perhaps a fan would give it five, but it still suffers from one major flaw, and that is, it tends to get soggy in milk. However, I will say, this one stays crisper longer. So good work.

I have a Great Dane and two Dachshunds.

Pros: My dogs loved these! They last a lot longer than Merrick Pig Snozzles. My Great Dane takes about 10-20 minutes to finish and my Dachshunds take as long as a few hours. Usually they don't get the option to finish because when my Dane finishes his, he goes after theirs.

Cons: Expensive. I'm glad I tried them, but I wouldn't get them again. Too expensive for a treat that doesn't last that long.

I'm giving them a high rating because my dogs thoroughly enjoyed them, but I don't think I would recommend them to somebody who doesn't want to spend a fortune on dog treats.

I have had to cut back on caffeine recently because of heart palpitations that seemed to be made worse by all the coffee I drink (5 cups a day, maybe.) So I am mixing 1/3 Melitta Colombian and 2/3 decaf. I substituted this for the other decaf I have been drinking and found that it has a rich smooth taste. Very little to none of the burnt taste that decaf often has. The price on amazon makes it a pretty good buy as well. I don't care for the packaging, however. I couldn't get it open without cutting the top, and then I had to transfer it to an old coffee can to store it, with all the mess that that entails. If it were in a can, I would be more inclined to buy it. But the taste for a decaf is quite good.

My 17 month old daughter tried these at a b-day party and loved them so much she ended up having 2 before we cut her off. Her twin brother found them frustrating to eat as he does not have molars yet.

I like that they are real fruit snacks and have no preservatives.

Like the other reviewer, the fruit snacks had a 2 month expiration. However, we use 30 twists within 2 months. Also, shelf life is shorter for items without preservatives.

What can you say about a body wash? Does it get you clean? Yes. Well isn't that enough?

Apparently not because this one has MICROMOISTURE technology. All these jargon words really make me laugh. You know there is a room of marketing guru's just sitting around thinking, "what words can we put together that will make our product sound revolutionary?"

This team came up with: patent filed technology (yes that's right, "filed"), micromoisture technology, clinically proven, dermatologist recommended, and total skin comfort. I'm sure one of these is a typo on the container.

But let's talk about the product now.

Smell - it smells clean, masculine, not overpowering. It reminds me a bit of an Axe body spray.

Texture - it has "purifying grains", which means it's sort of like using lava soap but in liquid form. It's gritty but not in a tear-up-your-skin way. That grit is supposed to help wash away dead skin cells and leave your skin refreshed and clean. I would have to say that yes, it does make my skin feel nice afterward.

Where to use it - it says "body and face" but I don't really like micro-beads getting into my eyes. Be cautious about that. Great for body, not for the eyes - so when you're scrubbing your face be sure to squint really tight until you wash all the grit off.

So what do I like? It smells good and it leaves my skin feeling like it's been cleaned very well.

So what don't I like? It's not a shampoo & body wash, just a body wash, so I wind up having to use shampoo as well. This won't apply for bald men, but for the rest of us - I don't recommend using this as a shampoo because it takes forever to wash the microbeads out of your hair.

As advertised the product gets 4 stars. Improvement idea would be to make an all-in-one product so I don't have to spend longer in the shower or use two products to get clean.
These are great!  Not the same as Maynards, but still really good in their own right! They were cheaper than expected but good quality.

Despite other negative reviews, I like this k-cup and overall am always pleased with the Timothy's brand. I've lost some of my sense of smell but have never felt it gave off an offensive odor. I too would like more Kahlua flavor but I think it has a good, smooth taste. I also wouldn't call it bold as others do. I think it is much more on the mild side. It's always interesting to see such diverse opinions when it comes to taste. I'm about to make my second purchase so it works for me.

This makes a very easy, tasty meal when combined with frozen mixed vegetables and instant mashed potatoes. Use a little less water in the instant potatoes. I made the pie using ground venison and it was wonderful.

Pleasant. not bitter in the least, low acidity. Definitely on the darker side of a medium roast.

I tried this because it was on sale and I'm quite happy with it. Would buy again.

I picked this up to try a different taste from my usual HAZELNUT. I was pleased with this taste.
Tom

These bars were delicious. The nuts were great, the honey flavor came through, and the dark chocolate was spot on. The only problem was the texture - I ordered these in the middle of summer & the chocolate had melted & wandered around in the wrapper. I hope to have better results ordering these in winter.

Tried these many months ago and found myself buying on a regular basis - so I wanted to buy in bulk to save $$$.  These are a great tasting snack that satisfies my between-meal hunger without excess calories, fat and sugar.  I will continue to purchase, especially now that Costco carries them.
Smaller than expected but greatly appreciated gifts. positive feedback from family members.  will give this gift again next year. thank you.

This is a really good popcorn at an excellent price.

Organic, which is a great big plus for me, and bears the USDA seal, so it is also GMO free. Doesn't pop as large as some, but there are very few un-popped kernels.

The only negative at all for me is that the taste is slightly bland.

Well worth a try. I'll be buying more.
OK, so it's just sugar.  I can't find this locally, so for the bar, I bought a few boxes.  So far, so good.  Dissolves much better than the usual granular.
My family and I really enjoy this on our chicken. It does not get mushy like Shake and Bake. Very crispy! We buy the pork variety as well.

Okay, first off, full disclosure: I am a pumpkin fanatic. I love the taste of pumpkin when the holidays roll around, from pumpkin cookies, to pumpkin pie, pumpkin soup, and (yes) even pumpkin ale.

So I might be a little biased.

However, I have to say that I really loved the Maxwell House International Pumpkin Spice Latte. It mixes up with a slightly frothy, slightly creamy consistency when drunk hot, and the flavors are rich and pumpkin-y, with some nice accents of cloves and cinnamon and other appropriate notes.

I also mixed it up as an iced latte, by mixing a little very hot water from the tap with a few spoonfuls of the coffee, mixing thoroughly and vigorously til dissolved, and then adding milk and giving one last stir. I then added ice, and it was just as delicious iced as it is hot.

Pumpkin Spice Latte is ultimately really yummy, and the perfect holiday treat for a cold day. It's basically like a cup full of hot pumpkin pie in coffee form. Which is a good thing for us pumpkin fans -- so if you're one of them, you'll probably really enjoy this coffee. I loved it so much I was sorely tempted to buy the case of six, since I know it's limited to the holidays.

Cheers and happy holidays!

The producers of this coffee did a marvelous job on the artistic packaging, but the coffee itself lacks the pizazz I'd expect from a coffee pod. I made the coffee in more than just the coffee pod, including taking the grinds out of the pod and putting them through my own filter, but the result was still the same--the taste was forgettable.

The packaging, like I said, was marvelous, but each packet had to be opened with scissors because there was no tear cut. Just a little thing, but noticeable.

If you like want organic coffee and you like Ethiopian beans, this is still a good option over other non-organic pods.

****

This Pomegranate Green Tea from Yogi Tea is an antioxidant refresher. It's an all natural tea made from organic green tea leaf, organic hibiscus flowers, organic flavors, organic peppermint leaf, pomegranate juice powder, stevia leaf, organic burdock root, and organic dandelion root. The taste is mild, only very slightly tasting of pomegranate, tasting mostly just of green tea, with a very pleasant aroma; in fact, it's so mild, that I would definitely use two tea bags and brew it for the full six minutes. It does not get bitter. Unless you enjoy very mild tea, you should plan on getting fewer cups of tea from the box. For this reason I gave this tea only four stars.

I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Pomegranate Green Tea comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site has a helpful glossary of tea ingredients and is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.

Yogi Tea writes this on the box about the tea's benefits: "Green Tea Pomegranate helps reinvigorate the body through the neutralization of harmful free radicals. Delicious Pomegranate provides this tea with a powerful dose of natural antioxidants and exciting fruit flavor. This cherished fruit contains polyphenols, chemical compounds that include Epigallo-catechin-3 gallate (EGCG), an antioxidant that is nearly 100 times more potent than vitamin C and 25 times more potent than vitamin E. A favorite of the Mediterranean peoples for centuries, Pomegranate has also been linked to nourishing the skin, supporting healthy cholesterol levels already in the normal range and promoting cardiovascular health. Like Pomegranate, Organic Green Tea also supplies polyphenols that help ward off free radicals. In fact, a single cup of Green Tea has been shown to provide greater antioxidant support than a serving of broccoli, spinach or strawberries. To further complement this healing formula, we've included the detoxifying qualities of Organic Burdock and Organic Dandelion, as well as the gentle essence of Organic Peppermint. Enjoy a cup of refreshing Green Tea Pomegranate and feel renewed with the benefits of nature's most powerful antioxidants."

There are no cautions or warnings on the box except the standard disclaimer that the tea is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Pomegranate Green Tea has contains approximately 30 mg of caffeine per tea bag, which is just one third of what is normally found in an 8 oz cup of coffee.

I really like this tea, and it is very health-promoting. Recommended.

****

Good product. I am reducing one star because of the fact when cooked, for the same cup size, the quantity seemed to be little less than the brand I used before. I also felt like it is refined a little bit more than typical bulgur.

I really liked the taste and texture of these cookies.  Not overly sweet and just a little fruity.  They are very crispy and because they are fairly thin, a little hard to stop eating.  Excellant with hot chocolate and of course all the kids liked them, too.  My only minor complaint is that they get a little stuck in your teeth.

The only reservation I have buying it online through Amazon is the price. Wow! I found it at Trader Joe's for $3.99. Seems like a bargain now. Amazon should adjust the price for buying in bulk.
I absolutely LOVE popcorn, and believe I have tried almost every type available. For my dollar, this is the best popcorn you can get outside a movie theater! Hands down. Worth every cent.

I bought this tea in hopes that it would be similar to the tea they offer at Panda Express (I know... dorky but I love their tea!) This was a bit more than I wanted to pay, however I am happy with my purchase. I like the taste of the tea and it goes a long way. I ordered this product for my daughter's golden birthday. I baked her a 6-tiered triple chocolate cake (the recipe came from a Cook's Country magazine) and we topped it with a gilded caramel-pecan turtle candy - she happens to be obsessed with live turtles right now...

The first time I ordered this product was only about 1 week before her birthday. I received my first shipment in time - it was on a Saturday - but unfortunately the wrong product was sent. I was a bit upset, as her birthday was on Tuesday and I didn't think I'd be able to get a replacement in time. At any rate, the final product looked brilliant and definitely made the cake special. It was a bit pricey, but since golden birthdays only happen once, and since I have 3 kids to share the cost, it only came to about $16/child.

I bought this for one of my three cats that had stomach problems. It didn't completely fix his stomach issues (only a change in food did that) but all three of my cats loved it when I sprinkled this on their food.

I decided to try this variety pack, as I needed an assortment and it seemed my only option. It contains a nice variety of teas and coffees, but I was disappointed that there wasn't any hot cocoa. I don't really want to buy a whole box of cocoa but maybe that's my only choice. I'd like to see a variety pack of just teas or teas and cocoas but no coffee. Also, it would be nice if the amazon description told you what would be in the variety pack. I like Timothy's K-Cups very much.

I really enjoyed the smoked sausages, it took me nearly 3 weeks to finish. But I would definitely purchase this again.

Oh Boy! Oberto Cocktail Pep Smoked Sausage Sticks, 3.8-Pound Package

When I first saw the size I was quite surprised because it looked like a snack for a 2 yr old.

But actually because this has no water/soup in it - just actual rice, etc - it is more than expected looking at the size - I ended up ordering more of it.

If what you're looking for is the most organic sugar for your buck, then you'll want to look elsewhere. Whole Food's has bulk organic sugar for around ~$1.60/lb. And by 'bulk,' I don't mean like Sam's Club or Costco's. You scoop/pour the sugar into your own jar (tagged and pre-measured at customer service) or a bag there.

If you're looking to help your fellow man out a little more, than this isn't too bad once in a while but it's steep increase at ~$2.80/lb. This is in contrast to the Wholesome Sweeteners Fair Trade Organic Sugar, 16-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12), which is the same exact product but around ~3.56/lb, and at best (with Subscribe/Save) $~3.03/lb.

To be completely fair, there have been arguments made against Fair Trade and whether or not it truly helps the struggling farmers that it markets itself as protecting. I won't link out to anything specific but you can Google "Fair Trade Debate" and find a good amount of criticism against it.

I like to think that it does help.

But I also won't pretend that I don't also get the standard organic sugar in bulk.

It's a fine, mild flavor, and black tea is very healthful.

I prefer flavored coffees and this one has been quite good.  The flavor is just enough - not too oppressive and not too mild.  I have also tried the Vienna and Kilarny and have enjoyed those too.  In comparison to the Maxwell House Hazelnut, these are superior. I never buy pre-ground coffee, we grind our own; however, I was tempted by the "low acid" offer, since I often have heart burn when I drink coffee.  I was extremely surprised with how GOOD this coffee tasted. Seriously, I had very low expectations, and I was blown away not only by the fact that I had less heart burn, but the taste was great!  It not only didn't taste like "low acid" coffee, it didn't taste pre-ground.  That said, I was reviewing the prices for the low acid coffee, and it is waaay expensive.  Not sure I'll be buying it - probably just stick to my big mug of sweet tea.  If you can't leave coffee alone and you have heart burn, however, go ahead and try it.  Recommended for taste and low acid, not for cost.

I like the foccacia mix.  At first I messed up two batches because I tried to make it without cheese - not a good idea. It came out too dry and turned hard.  I also used the wrong type of baking pan, you've gotta use a cookie sheet and make sure it's as thin as it states in the directions or it won't bake properly. But when I finally got it right, it was very tasty.
I like Folgers Instant Coffee and I especially like being able to buy jars of it in 3-packs of 4 oz. coffee jars.

We live on Crystal Light in our home, drinking gallons of it,  and every so often I like to try new flavors.  What I like about Crystal Light is that it is calorie free and that there is rarely a chemical after taste.  What I love about this drink is that the hint of grapefruit makes the drink more tart than usual(I always dilute them more than recommended) It's a pleasant change from iced tea and I think will become a new staple in our fridge.

Very fast shipping, good taste, and no extra fees.

I encourage this one!

To make this simple the tea is perfect! It's the same refreshing taste I'm used to during my stays in Japan.

Great product and true to the Japanese original. Just may not arrive 'AS' great.

My 1st 5 lb bag was great and I thought Amnia was crazy saying that the TooBerry Blueberry tastes like a wet dog...that is until I got my 2nd 5 lb bad. My name is Patrick, and I am an American shorthair of indeterminate age and semi-discriminating tastes. My human asked me to write this review for the Instinct Raw Boost Bites: Chicken Formula she got through the Vine program because she is unable to sample them herself.

I gobbled up the portion my human gave me right away. As far as I'm concerned, these deserve two paws up. My housemate Tiger, also enjoyed the Bites. I'm not entirely sure what all that stuff means, but I would recommend the Bites to other cats who enjoy chicken flavored snacks that are meant for cats.

I'm addicted.  I wish I wasn't.  This product is too expensive for me even though I buy them at a much cheaper price directly from the Nespresso site.  However, each day I have a smile on my face and a bit more energy.  And it's so much more fun than my typical coffee.  I love it.  And this is the only Nespresso capsule blend that works for me.

My folks drank Eight O'Clock coffee the whole time I was growing up, so when I became a coffee drinker myself, it was an easy product to pick up.  Over time, I sampled all sorts of other roasters and varieties, sometimes finding something better, sometimes not, occasionally even switching my everyday brand of choice for a while.  Eventually, I always ended up with Eight O'Clock again simply for the value: I have not found a reasonably good-tasting coffee at a lower price.  If you're a regular consumer of coffee (our house makes a pot per day for sure, sometimes more), you've got to find the brand that fits all your minimum criteria, and for me, this is it.

EVERYTHING WAS GOOD, THE SELECTION OF CANDIES WAS GOOD, SIZE OF CANDIES WAS OK, BUT THE COST WAS TOO HIGH.  TO PURCHASE THINGS OF THIS NATURE AT A LOCAL SUPER MARKET WOULD ALLOW GETTING MORE CANDY FOR COMPARABLE PRICE.

They are a little bit grainy, not overly sweet and don't have a lot of spice, however I rated them a little higher because they're my go-to cookie when I need to make a gluten free graham cracker pie crust or base for lemon bars, etc. I pulverized them in the food processor and made a crust for a key lime pie with them the other day and no one could believe the crust was gluten free. I have been making wine for several years and purchased mainly Wine Expert kits. I ordered one of these to try after making the Barlo kit. This kit suprised me on how it turned out. Granted its not a $15 bottle of wine but, it is enjoyable. My son thinks this is the best one I have made yet. After looking at the reviews I ordered a Chardonnay to try also.

I enjoyed this coffee beverage, tho I do wish it had more of chocolate taste to it, like a mocha coffee.

I'm not sure I'd go to the store specifically to buy this drink, but that said, it's the sort of fruity drink perfect for a tall glass, lots of ice, and a good book. There is a slight "diet" taste to it, but that could be because I'm not watering it down enough and therefore it's a bit "strong."
