My midwife suggested I start drinking this tea late in my third trimester because it's supposed to help coordinate uterine contractions during labor.  Did it work?  Well, no real way to tell, but the tea tasted good.  I would buy it again, but probably only if I was expecting.

My dog absolutely loves these. My only real complaint is that they are pricey for the few minutes, if that, they last for. I only give one to him every few days or one a week. But again, they are his number one pick

Kells is 11 this week and I jumped on a chance to try this for her. She still thunders down the agility course as fast as she can, and is in great happpy shape. Our walks are slower.
after giving her the recoomended does for about three weeks, she appears less stiff and more playful and rests in the middle of the room, instead of the padded dogbed. Wish she could tell me how she feels. But behavior indicates she is comfortable.
I gave this caviar to one of my relatives as a gift and she absolutly loved it. She said it tasted better than the caviar she had in Russia!
GREAT ramen! Make sure you have a big soup bowl because these noodles are way bigger then most and won't fit into a small bowl. Add some beef or veg to knock it up another notch.

I should start off by saying I was not instantly a convert to Larabars. I tried a few of the flavors in the regular line (Larabars) and did not prefer them over other snack/meal bars. The Jocalat bars, however, changed my mind. I love how they are the perfect balance of fruits, nuts, and cocoa. You can taste all of the flavors and they all work really well together. The chocolate mint is my favorite because the mint has a really clean natural favor and compliments the chocolate well. It easily takes away my cravings for a chocolate bar. I also really enjoy the chocolate orange and chocolate cherry flavors that are in this line. Now if they just come out with a chocolate banana version I will be in heaven.

Despite all my raving it's still important to keep in mind that these DO NOT taste like a candy bar or a baked brownie. They definitely have more of a raw taste to them and you can still taste the dates so if you do not like the flavor of dates you may not like these. I also recommend that you try the flavors before committing to a whole case. I've found the Larabar flavors to be hit or miss with my personal tastes. There are some that I love and enthusiastically buy again and others that don't seem worth the calories.

Overall these are great and I like them so much better than Larabar flavors and have recommended them to many friends.
This is a nice coffee...a go-to coffee I rely on.  It's not bitter, has a good aftertaste, and has a smooth body.
This is a great coffee,  My husband absolutely loves it.  But the price has gone up since FEB. without notification from Amazon or seller.

I love SKIPPY Peanut Butter, especially SKIPPY Creamy peanut butter, but the one thing I find so hard to believe is why Amazon has to charge almost $10 just to buy 1 40 OZ jar of SKIPPY when you can get the same exact brand & size for under $9 bucks at the grocery and/or retail store, but I guess Amazon figures that they can get away with it if somebody wants the product bad enough and doesn't want to have to bother getting out and over to the store.

Another thing that I have a hard time comprehending is why Amazon sells SKIPPY and JIF in a 40 Ounce size jar individually, but wont sell PETER PAN in a 40 OZ jar individually and only let you buy the 40 OZ jars and 28 OZ jars in a multiple packet of 3 or more and will only sell PETER PAN individually in a 16 OZ jar or 28 OZ jar only, but apparently it may be due to SKIPPY having a higher demand in more options and perhaps SKIPPY and JIF outsells PETER PAN.

Overall, SKIPPY was one of my favorite peanut butters growing up, especially in my childhood years when my mother was trying to watch how much sugar I ate in my diet since they say SKIPPY only has 1/3 less sugar than most other peanut butters.

I always expect these cans of coffee to be very creamy and sugary no matter what is written on the label; a contrast to how I drink my hot coffee.

Instead, this one is cold black coffee lightly sweetened - they did a pretty good job on the sugar level.

It is worlds better than most of the other cold coffees without cream that I have had, most of which have been out of 2 liter plastic bottles in Japan, which are always extremely disappointing. I can't give it a 5 because I don't love it, but I suspect that it is the best of its type one can get; you can sense that the quality is there. It doesn't suffer too much from being cold because it doesn't seem watered down, like most usually do.

This one is loaded with spinach, and that's what I wanted for my twin 10-month olds. It is not as dense as I expected or wanted evidently because they added enough water to make it more liquidly. Nevertheless, Earth's Best made it sufficiently tasty by adding carrots. That seems to be their technique to make what would otherwise not be popular with babies tasty enough. It already has brown rice so I don't think there's a strong incentive to add rice cereal to it, although one certainly could.

Of all the Earth's Best flavor brands, I believe this is the darkest natural green one. I have this by subscription and am glad for it. My babies like it. They are 10-months old; they might not have liked it some months ago.

Ingredients per the label: Water, organic spinach, organic potatoes, organic carrots, organic barley flour, organic brown rice.

This has 50 calories, 10% protein, 50% vitamin A, 15% vitamin C, 2% calcium and 4% iron. I've been informed that the percentage of daily needs met is based on an adult.
Good tasting popcorn and plenty for one person, just watch the microwave because it will burn quickly. Otherwise a good price and good flavor.
these are really good.  but kids and others who like sweeter treats might not like them.  they are not very sweet.  just more 'green.'

My cats have totally enjoyed all of the Before Grain flavors, but the #1 is their number 1 - I think next favorite for them is #5, then so on. They like it and I like the ingredients list - although I do wish there were no carageenan, it's thumbs up (or paws)
There is no excess water, this is meat for the cats - no fluff - I add a bit of water and they like that. This food always results in a clean dish and happy cats.
Good taste, a little on the weak side especially since I mix it with half soy milk after it's brewed.  Delicious nonetheless.

I ordered this not completely paying attention so I was a little caught off guard by the heavy citrus overtones.  It was not the traditional earl grey I had anticipated.  With that said, it is different but good.  I don't think that I will be buying it again as I feel the citrus takes over a bit more than I would like and I am a bit of a purist when it comes to my earl grey.

I have loved ramen noodles since my college roomate introduced them to me. I have tried all the flavors, and can buy them anywhere for a low price. I saw this and it's reviews on amazon and decided to try it. Anyway it tasts great, and for a decent price too.

I've ordered this honey before and am very satisfied with the quality, however, the packaging seems to be an issue.  Three cases and each one had leakage from several bottles--not too significant but enough to make a mess.  Caps appeared to be tight but somewhow the honey oozed out??  Other than that, the product is good and I'll continue ordering it.

My husband will not make more of an effort to feed himself than to heat something up and if I'm not around to provide for him or leave him something already made in the fridge, his immediate go-to is canned soups and canned pastas. As such, I thought these Hormel meals would be a brilliant thing to have around the house. Not only are they right up his alley with being extremely easy to prepare but there is a very wide variety, they come in their own bowl, and you don't need to refrigerate them. I had visions of him keeping a stash at work or in his car and never having to buy lunch if he forgot it at home. Or even him grabbing one for a late night snack and being pleased that he had so many different kinds to choose from.

Well, he quickly killed that after trying about four of them. He now will only eat them as a last resort. He's really not all that fond of them. Which leaves me to eat them seeing as how we have so many in the house.

The chicken breast and dressing is one of the better ones of the Hormel line but it does have its faults. The gravy is too salty like many of Hormel's products. The dressing, though, is good and filling and I actually prefer it over the potatoes you can find in many of the red meat meals. I'm not normally a fan of celery but the occasional crisp it adds to the dressing is very welcome. The texture gives what would otherwise be a pretty mushy meal, a tiny bit of contrast. The chicken in this is one of Hormel's better meats, mostly because I feel like I'm actually eating meat (which unfortunately isn't always the case with Hormel). I would say that the gravy would be much better with way less salt but I'm afraid if you took the salt away, the flavor would just be a bland, blah bore.

For what this is -- a non-perishable prepared food that is fairly cheap -- it's pretty good. It will fill you up quickly at very low effort and cost, but if you are going to compare it to something you can make yourself, well, there really isn't any comparison.

All I know is that if the end of the world were to come, we have so many of these that we would be set for some while. Well, as long as the end of the world didn't mean the end of working microwaves, that is :)

The double Earl Grey is a pretty strong tea. It is as strong as going loose leaf, but the quality of the better loose leafs is better than this tea. It is great for convenience. If you don't care about convenience, consider Rishi's organic, Twinings Aromatic (not regular E.G.), or if you can find it, Whittard of Chelsea.
I have used these for several months in road cycling.  I wish there were more of a variety of non-caffeinated GU energy gels (Lemon Sublime and Strawberry Banana only).

Used in conjunction with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Ultra Shea Smooth & Nourish Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce, this shampoo is good stuff. One thing I like so much about it is the shea butter smell, which makes me think I'm vacationing somewhere exotic. But the more important positive point is that it leaves my hair feeling full and clean. It also apparently nourishes and moisturizes your scalp and helps it breathe. I use hair gel on a regular basis, and apprently this shampoo cleans thoroughly enough to remove product you put in your hair, which I like.

The bottle is long and slender and has a convenient pop-up cap that's easy to open and close. I like how the cap end of the bottle is the flat portion that you place down; all the shampoo in the bottle builds toward that end, so you'll never have to hit the back of the bottle to squeeze shampoo out.

I may not be the best person to review these, because I bought them for general use, not food products.  The reason I got them from this supplier is because other bags of this size could only be purchased in much larger quantities.  As far as quality, these are fine for what I need.  Nothing amazing, but they live up to what is advertized.

I opened my chai tea as soon as I got it. The boxes that the k cups were in were smashed up. I do not believe any of the product was messed up, but the boxes would leave you to think otherwise. The product itself, however, tasted great. :) You have to add milk and sugar to make it taste like it came from a coffee shop, though.

I think this product is fun.  The presentation of the tea blooming in the clear pot is so beautiful and the tea has a great flavor.  I just wish they made some blooming teas that were decafinated.  The only reason it did not get 5 stars is some of the tea fell apart in the water as the sewing came apart so it never bloomed.  It is definately worth the purchase though.

I love the flavor of this tea. I wish it didn't come in nylon bags as I just can't make myself use and throw away all that plastic. I hope that they will come out with these flavors in a more ecologically responsible package.

We have been purchasing this bread mix for a couple of years now. It virtually never fails to make good bread in our bread machine. The bread is a heavy bread with a subtle and, we think, quite a good taste. If you like a good dense bread with a slightly different flavor you may very well like this.

Dr. Richard Pendleton

The dark chocolate flavor of this NEWMAN'S OWN ORGANICS DARK CHOCOLATE BAR is mild, compared to dark chocolate bars manufactured by specialty candy makers (for example, See's Candies). But the flavor is quite good, especially for a "commercial" candy bar designed for general sale in grocery stores. Unlike many health food store "organic" products, this "organic" chocolate bar leaves no unpleasant aftertaste.

The bar (approximately 2.5" x 4.5") breaks into six large snack pieces. One bar (one serving) weighs 64 grams, has 330 calories (200 fat calories), and 22 grams total fat. There are 5 grams sodium, 37 grams carbohydrates, 4 grams fiber, 28 grams sugar, and 3 grams protein.

The label warns that the bar is manufactured on equipment that may have been used to process other products containing peanuts, other nuts, milk powder, wheat, soy and egg (although the bar itself contains none of these). The bar is 54% cocoa (Rainforest Alliance Certified).

Because I'm a big fan of "Newman's Own" products, I was eager to try this offering from the "Newman's Own Organics" line. It did not disappoint.

These last me forever! Just make sure you keep the lid on tight, they get hard pretty quickly.
The best way to eat them is to bite off the ends (to make a straw) and use it to drink cheap champagne. It's delightful!
i would buy the mag plus calcium.  tastes ok.  wow 2o words?  i am happy happy happy happy happy happy with the product.

Regardless of what item(s) you purchase from Giftree just know that their customer service is TOP NOTCH!!!!!! :) Sometimes that is more important than the actual contents of a gift basket or what it is your purchasing. Years ago I was paying close to nothing for my mobile phone service but when it came time to contact them it was a nightmare!!!! It didn't matter if I called them or went directly into the store, it was the same. Eventually I switched carriers and decided to pay a bit more for quality customer service.

This particular gift basket was purchased as a gift for my husband and he loved it. (I was the one purchasing it and found some of the contents to be a bit "small" in quantity but after posting my original review Giftree responded right away and made good with a $50 Gift Card!!!!!)

I will be doing alot more business with this company.

I had Aged Mimolette Cheese at a New Year's Eve party. Highly recommended if you are cheddar cheese
lover. Great with Macaroni ......

Butterscotch is another one of those flavors that I adore. Butterscotch anything is pretty much a guarantee I buy it. I love the rich buttery-ness of it. In my drinking days, butterscotch schnapps was my go-to drink. I love it. Mix it with a bit of milk or hot cocoa...oh yes. The best, though, is around the holidays, mix a touch of it into egg nog. Ooooh, now that's an idea, egg nog matcha. Red Leaf Tea, I will love you forever if you develop an egg nog matcha by the holidays! I can't have real nog any more, so I've been hunting for a good tea substitute.

Anyway, yes. Butterscotch is love for me. It's another Dad memory, he loves it and it makes me think of him...or maybe I'm just homesick this week. Butterscotch pudding is the only pudding I'll touch and if an ice cream shop offers butterscotch topping, I'll risk the dairy allergy to get a cone covered in the stuff. Liquid gold, it is. And seeing the success of Red leaf Tea's Caramel and French Vanilla flavors, I have complete confidence in this blend being amazing. I think this definitely calls for a hot tea latte, despite it being stupidly hot outside. Am I in Toronto or back in Tennessee? These hot days are killing me...I should be able to handle them better!

No, I went for a cold matcha instead, it's too hot out there to bother with hot drinks, though this one was made to be enjoyed hot. Hot with a touch of rum and milk. Mmm...anyway. Yes. Cold, it's less than stellar, but it's still yummy. Very buttery and rich, but not too rich. I want to sip on this all day, but I need to save some for when it's cool enough to be able to handle a hot drink. It does taste like candy, but it's not overwhemingly sweet. It's just tasty. I'm not wowed by it like I am with some of their other blends, though. This one's good, but I need to try it a few more times before I decide if I'm going to keep it on my shelf or not. Perhaps a warmer water temperature will help, or a better ratio of tea to water. Still, it won't be hard at all to convince myself to drink this one! I might even be convinced to share it.

The candy is really good.  The price was pretty bad.  I hadn't been able to find these recently, so I ordered them.  They came in good time and good condition, but in the meantime I found them at a large WalMart for a MUCH lower price.

Didn't expect too much from these so I was surprised that with a few tweaks, I really liked them. I use 3/4 of a cup of water in a handled, plastic measuring cup and microwave for 4 minutes. Using a spoonful of cream cheese to mix in the cheese powder seems to give the M&C just that much more flavor and richness. The measuring cup is a convenient dish to eat from...not disposable, but hey, what are dishwashers for...and there's less trash. For fewer than 300 calories, not a bad meal.
There's nothing like a good cup of Ceylon tea... And this does the job very nicely! Would definitely recommend if you enjoy a cuppa.

I've been craving the old Lemon Cooler cookie for years, even found a mock recipe of them on the web that I haven't tried yet. Then, I found these and ordered right away. Very refreshing lemon taste and I love the powdered sugar. It would be a nice cookie for a picnic on a hot summer day.
I agree with the other reviewer that I miss the tart lemon taste from the Lemon Cooler cookie. It had a yellow granule of something tart in the middle of it that I remember as a kid and I think that's what gave it that little spark.
I never understood why Sunshine stopped making them when they are such a unique cookie, the only one like this on the shelf!
Overall, very good cookie and they are hard to put away!

The metal ring around the container will make buzzing sound while the item being microwaved. It's a little scary but I can't get rid of the metal ring.

The heated beefaroni is tasty, not too salty (got lots of salt but not to a point to burn my lips) and having decent flavor.

Don't expect anything gourmet. It's just a quick 220 calorie savory snack. I put a few in the office in case I got hungry. I have yet to eat it without heating but I think it should taste OK without heating. In that case, it can be a good backpacking or hiking fuel source.

I drink a ton of water anyway due to a variety of medical "issues" that require me to stay away from sodas, juice, alcohol, etc. Needless to say, water is my go-to drink whether I like it or not, and truthfully I've gotten used to it, but every once in a while I just need something to make it actually TASTE LIKE SOMETHING. I was using the powdery mixes for a while, but now I'm loving MiO. I like that you can control how much you add to the water without wasting. If you just want a little bit of flavor, you can squeeze in only a few drops, or if you're a person who really wants legitimate iced tea, then squirt away! The flavor is delicious too. It definitely tastes like iced tea with a nice helping of peach and doesn't have an artificial flavor in my opinion. I'd absolutely buy these again, particularly this flavor.
These are great sugar-free candies, but I would like to buy them in a larger, bulk quantity and not individually packaged.

Illy Cafe Medium Roast ESE pods is still my favorite with a strong fresh ground & unburnt taste. I have tried Starbucks, it has a burnt taste (common with dark roasts). I also use Lavassa Gran Crema ESE pods which comes in a close second with it's nutty aftertaste & very good crema - better & more consistent than the crema from Illy's.
It's very high cost is the only drawback.
I can taste the soy lecithin very easily so I do get tired of these things, but they are a good hunger fix if you are short on time.
Not as sophisticated in character as a good Scotch, but the maple sweetness isn't overdone, and contrasts nicely with the sharpness of the rye.

Similar to some other reviews, we found this mix to be very good, but not "5 star" outstanding.  But for the convenience of a mix, I do think it's one of the better mixes.  We've tried regular, blueberry and chocolate.  The chocolate waffle mix does a very nice job of keeping the chocolate in the middle, and their is definitely enough chocolate.  This morning we tried the regular again, and instead of water, used Butter Milk.  I had intended to add a little vanilla and cinnamon as well, but forget.  We all agreed that today's waffles were the best yet with this mix, so I think we'll keep on with the butter milk.
these do have the usual drawbacks of all food bars - gooey and overly sweet, but they are better than most.

I have gastritis ... and the very first thing the doctor said after my diagnosis was - NO COFFEE - and no caffeine. Both are contributors to the problem. As a result, I have moved away from drinking coffee, especially that which has caffeine.

So, I was very hesitant to try this low-acid coffee, just because it has caffeine.

It has a very roasted taste, a bit stronger than I am used to, but not bad. I would call it a medium to strong tasting coffee.

All-around, very nice, and I did not suffer any consequences, although I did make sure I took my medication in advance of drinking it (no sense spending the morning sick).

If you are on a salt-restricted or fat-restricted diet, this is the ideal product.  It has one of the best tastes of the light products I have tried, and so far, very few kernels remain after popping.  Terrific product reaction when served to guests.
Great flavor and it is the real stuff, 100% pure.  For me, its worth the price since I dont use that much in a month.

I purchased this for myself and the contained coffees were quite good.  The extras were a bit mediocre, half due to weak packaging.  The sugar packets were included in a mislabeled box, as were the creamers.  For your average coffee drinker the extras will be a pleasant surprise, just make sure you break open the basket and check the contents if you are giving this as a gift.
A wondeful gluten free product! The dogs in our house seem to love the flavor too! I feel great giving them treats that are made in the USA. We tried their other products and love them as well.

I like to use this flour instead of white rice flour because it's more nutritious. (Kind of like bleached flour vs. whole wheat.) It's a bit grainy, so be sure to mix other flours with it. Also, keep it in the fridge because brown rice flour goes bad quickly.

My kids love this chocolatey-rice cereal and I don't mind feeding it to them as it is not particularly unhealthy. Organic and tastey. Also, the print all over the box is informational and inspiring. It prompted my daughter to find out more about endangered species and want to adopt/donate.
The only thing I would change is to increase the size of the box - it goes quickly.

I've been keeping an eye out for different lunchtime food-type items I can bring to work and make with little fuss (aka, water and a microwave is about all I have access to). I really wasn't sure what to expect with this. I didn't know if it would be like the ramen noodles that college students survive on or if it might actually be a passable lunch. Luckily, it turns out to be far better than a "passable" lunch and it's a pleasant surprise.

Now, there are a good numbers of steps to prep it, but nothing you can't handle as long as you have access to water, a sink and a microwave. Don't need a measuring cup, I just use the fill line on the included bowl (another bonus, as I didn't have to scramble to find a microwave-safe bowl). It cooks up faster than I expected, which was nice not having to wait longer after all the other steps. The amount of food doesn't look like much at first, but after it's done, it's rather substantial. I had plenty to eat and it wasn't too salty like some miso soups tend to be. The noodles helped absorb some of that, I think. My only gripe, and it's relatively minor, were the "onions" that were included in the mix. They turned out rather soggy and limp to such an extent I don't think they could be classified as onions anymore. Maybe more like, "Clear, pliant tasteless "O"s. But other than that, it was quite enjoyable. I would buy this again, and I'd like to see what other flavors are available.
I think this is a great product but my picky dog gets tired of it after a week.

These 4 Jerky spices are super easy to prepare-mix with water add your fresh meat & marinate for 12-24 hours in the fridge.  All are excellent in flavor and make fantastic home made fresh Jerky.  The clear favorite with my family & friends is the Garlic & Cracked Pepper style, closely followed by all the other flavors.  I gave a less than perfect score because the Teriyaki flavor tastes almost the same as the Original flavor(both are delicious), I expected more of a soy sauce/tamari taste and it seemed a little lacking only in that perspective.  I bought the big box because I wanted lots of flavors, variety and the ability to make a bunch of jerky...I would buy this again, but I won't need to for a while!

My grandmother often got care packages from Ireland (these couldn't be found in the midwest in the 70's can't be found now either!) and there wouldn't be packages of these tucked into corners. I didn't know they were originally an American product until I found them here, I thought they were European. They are really unusually because they are such a very floral tasting candy, at first as a child I didn't care for them, I think because I initially ate one expecting it to be mint tasting, but when I tried them a second time I found I really enjoyed them. You find you can't eat several of them at once, but one or two here or there and they are really enjoyable.

These bars taste great! If anything, they may be a little on the salty side, but that's what you would expect if you've ever had salted Planters peanuts.

Upon opening the wrapper for these bars, the first thing you notice is the peanut butter on the bottom. So these bars are not for youngsters unless you don't mind a little cleanup. They are also a very substantial size (1.62 oz each) and much larger than say a Quaker granola bar. For those considering this product as part of a lunch for your kids, these bars are on the high side in calories and fat (220 & 13g) so this may not be a good idea to stick in a child's lunch every day.

For anyone who is not too concerned about eating healthy and enjoys both salty and sweet snacks I say give this product a try. You won't be disappointed.

This salsa was delicious. It was very spicy as I'm sure you've guessed, but was also pretty dang tasty. It was a bit sweeter than I prefer my salsa and given the price I don't think it is something I would eat with any frequency but definately worth the novelty and if sweet and spicy salsas are your thing, you just might end up loving it!

Taste is great, compared to the competition, and the price is fabulous.  The only thing I don't like is that there are little chunks of something inside, and no matter how much I shake the vials to try and get the chunks to dissolve, they never do.  So, given the price and the great taste these are a good buy - I just wish they could get rid of the chunks inside.
Very good capers. There are better out there, but these are very good for daily use.

This is one more coffee on my quest for a perfect coffee. It's got the strong, dark flavor I want, but it has a bitter undertone that I do not want. If it had no bitter undertone, it would be the perfect coffee. However, it has to settle for merely being very good coffee.
This Pavillion Pad Thai is surprisingly good.I liked it much better the the Pavillion Thai Peanut.The Thai Kitchen brand of Thai Peanut is the much better of the two.

These are DELICIOUS! They aren't health food. They are real chocolate chip cookies made with almond flour to cut the carb count. I dont like the price and will probably just buy some almond flour and make some recipes on my own. But these are very good and for not wanting to cook, its worth it.

My kids and I both love this cereal. It is natural and the company is pretty well trusted for being non-GMO and organic. However, I wish it would get down to less than $3 a box on amazon (how about $2?). I'm not getting a deal here.

This is a new type of baby food that is becoming very popular. Our youngest turned 6 months old when we tried this. She loved it. Although I am not sure I would trust her yet as a food critic. Although when my wife and I tasted it, we also thought it was pretty good.

This is an organic baby food. Organic is one of those buzz words that is all the rage right now. And while that is good, they are not inexpensive to purchase. Currently they cost about $28 for 12. That is about $2 each. When considering if this is the ideal food for your baby, price should definitely be factored in. And I am not sure if this is worth the price. Typically we make our own baby food (mashed bananas, sweet potatoes, carrots, etc)

I will say that the greatest use we found for these was to take them when we went out and mashing up food was not an option. The resealable lid is also handy. But even at the price, I still wonder if it is worth it.

So why 4 stars then? Well, obviously if you purchase it, you are aware of the price. If you still purchase them, you won't be disappointed in them based on taste, use or connivence.

This is the second time I have ordered this because I liked the first batch so much. This time, the taste of the cherries was not as good as the first time, though. They seem "older" and it may just be that they were sitting on the shelf for too long prior to purchase. They arrived quickly with no damage. I will certainly order again, and hope for a batch like the first one!

I used this conditioner for three weeks in place of my very pricey salon conditioner and found it to be quite comparable in quality, and it's a fraction of the price. I don't wash my hair everyday, so any conditioner that weighs down my hair immediately gets tossed out (I have straight hair - zero curl). I was definitely skeptical about the volumizing claim, I usually find hair products touting this to be gloppy and waxy feeling, but not so with this product. Here's the quick summary:

Pros
- a little goes a long way; you don't need a heap to soften hair
- the ingenious spout is on the bottom and doesn't leak (wish ALL hair products had this!)
- did in fact leave me hair feeling a bit more voluminous as advertised
- great value

Cons
- the scent is bit too strong (hence the 4 stars)

Don't get me wrong, these are not as good as a well-prepared pot of plain pinto beans. However, my experience is that to properly prepare whole pintos, you have to soak and soak, then rinse and rinse, then boil and boil and it takes time. Time that is worth it, but not always practical. With these I can have whole beans to serve with Mexican food in about 20 minutes and they taste good - not like the long-cooked version - but pretty darn good.

I gave the product four stars because even with proper cooking, some of the beans come out a little hard - but that happens to me when I make regular pintos, too.
The herbal mate tea Bolivia stores sells is a health benefit from high blood pressure to a cure for the gastro-intestinal ailment I have been plauged with all my life.

I use this honey in my tea and also instead of butter on toast.
Delish!!
The juice showed up right away and was exactly what I was expecting. I'm adding it to my diet to help manage gout symptoms, so hopefully it works.
My cholesterol readings have improved with the help of the chews, I believe.  However, I may like the chews better if they were less sweet.

I love dark roast coffee, but my husband hates the bitterness. Due to our differences in taste, I have two coffee makers in my kitchen, one for his light-medium roasts and one for my favorite espresso or French roast. Puroast Low Acid French Roast Coffee makes it easy for us to both to share a pot of coffee.

Depending on how strong you like your coffee, the three ounce pack is very finely ground making it suitable for both drip coffee makers or French presses (Bodums). I own both and made the pot of coffee in our drip coffee maker. Because my husband dislikes strong coffee, I used half the pack and it was more than enough for the 12-cup pot. The strength was perfect in my opinion.

The flavor of the dark roast comes through clear. I loved the smokiness left on my tongue after the cup, but there is no bitterness. It's smooth and satisfying. My husband, the dark roast skeptic, said there was no way he would like French roast. After one sip, he said it was very smooth and lacked the bitter aftertaste that he dislikes with dark roasts. Overall, I'd say that's a win!

This shampoo works well for dandruff. It does not leave my hair soft though. I regularly use the cheapest shampoo money can buy and my hair feels soft afterwards. I never use conditioner. This is more like dandruff treatment. I have to use conditioner when I use this product. I gave this product four stars because I think the main reason for this shampoo is to fight dandruff. It does that.

This tea surprised me. I tend to like strong flavored teas like Irish breakfast tea, but this light white tea is full of flavor and refreshing without being overpowering. It is the perfect pick-me-up after dinner without worrying that it will keep me up all night. I liked the aroma it gave off, too. This is an all around good tea at an excellent price.

This coffee has a really strong roasted/burnt flavor to it. If you like typical non-gourmet morning coffee then you will like this; however, I have traveled down south, to countries like Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Columbia, etc. and have tasted fresh roasted REAL coffee direct from the trees at the farm the very next day after a harvest. I prefer my coffee black, as-is, in other words I like to drink and taste my coffee rather than pour in a bunch of other crazy flavors.

Real coffee roasted properly is fairly smooth anyway, with a strong taste of coffee bean and a hint of smoke, it is very pleasing. This coffee is more like bitter burnt charcoal, but here in the USA we tend to drink coffee to stay awake so this coffee does have it's purpose, the burnt bitter taste slapped my eyes wide-open from the very first sip so I stay lively at work with a spring in my step all day, but not to any extreme, for example, 4 cups in 10 minutes didn't give me the caffeine jitters. I'll have to look for something a little smoother to drink at home though or I'll never want to sleep at night.

If you like green bean fresh roasted, gourmet, or exotic coffees stay away, this is not for you. If you like to fill your glass with milk and sugar, then give this a try, you'll have to pour in twice as much flavor filled fat and sugar to cover up the powerful taste of this stuff. If you sip coffee at work to stay awake this is a excellent choice because it is at least 2 times stronger than Folder's or Maxwell's dark roasts.

I've given these to my dog for the 4 years that I've had her. I LOVE them, and the fact that they're good for her! I recently ordered them from Entirely Pets, as my vet was out of them. I ordered a 6-pack, and it was wonderful -- fresh and soft. This is important, as my dog only has 3 teeth left. Too, I put a small pill in half of one if these, to give to Mitzi. Unfortunately, the second (and final) order for a 6-pack was dried out. And when they're dried out, they're really tough. I suppose I could've returned them, but I gave them to a coworker with a younger dog, who could chew them. Decided I wouldn't order online again, given this experience...I'll get them from my vet, and I open one of the packs before leaving to make sure they're fresh.

This product is great.....taste is wonderful, price was the best of my research.  The only issue is the high sugar content for those needing to curb their sugar intake.  Delivered in a timely manner with no hassel ordering.
these were good before christmas at 12.16 for 36 pack 2oz bags now they are double the price with a 3rd party, not right but good cookies

Smooth and creamy sauce, with a little kick.  Great for nachos, tacos, or any dipping sauce.  I think this sauce would even be good on a burger.  If you are a fan of taco bell, you will enjoy this sauce.  Nice to have the taste of taco bell in your own home.  Spice up any dish with this bold, creamy, spicy ranchero sauce.

Kettle chips are always delicious,though a little expensive considering they're just potatoes.  WAY better than anything Frito-Lays puts out.  It's a shame that the independent chip companies are dying out at the local grocers because Frito-Lays crowds them out, when the independents are so much better.  Take a trip to your local Trader Joe's or Amazon to find good chips nowadays, and cheap too if you find them on sale here, cheap all the time at Trader Joe's.

I just want to point out that this is not actually "Amish" popcorn.  Look at the company's website-this is "Amish country" popcorn, meaning I guess that Amish live in the vincinity.  Note the lack of any mention of organic popcorn on it.  This is good popcorn, but don't fool yourself into thinking you're getting an organic/chemical free product, or one raised in small batches by Amish folk.  Clever wording strikes again!

Tasty cookies, but a little different than most chocolate chip cookies.  Probably because they are gluten free. I enjoyed them.  So they are good even for someone who can eat regular cookies. When amazon had 40% off groceries, they were a good deal.

We have used this tea for many years. It is absolutely delicious.
Our family prepares 2 gallons at the time. Over the years we have developed what we consider a better end product and save money in the process. Bring 2 Gal. of water to boil. Switch off. Add 1 foil pack (contains 4 large tea bags) and let seep for 50 minutes. Remove bags. Add sugar or sugar substitute if needed.
Refrigerate. Same recipe for the raspberry tea. Of course you can half this recipe, the end result is the same.

I just tried this tea this morning, and it was delicious! I did find it very slightly bitter, even though I steeped it for exactly 2 minutes with hot (but not boiling water), as indicated by the instructions on the box. A bit of agave nectar quickly remedied the faint bitterness, though.

The melon flavor really came through and paired well with the green tea! The cup smelled wonderful while brewing, too. This is definitely a very fruity tasting tea, and it is not subtle on the fruit (melon) flavor at all! I'm usually not a big fan of fruit flavored teas, but the melon flavor in this one was delicious!

I tried it hot, but next I'm going to make a nice pitcher of iced tea using it. I think it would be refreshing for these hot summer days, maybe with a nice slice of cucumber floating in the glass (in place of the traditional lemon slice).

Highly recommended!
This sauce has a unique and interesting flavor. It makes a great salad dressing as well. Overall, I recommend and like the fact there are are few ingredients. Enjoy.

I saw the Balconi Tiramisu one day and bought it on a whim. I wasn't expecting too much, I just wanted something easy for dessert. I opened the package and sliced the cake and wow! A really tasty cake. The best part is it can keep, unrefrigerated, for up to three months (according to Balconi - don't ask me, they don't last nearly that long in my home.)
A slightly sweet, delightful dessert cake. It contains marsala wine; I suppose that will help the shelf life, in addition to giving it moisture and flavor. Also, this contains real Marscapone cheese.
If you are looking for a quick, easy and delicious dessert cake, Balconi Tiramisu fills the bill nicely. It is also a very reasonable price. You don't even need to find an italian bakery to enjoy some scrumptious Tiramisu.
This is the best Jasmine Green Tea so far. I have tried a couple other brands but Stash comes out as the best.

while these tasted very good, i found them a little crispier than other graham cracker i've had - and i liked it. really like the packaging too, half size individual serving type. conveninet and easy to use or carry.
i recommend these and will buy them.

Not a connoisseur by any stretch, but tea is whole leaf and tastes good. Considering the Twinnings tins in the store give you about 1/5th the amount for the same price (and it's tea leave dust) this is all the more valuable. 1lb lasts a while so maybe portion into zip top bags for longer storage.

Not sure how folks cannot make a strong cup of tea with this product. It has the capacity to make rocket fuel if you use too much.

Admittedly, the first sip I took I almost spit it out. This stuff is a bit spicy! You can definitely taste the ginger in this, so if you're not a fan of ginger, this may not be for you. Fans of chai would probably like this tea more, as it does have a strong, spicy taste. I've been drinking this tea for the past week (a tea bag a day), and have started acclimating to it. On second and third tasting, this tea became tolerable, and now I actually quite enjoy it. I let it steep for 10 minutes, since the spicy + piping hot combo makes me sweat, and it's summer. Also found that I don't need to sweeten it, even though I usually like sweetening my teas. This tea does warm you right up.

I have to say, the first couple of days I think this tea had a reverse laxative effect, if you know what I mean. I felt a bit stuck. But now that my body's adjusted to it, it's been doing its job well. Also, unexpected benefit has been clearer skin. I'm not sure if this is a direct effect of the tea, but since it's the only thing I've changed in my diet/routine this past week, I suspect it may be it. Score!!

Wouldn't say this tea bag is on the "cheap" side of the tea bag spectrum, but it's not too bad. I don't think I've gotten to the point of sipping this out of enjoyment, and probably never will. But so far, I've seen its health benefits, and that alone motivates me to continue on. Would recommend at least trying to stick to finishing the box in a timely fashion to see its health results, though.

I loved this drink, it was excellent.  Not too sweet, very mellow.  However, it contains chocolate flavor, so in my opinion it should be named Mocha.  Cappuccino is misleading and people who expect that flavor may be disappointed.

"Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Strong Lengths Nourishing Conditioner" (12.7 fluid ounces) conditions your hair with a slight and pleasant scent at a reasonable cost.

The conditioner consists of a moisture complex of vitamins B, C and E plus sunflower, almond, soybean, coconut oils and aloe vera to cleanse and nourish hair that is prone to breakage.

My wife found this product easy to use and was pleased that it rinsed so well without leaving any residue in her hair. She preferred the light scent over heavy chemical smells of other conditioners. And this product did what she wanted, left her hair soft, tangle-free, and a clean feel. Because my wife highlights her hair she is very careful about conditioners and found this one met her needs.

More expensive conditioners may perform better but this product makes for a very functional and pleasing every-day conditioner that is easy on the budget.

At this price the purchase was a no-brainer. I've had other Panamanian coffees and this one was particularly nice in both drip and french press modes. For drip you need to use a little more coffee grounds to get a full bodied cup. However, this is because I like a more concentrated cup to really enjoy the specific tasting notes. Overall, the cupping I've done (now almost finished with the 5 lb bag)has been very good. I would recommend this buy.

I started using these syrups in my coffee when I went on the Atkins diet. It uses Splenda and taste  pretty good. It doesn't have that syrupy after taste like a lot of these syrups. It's great if you're dieting & have a sweet tooth because it's carb-free. If I was more creative I could probably add the flavoring to other meals on my diet.

Great frozen....especially with a cup of coffee.
However, your price is TOOO HIgh. Can buy 24 for 7.99....sooo 48 would be
15.98!!!! Not $21.39 for 38 pieces.

I have always viewed "Crystal Light" as a grown-up's Kool-Aid. The flavors are more exotic, have less sugar and calories. Not for nothing, Kool-Aid over the years has gotten better about less calories and sugar. Anyway, this flavor of CL is "Mojito". Most folks know that mojito is a beverage that traditional uses alcohol. Well that is definitely not the case here. However that is not a bad thing, the flavor is very good. It has a smooth, crisp, clean and fresh taste. The underlining blend of mint, lime and other citrus elements shine through rather nicely, with no aftertaste. Also it would be great to drink this in winter to remind oneself of summer.

The only complaint I would have about this product is the amount that each packet makes. Notice that I use the word "packet", I remember in the old days when "Crystal Light" came in a tiny cup with foil over it. I suppose this new method is done to produce less waste. Nevertheless, it seems that these new packets do not make a pitcher worth of "brew". The directions state to use 8 cups of water, which only filled my pitcher half way. I suppose this is a minor grievance, but it is something worth taking notice. Notwithstanding, this is a very good beverage and I enjoyed it very much. I would use it again and it is a nice alternative to juice and/or soda.
I am happy with this purchase. Shiitake mushrooms are supposed to be a very healthy food, and these 1 oz packages make it easy to keep a supply on hand. They taste fine too.

This tea is pretty good if you are want to live a healthy life style and I do believe it has a lot of great benefits. However I found that it wasn't really effective with "weight loss" but it does make you need to use the bathroom quite a lot and it really does "empty you out". It is a great tea for you to try if you want to experience it for yourself and the price is GREAT!

I wasn't aware of Fruition Probars until I tried the new strawberry flavor.  I expected a hard-to-chew granola type bar (I hate granola snacks).  I thought I would hand them over to my husband and use him as a Guiney pig.  But as soon as I opened one I could smell strawberry and dates -- yummy.... I found the bar firm, but soft to chew. It really is tasty, and I appreciate that it's natural, low in calories, etc... We tried the bars when hunger hit and stopping to eat wasn't an option. Just one probar took the hunger away.  My husband's job is physically demanding. This power snack made such an impression on him he wants to try the other flavors.  I highly recommend the new Strawberry Probar.
I had received some of these nuts as a gift. After hunting around I found them at a much better price than the manufacturer site. They're still very good. Will buy again.

I also modified the kit instructions. I hydrated the yeast, however, the instructions said that you could do this as an alternative to using the yeast sprinkling method. My SG at start was 1.08. The first fermentation ended on day 11. After racking, I added toasted oak chips. I racked the wine again on Day 21 when the SG was .990, and again on Day 23 due to the amount of ugly sediment that was forming quickly at the bottom (and I was going on a business trip). The wine at this point was extremely cloudy, and tasted and smelled horrible. The alcohol tasted very strong and I thought that the alcohol content was way too high. I then removed the oak chips and added the gels. The wine cleared within a couple of days and seemed to darken a bit over the next week. I racked the wine again on Day 33, crossed my fingers and tasted the wine. I was shocked that it tasted good but I wish that it had more body and had more oak flavor and had more body. I have not bottled the wine yet but am thinking of adding more oak and bulk aging the wine a bit longer. Note that I am probably at 20 liters but I am not adding water or wine, but am spraying inert gas (Wine Preserve) into the carboy whenever I lift the airlock.

I like a very oak flavored Chardonnay and this kit contains no oak. That is the only reason that I am ranking this kit as a 4 star instead of a 5. I hope that Amazon continues to sell Vino Italiano kits. I would to try out the red and see how they compare to the much more expensive Vino del Vido and Mosti Mondial red wines that I have made.

Based on my results thus far, I would recommend this kit. I will add more information to this review if I am able to later.

Update June, 2011: Just opened one of my last bottles. It keeps getting better. Very smooth, very good flavor. I am ordering another kit.

Vine sent me this to review - I LOVE chocolate, especially dark chocolate so I was quite excited. Now if you order this product you will get a pack of 12 - I got 1 so my only option was to simply consume it. And I enjoyed that oh so much. It had a harder texture than your hershey's special dark, but had a very similar flavor and sweetness. It was very very tasty. I would have liked additional bars to try things like baking with to fill you in on things like does it melt well in chocolate chip cookies or to make chocolate covered strawberries... I will have to guess on this as I didn't have enough to do that experiment. Due to the harder nature of the chocolate I believe it would work well in cookies but not so much on strawberries.

I like the idea of my chocolate being organic - I like where Newman's is going with their product line... I hope that they keep the word "Organic" meaning something other than just another sales pitch tactic.

Anyway - if I'm in the market for Dark chocolate - I would pick this up without a second thought.
I really like this oil, you can also use it to cook. I prefer to use it as body moisturizer. Apply lightly because it is really oily.

I bought the variety pack and tried this flavor second (see my review for Socorro). I buy natural snacks for my kids (freeze dried fruit etc with no added sugar), but I find them bland. So I ordered these and loved the Socorro, but this one was much more spicy. My 4 year old did NOT like this one - too spicy for her and for me.

I decide to try a pure maple syrup instead of commercial products made with High Fructose. I have diabetes type 2 and have trouble processing High Fructose since I purchased this product I am able to go back and eat pancakes and waffles. I know this will not be the case with all people that have diabetes. Love the taste and product arrived in good condition at least this one I did have a bottle of grade A syrup that did not make the journey in one piece.

We found the 24oz bag at Costco last week.  This seems to only be around for the Holidays so stock up if you find them at your club.  That said they are about half the price at Costco as they are going for here at Amazon so if you have a membership head there fast.  As a long time Frango lover we are always looking for a Frango like chocolate since we only get to Seattle every other year or so to visit family.  Very happy to report that these truffle creme mints are the closest knockoffs yet.  Since Macy's bought out the Bon Marche years ago Frango's seem to have changed anyway (not as good as they used to be)  The secret ingredient that is slightly lacking in these mints is of course bad for you and that is salt.  These are just slightly less salty than the real deal but probably better for you as far as your blood pressure goes.  Of course if you want to make it taste like the real deal just grab your salt grinder and hit it with a light coating and pop in your mouth and you will have the perfect winning combination of chocolate, mint, sweet, salty in one glorious fell swoop.  WARNING:  As others have noted these things are ADDICTING!  But so well worth it.  Highly recommended!

I love these chips.  Not only are they gluten-free, but they help me stay on my Weight-Watchers Points Plus program, too.  I can enjoy a whole bag of potato chips, get that crunchy craving satisfied while not feeling deprived or guilty.  Sometimes I wish they were a little saltier, but that's not a big problem.  I just add a little sea salt when that happens.  Most of the time, they are just perfect!  I have reordered these repeatedly since I was first introduced to them earlier this year.  What a find!  (I have also ordered directly from Glenny's website.  Amazon often beats the price with super-saver shipping, though.)

This is a pretty good dog food if you are looking for grain free formula. Our dog didn't have any issue transferring to this food. Canidae overall is a good brand for dog food. If you are looking for a decently priced grain free formula this might be worth a try.

This has been a surprising taste treat for our whole family.  While I don't think these taste like something similar I remember eating a few years ago (but who can trust that kind of memory?), I do think they are really good.  And so does my husband and 3 kids!  Very good product.

Baronet Coffee Decaf 100% Columbian Medium Roast Pods did not disappoint. They fit very nicely in either a one cup or two cup Senseo coffee maker. They brew a medium to light coffee flavor. In order to enhance the fullness of the flavor, combine it in a two cup Senseo coffee maker with a stronger regular Baronet Coffee Pod that is packaged in a pouch rather than those that are individually packaged in a box. The individually packaged Baronet coffee pods are too full for the Senseo coffee maker.

This the wife's little indulgance for her morning coffee.  It's the small things in life that make a difference, and Int'l Delight has a great product here.  The larger package for home use might seem excessive, but she uses these at home and work.  I prefer the Irish creamer they make.  Great product.

Stevia is sweeter than sugar, so you only use a small fraction of the amount compared with sugar. Like most non-sugar sweeteners, stevia does not taste exactly like sugar. It took me and my husband a week or so to get used to the taste. He now prefers it to sugar in his coffee. I have tried other stevia brands, but SweetLeaf has been my favorite. The addition of fiber helps to add some body to the powder, without adding things I don't want (some other brands use lactose). I really like that it is a zero calorie sweetener, yet is made from a plant, not a chemical.

Because it is much sweeter than sugar and has a different consistency, I have not yet figured out how to accurately bake with it. Adding small amounts to sweeten pancakes or pasta sauce works fine, but baking cookies or cakes just doesn't work at all.

First we like canned salmon, a lot!  So you have to go from that angle.  This is a great product, it is kosher and has good flavor.  If you don't like canned salmon you won't like this but if you do you will be happy.  I didn't find a lot of fat, skin, or bones but just what you would expect.

You have to get your timing exactly right to make these taste llike regular pasta.  Play around with the suggested eleven minutes.  That being said, I like them.  I would not eat them all the time, but these are a great gluten free substitute when you get the pasta "itch."

If you like handfuls of almonds this might be the perfect mix. I love almonds and don't mind getting more than a few in every handful. The spoiler is the Brazil nuts, I can't stand them. They are too greasy and so large that they can easy take up a quarter of your 32.5 ounce container.
The packaging is good and they are perfectly salted. Not too shabby.

Purchased for my dear spiritual grandmother who has battled several serious infections from contact with the MRSR disease which she got at our local Hospital and she has already lost a limb to it. She had read about this product at her specialist Dr.'s office & so we ordered it to enable her body to fight off this dreadful disease! She is very happy with the taste & quality of this product except of course the EXPENSE is quite too high! However if it does what it is supposed to do we will happily absorb the high cost.

This food seems fine.  I only gave it a four star because my puppy didn't want to eat it.  This does not mean in any way it is not a good or tasty food.  I have been through several foods that were highly recommended only to find my puppy wouldn't like them.  I have found a food he likes and so I have mixed the two to finish up this bag.  His new food is Merrick Puppy Plate.  This one comes freeze dried and you are supposed to add water to make a gravy.  I find my pup likes it better without the gravy!  I still would highly recommend Castor & Pollux puppy food.  I later found out that the original owner of my pup was feeding him adult food.  That may be why he had a hard time getting used to puppy food.

Had been looking for this a long time in stores, with no luck. Finally did internet search and located several sellers. Didn't want to buy a large pack, as just for our own use, so it was good to find someone who sold by singles.  Kind of pricey for shipping though.  But this stuff is yummy!

We first tasted these crackers at the Biltmore Estate Winery in Asheville, NC and loved their taste.  I forgot to purchase them before leaving Asheville and was thrilled to see that Amazon had them for purchase at a reasonable price.  Just be aware that in shipping the boxes may be smushed a bit (doesn't hurt crackers), but for gift giving  - it does make a difference in the appearance of the box.  And I ordered them in July and they expire in November, so be aware you have to eat them quickly!  Have fun munching!

These work fine in K-cup machines, but have less packaging waste than regular K-cups, and cost much less, possibly because of both reduced manufacturing costs and not paying K-cup license fees. A definite win for Keurig users.
The San Francisco Decaf makes an tasty medium size cup, one of the best decafs I've had, though like most french roast, it's taste is almost (but not quite) burnt.

According to my cat this is the best stuff he's ever had. Unfortunately it is so much more expensive that I have had to stop buying it.  That's the only reason I gave it 4 stars. I hope that at some point the price will be comparable to the regular Fancy Feast.

I love this chocolate. Love. But I'm confused by the description. I received one 100 gram bar, but the shipping weight is 1 pound. The shipping cost makes this beautiful treat so expensive for a normal working person. Ad the photo shows three bars. Very confusing.

I will say first and foremost that I should have read that "banana" is listed second on the front of the package and in the description. I didn't realize 1) how sweet they would be and 2) how chewy mine were when others described them as "crisp." (the heat index is over 100 today though so some super heating while shipping may have affected, who knows)
They're chips as in disks about the size of a quarter, and to me they're very close to the chewy dried banana chips I had as a kid, now it's just like there's just grass mixed in. This is not necessarily a negative, as I definitely expected something with spirulina in it to taste very green and earthy, banana just takes over anything it touches and it has done so here as well. I wanted more of the spriulina/sesame seed taste i suppose.

I think this is a great company and despite the high price tag of goods such as these, it's still lower than storefront retail and seems to be VERY high quality. I'm looking forward to trying their other offerings.

full dose is very sweet(like imitation sweetener). I prefer to water down to taste and drink as I would water.
This stuff is great at the gym and I love it as a pick-me-up on long hikes. Great to sip on at camp after a long day. Remember, never put this kind of stuff in a WATER bladder!

I would/have suggested this to friends.

I've had long hair all my life, so I was attracted to the idea of strengthening long hair. Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy has a creamy texture and a pleasant smell and color (love the monochromatic thing with the bottle). I like the addition of vitamins and lipids to nourish the scalp. I used it alone, without the conditioner -- I don't know how much of a difference that makes, but the product should be able to stand on its own.

I used the shampoo for several weeks before writing this review (in fact, the bottle is nearly empty). Did it make my hair stronger? Possibly, but if it did it's not overly apparent. The comb goes through my wet hair easier right after shampooing, which is nice and certainly cuts down on breakage at that point. Overall, it seems to be a quality shampoo that I would use again.

Takes some getting used to, after using flour made of wheat for 35 years! It has a slightly "different/strange" taste to me but, since it is Glutten Free, I am willing to give it a chance and hope that my taste(s) will change and adjust. I will probably buy again, because glutten free is difficult to find in my area. Worth giving a chance...plus it is ORGANIC, which I love.

These are simply one of the best chocolates I have ever had. If you don't believe me, you should look at the way my my nephews and nieces act when I bring these for them. Their eyes light up instantly, and the way they simply ignore everything else in the world when they are enjoying the chocolaty goodness, is a five star review in itself.

Four stars, because it's pricey! But that never stops me from buying more ;o)
Awfully tasty for a white flour cracker snack. Perfect foil for creamy cheeses, spreads and avocados. Great value in bulk and the packaging keeps them from becoming stale.

Now that it is difficult to find bones for making stock - this beef base really helps "beef up" soups, sauces, and gravy. I have tried many bouillons and bases over the years and find this one to be the least salty. The tomato paste in it is sometimes not the flavor I am looking for, but, I am going to try their Au Jus for when I prefer a less complex flavor.

I used my Stir Crazy popper - almost every kernel popped, but it's quite dry for an oil popped corn. I think there might just be too much corn for the amount of oil. And definitely doesn't have the movie theater taste or texture. Also, if you put all the seasoning salt in with the corn & oil, a lot of it sticks to the machine, so I leave a little to sprinkle on afterwards to help with the flavor. I'm thinking maybe I'll try not using all the corn, next time and see if that is a better corn-to-oil ratio. I might also try just using a big pot too and see if that's any better than the Stir Crazy.

** EDIT ** July 2011 ** so, after popping quite a few bags in different ways, I can say now that if you use a regular kettle, with only 1/2 the salt, it tastes great. I think it's because only about 2/3 of it pops - so this allows for more oil/flavor per kernel.

My son is very picky about deodorants.  He doesn't like the smell of most.  He had been using a particular product that did not have a scent; however, it wasn't working very well.  I am so thankful that he finally found Axe Dark Temptation.  I'm not crazy about the way that it has been marketed, but he likes the product and it works for him!

I'm not exactly a fan of the original Oreos, but i really like these. I like the fact that it doesn't really leave cakey cookie all over your teeth, and they're soft so i can eat them without needing a glass of milk :)
Tellicherry Pepper at this price is remarkable.  The product is excellent, if a little difficult to pour from the large "mouth" into a small grinder.  Otherwise, great!

I bought it because of the reviews here but when I mixed it with my Nutiva cacao powder, I almost threw up. Pretty nasty, I could taste the "greens" underneath the cacao. I was too scared to add my hemp powder to it.

By itself, however, it was OK, it reminded me of watered-down juice.

I still want to use it though because of the health benefits but is there anyway to disguise the taste? I travel a lot and I can't bring a blender with me. I am trying to see if I can add hemp protein and amazing grass green superfood together without gagging. Any advice? (tons of stevia??)

I found this to be a really nice mid-day break.  The taste was well balanced without being bitter or overly sweet.  It's very good over ice and I found it refreshing and gave me a little boost.  The only drawback would be that it is 100 calories per can, which means it isn't something I would drink everyday, but as a treat now and then, or before working out, it's perfect.  With the hotter months around the corner, this is a nice alternative to a cup of hot coffee or tea.

bought this pancake waffle mix upon amazon suggestion I ordered the Waring WMK300A Pro Professional Stainless-Steel Belgian Waffle Maker. I wasn't disappointed in adding to order, very good flavor. I normally mix my own from scratch and whip up the egg whites to make it fluffier... IF you normally buy mix anyway this certainly is better then Krusteaz mix...

I doubled the suggested recipe on can, using 2cups of mix. made eight waffles..have 3/5 of first can remaining... probably will not reorder mix again only due to my required need to feed family of 7 people. looks like about 18-20 waffles per 33oz can

Great price for the chili compared to ordering it directly from Skyline's site (under $3.00/can from Amazon including shipping).  However, the packaging of the product was horrible and about 1/3 of the cans arrived dented from bouncing around in the much too large box they were shipped in.  I rate the product at five stars, but I have to take away a star due to the packaging.

After noticing my dogs LOVE to eat from cat bowls of friends/neighbors, I got them some. I've generally heard that ~most~ cat foods are richer than most dog foods, so if true, that makes sense why dogs like it too. Although you may be able to feed cat food to dogs, you're not supposed to give dog food to cats. I don't want them getting doggy gout from overly rich food, so I trained them to understand that they can split one of these (2.75 oz plastic cup) AFTER they finish their regular dry food. I've given them Friskies too, which is a larger size (5 or 5.5 oz), and they love that too. One of the dogs grabs the cup and holds it in his paws and licks every last speck out. If they're happy, so am I.

This stuff is great, while I don't like this kind as much as the Natural Calm with Calcium, it was my own fault for not looking close enough when I ordered the second bottle for the office. I actually look forward to having this in the AM with my breakfast and in the PM before bed. You can feel the relaxation slightly, it is not overwhelming. Not the kind of thing that knocks you out when you take it, but if you pay attention you can feel it.

The great thing about the calcium is it is a great way to help sustain and maintain weight loss. This is the best flavor they offer no doubt about it.

The first thing I noticed about this cereal is the unnatural color. Sort of a rust/orange, approaching a Cheetos color - definitely looks artificial! But then most cereals are. Shape-wise they look like Cheerios, especially the honey-nut variety with flecks of peanuts.

As far as taste goes, these are fine. They have a nice crunch to them, don't get soggy, and they feel light when you eat them. As other reviewers have commented, they are not overly or syrupy sweet, which is good because you get a nice balance between the sweet part versus the corn and some nuttiness. These are crunchier than Cheerios.

The only non-positive thing about this would be the price. It seems rather pricey to me.

I have to confess I am a Lazy Cook. One of THE laziest cooks in history, I would guess. I suppose my lack of enthusiasm for cooking comes from the fact that the effort in making any dish is soon demolished as the receipe involved is devoured either by other hungry people, or one's self. Nothing remains for all that work and effort! John Fiedler, (I think), once told Julia Child that cooking and music are similar, in that after the effort is expended, the work soon disappears. But Mr. Fiedler, (or perhaps John Williams -- or whoever else said this), was wrong. Because music can be RECORDED -- and listened to over and over again. Sadly, the same cannot be said for food. You can make it over and over...but the effort involved is always the same. Food cannot be "recorded", then "played back" in an instant. Unless, I guess, you make a lot and freeze some of it. But when the frozen portion is gone -- you've got to make the receipe all over again.

Yes -- I AM a lazy cook. A very, very, very, VERY lazy cook. To me, making a tuna salad is an effort. (Forget about anything more complicated to make!) However, I will ALWAYS make the effort to make a tuna sandwhich, and take my own home-made "liquid refresment" with me, (ice tea, lemonade, iced coffee, etc.) -- "brown-bagging" whenever possible, to save a few pennies, which, day after day, and year after year, DO add up!

Yes, even I will make tea. With tea bags, (or even with lose tea), it is very, (VERY!) simple to make, after all! (Even simpler than intant coffee....because, to make GOOD tea, the water should come just to boiling, whereas in instant coffee, the longer the water boils, the more tasty the instant coffee will be.

Therefore, even I see absolutely NO reason to buy bottled tea! OK -- maybe once, so that you can use the empty bottle(s) into which to pour your own, "home-made" tea, after the bottles are empty. All that is required is to rinse out the glass bottles, (IMMEDIATELY!) a few times, with very hot water, or put dish-detergent soap into the glass bottles, fill with water, leave overnight, and THEN rinse with very hot water. Or put the empty glass bottles in the dishwasher to get them clean. Not very hard -- even very lazy me can do these things.

But, I suppose if you are going to get some bottles to put your tea in, you might as well get HONEST TEA COMMUNITY GREEN TEA, offered here on Amazon in a 12-bottle pack. This tea is rated the No. 1 tea in one of a very famous series of diet -- or make that, non-diet -- books, (you know, the ones with all the pretty pictures in them). Anyway, the authors of this book are very, er -- authoritative -- being editor-in-chief, and food and nutrition editors of some very well known, and famous, men's and women's health magazines. HONEST TEA COMMUNITY GREEN TEA gets their highest marks. I also note that there is a nice wide mouth and screw cap on this bottle -- easy for refilling and opening and closing, (keep a sterilized funnel handy, if needed). This green tea has maltese oranges in it, (to sweeten the flavour and add to the health benefits), and is certified kosher by the Orthodox Union, and certified organic by the USDA. It tastes pretty good for a green tea -- and the anti-oxidents in green tea have been proven to increase metabolism, and do other good things. If you still don't like the taste of green tea, you can, (after finishing this product), COMBINE green tea with other tea, (orange pekoe, English Breakfast, jasmine, etc.), for a better taste. More cheaply -- with your own brewed tea from bags or lose-leaves.

HONEST TEA COMMUNITY GREEN TEA comes in a 16 ounce bottle. If you have a thermos of this size, (or larger), you might want to use it instead -- but this way, you will have many, (that is, 12!), eventually-empty bottles, and perhaps thus be able to fill, (and refrigerate), several at a time, thus saving yourself some extra work. (There's "Lazy-Cook" me again!)

To your health -- and your saving money, making for more leisure, now and in the future! : )

I've been on a diet and exercise program and was eating peanut butter as a snack and it started to get out of hand and I couldn't lose any weight. Well with roughly 200 calories in 2T of peanut butter, it is easy to figure out why. My trainer told me about PB2 so I got some to try and I do like it. It is NOT peanut butter, it lacks the creamy smooth taste. I guess if I had to explain what it tastes like, I would say peanut butter cookie dough - basically imagine what peanut butter would taste like mixed with flour. But given that I can eat it for 1/4 of the calories, it is a reasonable substitute when I crave peanut butter.

As I recall, the instructions call for 2T of powder and 1T of water. I found that wasn't enough water to mix it up properly and had to put in a little extra. Over time I've found 1T of water is needed for every 1T of powder (equal parts), and that provides a creamier texture.

If I've got a few extra calories to burn for the day, I will sometimes mix 3T of PB2, 3T of water, and 1T of real peanut butter.

So PB2 is a great product and it is helping me meet my diet goals, but I wish it tasted more like real peanut butter. I haven't tried it in smoothies or anything like that (because I don't drink them), but I can see how that could be good if you enjoy them. I've ordered some of the chocolate flavored and I look forward to trying it.

Nectresse is great for those who will not use artificial sweeteners but still want to indulge in sweet things. It is all natural, made from monk fruit, but has zero calories. It is made by the same company that makes Splenda. One packet of Nectresse is equivalent to two teaspoons of sugar.

I am a big user of Splenda so that is what I will compare it to. How does it taste? To me it is slightly less sweet than Splenda. It lacks that sharp, sweet taste, but still imparts a nice sweet flavor. The texture? It is much more grainy than Splenda -- more like regular sugar, which may or may not be a plus for you. I prefer the finer powdery texture of Splenda as it blends more easily when sprinkled over food and used in liquids.

So why did I knock it down a star? Because there was no notation anywhere on the box or on their website about Nectresse and tooth decay. The fact is artificial sweeteners will not promote tooth decay. But since Nectresse is all natural, it could promote tooth decay just like regular sugar. I searched their website but could not find any information on this, but I'm pretty sure this is the case. So, from this perspective, I feel the artificial sweeteners like Splenda may be better for oral health.

Because of all these reasons, I'm sticking to Splenda. But if you are one of those people who do not like using artificial sweeteners, then Nectresse is the perfect alternative.
