Great flavor, and HAWT! Trust me, this stuff delivers exactly what it says. Get an ice bath ready, and wear loose clothing. haw haw
I have tried both Vita Coco and Zico. This tastes more natural than Zico and is cheaper too. Buy it when it is on sale and 'Subscriber and Save' option is available.
For a GF product, I thought they had a great taste . I thought they were expensive for what you get.

I've been on a granola with greek yogurt kick lately and as a Celiac, I have been trying all the GF granolas I can find. So far my favorite has been the buckwheat & millet granola by Emco that I found at Grocery Outlet one time but I can't seem to find out where to purchase it. My second favorite so far has been the Kind Vanilla Blueberry flavored granola. It is crunchy, which is a must for me. It has some clusters but not many. It has a good flavor and doesn't taste burnt like the Bakery on Main Fiber Power Cinnamon and Raisin Granola I tried. Overall, this is good granola as the flavor is good and the texture is right. It is also a healthier granola. There are two reasons why this granola is only 4 stars instead of 5: 1) Price - I can really only afford to be spending $3.50/12 oz bag for granola, times are hard and gluten free food in general is not cheap; 2) Clusters - there just aren't enough clusters, which are my favorite part of granola, to satisfy me.
These are great.  Good taste, very fresh and soft.  Get them and enjoy.

I was not paying attention when I ordered these coffee pods...I thought they were K-cups.  so I have to cut them open and dump the coffee into a K cup modifier.  It tastes fairly good, but I am sure the tastee is mediated by the annoyance of cutting open the packet and the pod before use.

Bought these to supplement my growing supply of reusables....I have many of the freebie, typical fold-up, boxy, grocery bags from various stores, but they aren't washable, so I have been looking for alternatives. These Waste-less bags are, so far, my favorite. I also have some flip and tumble reusable bags, which are also GREAT, but don't hold quite as much as these -- though I prefer the longer handles on the Flip and Tumble bags, the handles on the Waste-less Bags are sufficient to sling over my shoulder as long as they aren't filled to capacity. The fabric is light-weight but strong, and they conveniently fold up, literally, to pocket size with a nice little velcro strap to secure them. I keep a couple in my purse and also in my diaper bag...wouldn't leave home without them. For an idea of size and capacity -- I fit 5 boxes of frozen waffles and a 3 lb. bag of fruit in a single bag today. LOVE these. The price is right, so why not?

Update, post washing (2/15/11):
OK, what started off as a 5 star review has to drop to a 4. I just washed one of the black and one of the magenta bags for the first time after they fell in a puddle of mud in my garage. They washed completely clean and remain as functional as ever, but the green design on the black bag COMPLETELY disappeared in the wash. Well, to say it "disappeared" is not entirely correct. It showed up on the rest of my laundry as little green flecks and pieces. Shoot. Ah well, nothing's perfect...and like I said, I still love these for the functionality. It's the cheap decorating that loses them a star.

These arrived promptly and were relatively freshly canned 10/2010. The expiration date is 10/2012 which is plenty of time to mow through these 25 cans! =) They were firm fillets with some bones but once cooked were unnoticable. They aren't the best anchovies you can buy obviously but are perfect for adding flavor to that pizza, sauce, or other dish you are cooking. I would buy again! For $1.32/tin you can't beat it!

FYI I bought these about a month ago, just getting around to writing a review now.
Almonds on their own are a great snack, now dust them with cocoa and you've got an even better snack!! The canister makes them great to travel with in the car or leave in the desk at the office.

my kids can't get enough of these at breakfast and at this price I can't complain, but I must admit the fake blueberry flavor is a bit overpowering and nauseating at times...  Having said that, I would buy them again if they were on spectacular sale again.

This coffee is flavored with cardamom and clove and makes for an interesting compliment to your breakfast. According to the Natasha's Cafe website, it's a blend that is closer to the taste of the coffee of the 16th and 17th centuries. I like it, but it's a variety that I couldn't drink every morning so I save it for the days I'm feeling like a change of pace.

I find that it tastes a little better with a teaspoon of sugar than without sugar (and I normally drink my coffee without sugar!) or if you want it really sweet a single packet of Splenda or other artificial sweetener will do you well. I also think that it would taste a little more complete with a bit of cinnamon, but I understand that they were going for a very specific flavor with this coffee.

If any of this sounds good to you, give this coffee a try. You won't regret it.

I've tried about a half dozen different ThinkThin Protein Bar flavors. But, this is the only one I consistently re-order. Some of their flavors are virtually inedible, either artificial-tasting or too sweet like a candy bar. This one is just right.

It makes a great on-the-go breakfast for those early mornings when I don't have a chance to eat a real breakfast. One bar in the car plus a low-fat yogurt after I get to work, and I'm set until lunch.

BTW, I've never had an issue with freshness, unlike a few other unlucky reviewers. But, I do notice that Amazon now shrink wraps the boxes in a thick green plastic. Perhaps this is as a response to complaints about stale product? It's been working, in my case.

Being a longtime tea drinker, I was surprised that I found this as good as I did.  The surprise is this zingy aftertaste.  I like it best piping hot.  You don't have to use an entire packet per cup.....you can make it milder if you want.  It is not in a loose tea form, but rather it is a mix that you dissolve as a solution.  Remember it is pretty powerful if you drink it as directed.

It's summertime, and everyone who enjoys the German beer gardens knows that it's the season for hefe weizen!
Dark amber in color and opaque from top fermenting yeast, this hefe weizen drinks easily and finishes slightly sour on the palate. It's a good summertime beer -- full of flavor yet not overly heavy. Admittedly, I have had other hefe weizens that I've liked a little bit more. However, this is still a very respectable beer, worthy of merit. This beer will definitely make my secondary rotation; when I'm looking for something a little bit different, I will keep this one in mind.

Chantea Aloe Vera Passion Fruit is a medium-sweetness tea with about 120 calories per bottle. The first thing most people will notice about it (even before the flavor) is the pulp floating in the bottle. Slightly disconcerting, I never the less took a long swig.. and was pleasantly surprised. The taste was sweet but not overpowering; the tea and passion fruit have a nice mellow balance that would be great for dessert or sipping on a warm day. The pulp both adds and detracts from the experience - it tends to have both a sharp and sweet flavor when bitten into. When I am just relaxing and drinking slowly, that's fine - if I'm trying to drink too quickly or quench a deep thirst, the pulp gets in the way and is annoying.

Rating: 4/5 Stars (served cold). I highly recommend it for those times people want a flavorful experience, but not for those when you just want to guzzle down a glass of something wet.

I have four healthy cats who have a strong preference for this cat food over any other dry cat food. Recently, when I had them finishing out a bag of Iams I bought because I thought it would help with their shedding (it didn't -- these cats have healthy coats, but shed), the cats found a way to get into the pantry where I was storing the new bag of Meow Mix, and ripped open their favorite product.

So, my cats do "ask for it by name."

I have used several green superfood products in the past and have found them all to be beneficial.
The Amazing Grass ORAC product was something I wanted to try and I am glad I did. I have been taking 2 doses a day for the last 2 months and have experienced a definite energy boost. In addition I feel the same effect I get from natural testosterone boosters, Yeah! Rock on! And I like the taste, mixing only with water.

Chocolate flavored granola, with dark chocolate chunks and dried red straweberries and raspberries? That's what "Nature's Path Love Crunch Premium Organic Granola, Dark Chocolate and Red Berries" offers you. Below are my impressions on this product.

Pros:
- It's tasty. I've eaten a fair amount of granola in my life, and flavoring it with chocolate actually makes it seem less granola-like, which is a good thing, if you know what I mean. The granola has a nice chocolate flavor, not too strong and not too sweet.
- It's certified organic. While I'm admittedly not an "all natural" kind of consumer and don't typically shop at organic food stores, I will buy (and pay more for) organic products when given a choice, provided they offer a similar taste.
- There are enough dark chocolate chunks to be noticible when you're eating, and they add to the positive experience

Cons:
- There aren't enough dired red berries. While you can see a few small pieces in the mix, you can't readily taste them.
- It's a little high in calories, so portion control is essential if you're going to use this as part of your healthy eating patterns. An 11 1/2 ounce bag contains 10 servings, and each serving has 140 calories, about 40 percent is fat. One or two servings at a time is fine, the whole bag is not. :-)

Overall, this is a good, tasty treat that is much better for you than cookies or ice cream and the like. Just be sure to watch how much you eat. Four starts.

I bought this product because my husband loves Quinoa, I know this product is made from corn as well. I have to say, I have made this 3 times already and while it is very good, I can not stop this Liguine from STICKING together in clumps! I have tried olive Oil still no luck. The Package states DO NOT OVERCOOK, but I think I will overcook it to see if I have no more clumps.

I bought this candy bar after trying a candy bar at an old irish shop that i was told i probably couldn't get here in the states; thanks to the magic of the internet i knew i had a shot. This is not the candy we tried, but is very similar, chocolate covered chocolate nougart with pieces of biscuit inside & layered with caramel - it's delicious. If you like chocolate this would probably be a very good choice.

OK SO I USED IT IN A MEAT DISH LAST NIGHT AND ALL I CAN SAY IS THAT I AM NEVER BUYING REGULAR PAPRIKA AGAIN! THIS IS JUST YUMMMMMM :)
IT IS JUST SO NICE IN DISHES, AND THE FLAVOR ACCENTS JUST PERFECTLY.
These cookies were delicious - even the kids loved them. These are great store bought cookies. Soft and raisins were perfect. Would buy and recommend to all.

This stuff is great i tried it for the first time last week thursday ... and im hooked .. its not too sweet and not too fresh .. great in the blender and mixes well with protein powder like suggested .
A good anytime coffee. More on the lighter roast side,smooth and not bitter. Good flavor,my go to coffee. Best in an eight ounce cup.

I was looking for a product that would give me a taste similar to Starbucks' Green Tea Frappucino, but at a lower cost (made at home) and stumbled across this. I thought the idea of sugar-free made it even better, as the Starbucks' version is high in sugar and calories.

The taste is fantastic!! After scouring the internet, for quite some time, I was able to locate some remaining stock of discontinued Torani Melon syrup (the green kind, not watermelon), and the resulting mix is very close to Starbucks' version.

The shipping was lightning fast, even with standard delivery. I was very pleased with the entire transaction.

In fact, my only complaint is that, if you are like me, and have a digestive system extremely sensitive to xylitol (or most artificial sweeteners ending in "-ol"), be aware that this product may have a "come-back-to-haunt-you" side effect. I won't get graphic with the specifics, but I think you can figure it out (I think the sweetener manufacturers refer to it as a "laxative effect").

The problem is...the stuff is so tasty, I consider the side effect a mild deterrent, at worst. I'm still drinking it. However, in the future, I may go ahead and reorder the product in its "cane sugar" form, and just try not to drink it obsessively, to escape the side effect.

This is both glorious and a work horse. This is affordable, not precious, and this is the one the big boys use, Mario, Eric, that calibre of big boys. I cook with it, use it in vinaigrettes, roast with it, rely on it for everything. This is the one you want right next to your stove for all sorts of cooking, roasting, finishing. You get the idea. I haven't a penny to spare these days, but this is one of things I won't compromise on.

My mom used to heat this up and pour it over toast for an after school snack in the 70's. It's still just as good except better because they took out the trans fats. I wouldn't eat it too often though because it is kinda high fat and sodium, but once in awhile shouldn't hurt.

These are very good.  They taste much better than the grocery store variety.  They are so good, by daughter requested that I order more.  One time I ate a whole block of noodles without cooking them.  They were quite tasty...most likely due to the high salt content.

It's about time that baby purees started tasting like real food. Not sure what happened but there's been a baby food revolution in the last 5 years Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1(6 Months+) Juicy Pear and Garden Greens Baby Food, 4.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12) is one of those 'revolutionary' foods. It just tastes better than the stuff in the jars and it looks better too (bright appetizing colors).

I hate to do this but I'm knocking one star off because I'm realizing that many of the manufacturers are starting to add pears to sweeten what would otherwise be just vegetables (and vegetables can be sweet on their own, right?) So of course it makes it taste good and babies love it but I worry that they'll have a hard time adjusting to food combinations that don't have that extra sugar kick (already happened to a niece of mine).

So if you can make your own purees good for you but if you can't this isn't such a bad alternative and I'll definitely be buying more.

The package comes with 5 individual packs inside of it. All you have to do is add 8 cups (2 quarts) of water to one packet, add ice, and waa-la, mocktail time! Each 8 fluid oz. serving contains just 5 calories! the drink turns a gorgeous green! A perfect match for the real thing!

We were split on our review of them. I like the strong flavor of tequilla in real Margaritas, so to me they seemed VERY sweet. But Mom felt they were just right. I think if you mixed some lemon-lime soda (for some fizz) in place of the water, and added some real fruit, you'd have a pretty tasty punch for a party! Perfect for a bridal or baby shower! Plus they would make some tasty frozen pops for your Moms Party!

This coffee is delicious, and even better, since it is already irish cream flavored, I don't need to add the extra calories from the irish cream creamers.  Its a nice way to wake up in the morning, and very well-priced for my budget.  Look forward to trying other Timothy's flavors, though I wish they had a "Variety Pack", or that you could "Make Your Own Variety Pack".

They are the real deal, but unfortunately arrived melted. The box seemed like a clump of chocolate. They are individually wrapped, a good thing. I did put the box into the fridge and yummy, and after a day, one pattie opened with little to no problem. Tasted great!

So I take away one star for being melted, yet they are a five star item when refrigerated.

They're staying in my fridge. Perhaps best to order in winter.

I thought this would have more of an oatmeal consistency, but instead the grains remain somewhat separate and not particularly creamy.  However, with dried fruit and a bit of agave, it makes a nice change from oatmeal.  You just have to get past the consistency being different.

These bags are very pretty. I gave them as gifts for Christmas. Even my friend who is not very environmental agreed that they were cute and might actually use it lol. One of the bags I got did come with some frayed strings/edge and didn't look super nice. (That's the reason I didn't give it 5 stars) I just kept it for myself. I've used it a number of time and it seemed to be holding up fine. I haven't used it for very heavy things yet though. I would buy them again, but would be a little cautious about the quality. Though for the price and style it is worth it.

Mocha nut fudge is good but not great. It tastes best with a mocha creamer. We have tried about 20 different k cups and The Donut House chocolate glazed donut and Timothys German chocolate cake taste the best to us so far. This one is good to have once in a while for variety though.

It came well packed and very timely.  On opening the first few there was leakage from the top when held upside down.  So far it has not happened since with the others.  I definitely will order this product again.  The taste is Coconut Water.  There are several pure coconut water products available.  For my taste this is not the best tasting yet being what it is, pure coconut water it is refreshing and sustaining and suits my purpose well.  I like the container.

I received a sample of this from Influenster and was pretty excited to try it because it was an interesting concept.  I tasted it and thought it tasted just like banana bread.  It had an odd texture and seemed a bit dry though, which is why I rated it four out of five stars.

I had ants tracking from outside the front door all the way to my kitchen. This stuff took care of the outside ants within hours and there were no more intruders. I also bought the inside liquid bait traps, but not a single ant got to those - this could be because it was late for the bait, or the outside stuff just demolished their track. I did watch to see if they would continue to track, but after laying this powder down the ants all died or moved on. I recommend this highly.

One warning, this product is waterproof. I went heavy on the application and that was a mistake - go light! - it will kill them! I have some caked powder around my door that I have to clean up, but had I applied lighter, would not really be an issue. This stuff works. I bought it through Amazon and it arrived within a week. Recommend.

The only reason I'm not giving this a 5 is that it will not go away once applied, but as mentioned above I went heavy with the application - go light, and it will not be a problem. Worthy of 5 stars for those who follow directions better than I.

Puroast Low Acid Coffee Low Acid Coffee French Roast, 3-Ounce Bags

I suffer from acid reflux and heartburn after eating and drinking certain foods. I have always loved coffee but I just could not handle the heartburn and other stomach problems after drinking coffee. I was so excited to see this available because I would love to start drinking coffee again on a more regular basis.

I have a 12 pot coffee maker and I only used 10 cups to brew for this pot of coffee and it was too potent for me. The aroma is wonderful but with 3ozs of coffee I needed to add more water. After adding additional water to the pot I found that it was drinkable for me. There is a mouthful of flavor in every sip with absolutely no aftertaste. No major coffee breath!
French roast has a naturally burnt/smokey taste to begin with and in this coffee you can really taste it. I just think I prefer a different roast type.
As far as the low acidity I was really happy about not having to suffer after a cup or several cups of coffee. Since this coffee comes in different roasts and flavors, I would seriously consider buying it to alleviate the negative side effects from drinking regular coffee.

I love these cookies, they are my favorites. And the price is a good price. The packaging was very good, the original box from the manufacturer placed in an Amazon box, with all the requisite protection. I don't know what happened, but every bag that I have opened so far, contains about half full cookies, and the rest in various states of brokenness. They still taste great and I don't really mind. However, if you were giving them to someone, I think it would be somewhat disappointing.

I have always liked eight o'clock coffee and thought that I had finally found a place where I could at least get a good deal on it. The good deal of course turned out to be too good to be true.After my first purchase at under $10.00 a bag, I got the notice for my next order and the price doubled. I can go into my nearest mom and pop and get it for less. What a ripoff the subscription shopping is!!!!!!!!!!!!

I prefer strong coffee, and usually buy the extra bold varieties like Espresso, Revv, Paul Neumann Organic, and my ultimate fave - Jet Fuel.

This coffee has an absolutely wonderful odor, but when it comes to taste, it is pretty watery and doesn't hold a match to my Jet Fuel. If they could strengthen up the coffee itself, I'd buy it just for the smell, but for now I'll stick to the strong stuff.
The only product I ever found that actually helps to collect those pesky moths that eat through clothing and rugs.

I use dehydrated beans for both backpack camping and for my emergency rations (living in California, I think of it as preparation for the supposedly-overdue "Big One").  I've tried several vegi-beans and the reason I like these is because they're so mild, they can be spiced the way each person likes.  I used to buy spicy beans but it wasn't spicy enough for me, while others wanted them less salty/spicy.  Now I can take these beans and my super hot sauce and everybody's happy.

I like the versatility of this granola pack. It's light enough to go on cereal or yogurt, but could also be a standalone snack. It tastes pretty good. The blueberries aren't full sized, or even like raisins, but rather like those preserved fruits you get in some types of cereals. It's still good, but I wouldn't recommend the pack if you're only buying it for the blueberry flavor. Another nice feature is that these grains are a bit softer than traditional granola, so it's not as crunchy to chew. Overall, not a bad choice to spice up your yogurt.

As a person who cannot eat gluten and doesn't really like flavor nuts that much, I struggle with trying to find items that I like. Out of all the nut-thin Blue-Diamond crackers, these WERE my favorite, until that is, Ib tried Blue-Diamond Country Ranch (see review of that one). The Cheddar Cheese crackers taste great with tuna salad, but are great without too! I used to buy them at Whole Foods which is about a 35-50+ minute drive depending on traffic, so needless to say, I was pleased to see that they sell them here online. And even without the subscription, they were still cheaper than buying them in the store, not by much, but still cheaper! Especially when you consider time, gas, and SALES TAX - all of which are momumentally saved on Amazon! I ended up signing up for the subscription, its a saving of $.48 cents per box, once again this excludes the sales tax of 10% I get charged plus the hefty price of gas! So, its well worth it to me!! I also signed up for the subscription for Country Ranch Blue Diamond Crackers, since they are my favorite!

Jack Link's Beef Jerky, Original, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 2)

Tough and chewiness, dry, not too salty, this is one of my favorites. Since the flavor isn't too strong, i tend to eat too much.
This was very relaxing and when you want to nap, you can drink this and then take a nap.  It contains no caffeine and gives a nice break from every day stresses.

Many energy drinks contain the artificial sweetener 'sucralose', which causes me migraines and makes me lethargic. Even many of the 'non-diet' ones have it!  Thankfully, regular Red Bull does not contain sucralose, so I can drink it and feel great.  I avoid 'sugar-free' Red Bull.

I am an absolute "Popcorn Nut" and my 10 month granddaughter is quickly joining the ranks as well. Of course, she's just eating modified kernals. I love this product because I get to sample multiple flavors without waiting for a new delivery. This product gives me an opportunity to savor these different flavors and decide my favorite. Well, guess what, I can't decide which is my favorite. Although, I am leaning toward the "Red River Valley".
Great stuff WisconsinMade.
I have been trying to find some fresh mint for my iced tea but couldn't find a reliable source.  This tea is very nice if you like mint in your iced tea, I recommend it highly.

Love this stuff -- use it in everything --- tastes fantastic in our fruit smoothies!  I do wish the sugar wasn't added, it's not necessary, but it truly beats chopping your own ginger, no matter how much I blended I would always find stringy pcs left over -- this solved that!  too easy

This tea was recommended by Dr. Oz and by weight loss doctor Medina Jampolis. Dr. Melina said to drink 2-3 cups of it a day, or maybe she said that SHE does that; I bought some from amazon.com and didn't really like the taste.  But it's grown on me and now, 3 months-or-so later, I truly ENJOY a cup or two a day! I wish I could report that I've lost weight, but I can't, although i haven't GAINED any, even tho' I'm getting more exercise (muscle weighs more than fat, drink tea some times when i'd otherwise have an unhealthy snack, and I'm in my 60's and don't walk independently due to MS, so weight loss is harder anyway. I'm still hopeful.  But this tea is my friend and definitely not working against me! Got to order more of it again.  Will buy from the same source--right here.

Ok, so our dog loves these, that's great. But they stink so badly that it's hard for us to want to give them to him. So if you don't care about stink then they are great for dogs, if you have a really sensitive stomach you may want to skip these.

The product arrived as promised and in good condition.  The only quarrel I would have is that although the bag was marked with the flavor of the candy, ie Mint, the covers on the individual pieces of candy were not so marked. I suppose they were "seconds" which is fine as long as the candy pieces look and taste good --- and they do!

My son and I are true coffee lovers.  We chose the Guatemalan coffee because we truly love the coffee we have had from there in the past.  This product was just as good. Very smooth. Nice to look forward to every morning.

If you like regular Slim Jim's, then you should like the Nacho flavor.  Similar to most of my food reviews, these are great for a low-carb diet.  For low-carbers the only problem is the HEFTY dose of sodium, so drink lotsa water with these.
I love Mrs. May's. These aren't my favorites of what they make, but they are tasty and handy to have around. The cashews or the black sesame seeds are the five star snacks!
This is a good flavor. Just a hint of coconut without being overwhelming. I will be ordering again when I run out!

Growing up, Shake'N Bake was a primary staple in our household. I can still remember the anticipation knowing that my mom was using this product to complete our dinner.

Fast forward thirty, okay, forty years and when I realized I hadn't used Shake'N Bake in more years than I wanted to admit, I jumped at the chance to try this out.

It was exactly as I remembered. The 2.05 ounce pouch holds just enough seasoning for an entire cut up chicken. I used five breasts and they were coated perfectly. It was just that easy. And just that tasty!

I would definitely use this product again. The spices are just right without being overpowering and the mixture coats the chicken just as intended.

Natalie S. for Amazon Vine

My dogs had to be on food with limited ingredients for a while and this was the best of the types I tried. The dogs ate it easily (although without great gusto) and it helped us get through the medical issues that precipitated our use of it.  Vet recommended. I wouldn't use for day to day dog food, since other flavors without " limited ingredients" appeal to the dogs more.

NASA must be pretty bemused that a Japanese chocolate is named after and shaped like their Apollo craft. It is amazing how things can be marketed using some completely unconnected with it. Having said that, these little Apollo shaped things are very good.

They might strike one as being sickeningly sweet, but like most things Japanese, they are not. One would be forgiven for exercising caution, but I don't think they are overdone on the sweetness side.

Combining strawberry and chocolate is an age old recipe, but Meiji have done it well this time. I thoroughly enjoy these whenever I can get them, but there are others that I would prefer. These, however, are more than good enough as a stop-gap measure for my real addictions.
Compared to any microwave popcorn this is GREAT!  Compared to Chief's Choice portion packs...not even close.  Second best for this brand!  Still very worthy of 4 stars.

My fussy little mix (yorkshire/shihtzu) will not eat or accept anything he does not like. He won't accept treats on a general basis and nixes all hard food. Poor little fellow came into my life with a set of bad teeth and since has had many extracted. So, chewing on hard and large items is not a possibility.

The good news is that he has actually accepted "Checkups" and I am thrilled because maintaing what few teeth he does have is a challenge. The bad news is that I have to cut them into bite size for him and this is not easy. So, if the product came in smaller bits for little dogs it would be good. If they were just a tad easier to use, I would give it all 5 stars!

I've had much better tea but this isn't bad. It's also quite expensive, since I have bought much better for cheaper. Also for those that drink tea as a coffee substitute, this tea doesn't have that much caffeine. I don't feel anything when I drink this but I do when I drink high quality green tea.

I recently bought these Wilton tints and they worked great!  I was able to tint white cake batter as well as buttercream frosting in seconds.  I do have to say, however, that the colors come out much better when used in the icing than in the batter.  However, overall, I was very pleased with how good the product was.  I agree with other reviewers about the red tint.  The red never seems to get really "red", but rather a really bright pink-red shade.  I used at least 8 of the colors in the past week, and have been really happy with all of them!  Highly recommend!  It is a great price for the variety that you get.  You only have to use a small amount of tint, so the set should last you a very long time.  This is a must have for any aspiring baker...and they work WAY better than food coloring!  Have fun!!
Takes an extra bottle shake or two to totally dissolve the formula, but we like it and so does our daughter.
The Tea provides that nice cozy feeling during those cool nights and soothes the throat when that nasty cold has taken hold.

Of all the Earl Grey's I've tried, this and Rishi's version are the most robust.  If you like the distinctive flavor of bergamont, but wish it were more pronounced than in the conventional blend, and your not opposed to some extra tannins, then this or Rishi are your Earl Greys of choice.  Of the conventional Earl Grey teas that are relatively easy to find, my favorite is Bigelow's. My favorite Earl Grey is made by Revolution, and includes lavender as an ingredient. However, I have to knock Revolution by trying cut costs by not including a string with their tea bags. If you want to try an Earl with a unique citrus zing, go for Stash Double Bergamont. I think it includes grapefruit flavoring (just my perception). Lady Grey by Twinings also tastes great, and includes small blue flowers, which you can see in the loose leaf version. Cool visual effect against the dark black tea leaves.

I don't know how much of a review I can write on dog food.  The dog seems to like it okay, but she doesn't seem to like it as much as her normal food.  I've read the other reviews that it has lots of fillers, but isn't that true of most dry dog foods?
I've purchased these here twice this year and the price was awesome with no shipping charge.  Now the price has more than doubled and shipping as well.  Guess I'll give up on my BottleCap fix.

I bought this for a camping trip and would definitely eat it again at home. Unlike everyone else, I do not taste an aftertaste or artificial taste with these. I also used less water than called for so mine isn't mushy when I mix it up. All of the regular-sugar instant oats are mushy IMO, so this product is  no better or worse on that score. If money were not an issue, I might take the Acai Pomegranate instead of my daily Nuun.

I was wandering the aisles of my local Wegmans supermarket recently and saw Brad's Raw Leafy Kale--Naked flavor on the shelf. We use fresh kale all the time for our smoothies, but I haven't been able to get myself to eat "raw" kale, like just-picked-from-the-garden-that-we-use-for-our-smoothies kale. So when I saw this "raw" kale snack I thought, they're not really "raw." They are dehydrated (under 115˚F) and seasoned, to make them palatable. And they are DELICIOUS. I love them. I am hooked. They have a slight crunch, but not a chip crunch, more like a firm bite. My kids like the initial taste but don't like the aftertaste. I love the whole thing. The problem is that they only come in a 2.5 ounce clear plastic container (supposedly 2.5 servings), which I can easily eat in one sitting. " If you look at the nutrition facts, you'll notice they're not totally healthy. They have 9 g of fat per serving, or 22.5 g of fat per container, which realistically is what I could eat at a time if I were hungry. They are also a bit pricey (I paid $7.50 for the one package). Surprisingly, Amazon's price is higher, so I'll have to buy them directly from Brad's website, or from Wegmans or Whole Foods. If these were cheaper, I'd buy them all the time. But for now they're more like a "treat myself" kind of snack.

I drink sugar free beverages exclusively. What this means is that I'm pretty immune to typical aftertastes for such products so take that in to account when considering my review.

I hydrate regularly throughout the day by filling up a coffee mug with water from our refrigerated drinking fountain. One squirt of this gives me a touch of flavor and a boost of nutrition, or so says the marketing literature on this and I'm not arguing. It tastes like Kool Aid to me, i.e., pleasantly sweet but not overpowering. If you add an extra squirt or use less water you'll get a stronger and (artificially) sweeter flavor.

As a reviewer who received this as a sample I always ask, "would I buy this with my own money?" Probably not. Still, it's pleasant enough and if slightly flavored beverage water is something you like, this is a very convenient way to use it. I keep this in the mini-fridge at work, and when I fill up my mug with icy drinking fountain water (I love our drinking fountain) I occasionally throw in a squirt of this Fruit Punch flavored package as a change of pace from, um, just water.

I might suggest if you are a Kool Aid household, that this is a much more convenient mechanism of flavor delivery than powder. Not a big deal, but there you have it.

And as the owner of a much-loved dog, isn't that what's most important? This long-grain brown rice smells more like green tea to me than floral. It arrived to me quickly and in fresh condition from Amazon.

Organic Mekong Flower Rice(tm) - Cambodia's Floral Brown Rice, Imported from Cambodia

Mekong Flower is called 'Phka Malis' in Khmer, which means beautiful garland of flowers, because of its delicate floral aroma. Leaving the germ and bran layer intact intensifies its fragrance and nutty flavor while retaining the highest nutritional value. This nourishing whole grain rice has a lovely supple texture - unlike the chewy and bland taste of some brown rice.

Perfect in dishes that will showcase its delicate fragrance, Mekong Flower is nutritious and flavorful.

Perfect for all cuisines, it can be used steamed plain, in a pilaf, stir-fry, salad or pudding.

Mekong Flower is chiefly grown on small family plots by households belonging to the Damrei Romeal Organic Rice Cooperatives in Takeo, a province dominated by rice fields and sugar palm trees. Cooperative members are using a set of growing methods, called the System of Rice Intensification (SRI), which enable smallholder farmers to harvest more rice from their traditional varieties using less water, seed, land and no chemicals. Researchers have found that the major aromatic compound in rice is increased in response to water stress. With SRI, farmers drain their paddies periodically, which may explain why Cambodian consumers are saying that SRI-grown 'Phka Malis' is more aromatic and better tasting. Visit our SRI section to learn more about this amazing system that is transforming the rice-growing world.

# Whole grain and heart healthy
# High in fiber, trace minerals and vitamins
# High in phytonutrients and antioxidants
# 3rd year transition, organic certification
# Fair trade
# Gluten and wheat free

With that proviso out of the way, these are some seriously awesome candies. If you've read my other Amazon product reviews, you may find that I am a bit of a candy snob. Tootsie Roll Caramel Apple Pops give you all the benefit of bobbin' for apples on Halloween, without the awkward costumes, getting wet, or any resulting nutritional value that one may enjoy from eating a real apple.

I have to admit that I purchased these candies to give to a client; curiosity got the best of me and I found myself employing surgeon-like skills in extracting one lollipop from a box seam. That is when I realized these lollipops are HUGE. In fact, that is my only gripe with the candy - they are too large to comfortably enjoy without the need to occasionally take a break. Also, I suspect that they were each shrink-wrapped immediately after manufacturing, so the caramel coating surrounding each lollipop takes on the irregular shape of the plastic sheath under which the candy is transported (occasionally bearing somewhat sharp edges).

That said, the caramel coating is mild, but substantial enough where the consumer clearly enjoys two distinct types of candy - which I suppose is what Tootsie brand pops attempts to achieve. Once you work your way through the caramel shell, the green apple "disc" is not overly tart - something I was concerned about after having Jolly Rancher brand green apple hard candies. The combination of the caramel and the green apple candy pairs up perfectly. You have to force yourself not to chew too much as the combination creates a bond that will surely rip out any dental appliance.

Nature's Path should consider using alternate sweeteners, such as, organic of course, brown rice syrup or raw blue agave syrup. The macrobiologists would be jazzed!

I got this sauce when Costco had the 40 oz. jars for $2 off the normal price of $7-something a jar. The price seemed right for those times when you need to cook supper fast, and don't have it in you to start from scratch. Now, they don't carry it anymore, and my stockpile for those "just in case" occasions has been completely depleted. I'm fretting.
Normally, I consider jarred pasta sauces to be beneath my dignity. I believe my Italian grandmother would roll over in her grave, if I used store-bought pasta sauce. However, this sauce passes as my own homemade. Sometimes, I'll doctor it up with a bit of this and that, but it isn't necessary. My family's discerning palates have been fooled on a number of occasions. That's a tall order in my opinion. I'm all for anything that makes my life easier, but doesn't compromise on quality, or authenticity of ingredients.
This is authentic-tasting Italian sauce, not like that gaggable stuff in the grocery store. People will think it's homemade, and you don't ever have to let them know otherwise.
The coffee is good: in no time (like 3 min) one gets a decent cup of coffee. Would recommend for busy people like myself.

This is a good K-Cup..the key though is to brew using the smallest size...of course thats less tea but it gives the closest to the "authentic" sweet tea that most of us that are familiar with the drink, are used to. I also think you could drink this one hot..Overall very good taste, not overly sweet but a good enough sweet tea taste to brew, grab, go & enjoy!

While not a huge fan of flavored coffee, Gevalia Dark Chocolate Truffle Ground Coffee isn't bad. It isn't exactly bitter or sweet,  but it is a little like bittersweet chocolate in the coffee. It has a pleasant aroma and tastes nice with milk. I don't use sugar, but I think that would improve the flavor. I am a coffee snob, but I do like my coffee ground, so that was a plus. If you like mocha coffee, that still tastes like coffee, you will probably like this. I probably will try a different Gevalia coffee next time.

I love Scharffen Berger chocolate and this bar is no exception. The flavor is rich and deep. If you don't like coffee, it has a strong presence, though not masking the dark chocolate itself.

This is a great snack on its own, and good in desserts as well. I recommend it!
I ordered this as pumpkin seems to be in very short supply this year.  I was unable to find it at any of my three local grocery stores.  The quality of this is excellent.
Great product! They are really cute and were perfect for my one year-old's puppy-themed party birthday cake.

My cat loves these bubbles. All I have to say is "Do you want bubbles?" and she comes running out from wherever she may be hiding. She meows and pounces on the bubbles. I am giving them a rating of 4 though because they smell horrible. If they drip on anything white it will turn green, but can easily be cleaned with some water and a sponge!!!!

I use Bumble and Bumble (salon brand) and Dove hair care products.  Quite honestly, I can't tell a difference between the very expensive Bumble and Bumble brand and the cheaper Dove brand products.  Clear Scalp & Hair Strong Lengths did an equally good job of cleaning and "nourishing" my hair as both the Bumble and Bumble and Dove brands.  I have only been using this shampoo (not the matching conditioner ... still alternate BB and Dove conditioner) for about 2 weeks.  I can tell an improvement in my hair, but my hair always seems to do better when I first change to another good shampoo.  My hair does not do well when I change to ANY shampoo, so that is still a good thing that my hair likes the shampoo.  All in all, I would recommend alternating this shampoo with other good quality (not necessarily more expensive) shampoos.  I do plan on trying the conditioner too to see the results with the combination of the two together.

I'm a bit of a cinnamon junky and have collected many variants of this tasty treat. There are a few better products but still I keep coming back to McCormick as it has been consistently good. The last couple orders of Indus Organics and Spicy World cinnamon I bought from Amazon had all the flavor of hardwood flooring (these are much more expensive products). I love to boil or pressure cook 6 or 7 sticks and mix with black tea for a killer batch of ice tea. The only reason I dogged Amazon a star is the fact you can often buy the same 8-oz McCormick cinnamon sticks at Costco for half the price. Still, great stuff and I'll be back for more.

I've been feeding Soft and Chewy Buddy Biscuits to my three dogs for years. They're great because they break apart easily, so you can give them whole or break them down for training or to fit appropriately in interactive toys.

Some dogs may not be thrilled about the lamb flavor as much as other Buddy Biscuit flavors (our three dogs seem to favor the Beef and Grilled Chicken), but I've never seen a happy dog turn them down.

I note these as a "mid-value" treat because I've tried using these as a high value treat for a fearful dog, and they just didn't cut it. It's not surprising, as high value usually needs to be something like cheese or meat, but I did want to make the distinction.

That doesn't mean they wouldn't be high value for your dog (every dog is different), but they do not work for us.

They are not "mid-value" as in quality. They are high quality treats, with good ingredients, made in the United States. We currently buy every flavor we can on Amazon through Subscribe and Save, if that says anything about how we feel about them.

Out of all of the flavors, our dogs like the Sweet Potato and Peanut Butter flavors the least. What does this mean? If you put out one biscuit of each, they'd choose these last. They still eat them happily.
these are pretty good.  there not so sour if that's what you're looking for.  won't order again though, shipping is a killing!
packaging is great, individually wrapped. very tasty. i also like the mango flavor.

I have three little dogs. We generally handle feeding them by leaving out some dry food for them all day and then giving them a small meal of meat and rice in the evening. Sometimes they're fairly picky about the dog food that they get and refused to eat certain brands. My general position was that we leave it out until they get hungry enough to eat it, but my wife usually override that and just tossed it. Then we started getting the Beneful a few years ago and we haven't had that issue since.

They definitely enjoy the meaty chunks (or whatever the chunks are) very much. As some other reviewer mentioned, the dog will go for that first. Mine will often dump the food out onto the floor and then find the chunks they want and eat those. I could see this being a problem if they only ate the chunks, because that wouldn't be good for their dental health; they're far too soft brush their teeth. Since we don't usually put very much out of the time, the dogs are forced to eat the crunchier bits as well to be full. They nearly always clean up the mess they made by late afternoon.

Our dogs have been eating this stuff for years and have been very healthy. Other than routine shots, only one of them has had to go to the vet for anything else. When they have been in the office, the vet has said that they appeared healthy. I'm not sure how much of that is the food and how much of that is just luck or genetics, but either way this brand seems to work well for us. I'm not sure if we'll start getting this delivered routinely by Amazon or not, but well likely stick to this brand until they get tired of it.

I paid just under $11 and in about a month, I've used maybe 3/4 of an ounce (I saved an empty 1 oz bottle to keep a more manageable portion on the spice rack). Like another reviewer said, it IS possible it tastes a bit different from the 1 oz version, but I couldn't say for certain, and moreover, I don't think it's bad - I'm using it, mainly on rice dishes. To me, it's legions better than Taste Specialty Foods Hot Curry Powder, 16-Ounce but not as good as Rajah Mild Madras Curry Powder 100g.

Google "curry powder health benefits" and you'll find plenty of results; it's best known for its benefits to digestion and for anti-inflammatory qualities, but also said to boost memory and protect against Alzheimer disease and cancer.

Title: "A nice pick me up to get you through the day"

In the sweltering heat of summer, a nice cool refreshing coffee can really get you through the day. In the east coast iced coffee seems to be everywhere, but in the midwest canned coffee seems to be the only way to get your fix.

Unlike that Seattle chain of coffee, this canned coffee has a much smoother flavor. A touch of sugar and creaminess makes it a good treat at only 45 calories a can. I'm interested in trying black truffle salt and since it's so expensive I thought I'd try a truffle salt popcorn to see if it's worth all the hoopla. I frequently make curry dishes from scratch.  I was looking for this box meal to make an easy version of that.  It succeeded in the easy department.  Making this meal was as easy as making Hamburger Helper.  Just cooking the meet, start the rice cooker, and add the sauces.  I was very pleased with the ease in cooking.  The flavor, however, left me a little disappointed.  It wasn't bad, but it just wasn't as good as homemade.  My family ate it all and said it was okay but gave it the thumbs down for future purchases.  They'd much rather eat my homemade.  I'm afraid I have to agree.  Although this was all right, it's worth the extra effort for better flavor.  I would be interested in buying other flavors from this company, and I would recommend this product to anyone that struggles in the kitchen.  It does make decent curry very easy.
This apple cider vinegar is great for incorporation into one's beauty regimen or household use. I would recommend it to others as it is a quality product at a reasonable price.

I ordered a package of 6 cans previously, and that order was completed as I hoped. So when I bought this order of 12 cans, I was expecting more of the same. However, of the 12 cans, 6 were dented, and 4 of them badly. It doesn't appear the seals were broken and the cans aren't swollen, etc, so the bread is fine. But based on the other reviews, anyone about to buy this product needs to be aware of the condition it might be in when you receive it.

As for the bread itself, it is delicious. It's very dense and fairly sweet. It goes well toasted with butter or with peanut butter (to my taste buds, anyway). This stuff isn't available in stores here in Texas to my knowledge, so I'm glad I can buy it on Amazon!

This is a very tasty product. This is my first time trying this, and I am glad I ordered it to see how it tastes. As a product I'd order it again.

One odd thing though that will cause me to lower this rating from 5 stars to 4 is that the listing here says a pound, but on the label 16 ounces is crossed out and 14 ounces is written next to it. I didn't weigh the container to confirm this, but if it is 14 ounces, then then they need to update their listing to show such.

this is a high quality Matcha which is very smooth and tastes great with no bitterness at all.  my order arrived fast (in 3 business days).  i'm satisfied with the quality of this Matcha, as well as the fast service from the seller, and would purchase this Matcha again.

I purchased this as a gift.  It arrived very fast and looked great.  The cookies are packed in a white box with a christmas picture on the front. It was wraped in clear plastic with a nice gift bow on top.  It was a gift so I do not know how they tasted, but it looked very nice.

This is great for smaller dogs or dogs with poor dentition and trouble chewing. Very small pieces so easy to ingest.

I ordered these after the ones I bought in Hawaii were gone. These were as fresh as the ones bought in Hawaii and the price was much better. Warning: Can be habit forming.
I bought one of these at an airport. Is a great idea and tastes good. I just wish there was more, especially of the hummus so that it would be more of a meal, thus the four stars instead of five.

Wellness is by far the best dogfood we have ever fed our yellow lab.  Though it is expensive, we figure we spend the same amount  or less than we would through purchasing a cheaper food as we would need to feed more for the same caloric intake.  We get by with a thirty pound bag about once a month or so.  Our lab's coat is healthy, he has high energy, and his "movements" are solid... May be too much information. To help with further comparison, our lab is 8 years old, is an active hunter nine months out of the year (waterfowl spring and fall, rabbits, upland birds), and he is an indoor family dog.

I love this product! It is wonderful to have in one's pantry when a storm has rolled in and you cannot get to a store, or the stores are not open. However, I will not buy this from Amazon again.
