After doing a lot of research on the quality of dog foods, it becomes obvious that what most of us probably buy for our dogs really may not be good for them. Meat by-products always raise questions, but the real concern for me is the grains frequently used that are indigestible by dogs or that the dogs may be allergic to or may develop such an allergy because of eating them. A particular concern is wheat gluten (allergy), soy (filler) and corn meal (filler). Most inexpensive dog foods are primarily made of these. Aside from being almost worthless from a food value view for a dog, their only "merit" is the artificial nutrients that are mixed in.

Once you start looking into dog foods that provide good quality foods (rather than fillers and chemical nutrients), the price usually climbs very quickly. (That's not to say that many poor quality dog foods aren't also really expensive.) I picked the Blue Buffalo Small Breed food because my energetic little dog needs a really good food to sustain him. It is a little more expensive than typical "name" brands, but MUCH LESS expensive than other high quality foods. If you do the research, you'll find this food highly rated for food content (though not at the very top), but far more reasonable in cost than something like EVO.

Does my dog like the food? Definitely. He is a picky, slow eater who is often not interested in eating at all. Since changing to the Blue Buffalo, he has not become a gluton, but now eats readily until he is full (not necessarily everything in the bowl). It has been easy to mix in this food with the original ProPlan we used and gradually increase the proportion of Blue Buffalo. But from the first day with only a little Blue Buffalo mixed in, he has shown more interest in eating and has not had any negative reactions.

This "Tao of Tea" Oolong tea is authentic Wuyi Oolong from Wuyishan, China, packaged in Portland, Oregon, and it is organic. Oolong tea leaves are midway between green tea and black tea in terms of processing because Oolong leaves are semi-oxidized, whereas black tea leaves are fully oxidized. The oxidation of the leaves affects the chemical properties as well as the taste of the tea. When brewed according to the directions on the container, this particular Oolong tea turns light amber in color and tastes very smooth and mild with hints of fruit flavor. It does not leave a "grassy" aftertaste the way some other Oolong teas do. Oolong in general does not taste as strong as most black teas. I usually get three infusions from this tea, starting with the original brewing, the third infusion tasting a bit weaker than the first. The flavor is better than some other Oolong tea brands, such as the Oolong variety sold under the Stash label and a few others commonly sold in grocery stores. It is mild, however, and does not have the robustness and richer flavor of "Da Hong Pao" (the most famous of all Wuyi varietals). What makes this Oolong tea stand out is the fact that it is authentic Wuyi tea and organic, in addition to tasting good.
This is a convenient gift for drop in guest or just a small thank you for neighbors.  It always seems to be appreciated to give a box of this tea

Also understand it has no cheese flavor in it (though I wish it did!).  3.75 Stars.

I think that this the product I received multiple times was not organic, meaning it could contain GMOs (genetically modified organics - google has lots of info) and that could be more dangerous to my health than worth. The products I have obtained never claimed 'non-GMO' on the package. Before I learned that difference though, I will tell you that this sure tasted excellent, and the price was likewise excellent.
On another note, their rice milk product shouts 'Non-GMO' on the can. Thought it interesting to mention the discrepancy in labeling. Unfortunately I thought it tasted really strange, so onto organic liquid soy milk for me.
It's a good item to have in the pantry for a rainy day.
I got these to eat healthier. They taste great with fat-free cheese or sugar-free jam.
The product came on time. It is much runnier than I expected. It's best to use a spoon to get it out because otherwise it's a bit messy. But we do like it, it tastes very good.

I love these figs. They are moist and meaty and sweet. I ordered four bags, and in two of them some of the figs had crystallized. They were still delicious. In the other two bags, the figs were perfect.

I'm not exactly sure how to review this product... i mean... it's DOG FOOD. It's not like I ate any of it myself. My dogs ate it. They seemed to like it. But they also eat their own vomit, cat poop, and anything plastic that sits in the yard for longer than 30 minutes. Their tastes aren't very discriminating. According to the bag it's supposed to be a pretty healthy dog food for them. Of course, they eat a lot of grass and wild jack rabbits in addition to the other delectable treats previously mentioned, so I'm not too concerned about the balance of their diet.

These are like candy for our cat, who goes crazy when she hears the bag rustle (or anything that sounds like it).  If you want to give your cats treats, they will probably love these.  They are also soft enough to wrap around a pill, so if you need to give your cat medicine they are a great option.  However, I only give 4 stars because I doubt the nutritional value of treats in general and I'm concerned with the almost addicting quality of these.
The ingredients seem good quality, although nothing is recognizable in the can, like with Merrick.  It's great for mixing with kibble to moisten it and if your dog needs mush--soft wet, canned food.

I'll start off by saying that this gum has a very good flavor. The electric watermelon also mixes in with some sort of banana flavor making a perfect combo. Its a great addition to the 5 collection and would recommend this gum to anybody here who enjoys the 5 gum series. My only negative sight on this item would probably be the lasting time. Flavor only lasts about 10 min, or so then begins to fade.

ALSO: Item has only 10 pack not 12, so I had to ask for a refund of $5.00. Be Careful!
This was the perfect size and gift for a go-away.  Although the plate is permanently mounted, "Thank You" we were able to put a "Happy Travels" card in front of it.

From time to time I felt like I needed the Bija Slimming Tea. It does work to curb your appetite.  I find that I don't need it everyday but maybe several times a week.  It's not the best tasting tea so you need a good sweetener like honey or agave.

We love this easy tasty vegan mac & cheese. If you want a fat free meal all you add is soy milk. If you want a richer pasta sauce you can add a dab of earth balance margarine. We like to add peas & carrots to ours for a full meal. Products like this make it easy to stay vegan and healthy.
Very good stuff, I had a bag or two rip which kind of upset me because I wasn't rough handlign them or anything, but other then that, its great.. very good.

Are readymade gallons of tea from the supermarket better? Usually. But heavy to schlep home.

Is homebrewed tea better? Yup! But too much work most of the time.

But when you want it easy in the house, this isn't bad. Better than most Diet Tea mixes (other than those 'real tea' expensive kinds). I wouldn't say the Peach is a true flavor but good.

I'm keeping this in stock, and also mixing it with the other flavors from Lipton. By the by, I really like their Diet Raspberry.

My kids absolutely love these and will choose them over many other sugary options. They are very simple to take around and do not promote a mess. My only issue is they do not have a large amount of nutional value - I would expect more fiber and vitamins from these.

But they are certainly better than the normal choices kids have for snacks.

Is it a great product or great value? No. Did my girlfriend's parents love it anyway? Yes. It seems like a thoughtful gift since it's specific to the person receiving it. So, if there's a difficult someone on your gift list that's around 50-60 years old and has a sweet tooth, you could do worse than this box of goodies. Just make sure you know how old the recipient is. Don't want to go offending people with your gifts.

This oatmeal delivers what it promises in terms of nutrients, flavor, and ease of use. However, because I had become accustomed to eating unsweetened organic instant whole grain oatmeal (different brand), I was startled at how sweet this tasted. (Once sugar use is reduced, the re-introduction of sugar can seem startling.)

I like all the flavors without exception, and appreciated the variety. I was able to reduce the sweet effect by adding extra water. If you prefer sweetened cereal, then you'll probably end up raving about this product like many of the reviewers who preceded me.

I won't be ordering this product again, however, due to the high caloric content created by the addition of sweeteners. Oatmeal is a super wholesome food, of course. Happily, it has a delicious nutty flavor naturally, which (for me, at least) doesn't need to be drowned out by sweeteners. For added taste, any oatmeal can be flavored with cinnamon, pure organic vanilla, organic fruit, etc. That's how I prefer to eat it.

BTW, unsweetened organic whole grain instant oatmeal is cheaper than this brand, also.

These fruit strips are delicious but expensive. I love fruit strips as a low-calorie snack for my sweet tooth cravings. I buy Stretch Island for my usual snack because I like the flavor & price, but these definitely are more tasty and they have a lot more Vitamin C. However, they are a LOT more expensive - 10 per box - so they are an occasional treat.

I'M NOT A CANNED PASTA PERSON BUT THERE IS A HUGE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE GENERIC CANNED SAUCE AND THIS PRODUCT.  I BUY IT FOR MY ELDERLY MOTHER AND GAVE IT THE TASTE TEST. AND I PERSONALLY LIKE THE ITALIAN SAUSAGE STUFFED BETTER THAN THE BEEF. I LIKE NOT HAVING TO CARRY THE BAG OF CANS IN FROM THE STORE. HAVING IT DELIVERED IS VERY HANDY AND MUCH EASIER TO PUT AWAY IN THE CUPBOARD.

These graham crackers shine as an organic-ish product: natural ingredients, sustainable packaging & production, etc. As for the taste, they are good but not great. And I REALLY wanted to love these crackers. The oatmeal pieces are a nice touch on the crackers, but they fall away quickly. Unlike most graham crackers I've eaten in my life, these are on the drier side and will leave you begging for some coffee or milk. I don't know what's missing? Maybe a little more honey or whatever else it is that makes graham crackers moist would do the trick.

Overall, I don't know that I'd go out of my way to buy these but if I had to choose between others on the shelf this would probably win in a holistic sense. Others will surely disagree, but I give them the nod of approval.

In this economy, I'm glad I found something that tastes good and fills you up for a low price. Maybe when the economy improves I'll be able to afford the diced kind i gravy. I think it would taste even better. It easy open can makes it perfect for snacks on the go, and easy lunch at work. What a great product!

OK I was just joking, but seriously though.

My cats love this stuff! My older cat who is about 15 years old begs for this every morning like clockwork. He knows my schedule and will meow at the shower knowing it's time for his canned food the minute I get out. I can only assume it must be good since it appears to be the highlight of my cat's day.

I'm very careful about what food I give my cats after the issue with the contaminated off-brand food almost killed one of my cats several years ago. I could buy cheaper cat food, but it's not worth the gamble.

My cat's like it, and it's reasonably priced here on Amazon.

These have a very mild flavor, like pine nuts. I add them to salads for a tasty "pop" instead of sunflower seeds. I like the little squirrel cracking a nut with a mallet on the package label... that means freshness!

The dill itself is very good, fresh, green and pure. Already minced to tiny pieces powder like level. I just transferred some of it to a large spice shaker. 16 oz is a huge quantity..... will have to find people to share it with otherwise 16 oz will last a very long time.
I folded the original bag to take the air out and resealed it with a tape and then placed it in a zip bag. Hope it will last fresh for a long time. Compare to $4-5 for small containers at supermarkets or Sam's club it is a super cheap price and you can use the Amazon free shipping. Wish they would ship it in a few smaller packages instad of one large one to keep it fresher for the long run.
I find the Kona blend coffee by Boyer's to be flavorful without the bitter after taste.  We use it daily.

Around the four minute mark of "Evilspeak", I definitely realized this wasn't the tame television version I remember seeing as a teenager. This is the uncut, unrated and more graphic version with plenty of gore. Anchor Bay studios have remastered "Evilspeak" to it's original 1.77:1 aspect ratio with crisp and clean dolby 2.0 sound. The video transfer is really impressive and worth the money if you're a fan of this movie. After discovering a book of the occult, Stanley begins to translate the writings on his computer and he summons a powerful and evil force to help him get his revenge. Stanley's fellow classmates and teachers at the military academy have pushed him around for to long and now they'll pay the ultimate price.

This movie does have some slow spots, but horror fans will appreciate the gore and carnage left behind as Stanley exacts his revenge on his tormentors in gruesome fashion. In my opinion, the ending in "Carrie" has nothing on this movie. This movie contains graphic violence, nudity and gore and in my opinion it isn't suitable for children. Evilspeak is a bare bones DVD release but does contain commentary with director Eric Weston and Clint Howard, plus the original theatrical trailer. Clint Howard may not be in the same league as his famous brother Ron Howard as an actor, but he's great when it comes to playing a creepy weirdo.

DVD Features:
* Widescreen presentation (1.77:1) enhanced for 16 x 9 TVs
* Audio commentary with writer, producer, director Eric Weston and star Clint Howard
* Theatrical trailer
* Poster and still gallery

All I can say is my dog LOVES these. He'll do anything to get one of these. I do use them as an actual treat so even if they contain a little sugar etc. what's the difference between that and a Snickers bar for me? All things in moderation people. Don't use them as dog food.

I bought this before I gave birth in hopes of going into labor a week or so early, but still at what's considered full term. I drank about a pitcher a day for a week, and then my water ended up breaking about 12 days before my due date. So does it work in aiding an early birth? I don't know, but the taste is okay so I guess it didn't hurt anything either way.

It is just like a k-cup...no ground left in the bottom of my coffee.  Makes a strong, hot cup of Joe.  The cup melts to the shape of your coffee maker.  It works wonderfully, but when i did the math for saving a few bucks...the whole reason i went looking for an alternative...it is just about the same as buying the prepackaged cups (i try to buy the K-cups around $28), except you can choose your own coffee and YOU have to measure it out.  Now i have not used all 50 cups yet so i will see if some of my coffee is left over and then it might be a little cheaper. The breakdown... $18 dollars for the disposable cups (shipping included), and $10 for my favorite coffee + time to fill the cups + environmentally wasteful = We need a better solution.  The reusable filters received mixed reviews, but i might give it a shot.

What's not to love? It's popcorn. Who could give it a bad review?

It pops. You eat it. It's tasty. That's worth 4-stars.

Things to watch out for - if the packets get cold, the oil/seasoning will solidify, making it more difficult to extract. But, if you've ever squeezed toothpaste out of a tube, you'll be fine.

The kernels mostly all popped. It smells great. It's inexpensive <---why I really bought it. So get some. You might get fat, but you won't be disappointed.

Overall, I'd give the noodles themself 5 stars. Super easy and quick to make, and healthier than that cheap junk. This ramen says "I'm not a starving college student anymore, and dammit I still love instant ramen". Or something like that. Anyway... I am withholding one star due to the seasoning packet, that quite frankly,  isn't that great, and very bland. I find that a healthy amount of black pepper, red chili flake, and a few drops of your favorite hot sauce and you're in business.
Even though my dog chewed off the rubber rope, he still loves it. Great toy.

I was really skeptical about this thing, but desperate to control a late summer flea problem. It works! The light bulb burned out after about 2 weeks, but they are easily replaced with bulbs for night lights. We even caught a spider. By itself, I wouldn't count on it to rid you of fleas, but combined with other approaches (spray, flea comb, etc.) I think it helped. Thankfully we are now flea free.

This soup is very good.  It's easy to fix--just add water--and olive oil if you want.  It's done cooking in 30 minutes.  What could be easier.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that the soup seemed a little thin compared to the home made bean soups I make.  The flavor is really good, however.  I might add a can of red beans to the mixture next time to give it more body.

My 2 Minature Schnauzers are 3yrs old and picky eaters. They were occassionaly spoiled by me adding chicken breast or turkey to their dry food. They eventually got bored of the Fromm Surf & Turf but for the first month loved to eat it. Yes, it's more expensive than the other dry foods but the ingredients used helped my prevent break-outs that one of my dogs were experiencing from allergies. I switched them to the Blue Buffalo Wilderness and it has higher protein and Omega fatty acids. The dogs enjoyed the change in food but it gave them both gas and one of them had diarrhea. I like the ingredients of the Blue Buffalo but according to my vet some owners are complaining about the same effects on their dogs because it's very rich. I'm remaining with the Fromm simply because of the quality and it's grain less so it helps my dog with allergies.

First - if you've never tried Knorr's hollandaise sauce - this is decent stuff. It's nothing like you'd get if you successfully made it from scratch yourself or if you got it at a fine restaurant in tablespoon quantities but it's comparable to what you'd get at a diner where they serve you oodles of the stuff. My guess is that this is what they use to make that. As such it's definitely a reasonable solution to attempting to get it just right from scratch.

Second - I had no idea how much there would be in this package, I just didn't do the math... each can is about the size of a large coffee can.

You can mix it at any level of "fat" that you like - use skim milk and less butter or use whole milk and lots of butter, you control how high fat you want it to be.

I could see buying this amount for a special large family gathering where you are serving a home cooked meal, maybe a group trip to the cabin or the beach, etc. The advantage to this container if you only want a little is that unlike the little packets you get this you can make as little as you choose at a time without having an open packet gathering dust in your spice cabinet.

I've been eating KIND bars for a couple of years.  They are a truly healthy alternative to the many so-called health & energy bars that have flooded the market in the last decade.  KIND is also a socially conscious company which donates portions of its proceeds to worthy causes.  They've now added cereals to their line of bars.  I tried the Cinnamon Oat Clusters with Flax Seeds.  It was tasty & satisfying.  It was tasty with milk, or on yogurt (Greek in my case), or as a stand alone snack.  However, the portion sizes listed on all food products are ridiculous & don't reflect real life.  At least not the life I know.  However, even doubling the portion size the result will still be a filling meal which is low in calories, high in protein, low in sodium, low in sugar, with 0 sat. fat & 0 trans fat.  That the package is just 11 oz. in size is one of my major complaints.  This is a healthy alternative to many of the granolas which are on the market.

I love the Starbucks iced green tea latte. So when I found this, I was extatic. The power is great, tastes great too, just like I bought it from Starbucks. The only thing is that it does not mix well with a spoon when you put it in milk. I use a blender and that works great.
we like these spicy pretzels, but if you are real pretzel lover, they are not quite the same. For me, at 7carbs, they are nice treat to have once in a while.
I am very happy with the quality of these peppercorns and it was a good buy....much better than what I can get at the co-op.

Hotter than I expected.  Not much pepper flavor but great for adding heat to anything.  A nice fine powder if you want to sprinkle on popcorn.  Jar doesn't say what type of peppers they are unfortunately but that is o.k. for me.  The jar is larger than I expected but 4 ounces is 4 ounces.
My dog really loves the Stella and Chewy's freeze dried dog food. The lamb patties are a little harder to break apart than the other flavors.

For the past years I used a different brand of tapioca but the process is long and tedious. My surprise is that Cook & Serve is much much faster and the taste is quite good. It can be eaten hot or cold.
Actually I like it cold and cover it with canned peaches. Cinnamon or bananas are good too.

I have tried a few of the Zevias and this orange one is really pretty good and refreshing if you don't want to give up your sodas because of all the unhealthy things in them, especially aspartame and high fructose corn syrup.  This one is sweetened with stevia.  Highly recommended!

It's so hard to adjust from putting Splenda and Hershey's syrup in my morning coffee, but this is a good alternative.  Like the Sweetleaf brand which is a little more costly, it's taking awhile to get the balance between enough chocolate flavor and too much sweetness from the stevia.  Still, it's more healthy than what I was using prior to this, so 4 stars from me.

I love these chips, which is why I bought them, to stock up for the entire school year. The chips taste great, and packages were all sealed and in good condition when the arrived. The box on the other hand was in tatters, with holes and complely squished... I don't know if that was a result of customs or the voyage, but to receive it was a bit disgruntling given it was falling apart. Luckily, there were no victims within. All the chips are as they should be.

So I didn't know what to expect when trying this product... I suppose I thought I'd detect a slightly off or metallic taste, with all the electrolytes added, but I did not.

Though the product advertises itself as "silky smooth" I don't think I'd describe it that way. It tasted fine, but not "better" than water, and not any worse.

If you really are struggling to find water that has some of these characteristics, then I'd give it a try. Me, I'm going to stick with filtered water, because I really couldn't tell the difference.

Purchased for the boyfriend and he says it is very, very good. The beans have a nice sheen to them and are a bit larger. He likes the re-sealable cans and will re-use them. These really make great gifts and I highly recommend them for your coffee snob friends. You won't be disappointed!

Great stuff.  Stumbled across this in France in September 2011.  Pretty tasty especially on a cold or rainy day.  If you can get past the racially insensitive packaging you'll find a nice hot chocolate.

These are the best-tasting, best-crunching GF crackers ever made. Before celiac (BC) whenever I was not feeling well, I would pull out the saltines. These aren't as salty, thank goodness, but they are like soul food to me now. Two problems: too often several crackers in a box are shattered. To minimize this, I cut the cellophane packets very carefully with scissors, once across the top, then down each side. But still there are some that were cracked before I got them. Second problem is that they need to be scored across the middle so you could have a "daintier" and neater serving.

When a restaurant proudly brings me their gluten free crackers, I shudder. They are pure cardboard. Once I took some of these in with me in my big purse. I enjoyed happy hour much better.
Awesome cookies . Great snack to have in the cupboard when you want something quick and sweet. The quality is amazing , worth every penny and then some.

These are really great to have on hand to just grab and take with you if you are on the go.  My 1 year old loves these.  He has also just learned how to drink from a straw and just hold this in his mouth and sucks most of it out(you have to help with the last little bit).  The taste isnt too bad(Had to try it out for myself).  You get a mix of fruit and vegetable in one serving which is really great.  My only problem is that they seem to be a little pricey for the size but they are convenient.

The product itself is very good.  I prefer it to many other brands I have tried: it has more true chicken flavor and doesn't taste articial like the other brands.  The service, on the other hand, leaves something to be desired.  The product was advertised and priced as a 3-pack, but only one was shipped.  Hard to figure out what went wrong.  I have to say that once I got through Amazon's convoluted process for talking with a live representative(Why doesn't Amazon want to make it easy for its customers to talk to a live person?  What do they have to hide?), they were quick enough to provide a prorated rebate for the unshipped items.
I really does not taste any different than sugar. It is like brown sugar and I put into a glass container, it stays fresh.

I am not usually a fan of green vegetables, personally. In fact, it is a joke around our house that I will not eat anything green. I tried this product first, myself, before feeding it to a friend's little one. It actually tastes great! No sugar, all organic, lots of vitamins and babies like it too!

My only complaint is with the cap.....it's small enough to be swallowed, so pay attention when feeding. Maybe the company will find a way to keep the cap attacned to the package, by a tab or something, to make it safer.

Tastes good, good for you both. Can't ask for more than that

I'm all for trying out alternative noodle products that aren't made out of wheat. So this brown rice vermicelli seemed to be right up my alley. It boasted all natural ingredients, gluten free, fat free, and cholesterol free attributes, so it was a healthy option too. And the fact that there is only three ingredients in the product is a huge plus too. The package says it only contains Brown Rice, Sago Starch, and water. Pretty simple, and I like that.

The package it came in was pretty attractive, I do have to say. A nicely designed bag with some marvelous looking food on the front and it clearly stated what was in the package. There was a clear window in the back where you could see the actual product as well, so you're not buying blindly. And they even included two simple recipes on the back along with the nutritional information. What surprised me most was just how thin this vermicelli was. Very tiny noodles and they were looped together like a giant thing of thread. And thread size is actually a good comparison for it. It was colored a very pale brown, which accounts for being made out of brown rice.

Cooking was easy enough. I tossed it into a pot of boiled water and within minutes it was done. But due to the very thin nature of the noodle I would advise watching it carefully or you could end up with a goopy mess if it overcooks. The taste was good, a bit plain but it carried the sauce I made (a cheese base) well and let the sauce shine through instead of the noodle. It was very soft to bite into, but as said before about the over cooking, that was probably a result of my skills and not the actual product.

I would probably get these noodles again. I like that they have few ingredients and are healthy, and I can have some gluten intolerant people over for dinner. Not a bad deal all around.

Review by M. Reynard 2012

I like this coffee, but I prefer the Community Breakfast Blend over this one.  This one is strong coffee and much better than Seattle's Best coffee that I bought when I ran out of the Community coffee.  I really like this brand and this coffee.  I will keep buying this brand.

Hi, I was pleasantly surprised.  There is not alot of shrimp in the stuffing but we did find some.  Texture of the sole was very good and no small bones.  Good stuffing, not overly spicy.  Tasty fish.  I liked it better than what I get in the restaurants.  Buy it when it's on sale.

I purchased this organic yogurt snack for my daughter.she said the snack melt in her mouth quickly ,the different flavor tastes different, she likes the mixed berry most.
The only concern is the sugar content is still a bit high ,so I try to limit the amount I give her when on the go ,at the playground ,recommend other moms to try.

I love this cereal. It has just the right amount of raisons and oaty flavor. My local store stopped carrying this so I've had to turn to Amazon to deliver to me. I do wish the boxes were a bit bigger (as I go through cereal pretty quickly).

Great worms and a great value for money. A bit on the sour side, as the sour will overpower the flavor of the worms, which are quite enjoyably flavored, so I took one star off. I have been pleased with other albanese products as well

Samsclub sell this like $10, much better price, this is great for office use, when you want something quick without need of microwave.  Wish it has napkins, it does has folk, couple piece of craker, the tuna salad itself is delicious, try to eat like 2 of them same time, it has has some fat on it.

I was happy to see this at Amazon-- it was at my local grocer, but only in July! It is a nice flavor, and I have been known to...ahem... "substitute" a bit of vodka for for the water!

Kinda nice to have on hand for those who may NOT drink, yet still enjoy a festive looking cocktail. Really fun! I like it!

So far, I have thoroughly enjoyed all of the teas in the "zinger" series.  I like Celestial Seasonings in general.  Of course, the tea bags have no strings and that is something of an annoyance, but other than that, the teas are tasty and enjoyable.  Zinger really is a great description of the product.  It has a surprising and deeply flavorful taste and an aroma to match.  It is a great option for those who enjoy herbal teas.

Bought these after reading the reviews. They are tasty (a little strange at first but they really grow on you). One nice thing is that for me, I can eat them as a chip alternative but I don't eat too many. About 10-15 crisps and I'm done. I have also used them in salads.

I bought a case here and I don't think I'll do that again. I've seen them at my grocery store and I'll buy a bag now and then. For now I have a big box full in the closet. I think it will take a while to get through them.

Buffalo Bills 8oz Spicy Beef Jerky

I ordered Buffalo Bills 8oz of Buffalo Bills 8oz Teriyaki Country Cut Beef Jerky Packand got a free sample of Buffalo Bills 8oz Spicy Beef Jerky with it.

If you like jerky it doesn't get much better than this; at least I haven't eaten it. I prefer the Teriyaki and the Bar-B-que to the Spicy, but it is all good.

Gunner March, 2010

Amazon is always a reliable source for my tea, no matter where I am in the world. I just wish I could get it shipped directly instead of through a third party.  Still, it's nice to have this option to get my tea.

I was able to try my quaker bar complimentary through Influenster, and was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it was. It was soft and flavorful! I did not try it hot, but I ended up buying a box and my friend heated it up and said it was even better. These bread bars are a perfect breakfast treat, I definitely recommend them!

I got a very nice assortment, but I suppose that may attributable to luck considering all the other negative reviews. I purchased two variety packs the other being Crazy Cups Travel The World Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 35) and the variety of that one was awful, providing more evidence your selection will come down to luck. I will say that three of the K-cups didn't seem to have the seal pressure of the others, leading me to believe that the may have been punctured. This is concerning in itself and certainly could affect the freshness. All in all, I would suggest that if you are picking this sampler because of specific coffees listed, don't; you'll likely be disappointed. If you just want to try some different K-cups go for it.
Okay, here is the best way to cook this stuff.  Get some Nutritional Yeast or Brewer's Yeast.  Coat the Fri-Chik in the yeast and fry.  Mmmmmm  Mmmmmmmm  Good!

This tastes nothing like a slim jim to me so for those that claim it does, either they haven't had one in a long while or their mind is tricking them. Most of my friends get a whiff of it before they try it and turn it down. I'm Asian and trust me half of our food doesn't look tasty or smell good, but is often very good. I love these sticks. I will admit they are probably going to be an acquired taste for some. I've only bought the natural from amazon. I tried some of the other flavors and found them a poor product. Their additional flavors were in harsh contrast to the natural flavor of the ostrich meat so I can see how some would see it as a turn off. My personal opinion though.

Like a few other said, I don't like the inconsistency. Sometimes the quality is good, sometimes not. I'm wondering if there are dips in the ostrich meat market where they have to sometimes use meat they normally wouldn't. Or if they were left in bad conditions too long during transport. If the saltiness and dryness were consistent each time, I'd be much happier.

I discovered the Twinings English Classic Cold Brewed Tea in tea bags last summer and liked it for making sun tea. I could not find it in my grocery stores this year, so ordered it through Amazon. My order was delivered promptly, and my only complaint is that I could only get it in a 6 box bundle - in other words 120 tea bags. I won't need to be recordering for a few years, lol!

Some reviewers have complained that it isn't completely "natural" tea, and that the Twinings brand has deteriorated from "the good old days" but I guess I am not that much of a tea snob. It has the English Breakfast tea taste I like and brews up nice and dark as sun tea. It tastes a lot better than Lipton or any of the store brands. I let it sit in the sun all day (gets quite hot actually), and then put it in the refrigerator to drink cold, no sugar.

These 'ramen-like' noodles will be a tasty addition to anyone's lunch repertoire - providing of course you have a microwave handy at the office\shop.  The 'Spicy Chicken Flavor' lives up to it's name.  These noodles bite back!  :)  ((But nothing too bad))  I have a love of all things spicy -- but I found these to be somewhere in the low to middle range of heat\spice.  Each bowl contains 2 servings - bringing the total calorie count to 380 per bowl (Total Fat = 7g, Cholesterol = 0mg, Sodium = 890mg, Total Carb = 28g, Protein = 4g).  The package is used as the bowl.  You peel back the lid, and add room temperature water to the easily seen line - then microwave for 3 min.  Or you add hot water and wait 3 minutes.  There were a few small chunks of chicken - ideally I would want more.  The packaging indicates it has 30% less sodium - but at 890mg of sodium I would hate to see that extra 30% back.

I picked this for when I wanted a break from the harsher anti-dandruff shampoo I normally use. Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo gets my hair clean with just one wash and I didn't need to use a lot of product to get a good lather. It leaves my hair soft and shiny and best of all it didn't dry out my scalp like many other non-dandruff shampoos have over the years. The scent is light and not so feminine that a guy like myself can't use it. It smells fresh and clean not heavily perfumed. This is another product I'll be sticking with. It works great.

I always look to amazon to save me some money. This is a good quality product for a price below the grocery stores (even better than most sale prices) I can't say the flavor is better than homemade seasoning or some gourmet products out there, but it tastes right for the price and is convenient enough to make for a quick dinner. I will buy again as long as the price stays the same ($10.91 when I purchased with Subscribe and Save)

Oh goodness this is so delicious if you like these flavors and love kool-aid! I can't believe there are no calories in this and I love the fact it can fit into my purse to take with me when I need a little sweetness in my spring water. I am not one who likes water so this is a great alternative to buying sugar-laden, or nasty sugar-free energy drinks. The flavor is strong or weak depending on how much you use in your water. I like it fairly sweet so 2 semi-long squirts is just right. It's kinda addicting since it reminds me of drinking kool-aid! The only reason I give it 4 out of 5 stars is the price, I can not believe what they charge for this considering it is not an energy, vitamin enhancer, or health increasing kind of drink. Just some yummy flavor to perk up your water now and then : )

MY DAUGHTER AND I LOVE THIS COFFEE.  WE HAVE ORDERED DIRECTLY ALONG WITH OTHER COFFEES.  THIS IS STILL OUR FAVORITE.  SO MUCH CHEAPER THAN STORE COFFEE BUT SO MUCH BETTER.  WE'VE BEEN DRINKING THIS FOR A YEAR OR TWO AND KEEP GOING BACK FOR MORE.  I GIVE IT A 4 STAR ONLY BECAUSE I CANNOT GIVE IT A 4.5!

I've ordered several times from this company and I am 100% satisfied with the product and service. I only gave this a 4 star because I actually liked the regular Wulong better than the Sechung Wulong. The Sechung seemed to be a little more bitter. I wouldn't claim to be a connoisseur of teas and drinking Wulong has not caused me to lose any weight. I put about 1/2+ cup of leaves in a coffee filter and brew it like coffee. I usually dump the first pot (I read this gets rid of any caffeine) and then brew another. I save the leaves in the fridge and can easily make 3-4 more pots of tea without losing flavor. It just seems to keep on giving! I pour it over a cup of ice and that's what I drink all day long at work. I am also surprised to find the prices are quite a bit cheaper on Amazon and when you factor in the free shipping...I have been ordering directly through the website and just saved myself $10 ordering through Amazon. I don't know how they seem to have such a great product at such a low price but I hope they continue because I am a happy returning customer.

I have constant mild dandruff and this shampoo kept it at bay as efficiently as Head and Shoulders, which is the brand I normally use. This lathers up nicely, requiring a small amount for a lot of hair. In other words, the first couple times I used this product, I got more than I needed because I'm used to the set amount of H and S that I need. This is nice because this makes the bottle last longer. The smell is not overly powerful and my hair felt clean for over 24 hours. I would purchase this item for continual dandruff control and I like how it cleans my hair as well. Recommended.

The Switch in Kiwi Berry is quite tasty- it's very berry but not quite kiwi...The kiwi is very subdued, seems like it enhances the tartness of the berry but doesn't quite warrant "kiwi" in the flavor title....

The Switch is a good replacement for traditional sugar/corn syrup laden sodas...It is not necessarily lower in carbs, as the sweetness comes from the juices...For me, as a diabetic, I would use these instead of coke or juice boxes when treating a hypoglycemic episode... My child does not like anything "sparkling" but if I had kids who liked soda, I would probably try to move them over to something like this (actually, probably to water or sparkling water with a splash of juice) for special occasions...

The flavor is very sweet (even though it is "natural" from the juices) and very tasty... The carbonation is light and sparkling- the flavor and carbonation reminded me of Martinelli's Sparkling Apple Cider, but a little more fun...

It tastes great. I use it for everything that I may use sugar for.

However, bottles have repeatedly arrived with the seal broken and the honey spilled into the cap. Of the 6-pack, about 3 seals are usually broken.

My proposed solution to the seller: Don't fill the bottles all the way to the top and provide expandable volume for expansion due to heat -- which is inevitable. You can't fight physics.

This is a very reasonable vegan nutritional bar that I have been trying out as a breakfast item. It has a nice filling taste and the raisins are not overpowering or dominating the taste which was my main worry when I first saw it.

It comes in a cardboard box with 12 individually wrapped bars. If you like to reuse-before-recycle as much as possible, you can easily reuse the box to store other items after you finish the included bars.

Nutrition-wise, according to the nutrition facts on the box, one bar has 200 calories, with 12g of fat (2g saturated), no cholesterol, 230mg sodium, 260mg potassium, 18g carbs (5g fiber, 8g sugars), 7g protein, 6% iron and 2% calcium. The box stresses that only real natural vegan ingredients were used.

This is a sticky bar, so you may not want to eat it at a place where you can't wash your hands after.

Kashi bars are high in protein and fiber to help keep you full while dieting. They are full of good-for-you ingredients. This particular bar actually does taste like Malted Chocolate Crisp. All of the Kashi bars are very sweet including this one. Great meal replacement and sweet tooth solver! Taste is reminiscent of Whoppers candy.

My family has gotten these cherries for a couple of years now on Amazon. They are SO good. They can give you gas if you eat too many at once tho- so be aware! :)  But they are so flavorful and the deal is a breaker, better here than the home site. So fret not- buy!

I love this drink, especially when I take my diuretic.  I don't have to take potassium from the pharmacy anymore, I just drink a coconut water.  Yay!  The only down side is that it is a little on the expensive side.

I really enjoy Jelly Belly's so thought that this would be a fun thing to order. The assortment was good...lots of chocolate beans, though...All in all, a fun purchase but buying 8 pounds at one time was a bit of overkill!!!

I had tried Weruva flavors with veggies in them and my cats either wouldn't eat as much of the bowl, would eat around them or kick the peas around the room!  This one and the "paw lickin chicken" were preferred by them.  There are huge chunks of fish in here that make you feel like you're opening it for yourself.

This cereal is more chewy than it is crunchy, and therefore not much like mainstream granola cereals. The taste isn't quite what I expected - again, not much like regular granola, but it is good. I would have given it 3 stars for taste and texture alone, but the fact that it is gluten free and high in fiber earned it an extra star!
these are the best dried mangoes out there.  I have tried many, some are way too sweet.  I have a sweet tooth, but look for a good balance of flavor and sweetness.  These are the best ones out there.
Decent substitute for cavity prone sweets ,but sticks tend to dissolve with saliva !~ needs to  be improved for customer satisfaction ~

These have a very good texture when compared to most gluten free crackers. The taste is distinctive and makes a good snack even if you don't add spread. If you want a bland cracker, this is not it.

I was tired of spending $$ everyday for my morning coffee at work. I found Bustelo Mexican Blend at a local Hispanic Supermarket and was pleasantly surprised. It is much better than Starbuck's instant and Bustelo's is a fraction of the price.

For those with smaller dogs (I have a Yorkie and a teacup Yorkie), you really need to cut some of the pieces up a bit smaller, as they can be pretty large and my teacup has a hard time getting them into her mouth.  My other two large dogs have no problem and just scarf it on down!
These Cappuccino cups were waaaayyy too sweet for me, but I rated them with 4 stars because they were delivered quickly and my boyfriend loves them I figured he would be the one drinking them anyway

I will admit that it is more subtle than regular ice cream, but I kind of expected it since there are no egg yolks/fats to intensify the flavor.

Arctic Zero is a good brand to try if you're satisfied with mediocre ice cream and want to pay a hefty price. However, I do admit that it is a good alternative if you're watching calories.

This is another example in this line of pleasant warm-drink mixes from Maxwell House. It is smooth and rich and good-tasting. You have to put rather a lot of it in the cup, and it is quite high in calories, but that is sometimes a price worth paying for something which tastes good. In any case, it is not something one would want to have every day; more for when one deserves a bit of a treat.

The owner of a small kitchen gadget shop insisted that I buy one of his jars of Borsari. I thought he was blowing smoke to move product. But he is from India, so I figured he might know a thing or two about spice. Well, he was right to be so passionate and insistent. This is amazing stuff. I'm a burger expert, and have lately been musing over ways to spice up burger projects; without overwhelming the natural ground beef taste or grilled smokiness. This does the trick in spades. Big thrill. Previously I'd used kosher salt and fresh ground pepper, which is logical and traditional. This Borsari salt maintains that logic but ads a touch of magic.

This would get five stars, but, not to sound silly, does it really need kosher AND sea salt? A bit less of either would make it less salty, so the other flavors could come through just a tad more.

I thought these were good.  They are not as good as homemade, but I didn't expect them to be.  I haven't had the other canned brands to compare them with, but I was surprised at how good they actually were.  It's true they are on the mushy side, possibly because they are sitting in oil, I assume to keep from drying out.  And some of the leaves were torn, but none were falling apart and I had no trouble getting them out of the can intact.  They were wrapped very tightly.  The directions say to drain the oil, and that's good advice.  They tasted even better after doing that and refrigerating them.  They have a lemony taste, but not too strong.  Couldn't even taste the mint.  They use sunflower oil, which I don't think is as good as olive oil, but most of the canned stuffed grape leaves seem to do the same, probably because it's cheaper.  The recipe I prefer has a lot of dill and onions and lemon and uses extra-virgin olive oil (a Greek recipe), and the Roland  has no dill.  But for the price I thought these were definitely worth buying.  I certainly won't have a problem eating them in a few days.  I've never frozen grape leaves before, but I don't see why it couldn't be done.  I doubt these are the best canned stuffed grape leaves out there (the Al-Wadi and Divina have better ratings), but they are good enough for me, especially for the price.  And they are vegetarian.

This coffee is really good. I know that true coffee snobs do not like dark coffee, preferring to savor the flavor of the beans, without the toasty flavor getting in the way. However, I do like a bold coffee, and this is a good one. Really nice, bold, rich flavor without hardly any acidity. And, for the price (especially the subscribe & save price) it can't be beat.

I have been drinking this tea for some time. I happen to like Chamomile teas they are very a mild, I do not like teas that are to strong. One bag is enough or me I can put it in a cup of hot water and leave the bag in without worrying if it was to get too strong like other teas do. Adding just a little raw honey enhances the flavor also.
I enjoy this tea before I go to bed and it has a very soothing and the warmth of the liquid allows me to slip into a nice sleep.

I like the convenience of a foil package, I can carry one or two with me when I go out to lunch with friends, I just order a cup of hot water and slip this tea into it.
I have on occasion I have put this is a cup with some fresh ginger and it makes a totally different tea, and he ginger helps sooth the tummy while the Chamomile tends to relax you.

I must say I was somewhat skeptical about the MIO liquid peach tea at first. But, after trying it out for over two weeks, I actually really like the way it makes water tasty to drink.

First off its very concentrated and a little really does go a long way. You really just need a few drops and one bottle will last a long time. Well after some hours on the internet looking for a truly RAW honey I stumbled on this and decided why not give it a try.
After receiving it in the mail I realized that 23oz wasn't much at all, but I guess that's the price you pay for unheated, untreated honey these days.
With my first spoonful it was quite clear that this was honey was well above par. Consistency is great, not runny but not stone hard either; texture is smooth & soft, and taste is very unique for a honey. It tastes more like candy to me then actual honey. Very sweet, mild tasting. For some this may sit well but for me I was looking for something more "earthy," more "organic."

Bottomline: An excellent honey if you are interested in something RAW, SWEET tasting, & very MILDLY aromatic, but other then that I would recommend to others.

Update: I recently picked up Stakich's Manuka Honey and I must say it's really a spectacular tasting honey, exactly the taste I was looking for, although the consistency was a bit more runny then I wanted. After trying out over six different honey types & brands this is my favorite by far.

I got interested in purchasing and caring for a bonsai after reading an article from my local bonsai society. The article pointed out that many beginners to bonsai fail to realize that these are primarily outdoor plants, requiring the same environmental conditions as their full sized counterparts. I had received a bonsai as a gift several years ago, a juniper, and, bringing it inside for the winter, I killed it. I have a nice outdoor garden, though, and, since urban gardeners don't command a lot of space, I decided that bonsai trees would be a great way for me to cultivate species that I would never otherwise have the room for.

I purchased this bonsai Chinese Elm on a whim to be a companion plant to the first bonsai I ordered: A Full Japanese Juniper Bonsai Tree in an AUTHENTIC Japanese Stoneware Container. I figured, for the price, which was only $19.99 plus a nominal shipping, I could start the bonsai hobby with two plants instead of one. Great!

The Chinese Elm arrived first, so here are my comments:

The tree arrived by USPS Priority Mail. It shipped from California on a Wednesday and arrived on my doorstep by Friday. The tree was listed by the seller has having shipped on Tuesday, however, so that set my expectation: I would recommend that the seller mark items as shipped when they are actually shipped rather than when they are processed.

The tree was packed well, with Styrofoam peanuts protecting the branches and plastic wrap containing the pot and soil. The soil was still moist, and the tree had lost only about three leaves, so no significant defoliation at all. Again, great. I found it odd that the tree was packed in a horizontal box. The tree must have spent the last few days lying down, though it seems none the worse for wear.

Upon unwrapping the base of the tree, I found a slug attached to one of the drainage holes on the pot. Ugg. The tree also appears to be newly transplanted. I noticed that you can still see where the soil has been pressed into the pot, and the tree is a bit loose in its soil, so not firmly rooted in. The tree is not wired into its pot.

It's a nice overcast day at the beginning of June, and we're getting a gentle, steady rain, so I have placed the Chinese Elm bonsai into its place in my garden. It will be displayed on a nice brownstone slab that I rescued from a neighbor's lot. I hope it likes it there and gets some good strong root development. I plan to update this review later in the summer after the tree has had a chance to acclimate.

I first heard of this product while reading an argument over Jack-in-the-Box's new bacon milkshakes.

I went to the manufacturer's website to do a little comparison shopping, and they had a tool for searching local stores to see who carries their products. After finding one, I paid a visit and came home with one jar of regular, and one of light.

The consistency is of a thick spread, not quite as gelatinous as mayo, and the consistency feels appropriate to the flavor when you eat it. The sauce has very small bits of bacon or bacon-like substance in it. It is not sweet, not particularly salty (5% RDA for one tablespoon), and has a light flavor of smoked bacon. It's pretty high in saturated fat (14% RDA for one tablespoon), but, compared to actually eating bacon, that's pretty good.

My first experiment was to try a fried egg sandwich: two slices of whole wheat, egg, Baconnaise. The egg and bread overpowered the sauce. I'll try a Baconnaise-lettuce-tomato sandwich next and post my results, but I suspect this stuff will do best as a dip for crackers or a veggie tray. If you could find a mild-tasting bread, it might also work in place of butter on toast for someone who can't eat bacon but who wants the taste.

Experiment 2: substituted Baconnaise for mayo when making tuna salad (plain, just tuna + sauce). This made an EXCELLENT tuna, lettuce & tomato sandwich.

Verdict so far: it tastes pretty good, but the only bacon in the world is... bacon!

I found this mix to be great for a pizza crust, or a crispy flat bread. The first (we use up to 11 minutes) and second baking times (8 to 12 minutes depending on the number of toppings)in a 425 degree oven will vary with your oven and your preferences.  I also found that you can actually make up to four pizza crusts out of one bag that are about nine inches in diameter. This of course depends on the number of servings that you need at one time, how thick you like the crust (we like a thin crust) and the appetites. The pre-made dough keeps very well in the refrigerator for up to 5 days and if you let the refrigerated dough rest for 30 minutes before the first baking as the directions state, you will get a very nice crispy crust with a soft bread-like center. Test your amounts. You will be surprised at how little makes a full strong pot. As the saying goes, strong enough for the church mouse to walk over. Overbrewing is not an issue, so it can make a rather good iced tea (hot, let cool to room temp, decant, refrigerate), but you can make it a bit too strong with too much tea.

Side note; this is a cut & tear leaf tea, meaning a coffee grounds like texture. You will need a mesh filter like the bodum press pot, which is great for tea. You -can- use a standard filter coffee maker. Clean the 'roof' by the water outlet and the filter cup throughly, removing all the coffee oils. Something to do regularly anyway. My name is Annelies and I work for attune foods, the manufacturer of Erewhon Crispy Brown Rice- Gluten Free cereal. Our Erewhon certified gluten free cereals are made in a peanut-free, tree-nut free and dairy-free facility. They are run on a shared line with gluten and we abide by good manufacturing practices to help ensure against cross-contamination. This consists of the machinery being sanitized and thoroughly washed down before the cereal is made. Then after it is made, the cereal is tested to ensure it is less than 20 ppm of gluten. We sent the cereal to a separate facility last fall to double check the levels at which it tested and found it to be less than 5ppm of gluten. In November of 2010, our Erewhon gluten free cereals were certified gluten free by GIG. I hope this helps clarify our current practices as I realize there are reviews dating back many years on amazon.com and thought it would be helpful to update interested consumers of it on amazon.com.

Pros: Easy to use. Plug it in, set your levels and go! Works well with Condenser Mics. Has 48v Phantom Power. Runs solely off USB (No need for a wall wart).

Cons: Very plastic. Feels like it could snap with the slightest bit of rough handling! I wouldn't try to plug it directly into a mic. Use an XLR cable. No headphone monitoring jack and quite a bit of latency when monitoring with a separate interface. I would not recommend it for Dynamic mics. I tried it with my Rode Procaster Dynamic Mic and could not get high enough levels without practically yelling into the mic. I also tried it with an old V-Tech handheld stage mic and levels were a little better, so dynamics with a higher line output might work better with it.

Overall, it does what it's supposed to, but it could be a lot better. For about $30-40 more, you can get better interfaces with 2 mic inputs, but this one is nice for situations where running off of USB power is a must.

I order a lot of coffee, and have tried many various brands. I find this particular coffee, Timothy's Breakfast Blend to be the one I like best. It is not too strong, or bitter. It is really delicious, and I look forward to my cup every morning.
The mustard is versatile, use it with anything that is mustard compatible. I was expecting it to be a little spicier; however, the taste is very pleasant.

For those who like a zesty taste and do not mind a sweet and slightly hot taste to their sauces, this sweet hot mustard is for you. I really like the taste and it gives a new life to plain old beef hotdogs. There is a great recipe for a seaside sauce which is on the side which is very good. And the mustard can be used as a marinade for ribs, beef, pork, chicken and BBQ. It can be mixed in seafood, pasta, vegetables, fish and in stir fries. Great on hot dogs or in cold salads and as a cheese dip.

It is fantastic on grilled cheese sandwiches for extra flavor and you can use it on ham biscuits (although for this particular use, I have not had an opportunity to experiment).

It is all natural, fat and gluten free with no msg. It is certified Kosher/Pareve. You can even make a bagel spread by mixing cream cheese together with diced onions and the mustard. It is manufactured by Ford's Foods, Inc in Raleigh, North Carolina. And they have a toll free number: 1-800-446-0947. It comes in a variety of sizes and you can try it out with a smaller package (also on Amazon). Bentley/2007 Bone Suckin' Sauce Sweet Hot Mustard 12 oz Jar
This is pretty good. It is slightly too sweet for me. I was shocked when I read the nutrition facts and is had no sugar! but it has sucralose instead
Excellent K-cup coffee . Robust, flavorful and almost as bold as advertised.  One of my favorites.  Worth a try

This is a great product and while my cats don't eat much of it they eat enough to maintain a healthy weight. The product I received did not have the X kibbles in the description. My cats would like it better if they were X kibbles since they find that easier to grab with their teeth and chew on. I would buy this again.

I got these because I don't usually like the grainy protein chocolate bars and these are better but high in salt.  My favorite flavor by far is bbq, it doesn't taste like bbq chips it takes like a mild slim jim.  The worst in my opinion in the teriyaki, basically because its too salty and not very sweet like you would want a teriyaki.  Original and pepper are ok but I actually look forward to eating a bbq

I have been hunting for and buying aged gouda cheese from a number of sources.  This cheese is excellent and worth buying.  Of all cheeses, aged gouda is my favorite.  I do have another source I think is slightly better (same price) but they have run out of product.
The bread is a very good tasting bread. Would like it better if it rose a little more.

I ordered San Francisco Bay Coffee Fog Chaser because of the title "fog chaser" and the price was good. We were pleasantly surprised with the make up of the k-cup.  It is not all plastic, it is made up of a fiber which means, to me, less plastic for my hot coffee to run through.  I am pleased with the product and even signed up for the automatic delivery option so we don't have to be without good coffee when we get up in the morning.

I bought this kit for my boyfriend for valentines day.  I bought an extra bag of coffee to go with it, because I don't know where to buy Turkish coffee where I live.  It came very quickly and it was packed in a box with straw and instructions.  I think it was a great gift for someone wanting to try turkish coffee.  The only problem that we found was that the ibrik is a little small (it only makes one cup at a time), so we might upgrade to a larger size.

I've been using the MIO products for approximately two years, ever since discovering them at a demonstration at my nearby Farm Fresh. The tear-shaped bottles are convenient for carrying with me in my backpack; I use them at restaurants, church, work, etc., for flavoring my water. Thanks to MIO, I've considerably decreased my intake of carbonated sodas.

I suffer from chronic sinusitis. Sodas have a strong tendency to make me congested. A few minutes after I begin consuming one, I notice that my nostrils start to feel clogged. This doesn't happen when I drink tea, coffee or the MIO liquid water enhancers. Indeed, I am living proof that MIO products are a healthier alternative to sodas.

The MIO Peach Tea liquid water enhancer reminds me of the delicious Peach Bellini Iced Tea I sometimes order at Olive Garden during the warm months. Thanks to MIO, I can enjoy this delicious flavor anytime of the year. All you need is cold water and ice. Also, I can control the taste by varying the number of drops I squirt into a bottle, tumbler, glass, etc.

MIO offers a wide assortment of liquid water enhancers and I have indulged in all of them. However, my favorite ones are the tea flavors. They are more refreshing; they are also more suitable for quenching my thirst after exercising and for drinking with my meals. Note: I haven't tried any products from the line of MIO Energy Liquid Water Enhancers.

I recommend the MIO liquid water enhancers for those who want a healthier, more economic alternative to sodas. I always carry a MIO product in my backpack inside a Ziploc bag to prevent spillage. All the other products are kept in my refrigerator. They don't need refrigeration but I believe the cold environment helps maintain freshness. In this manner, one can enjoy a wide variety of flavors at the same time without worrying too much about expiration dates.

Joseph B. Hoyos
I love gummie candy, but the bears were a little harder then I expected, but they were still good.

Compared to the Raspberry Preserves, this is much sweeter. While my son doesn't seem to mind, I rarely reach for the blueberry preserves.
Flavor is good, and it makes a good ice cream topping.

I sent this to my brother, a 37 year old consumate bachelor.  His comment was, "I don't know why they call this Hamburger Helper....I think it does just fine by itself!"  In all seriousness he liked it a lot and said kids would really like it because it's so cheesy.  He would know...

I love nestle chips, but the top of the box's bags and the bottoms were half way melted, and I couldn't find anyone in Amazon to complain to.  I really wish I could figure out where you complain to Amazon.  I know how to complain to the stores but not to Amazon itself.

The price can't be beat for gluten free. Like most GF bread - toast it before you eat it. I like the fact that it has no preservatives but has a 1 year shelf life due to the double vacuum seal technique used. Be careful about subscribe and save though! Something went funky and I ended up getting shipped 60 loaves of bread! My BF also ended up getting duplicate orders of her subscribe and save items. So keep a close eye out!

I love the Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough. Its amazing. Good product--mostly filling for something on the go. Would recommend. Package got to me in 2 days with Amazon Prime. It came in good condition. Was a little worried about melting but I haven't experienced that as being an issue.

I bought these to keep in my office for when I need lunch but can't get out of the office to get something. I'm glad I did!

It initially looks like there is not much in the package, but one packet combined with some rice makes for a great, filling lunch that tastes surprisingly authentic. As others have noted, make sure to cover the bowl if you microwave it, because chickpeas have a tendency to explode in the microwave. Ask me how I know :)

I'm very pleased with this product, and I'll probably buy more soon! And for roughly $3/pack, it's not a bad price. Certainly cheaper than going out.
I have ordered this item several times and am very pleased with it. Will order again. It is one of my favorite jack link products.

The name is not very exciting, but don't let that deter you from tyring it. It is a great cup of coffee. It is not overly strong but absolutely not weak. No bitterness and no aftertaste. It has some very subtle flavors that I can't quite identify and that makes it a unique experience. This is one of my "go to" blends and I keep more of it on hand than the other varieties.

So I was really hungry for some gummi bears, and I had heard a bunch about the Albanese brand.  I've always been a fan of gummi's, usually going for the Trolli brand, so I figured I would give them a try.  Sadly, the free shipping and good pricing was only available on 2 5 lb bags, which is an absurd amount of gummi bears.  They arrived the next day (Thanks Amazon Prime 2-day shipping!).  The gummi bears are very good, a bit larger in size than the normal haribo ones, and I think they taste a good bit better.  I usually prefer sour candies, as the standard gummi's are lacking a bit in flavor, but these certainly fit the bill.  The item gets 4 stars instead of five because the gummi's really aren't that amazing, they are simply very good.

I have a very, very, very, very, very hyper 4-yr old. He is particularly sensitive to artificial colors. Many of the "kid" drinks on the market are filled with hideously vibrant artificial colors. I needed an alternative for him.  The flavor isn't quite the same and the sweetness of this drink isn't the same type of sugary sweetness you find in the typical kid punch type drinks, but that's actually a good thing.  This tastes more like real cherry. My son loves this drink mix. I use it at less than half strength so the jar lasts even longer. The fact that it doesn't have sugar or artificial sweeteners is a plus. My son doesn't get that sugar high.  I also love to add this to water (although my favorite flavor is the strawberry while his is the cherry). This is definitely as good for adults as it is for the kids.

This is a decent balsamic glaze/reducation.

It has a faint yeasty taste that I don't care for...not so heavy to preclude using it again, but I have a different brand that I love love love, so this is just a back up.

FYI try Blaze balsamic reduction/glaze. It is superb.
The KIND Plus cranberry almond bars are healthy for you and absolutely delicious.  I think they are better if you refrigerate them prior to consuming.  Great product.

I have a small cat. He's had a number of different varieties of 3oz canned food, but he really seems to like Fancy Feast over other brands. He doesn't even leave any small bits of this food in his bowl...he licks it clean. He has a bowl of dry food always available to munch on, and he eats one 3oz can per day (half of the can early in the day, the other half in the evening). Delivery was fast, and at a good price. I've decided to get an automatic monthly delivery of this 24 pack to simplify things.

Yogi Tea has introduced a winner in Egyptian Licorice Mint.  It's the perfect after dinner herbal tea.  It doesn't have a strong licorice or mint flavor, but instead a delightful synthesis.  I feel like it's easy on my tummy and doesn't need food to complement it.  What more could you ask for?

I had visions of "Chia Pets" when ordering these, but based on reported nutritional value, we got some anyway.

While there is little taste - particularly in smoothies for example, the texture does exactly what the product packaging says it will do - thicken up fairly rapidly.

I don't know what else can be said about this product, other than it is a particularly great smoothie ingredient. There are other possible uses, and they seem very reasonable now that we've actually used the chia seeds, we just happen to prefer to use it with smoothies.

The one negative is the price - nearly $10.00 per pound seems a bit steep, even for organic seeds. Still, a little goes a long way.

The product tastes great. It tastes like higher end bottled water. One reviewer called the taste "silky" and I can't think of a better description for it. It goes down smooth, that's for sure.

I'm unsure about certain aspects of this water. On the one hand, I wish I would have had some during the times my youngest suffered from acid reflux or when anyone in the household suffered from an upset stomach. On the other, I'm concerned that drinking too much of it will cause an imbalance with stomach acids, causing further digestion problems.

I do think this is an excellent product overall for those who need it. For me, I'm probably going to keep a bottle or two on hand for upset stomachs. I don't think I will be drinking it daily or replacing my current water-of-choice with it.

We love this cereal and found that the value offered by Amazon's Subscribe and Save deal was great. Only problem is that quality may be hit or miss - one out of the three boxes we received was stale and tasted pretty bad.

This is a combination of 2 of the best sweeteners that are safe and do not raise blood sugar at all. I highly recommend it.

As some of you may know, most sugar alcohols that end in -ol will produce gastric upset. Erythritol has not upset me at all, even at higher consumption!

It has no awful aftertaste, either. Stevia on its own without mixing has an awful aftertaste. By mixing stevia and erythritol, the aftertaste is eliminated!

There are two unique tastes, though, that occur with z-sweet:

1) a slightly cooling sensation-- not a taste, but a cooling. If you have had any of the other sugar alcohols, you will recognize it. It is often used in sugar free breath mints.

2) a very minor peppery taste. I rather like it!

I think this is the safest and the very best tasting natural sugar substitute out there. I have made a carrot cake and cream cheese frosting using it, and it was delicious! I intend to use it for more baking and frosting.

Don't expect this to taste EXACTLY like peanut butter because it doesn't.  However, it still is pretty tasty.  It's great if you're dieting to add a little extra flavor to something (I usually have some with a banana or sprinkle a little on my cheerios).  The company's website has several recipes which is nice too.

FYI: In the package, you get two each of: Bananas and Strawberries, Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal, Tender Chicken and Stars, and Vegetable Beef Pilaf. Good value, though I wish they came in packs of 12 like the 1st and 2nd stage foods do.
Received these in my Influenster box for Summer, taste great and very soft. Seemed to be a healthy alternative to regular cookies just concerned as to how much they will cost.

When diagnosed with Celiac Disease in August, 2010, I had no idea what to do. Tried and true method is to buy expensive gluten free products. I have eliminated this trial by error to Quinoa products, I have found them to be the best so far. Red Mill Rolled Oats are very good. Udi's white sandwich bread is the best so far, makes a really good grilled cheese and toast.

I am doing a lot of home cooking, using Pantry flour, it is great. Gluten free Bisquick is great. I have been released from the specialist as he understands that I am being extremely careful and adjusting to my life changing diet.

I am going to try Udi's hamburger buns next. The shipping fee makes Udi's a very expensive purchase. Help!!!!

Sincerely,

Frances C. Cann

When they say smokey, they mean SMOKEY!  I'm used to meat sticks that are more like pepperoni These are not like that.  The smoke flavor is very strong. At first I wasn't sure I liked them but they are growing on me.

As most of you probably are, I was a bit skeptical while placing my order for this Wheat Grass Powder. Instant wheat grass sounds both unappetizing and not especially nutritional. Well, as is my nature, I did needless amounts of research on the effectiveness of powdered wheat grass, and found several articles with very mixed answers, so I decided to give it a shot and decide for myself.

My first impression was that this stuff was disgusting. While fresh wheat grass bought at a health store smells like a freshly cut golf course, this stuff smells like a barn. I held my breath and mixed the recommended amount of the dark green powder with a glass of ice water and chugged. I couldn't get 1/4 way through with the mixture before I gagged and decided I would never drink the stuff with water again. The label recommends drinking it with a juice, particularly orange juice, so that's what I did the second time around. If you mix it with a strong enough flavored juice, it is actually quite enjoyable. The nasty taste is barely detectable, and all you are left to put up with is the smell. Currently my favorite juices to mix it with are stronger flavored juices mixed with multiple types of fruits - anything with grapefruit juice works great. On to the effects.

When I down a shot of fresh wheat grass, I get a small boost of energy - but most importantly I maintain a healthy up-beat feeling throughout the day. The result is more of a lack of fatigue than an elevation in energy. With this powdered wheat grass, I get the same effect, simply on a lesser scale. The initial boost of energy is barely noticeable, but I am able to maintain that same "healthy feeling" that I get with the fresh wheat grass. And the nutritional value is all there: both the vitamins and chlorophyll (see table below). The final test, which I plan on conducting: The Hangover Test. A shot of wheat grass will get me out of that half-asleep feeling I get after a night of heavy South Florida binge drinking, so it is only natural that I test the effects of the powdered wheat grass on a hangover. While I am tempted to drink solely for the sake of this review, for now I must wait - I will update with results asap.

Nutritional comparison of generic wheat grass powder to fresh wheat grass. (Please note that these numbers are not the same as the Amazing Grass brand, nor are they the values for an equivalent serving size as the values listed by Amazing Grass.)
